publicationDetails.detailsText: Published in: Ziemba, Ewa Wanda and Kita, Rafał, "Concepts of AI-Enabled Digital Government in an AI-Society" (2026). AMCIS 2026 Proceedings. 1.  https://aisel.aisnet.org/amcis2026/egov/sig_egov/1ed in:

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is increasingly shaping how governments communicate, deliver services, and support administrative work, yet "AI in government" remains fragmented and inconsistently defined. This study develops a conceptual framework for AI-Enabled Digital Government (AIDG) in an AI-Society context and positions AIDG relative to e-government/digital government and "intelligent e-government." Using structured conceptual analysis, we develop a concept hierarchy, clarify definitional boundaries, propose a working definition of AIDG, and identify six core, interrelated sub-concepts: AI-Information, AI-Service, AI-Decision (algorithmic decision-making), AI-Oversight & Audit, AI-Participation, and AI Policy Support & Administrative Intelligence. We explain how these elements relate within an integrated model that links citizen-facing pathways, service and decision support, and cross-cutting oversight, illustrated with consolidated usage examples. The framework treats oversight and accountability safeguards as integral requirements for responsible AIDG, supports cumulative research on AI-enabled public governance, and provides a shared vocabulary for more consistent empirical operationalization across policy domains and administrative settings.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结构化概念分析，提出了AI赋能数字政府（AIDG）的概念框架，明确其与电子政府、智能电子政府的关系，并识别出六个核心子概念，强调监督与问责是负责任AIDG的组成部分。
AI.research_question: 如何系统界定AI赋能数字政府（AIDG）的概念，并构建其核心构成要素及相互关系？
AI.motivation: "AI in government"领域研究碎片化、定义不一致，缺乏统一的概念框架来指导实证研究和政策实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构化概念分析、概念层级体系、整合模型（连接公民面向路径、服务与决策支持、跨领域监督）。
AI.method: 结构化概念分析（structured conceptual analysis），通过构建概念层级、界定定义边界、提出工作定义并识别核心子概念。
AI.findings: 提出了AIDG的六个核心子概念：AI-信息、AI-服务、AI-决策（算法决策）、AI-监督与审计、AI-参与、AI政策支持与行政智能，并构建了整合模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI赋能公共治理提供了统一的概念框架和共享词汇，促进跨政策领域和行政情境的实证操作化一致性。
AI.practical_contributions: 将监督与问责保障作为负责任AIDG的内在要求，为政府AI应用提供了实践指导框架。

title: Fully Homomorphic Compression (FHC)
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Fully Homomorphic Compression (FHC)
detail.abstract: Compression algorithms and functions have been extensively utilized in various applications, e.g., in digital storage and communication. In recent years and with the popularity of machine learning applications, researchers have utilized compression techniques for addressing key problems in machine learning, e.g., for compressing artificial neural networks or for optimizing KV-cache memory in LLMs. Due to extensive applications of compression algorithms in different domains, a whole new era of innovations and applications for data compression algorithms can be envisioned. In this article, we discuss that compression functions with interesting properties, e.g., fully homomorphic compression (FHC) algorithms, can have applications beyond compressing data. FHC algorithms can potentially enable performing computation on compressed (and encrypted) data. Thus, fully homomorphic compression techniques can be used for reducing the computational and communication costs of compute and communication-intensive workloads, such as fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) & zero-knowledge proof (ZKP) applications, (secure) vector databases (VDBs and SVDBs), blockchain-based technologies, image and video processing, privacy-preserving or private LLMs, and LLM & AI inference, etc.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型数据压缩思路——全同态压缩（FHC），该算法不仅压缩数据，还能在压缩（及加密）数据上直接执行计算，从而降低计算和通信开销，适用于FHE、ZKP、安全向量数据库、区块链、隐私保护LLM等多个前沿领域。
AI.research_question: 压缩算法除了压缩数据之外，是否还能在压缩（及加密）数据上直接执行计算，从而拓展其应用边界？
AI.motivation: 压缩算法在数字存储、通信和机器学习中应用广泛，但现有压缩方法通常仅关注数据体积缩减，无法在压缩态下进行运算。随着FHE、ZKP、LLM等计算密集型和通信密集型应用的发展，亟需一种既能压缩数据又能支持直接计算的算法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全同态压缩（Fully Homomorphic Compression, FHC）理论框架，结合了数据压缩与同态加密的思想。
AI.method: 概念性讨论与框架提出，未涉及具体实验或实现细节。
AI.findings: FHC算法能够在压缩（及加密）数据上直接执行计算，从而降低FHE、ZKP、安全向量数据库、区块链、图像视频处理、隐私保护LLM及AI推理等场景的计算与通信成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了全同态压缩（FHC）这一新型理论概念，将压缩与同态计算能力相结合，拓展了压缩算法的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: FHC有望显著降低FHE、ZKP、安全向量数据库、区块链、隐私LLM等前沿应用的计算与通信开销，具有广泛的工程应用价值。

title: Data Architecture and Governance in the Agentic Era: Paradigm shifts from 2026 Databricks DAIS

detail.title: Data Architecture and Governance in the Agentic Era: Paradigm shifts from 2026 Databricks DAIS
detail.abstract: Enterprise data infrastructure has historically separated transactional application stores (OLTP) from analytical systems (OLAP), bridging the two with brittle Change Data Capture (CDC) and Extract-Transform-Load (ETL) pipelines. While functional for humanengineered workflows, this layout has been exposed as a bottleneck by the operational loop speeds of autonomous AI agents. This paper synthesizes the structural breakthroughs announced at the 2026 Databricks Data + AI Summit (June 15-18, 2026, San Francisco) and contextualizes them within the established literature on data architecture, governance, and AI security. We analyze five interconnected paradigm shifts: (1) the unification of transactional and analytical processing under a single Lake Transactional/Analytical Processing (LTAP) architecture built on Lakebase, Lakehouse, and the Reyden engine; (2) the evolution of Unity Catalog from a passive system of record into an active runtime decision-making engine through the Unity AI Gateway, with native Model Context Protocol (MCP) interception and an open cybersecurity ecosystem spanning ten security and four identity partners; (3) the construction of a governed semantic bridge through Unity Catalog Business Semantics and contributions to the Open Semantic Interchange (OSI) initiative; (4) ecosystem openness through the Omnigent meta-harness framework and the contribution of the OpenSharing protocol to the Linux Foundation; and (5) the transition from interactive analytics to autonomous operations through scheduled agent tasks and ZeroOps. The contribution is interpretive: the paper organizes a coherent vendor paradigm around four analytical pillars (Context, Cost, Control, Choice) and maps it against established normative frameworks (NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act, NIST SP 800-207 Zero Trust Architecture). The paper closes by identifying open challenges, including real-time synchronization limits at scale, compliance alignment across volatile international frameworks, the compute requirements of scaling execution guardrails, and the need for independent empirical evaluation of vendor capability claims.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了2026年Databricks Data+AI Summit上发布的数据架构突破，分析了五大范式转变：LTAP统一事务与分析处理、Unity Catalog演进为主动运行时引擎、治理化语义桥梁构建、Omnigent元框架及OpenSharing协议的生态开放、从交互分析向自主运营的转型，并将其映射到NIST AI RMF、ISO/IEC 42001、EU AI Act等规范框架中。
AI.research_question: 2026年Databricks Data+AI Summit上公布的结构性突破如何构成一个连贯的数据架构范式，并与现有治理和AI安全框架相匹配？
AI.motivation: 传统OLTP/OLAP分离架构配合CDC和ETL管道在自主AI代理时代成为瓶颈，需要新的统一架构范式来支持AI代理的操作循环速度。
AI.theoretical_framework: LTAP架构（Lake Transactional/Analytical Processing）、Unity Catalog与AI Gateway、NIST AI风险管理办法、ISO/IEC 42001、EU AI法案、NIST SP 800-207零信任架构。
AI.method: 文献综合与厂商范式阐释，将Databricks公告与现有数据架构、治理和AI安全研究进行情境化对比分析。
AI.findings: 五大范式转变：(1) LTAP统一事务与分析处理；(2) Unity Catalog进化为主动运行时决策引擎；(3) 治理化语义桥梁；(4) Omnigent元框架与OpenSharing协议的生态开放；(5) 从交互分析转向自主运营（ZeroOps）。围绕Context、Cost、Control、Choice四个分析支柱组织成连贯的厂商范式。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Databricks的五大技术突破组织为连贯的厂商范式，并系统映射到NIST AI RMF、ISO/IEC 42001、EU AI Act、零信任架构等规范框架中，为数据架构与AI治理的交叉领域提供整合性理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供了自主AI代理时代数据基础设施的架构蓝图，明确了实时同步极限、国际合规对齐、计算资源需求等开放挑战，并为厂商能力声明的独立实证评估指明了方向。

title: Amplifying Difference: Perceptual Design and Verification of Human-Centric Entropy Visualizations *
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Amplifying Difference: Perceptual Design and Verification of Human-Centric Entropy Visualizations *
detail.abstract: Security increasingly asks ordinary people to verify high-entropy values by eye-SSH host-key fingerprints, messaging safety numbers, blockchain payment addresses-a task that pits a known human weakness, serial symbol matching, against a known strength, holistic pattern recognition. This paper analyzes entviz, an algorithm that renders a high-entropy value as a layered set of perceptual channels so that an untrained adult with reasonably good vision can decide whether two values are the same or different. The thesis is that entviz advances human-centric hash visualization by applying psychophysics and cognitive psychology systematically to the goal of amplifying difference. We defend the design with an explicit, channel-by-channel perceptual-entropy budget; we draw the distinction between machinecentric perceptual hashing, which prizes robustness to similarity, and human-centric authentication visualization, which must prize sensitivity to difference, and show that conflating them is a security bug. The same perceptual reasoning yields not only a better picture but a better procedure: a commit-and-reveal, seeded comparison walk that defends the habituated user whom real attacks exploit. We are candid throughout that the perceptual budget is an analytic estimate and the procedure's human ergonomics are as yet untested; a companion paper takes up the security-relevant habituated estimate from the adversary's side.

AI.tldr: 本文提出entviz算法，利用分层感知通道将高熵值可视化，使普通人能通过模式识别判断哈希值是否相同，并区分了机器感知哈希与人类认证可视化在安全上的根本差异。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地利用心理物理学和认知心理学原理设计高熵值的可视化方案，使普通成年人能可靠地判断两个值是否相同？
AI.motivation: 安全系统要求普通人通过肉眼验证高熵值（如SSH密钥指纹、安全号码、区块链地址），但人类的序列符号匹配能力弱而整体模式识别能力强，现有可视化方案缺乏系统的感知理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 感知通道（perceptual channels）理论、心理物理学（psychophysics）、感知熵预算（perceptual-entropy budget）、机器感知哈希与人类认证可视化的区分。
AI.method: 提出entviz算法，按通道分配感知熵预算进行分层可视化；设计提交-揭示（commit-and-reveal）的种子化比较流程；以分析性估算论证设计的合理性。
AI.findings: entviz通过系统性运用感知心理学原理放大差异；混淆机器感知哈希（追求相似鲁棒性）与人类认证可视化（追求差异敏感性）是安全漏洞；提交-揭示流程可防御针对习惯化用户的真实攻击。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确区分了机器感知哈希与人类认证可视化在安全目标上的根本差异；提出并应用了感知熵预算这一分析框架；将心理物理学的系统方法引入哈希可视化设计。
AI.practical_contributions: entviz算法为SSH密钥指纹、安全号码、区块链地址等高熵值验证场景提供了更符合人类感知特性的可视化方案；提交-揭示比较流程增强了针对习惯化用户的攻击防御能力。

title: Measuring the Glance: An Adversarial Estimate of Habituated Perceptual Entropy in Entviz and SSH Randomart
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Measuring the Glance: An Adversarial Estimate of Habituated Perceptual Entropy in Entviz and SSH Randomart
detail.abstract: An entropy visualization is only as strong as the part of it a person actually checks. The entviz design paper separates a careful reader, who reads the figure's lossless text and so verifies the whole value, from a habituated one, who recognizes a few landmarks and trusts the rest-and names the bits a habituated glance carries (estimated at twenty to forty) as its central open problem. We estimate that quantity from the adversary's side: a render-model reimplementation, certified field-for-field against the reference by a differential oracle, drives a grinder that counts the hashing work to forge each casually-checkable channel. The central result is not a number but a curve. The habituated glance is parallel-a bundle of global channels taken in at once, the low-to-mid teens of bits-and it rises with deliberate attention toward the lossless text ceiling, the whole value. We measure the same way for SSH randomart, the drunken bishop, yielding the first habituated figure for any randomart: the two are comparable at the bare glance, but entviz is decisively more robust at the careful ceiling and, by design, along the habituation path a deployment would cultivate. Every perceptual tolerance and salience weight here is modeled, not measured on people, and was hardened by two rounds of independent adversarial expert review before the numbers were locked; the human study the design paper calls for remains what would turn these models into measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文从攻击者视角量化了熵可视化（entviz）的"习惯性一瞥"可验证信息量，发现其约为低至十余比特，并随刻意关注向无损文本天花板上升；与SSH随机图对比，两者在粗略一瞥时相当，但熵可视化在谨慎观察上限和习惯化路径上显著更强。所有感知参数均通过模型而非人类实验确定，并经过两轮独立对抗性专家审查。
AI.research_question: 熵可视化中，用户"习惯性一瞥"所能验证的信息量（比特数）是多少？与SSH随机图相比如何？
AI.motivation: 熵可视化设计论文将"细心读者"（验证全部信息）与"习惯性读者"（仅检查少量地标）区分开来，并将习惯性一瞥可携带的比特数（估计20-40比特）列为核心开放问题。本文从攻击者视角实际测量这一数值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 习惯性一瞥的并行处理模型（全局通道一次性摄入）；基于差分谕言的渲染模型重实现；哈希工作量的通道伪造计量。
AI.method: 实现一个经过差分谕言（differential oracle）认证的渲染模型重实现，驱动一个"研磨机"（grinder）计算伪造每个可随意检查通道所需的哈希工作量，从而反向估算习惯性一瞥可验证的信息量。
AI.findings: 1）习惯性一瞥是并行的，约为低至十余比特；2）随刻意注意向无损文本天花板（全部信息量）上升；3）SSH随机图（醉主教算法）在粗略一瞥时与熵可视化相当；4）熵可视化在谨慎观察上限和习惯化路径上显著更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从攻击者视角量化了熵可视化的习惯性一瞥信息容量；提出了"不是单一数字而是一条曲线"的核心结论，即信息量随注意水平连续变化；给出了首个随机图（SSH randomart）的习惯性一瞥测量值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为熵可视化设计提供了安全性的实证基准；证实了熵可视化在设计上比SSH随机图更适合需要高安全性验证的场景；为未来的人类实验提供了测量假设和模型基础。

title: Do AI Need a Peer? Emotional Support, Critical Feedback, and Self-evaluation in Multi-agent Systems

detail.title: Do AI Need a Peer? Emotional Support, Critical Feedback, and Self-evaluation in Multi-agent Systems
detail.abstract: When humans collaborate, emotional support matters as much as informational feedback-yet the multi-agent AI literature focuses exclusively on critique-based interactions. We ask: does emotional support from a peer AI affect an AI's self-evaluation and task performance? We design a controlled experiment with four conditions-an AI working alone, with a critical reviewer, with an emotionally supportive peer, and with both-across MMLU factual reasoning and creative writing tasks using GPT-4o (N = 3,200 trials). We measure objective accuracy, self-reported confidence and satisfaction, and independent third-party evaluations. We find that emotional support does not harm objective quality on either task, but it consistently inflates the AI's self-assessment: the calibration gap between self-evaluation and external judgment nearly doubles under encouragement. Critical feedback has task-dependent effects: on creative writing, it improves calibration by tempering self-regard; on MMLU, it decreases accuracy while increasing confidence, producing the worst calibration of any condition. When both feedback types are present, the critical component dominates. These findings parallel Optimal Matching Theory from social psychology and reveal what we term the social context sensitivity of AI metacognition: the emotional tone of inter-agent communication is not a neutral backdrop but actively shapes how AI systems perceive and report the quality of their own work. For organizations deploying multi-agent architectures, this implies that conversational tone is a design variable with measurable consequences for system reliability.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实验发现，AI同伴的情感支持虽不损害客观任务质量，但会显著膨胀AI的自我评估，导致校准偏差增大；批评反馈的效果则因任务类型而异。这表明AI元认知存在"社会情境敏感性"，多智能体系统中的对话语气是影响系统可靠性的重要设计变量。
AI.research_question: 同伴AI的情感支持是否会影响AI的自我评估和任务表现？
AI.motivation: 人类协作中情感支持与信息反馈同样重要，但多智能体AI文献仅关注基于批评的交互，忽略了情感支持的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会心理学中的最优匹配理论（Optimal Matching Theory）；AI元认知的社会情境敏感性（social context sensitivity of AI metacognition）
AI.method: 控制实验，设置四种条件（AI单独工作、有批评者、有情感支持同伴、两者皆有），在MMLU事实推理和创意写作任务上使用GPT-4o进行3,200次试验，测量客观准确性、自评置信度与满意度、第三方独立评估。
AI.findings: 情感支持不损害客观质量，但会膨胀AI的自我评估（校准差距几乎翻倍）；批评反馈在创意写作中改善校准，在MMLU中降低准确性并增加信心（最差校准）；两种反馈同时存在时，批评成分占主导。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI元认知的"社会情境敏感性"——智能体间沟通的情感基调不是中性背景，而是主动塑造AI系统感知和报告自身工作质量的方式。
AI.practical_contributions: 对组织部署多智能体架构而言，对话语气是一个具有可测量后果的设计变量，直接影响系统可靠性。

title: Ban and Regulation: Governing Generative AI in the Knowledge Commons
affiliations: and

detail.title: Ban and Regulation: Governing Generative AI in the Knowledge Commons
detail.abstract: This study investigates how AI governance shapes contributor behavior, participation concentration, and aggregate coordination in knowledge commons. Using two quasi-natural experiments based on Stack Overflow's platform-wide AI governance transitions, we examine the impacts of sequential governance regimes: from a community-curation baseline to AI-Ban and then to AI-Regulation. Analyses of Stack Overflow data from 2021 to 2024 reveal that AI-Ban reduces incumbents' contribution-intensity advantage relative to novices, whereas AI-Regulation increases incumbents' contribution-novelty advantage. Yet these behavioral shifts are accompanied by distinct platform-level consequences. AI-Ban reduces overall contributor concentration, suggesting broader participation, but also contracts aggregate answer volume, active answerer participation, and question volume. Conversely, AI-Regulation sustains lower contributor concentration while improving accepted-answer probability, even though it does not significantly restore aggregate activity. By bridging AI governance and knowledgecommons research, this study shows that governing generative AI is not merely a question of allowing or banning AI-generated content. Instead, AI governance redistributes human effort, reshapes participation structure, and alters the coordination capacity of digital knowledge communities.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Stack Overflow平台的自然实验，研究了AI治理（从AI禁令到AI监管）如何影响知识共享社区中的贡献者行为、参与集中度和整体协调能力。发现AI禁令降低老手优势但减少整体产出，AI监管提升老手创新优势并改善答案质量。
AI.research_question: AI治理如何影响知识共享社区中的贡献者行为、参与集中度以及整体协调能力？
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI在知识共享社区中的广泛应用，平台面临如何治理AI内容的挑战。现有研究缺乏对AI治理政策如何系统性地重塑社区参与结构和协调机制的实证理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI治理理论、知识共享理论、参与结构理论、协调机制理论
AI.method: 基于Stack Overflow平台两次AI治理转型（从社区筛选基线→AI禁令→AI监管）的准自然实验，分析2021-2024年平台数据。
AI.findings: 1) AI禁令降低了老手相对于新手的贡献强度优势，但减少了答案量、活跃回答者和问题量；2) AI监管增加了老手的贡献新颖性优势，提高了答案被采纳概率，但未显著恢复总体活动水平；3) 两种治理模式均降低了贡献者集中度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI治理与知识共享社区研究连接起来，揭示AI治理不仅是允许或禁止AI内容的问题，而是重新分配人力劳动、重塑参与结构和改变数字知识社区协调能力的系统性力量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为知识共享平台设计AI治理策略提供实证依据，帮助平台在促进参与公平与维持产出质量之间做出权衡。

title: Do LLM Agents Form Echo Chambers? A Replication of Shore et al. (2018) on an AI Social Platform

detail.title: Do LLM Agents Form Echo Chambers? A Replication of Shore et al. (2018) on an AI Social Platform
detail.abstract: Shore et al. (2018) locate Twitter echo chambers in a small, highly visible core: the core polarizes even as the typical user mainstreams. Does the same structure emerge when the participants are autonomous LLM agents? We replicate their framework on Moltbook, a Reddit-style agent platform, using an LLM-scored autonomy axis and a comment-based revealed-attention network. At the population level, agents mainstream, just as Twitter users do. At the core, however, the patterns diverge. Under Shore's visibility-based definition, the agent core does not polarize. Polarization appears only when coreness is defined by engagement breadth-how widely an agent comments. Cores defined by incoming comments, karma, or PageRank all mainstream. We also validate the result using another stance axis and find consistent results.

AI.tldr: 本文在LLM智能体平台上复现了Shore等人关于Twitter回音室的研究，发现智能体群体整体走向主流化，但核心极化现象仅在基于参与广度（评论多样性）定义核心时出现，而非基于可见性定义。
AI.research_question: 当参与者是自主LLM智能体时，Twitter回音室中"核心极化、边缘主流化"的结构是否同样出现？
AI.motivation: 检验Shore等人（2018）发现的社交媒体回音室结构（核心极化vs用户主流化）在LLM智能体环境中是否成立，探索人类与AI社交行为的异同。
AI.theoretical_framework: 回音室理论、核心-边缘结构理论、极化与主流化理论、基于可见性vs参与广度的核心定义比较。
AI.method: 在Moltbook（Reddit风格智能体平台）上复现Shore等人的框架，使用LLM评分的自主性轴线和基于评论的注意网络，比较不同核心定义（可见性、参与广度）下的极化模式。
AI.findings: （1）群体层面：智能体与Twitter用户一样走向主流化；（2）核心层面：基于可见性定义时核心不极化，极化仅在基于参与广度（评论多样性）定义核心时出现；（3）基于其他核心度量（如入评论、karma、PageRank）的核心均主流化；不同立场轴线验证结果一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了LLM智能体社交行为与人类社交行为的核心差异：可见性驱动的极化可能依赖人类特有的社会心理机制，而参与广度驱动的极化在智能体中仍然存在，为回音室理论在AI社会中的适用性提供了边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI社交平台设计提供参考：若需避免智能体极化，应关注其参与广度而非可见性；提示人类与AI混合社交环境中极化机制的潜在差异。

title: Beyond the Pilot
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Beyond the Pilot

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I, the author is a founder of Lexa (lexa.lawyer), the legal-technology venture that serves as the case study in this paper, and therefore has a personal and financial interest in the entity analyzed. This relationship is disclosed in the paper's author note. The study adopts an explicit practitioner-researcher position: Lexa is examined critically, including its pivots, dependencies, and unresolved risks, and the paper's central claims are framed to be falsifiable independently of the venture's commercial outcome. The author declares no other personal or financial relationships that could be perceived to have influenced the work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, or personal data requiring ethics-committee review. It is a single-firm case study drawing on the author's direct involvement in the venture and on publicly available secondary data (industry pricing, and published demographic and economic statistics). No individual-level or personal data were collected and no procedures requiring institutional review board approval or participant consent were undertaken; ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or financial support from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The venture discussed as the case study (Lexa) is privately funded; its development was not undertaken for the purpose of this study, and no external party funded the analysis or writing of this paper.

detail.abstract: Most scholarship on the digitalization of law in low-and middle-income countries (LMICs) studies state-and donor-led court reform, where projects routinely die of pilotitis: they succeed under best-case conditions and then collapse when grant funding ends. This paper argues that the binding constraint on legal-technology in these markets is rarely the technology itself. Drawing on Richard Heeks's design-reality gap model and on a practitioner case study of Lexa (lexa.lawyer), a privately funded legal-AI venture built around the first machine-readable corpus of roughly seventy-five years of post-independence Pakistani jurisprudence, the paper develops two claims. First, in low-resource legal markets the corpus, not the model, is the moat: a foreign general-purpose model carries almost no clean local case law, so its competence must be manufactured through proprietary data acquired by importing scanners, employing a thirty-five-person digitization pipeline (a textbook instance of "ghost work" and jugaad frugal innovation), and exposing it to the model through retrievalaugmented generation. Second, the venture's economics are governed by a margin scissor: revenue is anchored to local willingness-to-pay and collected in rupees, while the costs that scale with usage (foreign model APIs, managed vector retrieval, and globally arbitraged senior engineering labour) are incurred in hard currency. The same LMIC context that denies a startup a pre-built corpus simultaneously supplies cheap skilled labour to build one; but that discount is thinnest for the most critical hires and never closes the dollar-versus-rupee gap on the marginal cost of serving a user. The paper reframes legal-technology failure in LMICs as a problem of unit economics and institutional design rather than capability, and closes with the public-policy tension created when a single private firm comes to own the only usable digital record of a nation's law. The analysis is written from an explicitly disclosed practitioner-researcher position.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Heeks的设计-现实差距模型和巴基斯坦Lexa法律AI项目的案例，论证低收入国家法律科技失败的核心约束不是技术能力，而是单位经济性和制度设计——语料库壁垒和"利润率剪刀差"使得私人企业拥有国家唯一可用数字法律记录，引发公共政策难题。
AI.research_question: 低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）法律科技项目为什么常常失败？其根本约束条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多聚焦于政府与捐助者主导的法院改革，将其失败归因于"试点病"（pilotitis），但忽略了法律科技在市场中的经济与制度约束。本文试图从私人创业企业角度揭示法律科技在LMICs失败的深层原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: Richard Heeks的设计-现实差距模型（design-reality gap model）；"语料库即护城河"（corpus is the moat）；"利润率剪刀差"（margin scissor）概念；"幽灵工作"（ghost work）与"节俭创新"（jugaad innovation）理论。
AI.method: 理论分析结合实践者案例研究。案例为巴基斯坦Lexa法律AI项目，该项目基于约75年独立后巴基斯坦判例法的第一个机器可读语料库构建。
AI.findings: (1) 在低收入法律市场，语料库而非模型才是竞争壁垒：通用模型缺乏本地判例法，必须通过进口扫描仪、雇佣35人数字化团队（幽灵工作+节俭创新）构建专有语料库，并通过RAG暴露给模型。(2)"利润率剪刀差"：收入锚定于本地支付意愿并以本币（卢比）收取，而随使用量增长的成本（海外模型API、向量检索、高级工程劳动力）需以硬通货支付。本地廉价劳动力虽能降低语料构建成本，但最关键的稀缺人才折扣最小，且永远无法弥合美元与卢比之间的单位服务边际成本差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 将LMICs法律科技失败的原因从技术能力问题重新框定为单位经济性和制度设计问题；提出"语料库即护城河"和"利润率剪刀差"两个理论概念，丰富了法律科技与低收入国家创新研究的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了私人企业独占国家唯一可用数字法律记录所引发的公共政策紧张（公地悲剧与数据主权问题）；为LMICs的法律科技政策制定者、投资者和创业者提供了关于商业模式设计和公共干预方向的实践启示。

title: Cryptographic Agility in EU Cybersecurity Law: From Concept to Requirement
affiliations: University of Copenhagen - Centre for Advanced Studies in Bioscience Innovation Law (CeBIL)

detail.title: Cryptographic Agility in EU Cybersecurity Law: From Concept to Requirement

declarations.funderStatement: Research was supported by a Novo Nordisk Foundation Grant for a scientifically independent International Collaborative Bioscience Innovation & Law Programme (Inter-CeBIL programme—grant no. NNF23SA0087056).

detail.abstract: Cryptographic algorithms do not remain secure indefinitely. Replacing one is rarely simple, since algorithms are embedded deep within the systems that rely on them, and systems that cannot update their cryptography become legacy liabilities. Cryptographic agility, the capacity to replace and adapt cryptographic algorithms whilst preserving security and ongoing operations, offers a response to this problem. Its most urgent driver is the quantum threat to public-key cryptography and the post-quantum migration now underway, though its significance is independent and enduring, extending to future cryptographic transitions. This article examines the concept of cryptographic agility within EU cybersecurity law. It argues that the regulatory framework is on a trajectory towards recognising agility as a general, operationalised requirement, and that this trajectory can be identified, assessed, and accelerated. No EU instrument expressly requires agility in its primary text, and the references that have appeared are patchwork and undefined. Across four principal instruments, the GDPR, NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act, and DORA, the article maps the pathways for embedding the concept, distinguishing those where Commission delegated and implementing regulations have already used agility language from those where the route runs through the 'state of the art', harmonised standards, or supervisory practice. It then contends that the EU can and should move to give the requirement determinate content on its own terms rather than awaiting its organic percolation into the 'state of the art'. As the means to do so largely exist within the current framework, doing so requires institutional action (including guidance, standardisation, and certification) rather than reform of the primary acquis.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了密码敏捷性（cryptographic agility）在欧盟网络安全法律框架中的地位与发展轨迹，认为监管框架正朝着将敏捷性视为一项普遍、可操作要求的方向演进，并主张欧盟应主动通过机构行动（如指南、标准化和认证）而非改革基本法律来赋予这一要求以确定内容。
AI.research_question: 欧盟网络安全法律框架如何识别、评估并加速将密码敏捷性作为一项普遍且可操作的要求？
AI.motivation: 密码算法不会永远安全，替换算法困难重重，量子威胁对公钥密码学的冲击以及后量子迁移的迫切性，使得密码敏捷性成为亟需关注的议题，但现有欧盟法律文本尚未明确将其作为一项要求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 密码敏捷性概念；欧盟网络安全法律框架（GDPR、NIS2、Cyber Resilience Act、DORA）；"state of the art"（最新技术水平）标准；委托立法与实施立法路径。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析，对四项主要欧盟法律文书（GDPR、NIS2、Cyber Resilience Act、DORA）进行条文梳理与路径映射，区分已使用敏捷性语言的委托/实施条例与通过"最新技术水平"、协调标准或监管实践引入的路径。
AI.findings: 1. 没有任何欧盟法律文书在其主要文本中明确要求密码敏捷性，已有提及零散且未定义。2. 四项法律文书存在嵌入敏捷性概念的不同路径，部分已通过委托/实施条例使用了敏捷性语言。3. 欧盟可以且应当主动赋予该要求以确定内容，而非等待其自然渗透入"最新技术水平"。4. 实现手段主要在现有框架内，需机构行动（指南、标准化、认证）而非改革核心基本法。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地将密码敏捷性概念引入欧盟网络安全法律分析，揭示了监管框架中隐式与显式的敏捷性路径，提出了"轨迹识别—评估—加速"的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟立法机构、监管机构及标准制定组织提供了将密码敏捷性从模糊概念转化为可操作法律要求的具体路径建议，指导后量子迁移背景下的立法与实践行动。

title: The Sovereignty Stack - Engineering Integrity from Classical to Quantum AI

detail.title: The Sovereignty Stack - Engineering Integrity from Classical to Quantum AI
detail.abstract: The rapid deployment of artificial intelligence systems has introduced unprecedented sociotechnical risks, driven largely by the prioritization of short-term delivery velocity over long-term architectural stability. This paper is a theory-building and framework-development study that synthesizes evidence from software engineering, interpretable machine learning, and AI governance scholarship to advance two interconnected arguments. First, the prevailing velocityfirst development paradigm creates a compounding cycle of technical debt, algorithmic opacity, and proxy discrimination that reactive crisis management cannot address-a condition termed here the Velocity Trap. Second, and critically for the governance community, the classical AI governance frameworks currently being constructed are already obsolete: they are designed for a horse that has left the barn. Quantum AI is not a future contingency; it is an accelerating present, and its structural properties-superposition, entanglement, and measurement-induced collapse-render post-hoc explainability not merely unreliable but physically impossible as a governance instrument. To address both failures, this paper advances the Luevano Standard: a proposed adaptive, riskstratified governance framework grounded in the civil rights legacy of Luevano v. Campbell (1981) and the disparate impact doctrine of Griggs v. Duke Power Co. (1971). Because the Luevano Standard mandates inherent interpretability over post-hoc explanation, proactive architectural governance over reactive remediation, and regulated self-regulation over rigid mandate, it is structurally positioned to survive the classical-to-quantum transition. This paper introduces the Sovereign Stack as the technical instantiation of that standard-a layered architecture in which governance obligations are engineered into the foundation, not appended after deployment. The Luevano Standard is the saddle for the quantum horse. The question is whether the governance community will put it on before the horse accelerates beyond reach.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了AI开发中的"速度优先"范式，指出其导致技术债务、算法黑箱和代理歧视的恶性循环（"速度陷阱"），并主张当前经典AI治理框架已因量子AI的兴起而过时。作者提出Luevano标准——一个基于民权法判例的适应性风险分层治理框架，要求内在可解释性、主动架构治理和受监管的自我规制，并以"主权堆栈"作为其技术实现方案。
AI.research_question: 在AI系统快速部署与量子AI技术加速发展的背景下，现有AI治理框架为何失效？如何构建一个能够跨越经典计算到量子计算转型期的可持续治理框架？
AI.motivation: AI部署速度优先（velocity-first）的开发范式导致技术债务、算法不透明性和代理歧视问题累积形成"速度陷阱"，而经典AI治理框架基于的传统假设（如事后可解释性）在量子AI的结构特性（叠加、纠缠、测量塌缩）下将变得物理上不可能。亟需一种前瞻性、架构级的治理方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 速度陷阱理论（Velocity Trap）：速度优先范式导致技术债务、算法不透明和歧视的复合循环；Luevano标准：基于Luevano v. Campbell (1981)和Griggs v. Duke Power Co. (1971)的民权法差异化影响原则，构建适应性风险分层治理框架；主权堆栈（Sovereign Stack）：将治理义务工程化嵌入系统架构的分层架构理论。
AI.method: 理论建构与框架开发研究，综合来自软件工程、可解释机器学习、AI治理学术三个领域的证据进行理论综合与框架设计。
AI.findings: （1）速度优先开发范式导致"速度陷阱"——技术债务、算法黑箱与歧视的恶性循环；（2）经典AI治理框架在量子AI面前已过时，因为量子系统的叠加、纠缠和测量塌缩使事后可解释性（post-hoc explainability）在物理上不可能；（3）Luevano标准通过强制内在可解释性、主动架构治理和受监管的自我规制，可跨越经典到量子的技术转型期。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"速度陷阱"概念，首次系统阐述了速度优先开发范式与治理失效之间的因果机制；揭示了量子AI对经典AI治理框架的根本性挑战，指出事后可解释性在量子语境下的物理不可能性；构建了Luevano标准这一跨技术代际的治理理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了"主权堆栈"作为Luevano标准的技术实现方案，为AI系统设计提供了架构级治理嵌入的实践路径；为政策制定者和监管机构提供了基于民权法判例的、可操作的适应性风险分层治理框架；对AI开发者和企业提出了从"事后补救"转向"事前架构治理"的实践变革指南。

title: From Classical Coordination to Keynesian Uncertainty: Informational Distance and Institutional Possibilities Beyond Money and Interest

detail.title: From Classical Coordination to Keynesian Uncertainty: Informational Distance and Institutional Possibilities Beyond Money and Interest

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is a theoretical/conceptual study and does not involve human subjects, patients, or participant data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper reinterprets the classical-Keynesian divide as a difference in informational regimes rather than as a simple opposition between competing universal theories. Classical coordination is understood as most applicable when coordination burdens remain manageable relative to society's capacity to process, verify, and coordinate relevant information. Keynesian uncertainty becomes dominant when informational distance is high: when coordination burdens exceed coordination capacities and economic agents rely more heavily on scalar mechanisms such as money, interest rates, prices, and aggregate indicators. The paper develops a simple framework in which informational distance is represented by the ratio of coordination burden to coordination capacity. Within this framework, money and interest are interpreted not as permanent primitives, but as historically contingent coordination mechanisms that bundle both fundamental and distance-induced functions. As informational distance declines, some functions historically delegated to money and interest may become less necessary as generalized scalar mechanisms and increasingly subject to institutional design. The argument does not predict the disappearance of money or interest, nor does it prescribe a particular institutional destination. Rather, it identifies conditions under which arrangements commonly treated as necessities may become matters of institutional choice.

AI.tldr: 本文重新解读古典-凯恩斯主义分歧，将其视为信息体制的差异而非普遍理论的对抗。通过"信息距离"框架（协调负担与协调能力之比），论证货币和利率是历史偶然的协调机制，其功能随信息距离缩小而可能从必然变为制度选择问题。
AI.research_question: 古典经济学与凯恩斯主义经济学之间的根本分歧究竟是什么？货币和利率在协调机制中扮演何种角色？这些角色是永久性还是历史偶然性的？
AI.motivation: 古典与凯恩斯经济学长期被视为相互竞争的普遍理论，这种对立视角限制了我们对经济协调机制本质的理解。作者试图超越这种二元对立，从信息体制的角度重新审视这一分歧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息体制理论、协调负担与协调能力框架、信息距离概念（协调负担/协调能力之比）、货币与利率的功能捆绑理论
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建：通过定义信息距离、区分协调负担与协调能力、分析货币和利率作为标量机制的功能捆绑，建立理论模型。
AI.findings: 1）古典协调在信息距离较小时适用，凯恩斯不确定性在信息距离较大时主导；2）货币和利率是历史偶然的协调机制，同时承载基础功能和距离诱导功能；3）信息距离下降时，部分功能可能从标量机制转向制度设计；4）货币和利率不会消失，但其必要性程度取决于信息距离条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出信息距离概念作为统一古典与凯恩斯理论的分析工具；2）重新定义货币和利率为偶然性协调机制而非经济系统永久基元；3）为理解经济协调机制的历史演化提供新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为货币政策与制度设计提供条件依赖性指南：何时货币和利率是必要的，何时可被替代；2）为理解现代信息经济中经济协调机制的可能演化方向提供分析框架；3）为制度选择提供理论依据，识别哪些看似必然的安排实际上可能变为可选。

title: Digital Access to German Civil Courts
affiliations: University of Bremen - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Digital Access to German Civil Courts
detail.abstract: The digitalisation of civil court access in Germany has been a decadeslong process marked by legislative ambition, structural inertia, and persistent implementation failures. This contribution traces the evolution of electronic legal communication, electronic case files, and video hearings from their statutory origins to the present day, with particular attention to the asymmetric outcome that has emerged: a professional-user infrastructure that is largely functional and a citizen-facing infrastructure that, despite the 2023 launch of MeinJustizPostfach, remains fragmentary-not least because of the structural asymmetry of consent to electronic service under § 173 ZPO. Against that backdrop, the contribution turns to the Act of 22 December 2025 on the Development and Piloting of an Online Procedure in Civil Jurisdiction-the most significant procedural reform in German civil litigation in many years. The Act introduces a new Book 12 to the Code of Civil Procedure. It establishes a digitally integrated, optional procedure before district courts for monetary claims up to €10,000, supported by guided digital input systems, a federal communication platform, structured data exchange, flexible digital evidence taking, and a reduced fee schedule. Situated within what Hess has described as the fourth wave of the access-to-justice movement, the procedure functions as the domestic counterpart to the European Small Claims Procedure. While the reform addresses several of the structural deficits that have impeded digitalisation in the past, it does not resolve them. Three problems persist: a pilot trap, in that the Act creates possibilities rather than rights and leaves rollout to state discretion; a federalism problem, in that the constitutional tension between federal rule-making and state-level implementation responsibility remains intact and federal funding remains a political agreement rather than a constitutional entitlement; and a user problem, in that the demand side of access to justice-whether ordinary citizens will find, understand, and use the new procedure-is left largely to chance. The very title of the Act, referring to 'Development and Piloting', signals that the legislature did not expect this to be the last word. The history of judicial digitalisation in Germany is, after all, a history of legislation that was not implemented, not funded, or not used. Whether the Online Procedure escapes that pattern is a question that only the next decade can answer.

AI.tldr: 本文追溯了德国民事司法数字化（电子法律通信、电子案卷、视频听证）的发展历程，重点分析了2025年12月22日《民事管辖权在线程序开发与试点法案》——这项引入《民事诉讼法》第12卷的重大改革。该法案为1万欧元以下金钱索赔设立了数字化整合的简易程序，但面临试点陷阱、联邦制问题和用户问题三大结构性障碍，其最终成效尚待时间检验。
AI.research_question: 德国民事司法数字化经历了怎样的演变？2025年《民事管辖权在线程序开发与试点法案》能否克服历史性结构化障碍，实现真正的数字司法转型？
AI.motivation: 德国民事司法数字化长期面临立法雄心与实施失败的矛盾，形成"专业用户基础设施相对完善、普通公民基础设施支离破碎"的非对称格局。2025年重大改革法案的出台提供了重新审视这一困境的契机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 第四波接近正义运动（Hess提出）；欧洲小额索赔程序作为对标参照；联邦制下规则制定与执行分离的宪政张力理论。
AI.method: 法律史学方法（追踪电子法律通信、电子案卷、视频听证的立法起源至今的演变）；立法文本分析（2025年法案条款）；结构性缺陷识别与批判性分析。
AI.findings: （1）德国司法数字化呈现不对称结果：专业用户基础设施（律师-法院系统）基本可用，但公民端基础设施碎片化，§173 ZPO的电子送达同意机制造成结构性不对称；（2）2025年法案引入第12卷，建立可选性、数字化整合的简易程序，但存在三大问题：试点陷阱（创设可能性而非权利，实施由各州裁量）、联邦制问题（联邦规则制定与州执行之间的宪政张力未解）、用户问题（普通公民能否找到、理解和使用该程序无人问津）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将德国司法数字化置于"第四波接近正义运动"的理论框架中分析，揭示了技术性改革背后的宪法与制度结构性张力，丰富了接近正义理论的实证研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 系统梳理了德国司法数字化的立法失败史，明确指出2025年法案的三个核心缺陷，为政策制定者提供了改进方向：需将各州的"可能性"转化为公民的"权利"，解决联邦资金保障的宪政基础，并主动设计用户端需求策略。

title: Two Decades of Cybersecurity and IS Governance in Europe and Around the World: A Bibliometric Analysis with Implications for Strategic IT Management
affiliations: , University of Freiburg and Kiel University of Applied Sciences

detail.title: Two Decades of Cybersecurity and IS Governance in Europe and Around the World: A Bibliometric Analysis with Implications for Strategic IT Management
detail.abstract: Cybersecurity has become a strategic imperative for organizations and policymakers, yet the evolving research landscape that informs strategic IT and IS governance decisions remains poorly mapped. Through bibliometric analysis of 43,662 publications (2003-2022), we examine how cybersecurity research has evolved globally and in Europe across thematic priorities, geographic distribution, and citation impact. The field shifted from network security toward machine learning and cloud security, with governance and privacy gaining prominence after the Snowden revelations (2013) and GDPR (2018). European-focused research represents 27.5% of global output, yet grew nine-fold over the study period versus a five-fold global increase. Despite smaller scale, European-focused research achieves comparable citation impact at top performance levels, suggesting quality parity with global benchmarks. Our findings identify emerging thematic priorities, validate European-focused research as a competitive knowledge source, highlight geographic concentration patterns while informing strategic IT management and IS governance decisions at organizational and policy levels.

AI.tldr: 通过对43,662篇文献（2003-2022年）的文献计量分析，发现网络安全研究从网络安全向机器学习和云安全转变；欧洲相关研究虽仅占全球27.5%，但增长九倍（全球五倍），且在顶级绩效上具有相当的引用影响力。
AI.research_question: 网络安全研究如何在全球和欧洲层面随时间演变（主题重点、地理分布、引用影响力）？欧洲相关研究的地位如何？
AI.motivation: 网络安全已成为组织和政策制定者的战略要务，但指导IT和IS治理决策的研究格局尚未得到清晰描绘。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文献计量学、科学计量学
AI.method: 文献计量分析（Bibliometric analysis），分析43,662篇出版物（2003-2022年）。
AI.findings: (1) 研究重点从网络安全转向机器学习和云安全，斯诺登事件（2013年）和GDPR（2018年）后治理与隐私研究兴起；(2) 欧洲相关研究占全球27.5%，但增长九倍（全球五倍）；(3) 欧洲研究在顶级绩效水平上与全球基准具有相当的引用影响力。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统描绘了网络安全研究20年来的演变图景，揭示了全球与欧洲研究的增长与影响力差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织和政策层面（IT管理、IS治理决策）提供战略参考，验证欧洲相关研究作为竞争性知识来源的价值。

title: Toward a Platform State: NIK-Centric Identity Architecture as a Structural Solution to Fragmentation, Fiscal Leakage, and Service Inefficiency in Indonesia's Digital Governance Transition

detail.title: Toward a Platform State: NIK-Centric Identity Architecture as a Structural Solution to Fragmentation, Fiscal Leakage, and Service Inefficiency in Indonesia's Digital Governance Transition

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a conceptual policy analysis based entirely on publicly available secondary literature and does not involve human participants, clinical trials, or private medical data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

keywords.keywords: digital identity infrastructure; governance interoperability; public service architecture; NIK; e-KTP; institutional fragmentation; digital state transformation; INA Digital; SPBE; Indonesia

detail.abstract:
Indonesia's public service architecture remains structurally fragmented, organized around competing sectoral identity systems that operate in administrative isolation. Citizens navigating state services must present separate credentials for healthcare enrollment, social assistance eligibility, fuel subsidy access, tax compliance, and electoral participation, a design that generates redundant data, chronic inclusion and exclusion errors, and substantial fiscal leakage. This paper argues that this fragmentation is not incidental but systemic, and that addressing it requires a foundational rethinking of how the state manages identity as a governance infrastructure.

The central proposition is that Indonesia's e-KTP, anchored by the Nomor Induk Kependudukan (NIK) as a universal primary key, constitutes an underutilized architecture capable of functioning as a unified national digital identity layer. Rather than treating e-KTP as a citizen identification document, this framework reconceptualizes it as core state infrastructure, a cross-sectoral interoperability mechanism integrating welfare distribution, healthcare systems, subsidy targeting, taxation, education financing, financial inclusion, and electoral administration within a single identity plane. Drawing on conceptual analysis, comparative governance evidence from Estonia's X-Road framework, India's Aadhaar-based digital public infrastructure, and Singapore's SingPass ecosystem, and empirical grounding from Indonesia's own NIK-DTKS matching experience and SATUSEHAT implementation, the paper develops a theoretical model for NIK-centric integration and examines its institutional preconditions. The analysis identifies measurable governance gains, including improved targeting accuracy, reduced administrative duplication, and diminished opportunities for benefit fraud, while foregrounding the constraints that have historically impeded integration: institutional ego, asymmetric data quality across agencies, interoperability deficits, and risks of state surveillance that any serious deployment must constitutionally bound. The paper concludes that Indonesia's digital governance reform hinges less on technological readiness than on political will and institutional design. Positioning e-KTP as platform state infrastructure reframes the NIK not as a number on a card, but as the connective tissue of a coherent, accountable digital state.

AI.tldr: 本文指出印尼公共服务因围绕分散的部门身份系统运作而碎片化，主张将基于NIK的e-KTP从公民身份证件重新构想为统一的全国数字身份基础设施，通过跨部门整合实现治理效率提升，并指出实现这一转型的关键在于政治意愿与制度设计而非技术准备。
AI.research_question: 印尼碎片化的公共服务架构如何通过将e-KTP（基于NIK）重新定位为统一的数字身份基础设施来实现跨部门整合，以及实现这种整合所需的制度前提和面临的约束是什么？
AI.motivation: 印尼公共服务体系因部门身份系统各自为政，导致数据冗余、包容性和排斥性错误频发、财政流失严重。现有碎片化问题并非偶然而是系统性的，需要从根本上重新思考国家如何将身份管理作为治理基础设施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平台型国家基础设施理论；数字身份作为治理基础设施的跨部门互操作性框架；基于NIK作为通用主键的统一身份层理论模型。
AI.method: 概念分析；比较治理研究（借鉴爱沙尼亚X-Road、印度Aadhaar数字公共基础设施、新加坡SingPass生态系统的经验）；印尼本土实证依据（NIK-DTKS匹配经验、SATUSEHAT实施情况）。
AI.findings: NIK/e-KTP具备作为统一数字身份层的潜力但未充分利用；整合可带来靶向精准度提升、行政重复减少、福利欺诈机会降低等可衡量的治理收益；阻碍整合的历史约束包括机构本位主义、跨机构数据质量不对称、互操作性缺陷以及国家监控风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了NIK中心化整合的理论模型；将e-KTP重新概念化为"平台型国家基础设施"而非单纯的身份证件；将NIK重新定义为"连贯、可问责的数字国家的连接组织"而非卡片上的编号。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印尼数字治理改革指明了关键路径：技术准备并非主要障碍，政治意愿和制度设计才是；识别了实现整合必须应对的具体制度约束（机构本位主义、数据质量、互操作性、监控风险）；为发展中国家利用现有数字身份基础设施推动公共服务整合提供了可借鉴的分析框架。

title: Bangladesh Tourist Spot Recommendation System Using Hybrid Machine Learning Techniques
affiliations: Dhaka International University

detail.title: Bangladesh Tourist Spot Recommendation System Using Hybrid Machine Learning Techniques

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no conflicts of interest regarding the publication of this paper. The research was conducted independently without any financial, commercial, or personal relationships that could have influenced the results or interpretation of the study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, clinical data, or sensitive personal information. Therefore, formal ethics approval was not required. The research is based on publicly available data on tourist attractions in Bangladesh.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was conducted as an independent academic project.

detail.abstract:
Tourism plays a significant role in the economic and cultural development of a country. Bangladesh possesses a wide variety of tourist attractions, including historical sites, natural landscapes, beaches, waterfalls, religious places, and archaeological monuments. However, tourists often face difficulties in identifying suitable destinations due to the lack of intelligent recommendation systems specifically designed for Bangladesh. Existing tourism platforms mainly provide static information and do not offer personalized recommendations based on user preferences and geographical proximity. 
This research proposes a hybrid tourist spot recommendation system for Bangladesh that combines content-based filtering and location-based recommendation techniques. A structured dataset containing tourist attractions from different divisions of Bangladesh is utilized. The proposed system analyzes tourist spot categories, regional information, and geographical coordinates to generate personalized recommendations. Cosine Similarity is employed to identify attractions with similar characteristics, while the Haversine Distance formula is used to calculate geographical proximity between users and tourist destinations.
 The proposed framework aims to improve travel planning by providing accurate and personalized tourist recommendations. The system is implemented using Python, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, and Streamlit. Performance evaluation is conducted using standard recommendation metrics, including Precision, Recall, and F1-Score. The findings demonstrate that integrating user preferences with location-based information can significantly enhance recommendation quality and user satisfaction.

AI.tldr: 本文针对孟加拉国旅游业缺乏智能推荐系统的问题，提出了一种混合型旅游景点推荐系统，结合基于内容过滤和基于位置的推荐技术，利用余弦相似度和Haversine距离公式，为用户提供个性化且地理邻近的景点推荐，实验表明该方法能显著提升推荐质量和用户满意度。
AI.research_question: 如何为孟加拉国构建一个能够结合用户偏好与地理邻近性的智能旅游景点推荐系统？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国拥有丰富的旅游资源，但现有旅游平台仅提供静态信息，缺乏针对该国的智能推荐系统，游客难以根据个人偏好和地理位置找到合适的旅游目的地。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于内容的过滤（Content-based Filtering）、基于位置的推荐（Location-based Recommendation）、余弦相似度（Cosine Similarity）、Haversine距离公式。
AI.method: 采用混合推荐方法：使用余弦相似度计算景点内容相似性，使用Haversine公式计算用户与景点间的地理距离；数据集包含孟加拉国各分区旅游景点的分类、区域信息和地理坐标；使用Python、Pandas、Scikit-Learn、Streamlit实现系统；采用精确率、召回率和F1分数进行性能评估。
AI.findings: 将用户偏好与基于位置的信息相结合，能够显著提升推荐质量和用户满意度。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了内容过滤与位置推荐混合方法在旅游推荐场景中的有效性，拓展了余弦相似度和Haversine距离在推荐系统中的应用组合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为孟加拉国开发了实用的旅游景点推荐系统原型，帮助游客更高效地规划旅行并发现合适的旅游目的地。

title: Problem Reframing in AI-Enabled Decision Systems: Mechanisms within a Five-Dimensional Decision Architecture
affiliations: and National Taiwan Normal University - College of Education

detail.title: Problem Reframing in AI-Enabled Decision Systems: Mechanisms within a Five-Dimensional Decision Architecture

AI.tldr: 本文提出问题重构的五维决策架构（问题、数据、学习、生成、治理），识别了四种重构类型（情境驱动、行为驱动、信号驱动、AI驱动），其中AI驱动重构通过学习与生成的互动持续产生替代性问题定义，改变了传统决策范式。
AI.research_question: 问题重构在决策过程中如何运作？AI-enabled系统如何改变问题定义的动态过程？
AI.motivation: 现有研究将问题重构视为一次性认知活动，未清晰解释其在决策过程中的运作位置与机制；同时AI系统使问题定义日益流动化，需要新的理论框架加以解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 五维决策架构（问题、数据、学习、生成、治理）；四种重构类型分类（情境驱动、行为驱动、信号驱动、AI驱动）
AI.method: 概念性/理论性研究，通过结构分析与类型学构建提出框架，并引用半导体制造、工程设计和物流系统的实证证据（Huang & Lin, 2026）进行支持。
AI.findings: 问题重构可在决策过程不同阶段发生，由不同来源触发；AI驱动重构不同于外部触发的三种类型，其通过学习与生成的互动持续产生替代性问题定义，使决策从"固定问题下选择最优解"转向"导航和生成替代性问题定义"。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了问题重构的结构性解释，将重构从一次性事件重新定位为决策架构中的多阶段、多来源过程；识别了AI驱动重构作为新型重构类型。
AI.practical_contributions: 对人机协作环境下的治理与组织设计提出了新启示，特别是AI决策系统和AI Agent环境日益普及的背景下。

title: A Comprehensive Tutorial and Survey of Business-Outcome-Driven Private 5G/6G Networks: Exploring Enterprise Intent, Economic-Aware Control, Deployment Options, Use Cases, and Challenges
affiliations: , Celona Inc., Chongqing University and NIT, Warangal

detail.title: A Comprehensive Tutorial and Survey of Business-Outcome-Driven Private 5G/6G Networks: Exploring Enterprise Intent, Economic-Aware Control, Deployment Options, Use Cases, and Challenges
detail.abstract: Private fifth-generation (5G) and future sixthgeneration (6G) networks are moving from experimental connectivity platforms into operational infrastructure for factories, ports, warehouses, hospitals, mines, campuses, utilities, airports, and other enterprise environments. However, most network intelligence still optimizes technical key performance indicators (KPIs), such as latency, throughput, reliability, availability, coverage, jitter, energy efficiency, spectrum utilization, and slicelevel service level objectives. These quantities are necessary, but they are not the final objective of enterprise deployment. Enterprise decision makers care about production output, downtime avoidance, worker safety, energy cost, logistics flow, asset utilization, regulatory compliance, risk exposure, and return on investment (ROI). This mismatch creates a semantic, economic, causal, and governance gap between business objectives and network-control actions. This article provides a comprehensive tutorial and survey of business-outcome-driven private 5G/6G networks. We synthesize private-network architectures, nonpublic network (NPN) management, intent-based networking, autonomous-network standards, Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) service management and orchestration (SMO), RAN intelligent controllers (RICs), network slicing, edge computing, digital twins, knowledge graphs, large language models (LLMs), agentic artificial intelligence (AI), and economic-aware optimization. We introduce a layered abstraction in which business intent is transformed into operational intent, service intent, network intent, resource-control action, and measurable business outcome feedback. We further develop a reference architecture for Enterprise Network Intelligence, identify the role of Business Intent Languages (BILs), define the KPI-to-outcome translation problem, present economic objective formulations, analyze deployment models and use cases, survey datasets and testbeds, and derive research challenges. The central thesis is that future private networks should not merely automate network operations; they should become governed enterprise decision systems that optimize communication, computing, sensing, and operational resources according to business value.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了面向业务成果驱动的私有5G/6G网络，指出当前网络优化聚焦技术KPI与企业业务目标之间存在语义、经济、因果和治理鸿沟，提出了从业务意图到可衡量业务成果反馈的分层抽象架构，并综合了O-RAN、数字孪生、大语言模型、智能体AI等技术，主张未来私有网络应成为以业务价值为导向的企业决策系统。
AI.research_question: 如何弥合私有5G/6G网络技术性能指标（KPI）优化与企业业务目标（如产量、停机避免、投资回报率）之间的鸿沟，构建以业务成果为导向的网络智能体系？
AI.motivation: 现有私有5G/6G网络优化仍聚焦延迟、吞吐量等技术KPI，但企业决策者真正关心的是生产输出、能源成本、合规性等业务成果。这一错位导致网络控制行动与商业价值脱节，亟需建立从业务意图到网络动作的端到端翻译机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分层意图抽象（业务意图→运营意图→服务意图→网络意图→资源控制动作→业务成果反馈）、KPI到成果翻译问题、经济目标函数建模、企业网络智能参考架构。
AI.method: 综合性的教程与综述研究，涵盖私有网络架构、NPN管理、意图驱动网络、O-RAN SMO/RIC、网络切片、边缘计算、数字孪生、知识图谱、大语言模型、智能体AI及经济感知优化等多个技术栈，并分析部署模型、用例、数据集和测试平台。
AI.findings: 1) 技术KPI优化无法直接映射到业务成果，存在语义、经济、因果、治理四类鸿沟；2) 需引入业务意图语言（BIL）将企业目标转化为网络可执行意图；3) 未来私有网络应成为受治理的企业决策系统，联合优化通信、计算、感知和运营资源以最大化业务价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次系统定义了KPI到业务成果的翻译问题（KPI-to-outcome translation）；2) 提出多层意图抽象与反馈闭环的理论框架；3) 将经济目标函数（如ROI）纳入网络优化问题形式化表述。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为企业部署私有5G/6G网络提供了从技术指标到业务价值的完整转换路径；2) 给出了私有网络架构设计与O-RAN集成的实践参考；3) 梳理了当前可用数据集、测试平台及研究挑战，指导产业界和学术界后续方向。

title: When Is Data Annotation Participatory? A Comparative Study of Authority in AI Data Work
affiliations: and Pennsylvania State University

detail.title: When Is Data Annotation Participatory? A Comparative Study of Authority in AI Data Work
detail.abstract: Despite growing calls for "participatory AI" in response to concerns about bias, labor exploitation, and accountability, participation is often invoked without specifying whether it meaningfully redistributes power. In data annotation, participatory language frequently functions as legitimizing rhetoric, even as authority over problem framing, workflows, and downstream use remains centralized. This paper examines when, and under what conditions, data annotation can be considered genuinely participatory. We present a comparative analysis of six data annotation initiatives across commercial, academic, and community-driven contexts using an integrative framework that distinguishes between epistemic, procedural, and governance authority in data annotation. Drawing on deductive coding of organizational documents, we analyze how participatory claims are operationalized in practice. Across cases, we identify three recurring participation configurations: commercial crowdwork, institutional volunteerism, and community collaboration, that differ systematically in how authority is distributed. We find that genuine participation does not arise from human involvement, ethical labor conditions, domain expertise, or transparency alone, but from structural conditions that redistribute authority over problem framing, annotation practices, and control beyond the point of data production. We reframe participation as a question of authority distribution rather than labor inclusion, with implications for democratic accountability in AI governance.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较六个数据标注项目，指出真正的"参与式AI"不在于让人类参与或改善劳动条件，而在于重新分配问题框架、标注实践和治理控制权。作者提出了一个整合框架，区分了数据标注中的认知权威、程序权威和治理权威，并识别了三种参与配置形态。
AI.research_question: 数据标注在什么条件下才能被视为真正的"参与式"？参与式语言在数据标注实践中是如何被操作化的？
AI.motivation: "参与式AI"的呼吁日益增多，但"参与"一词常被模糊使用，未能明确是否真正重新分配了权力。许多数据标注项目虽使用参与式修辞，但核心权力（问题框架、工作流程、下游使用）仍高度集中，参与沦为合法化修辞。需要系统分析参与的真实条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合性权威框架：区分三种权威类型——认知权威（问题框架的知识控制）、程序权威（标注实践和工作流程控制）、治理权威（对数据下游使用的控制）。
AI.method: 对六个数据标注项目（涵盖商业、学术和社区驱动三种情境）进行比较分析，采用演绎编码方法分析组织文档中参与式主张的操作化方式。
AI.findings: 识别出三种参与配置形态：商业众包（commercial crowdwork）、制度性志愿服务（institutional volunteerism）和社区协作（community collaboration），它们在权威分布上存在系统性差异。真正的参与不来自人类参与、道德劳动条件、领域专长或透明度本身，而来自能够重新分配问题框架、标注实践和超出数据生产点的控制权的结构性条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 将参与重新定义为权威分配问题而非劳动包容问题，提供了区分认知、程序和治理三种权威的分析框架，揭示了不同参与配置形态的系统性差异，深化了对AI治理中民主问责的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为评估数据标注项目是否真正具有参与性提供了可操作的分析标准（三种权威维度），警示从业者不要将劳动参与、伦理条件或领域专长等同于真正的权力分享，指导AI治理实践中的权力重新设计。

title: The Epistemology of Unaffiliated Research: A Theoretical Framework for Measuring, Validating, and Preserving Independent Knowledge Creation

detail.title: The Epistemology of Unaffiliated Research: A Theoretical Framework for Measuring, Validating, and Preserving Independent Knowledge Creation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: For refinement purposes, free resources have been used. The author declares no competing interests. The paper is based on the author's own experience and thoughts.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a theoretical/conceptual paper and did not involve human participants, animal subjects, or identifiable personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper presents a theoretical framework for recognizing, measuring, and preserving research output generated entirely outside institutional structures. Drawing from the documented case of an independent researcher who produced a substantial body of publicly documented research without institutional funding, research staff, or proprietary infrastructure, we propose a new paradigm for validating unaffiliated knowledge creation. We introduce the concept of "Unaffiliated Researcher Temples"-decentralized physical and digital repositories designed to preserve grassroots innovations and establish intellectual sovereignty for independent creators. We examine transformative policy innovations by leaders who emerged from non-elite institutional backgrounds as compelling evidence that profound intellectual contributions do not require prestigious academic credentials. The framework challenges traditional hierarchies of knowledge production by establishing an epistemology of lived experience, demonstrating that profound intellectual contributions emerge not only from institutional abundance but also from individual necessity, self-reliance, and practical intelligence. We argue that independent research activity can be documented, examined, and evaluated through transparent public records, meeting the criteria for formal recognition within global achievement frameworks. This paper contributes to decolonizing knowledge systems by validating street-level epistemology and proposing sustainable governance models through Decentralized Science (DeSci) principles and community-based stewardship.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套理论框架，用于识别、衡量和保存完全在机构体制外产生的研究成果，引入"非附属研究者殿堂"概念，主张通过去中心化科学（DeSci）原则和社区治理来验证和保护独立知识创造。
AI.research_question: 如何识别、衡量和保存完全在机构结构之外产生的研究成果？非附属研究者的知识创造如何获得正式认可？
AI.motivation: 传统知识生产体系将机构隶属关系视为学术合法性的前提，系统性忽视了非机构化研究者的贡献，存在知识生产等级制的认知不公。
AI.theoretical_framework: 去殖民化知识体系、街头认识论（Street-level Epistemology）、去中心化科学（DeSci）原则、生活经验认识论（Epistemology of Lived Experience）
AI.method: 文献案例研究法，基于一位独立研究者的记录在案的案例
AI.findings: 非附属研究者能够产生经得起公开记录检验的实质性研究成果；非精英背景出身者也能产生变革性政策创新；独立研究可以通过透明的公共记录进行记录、检验和评估。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统知识生产的等级制，建立了生活经验认识论，证明知识贡献不仅来自机构丰裕，也来自个体必要性、自力更生和实践智慧；为去殖民化知识体系提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出"非附属研究者殿堂"作为去中心化的实物和数字存储库；基于DeSci原则提出可持续治理模式和社区管家制；为独立研究进入全球成就框架提供路径。

title: The Inference-Compute Frontier and a Latency-Efficient Architecture for Limit Order Book Prediction
affiliations: Independent Researcher, USA.

detail.title: The Inference-Compute Frontier and a Latency-Efficient Architecture for Limit Order Book Prediction
detail.abstract: We study whether a scaling-law-style inference-compute frontier appears in limit order book prediction. Using FI-2010 and a suite of models ranging from small decision trees to neural LOB architectures, we find that the realized empirical frontier of predictive loss versus structural forward work is well summarized by a power law. In particular, with MLPLOB held out as an architecture family, a power-law fit to the low- and mid-compute non-MLPLOB frontier extrapolates across multiple orders of magnitude and attains 𝑅 2 = 0.941 on the excluded high-compute MLPLOB target frontier. A similar exercise in latency space gives substantially weaker results, showing that latency is not merely noisy compute. We use this gap to motivate FastBiNLOB, a dense axis-separable LOB mixer built from hardware-friendly temporal and feature mixing operations. In a five-seed experiment, FastBiNLOB exceeds the published 𝑦10 and 𝑦100 macro-F1 targets at notably lower latency than existing published SOTA architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了限价订单簿预测中是否存在类似规模法则的推理-计算前沿，并提出了一个低延迟、高精度的新架构FastBiNLOB。
AI.research_question: 限价订单簿预测中，预测损失与计算量之间是否遵循幂律分布（规模法则）？
AI.motivation: 理解限价订单簿预测中计算资源与预测性能之间的权衡关系，并利用这一关系指导低延迟、高性能模型的设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 规模法则（Scaling Law）、幂律分布、推理-计算前沿（Inference-Compute Frontier）
AI.method: 使用FI-2010数据集，构建从决策树到神经LOB架构的多个模型，拟合预测损失与结构前向计算量之间的幂律关系；在延迟空间中重复实验；提出FastBiNLOB架构。
AI.findings: 预测损失与计算量之间存在清晰的幂律前沿；排除MLPLOB后拟合的幂律模型能很好地预测MLPLOB的高计算量前沿（R²=0.941）；延迟空间中的类似拟合效果较差；FastBiNLOB架构在更低延迟下达到了超越现有SOTA的宏F1指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统验证了限价订单簿预测中存在类似规模法则的推理-计算前沿，揭示了计算量与预测性能之间的幂律关系，并指出延迟与计算量并非等价。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了FastBiNLOB这一硬件友好的低延迟架构，在实际交易场景中以更低延迟实现更优的预测性能，具有重要的工程应用价值。

title: Beyond Bretton Woods: Dollar Hegemony, Institutional Fracture, and the Architecture of a Multipolar Global Financial Order
affiliations: University of Benin

detail.title: Beyond Bretton Woods: Dollar Hegemony, Institutional Fracture, and the Architecture of a Multipolar Global Financial Order
detail.abstract:
The post-war Bretton Woods architecture, constructed in the shadow of catastrophic geopolitical failure and designed for an economy in which the United States accounted for nearly half of global industrial output, has proven resistant to reform even as the structural conditions that justified its design have dissolved. Eighty years after the Bretton Woods conference, the International Monetary Fund retains a voting structure in which the United States alone commands a de facto blocking minority; the Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) remains simultaneously a technical chokepoint, a geopolitical instrument, and a barrier to financial inclusion for the developing world; and the dollar continues to constitute 57.4 per cent of global foreign exchange reserves despite the United States accounting for approximately 25 per cent of global GDP. This paper interrogates these asymmetries through the lens of Comparative Political Economy, synthesising Developmental State Theory, Social Democratic Institutionalism, and inductively derived institutional patterns to construct an analytical framework adequate to the complexity of contemporary global financial governance. 
The paper makes four original contributions to the literature. First, we conduct the first comprehensive multi-continental institutional audit of nine major regional economic blocs, examining the African Union's Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA), ECOWAS and its aborted ECO currency project, BRICS+, ASEAN, the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC), CELAC and Mercosur, the European Economic Area, and the Pacific regional architecture, within a unified analytical framework that tracks their stated objectives against demonstrated achievements. Second, we deploy scenario-modelled de-dollarisation simulations at 20%, 40%, and 60% thresholds, projecting impacts on trade finance costs, reserve currency composition, emerging market foreign exchange volatility, and global trade growth — an exercise absent from the existing reform literature at this level of specificity. Third, through composite scoring and cluster analysis of the top and bottom deciles of countries across six development metrics, we theorise the institutional determinants of development success and deprivation, drawing on patterns observed across Nordic social democracies, East Asian developmental states, and chronically underdeveloped frontier economies. Fourth, we synthesise findings into four reform pathways for the post-Bretton Woods order — a reformed Special Drawing Rights (SDR) system, a Plurilateral Monetary Compact, a regional reserve pooling architecture with CBDC interoperability, and comprehensive governance democratisation — with evidence-derived weights assigned to each pathway's feasibility and developmental impact. 
A dedicated sub-case analysis of Nigeria foregrounds the specific challenges and reform opportunities facing resource-rich, institutionally constrained African economies, drawing extensively on the scholarship and policy prescriptions of Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala, Soludo, and Sanusi Lamido Sanusi. The paper concludes that the current architecture is not merely suboptimal but structurally biased against the populations most in need of the stability and financing access it ostensibly provides, and that evidence-guided reform can achieve greater equity, financial stability, reduced USD dependency, and accelerated human development simultaneously rather than sequentially.

AI.tldr: 本文系统批判了战后布雷顿森林体系的制度惯性，通过比较政治经济学视角和多大陆制度审计，提出四条改革路径，论证当前全球金融治理结构对发展中国家存在系统性偏见。
AI.research_question: 后布雷顿森林体系的制度不对称性如何形成、如何固化？哪些改革路径能够同时实现公平性、金融稳定性和人类发展目标？
AI.motivation: 布雷顿森林体系建立80年来，其制度设计（如IMF投票权、SWIFT控制、美元主导）已严重偏离最初的结构合理性，但改革阻力巨大。现有文献缺乏多维度的系统性改革方案和量化模拟。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较政治经济学（CPE）、发展型国家理论、社会民主制度主义，结合归纳推导的制度模式分析。
AI.method: 1. 九大区域经济集团的多大陆制度审计；2. 20%/40%/60%阈值下去美元化情景模拟；3. 六项发展指标的顶层和底层十一分位数复合评分与聚类分析；4. 尼日利亚子案例深度分析。
AI.findings: 1. 当前体系不是次优而是结构性偏见；2. 四条改革路径（改革SDR、诸边货币协定、区域储备池+CBDC互操作性、治理民主化）各有不同的可行性和影响力权重；3. 去美元化可显著降低新兴市场汇率波动并促进贸易增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在统一分析框架内对九大区域经济集团进行系统性制度审计；将发展型国家理论与社会民主制度主义综合运用于全球金融治理分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供量化的去美元化情景模拟结果；提出四条具体的后布雷顿森林体系改革路径及其可行性权重；为尼日利亚等资源型、制度受限的非洲经济体提供政策处方。

title: Beyond Prediction: Toward a Structural Complexity Science
affiliations: The Force Global Research Facility

detail.title: Beyond Prediction: Toward a Structural Complexity Science
detail.abstract: Complexity science successfully identified phenomena such as emergence, self-organization, adaptive dynamics, and nonlinear transitions, but did not identify the governing mechanism underlying them. This article proposes that these phenomena become interpretable when viewed through coherence physics and the Continuous Collective Capacity (CCC) architecture. Building on the invariant C + L + D = 1 (∀t), ΔC ≥ 0, complexity is redefined from an intrinsic property of systems to a relational condition between environmental variety and the coherence capacity of an intelligence field. From this perspective, emergence becomes the observable expression of coherence formation, self-organization becomes coherence convergence, and adaptive dynamics become expansions of metabolic capacity. Developed through design-science methodology and validated under controlled operational conditions, the framework offers a falsifiable reinterpretation of complexity science. Generalization beyond the tested environment remains subject to further empirical scrutiny.

AI.tldr: 本文提出复杂性科学中涌现、自组织、自适应动力学等现象的本质是相干性物理与连续集体容量架构的表现，基于C + L + D = 1（∀t）、ΔC ≥ 0这一不变式，将复杂性从系统的内在属性重新定义为环境多样性与智能场相干容量之间的关系条件。
AI.research_question: 复杂性科学中涌现、自组织、自适应和非线性转变等现象背后的支配机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 复杂性科学虽成功识别了涌现、自组织等现象，但未能找到这些现象背后的统一支配机制。本文试图填补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 相干性物理学（Coherence Physics）与连续集体容量架构（Continuous Collective Capacity, CCC），核心不变式为C + L + D = 1（∀t），ΔC ≥ 0。
AI.method: 设计科学方法论（design-science methodology），在受控操作条件下进行验证。
AI.findings: 涌现 = 相干性形成的可观察表达；自组织 = 相干性收敛；自适应动力学 = 代谢容量的扩展。复杂性被重新定义为环境多样性与智能场相干容量之间的关系条件（而非系统内在属性）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了复杂性科学的一个可证伪的重新解释框架；将涌现、自组织、自适应等核心现象统一在相干性物理学的视角下；从系统的内在属性转向关系条件视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解和分析复杂系统提供了新的操作性工具，但实际推广仍需进一步的实证检验。

title: Bank Ownership as a Political Instrument: Evidence from Chinese Local Governments
affiliations: Georgetown University and Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) - Shanghai Advanced Institute of Finance (SAIF)

detail.title: Bank Ownership as a Political Instrument: Evidence from Chinese Local Governments
detail.abstract: We study how local governments use equity stakes in banks as a political and fiscal instrument to expand off-budget credit. We develop a novel city-bank-year measure of Chinese local government ownership from banks' shareholder registries and link it to transaction-level borrowing by local government financing vehicles (LGFVs). We find that a one-standard-deviation increase in a local government's ownership stake in a bank raises that bank's credit to local government borrowers by 11%. We exploit a regulatory reform that forced private shareholders to unwind bank holdings to support a causal interpretation. This effect is stronger when political competition is intense, officials near the end of their terms, and fiscal constraints are tighter. Greater local-government ownership also makes LGFV investment more responsive to industry performance, yet these projects are more likely to fail, indicating that ownership directs credit to attractive industries at the cost of project quality.

AI.tldr: 本文研究地方政府如何利用银行股权作为政治和财政工具来扩大预算外信贷，发现地方政府持股增加会导致银行对地方融资平台的贷款增加11%，且这一效应在政治竞争激烈、官员任期将满和财政约束紧张时更强。
AI.research_question: 地方政府如何利用银行股权作为政治和财政工具来扩大预算外信贷？
AI.motivation: 地方政府面临财政约束时，会寻求通过控制银行来获取预算外信贷资源，但这一机制尚未得到充分实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、财政联邦主义、银行公司治理
AI.method: 构建城市-银行-年度层面的地方政府持股度量指标，结合地方融资平台（LGFVs）的贷款交易数据，利用监管改革作为外生冲击进行因果识别。
AI.findings: 地方政府持股每增加一个标准差，该银行对地方政府借款人的信贷增加11%；政治竞争激烈、官员任期将尽、财政约束紧张时效应更强；地方政府持股使LGFV投资对行业表现更敏感，但项目更易失败。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了地方政府通过银行股权影响信贷配置的政治经济机制，丰富了财政联邦主义和银行公司治理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解中国地方政府债务扩张和金融风险提供了新视角，对银行监管和财政改革具有政策启示。

title: Same Capital, Different Absorption: Foreign Venture Capital and Startup Acquisition Channels in Japan and Singapore

detail.title: Same Capital, Different Absorption: Foreign Venture Capital and Startup Acquisition Channels in Japan and Singapore

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author was previously affiliated with B Capital Group during part of the research period. This study uses commercial deal-level data and was conducted independently; it is unrelated to B Capital, the Japan Investment Corporation (JIC), or any firm or investor analyzed in the study. No party reviewed, funded, or approved the manuscript, and the author has no other financial or personal relationships that could be perceived to have influenced this work. Generative-AI tools were used for drafting, editing, and coding assistance; all empirical results were produced and verified by the author from the source data.

detail.abstract: Foreign venture capital (foreign VC) universally raises both the capital scale of portfolio startups and their propensity to become acquirers, yet the buyer-side acquisition channel into which this expanded capital is absorbed depends asymmetrically on the host country's institutions. We examine this proposition using 10,051 VC-backed startups in Japan and Singapore from PitchBook (2010–2024). After a strict screening filter, we estimate linear probability models with fixed effects and a timing-clean treatment that counts only foreign-VC exposure occurring before a firm's first acquisition, with standard errors firm-clustered for round-size models and HC3-robust for firm-level models. Foreign-VC involvement expands round size by about +99% in Japan and +106% in Singapore, and raises the pooled propensity to become an acquirer by +7.19pp (all p < 0.001). The institutional absorption of this propensity is asymmetric. Japan-favoring domestic absorption is negative and significant (foreign_vc_pre × Singapore on domestic acquisition = −5.66pp, p < 0.001) and survives controlling for pre-acquisition cumulative capital (−4.88pp, p = 0.001), distinguishing a capital-scale-independent institutional channel. By contrast, the Singapore cross-border interaction is +0.42pp (n.s.) in the preferred specification, and the cross-border main effect becomes statistically indistinguishable from zero once capital is controlled; Singapore's cross-border orientation is better interpreted as a composite of baseline ecosystem openness and capital scale-up than as an independent foreign-VC interaction. The central finding is universal capital scale-up plus asymmetric institutional absorption. We provide, to our knowledge, among the first firm-level estimates of whether VC-backed startups themselves become acquirers, and use a binary Japan–Singapore institutional-regime contrast to distinguish this asymmetric absorption. Findings reflect strong, mechanism-consistent associations rather than causal identification.

AI.tldr: 本文研究外国风险投资（foreign VC）对初创企业资本规模和收购倾向的影响，发现在日本和新加坡，外资VC普遍提升企业资本规模和成为收购方的概率，但该效应通过东道国制度不对称吸收：日本呈现显著的国内吸收效应，而新加坡的跨境收购效应主要由生态系统开放性和资本规模驱动，而非独立的外资VC制度交互作用。
AI.research_question: 外国风险投资如何影响初创企业的资本规模和收购方行为？东道国制度如何不对称地调节这一效应？
AI.motivation: 现有文献缺乏对VC支持型初创企业本身成为收购方的微观层面估计，且较少关注外资VC效应在不同制度环境下的异质性吸收机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论、外资VC溢出效应、企业收购行为理论
AI.method: 基于PitchBook 2010-2024年日本和新加坡10,051家VC支持型初创企业数据，采用线性概率模型（LPM）结合固定效应，严格时序清洗（仅计算首次收购前的外资VC暴露），标准误分别采用企业聚类（规模模型）和HC3稳健（企业层面模型）。
AI.findings: （1）外资VC参与使融资轮规模在日本扩大约+99%、新加坡+106%；（2）外资VC使企业成为收购方的概率提高+7.19pp（p<0.001）；（3）制度吸收不对称：日本的国内吸收效应显著为负（-5.66pp, p<0.001），且独立于资本规模；新加坡的跨境收购效应不显著（+0.42pp），在控制资本后消失，说明其主要由生态系统开放性和资本规模效应驱动。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供VC支持型初创企业本身作为收购方的企业层面估计；通过日本-新加坡二元制度对比，揭示外资VC效应的制度不对称吸收机制，区分了独立制度渠道与资本规模渠道。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和投资者理解外资VC在不同制度环境下的异质性效应提供实证依据；提示日本需关注外资VC国内吸收的抑制因素，新加坡应利用其生态系统开放性强化跨境收购优势。

title: An Economic Analysis of Decentralized Commerce Trust Mechanism Based on Feynman Diagram Model

detail.title: An Economic Analysis of Decentralized Commerce Trust Mechanism Based on Feynman Diagram Model
detail.abstract: Background: Centralized e-commerce platforms have resolved the trust problem in remote transactions through platform credit intermediation, but have created a new "trust black hole"-platforms can unilaterally modify rules, freeze funds, and abuse user data, leaving both merchants and buyers locked into the platform. Existing consortium blockchain solutions remain permissioned and fail to fundamentally resolve the trust issue. Research Question: How can we construct a programmable credit system that does not rely on any centralized platform, thereby rebuilding the physical foundation of commercial trust from an economic perspective? Methodology: This paper proposes the "Decentralized Commerce Feynman Diagram Model," introducing the formal methods of quantum field theory's Feynman diagrams into commercial transaction modeling. Through the creation and annihilation mechanisms of dNFT pairs (+/-credit quanta), local interaction vertices, and dual-world conservation laws, we establish a comprehensive trust cost analysis framework. Key Findings: 1. Trust Cost Quantification: The trust cost of remote transactions is 15-30% higher than face-to-face transactions (commissions 5-25% + return rates 10-30% + processing time 3-7 days). 2. Locality Value: Two local vertices (transaction contract + receipt contract) can reduce trust cost to $0.50/transaction (vs. platform commissions of 5-25%). 3. Game-Theoretic Stability: When delta x V_future >= V_fraud, honesty is the optimal strategy (empirical: at 96% discount factor, annual revenue $24,000 > fraud gain $5,000). 4. Cold-Start Feasibility: A three-dimensional initial credit generation mechanism (asset staking + verifiable credentials + guarantees) can provide new merchants with an initial credit score of 75 (out of 100). Policy Implications: Provides a theoretical basis for regulatory framework design, credit system standardization, and cross-border transaction trust mechanisms for decentralized commerce.

AI.tldr: 本文提出去中心化商业费曼图模型，利用量子场论形式化方法构建不依赖任何中心化平台的可编程信用系统，通过dNFT对（+/-信用量子）的创造与湮灭机制、局部相互作用顶点及双世界守恒律，将远程交易信任成本从15-30%降低至0.50美元/笔，并在博弈论条件下（折现因子96%时年收入$24,000 > 欺诈收益$5,000）证明诚实为最优策略。
AI.research_question: 如何构建不依赖任何中心化平台的可编程信用系统，从而从经济学视角重建商业信任的物理基础？
AI.motivation: 中心化电商平台通过信用中介解决了远程交易的信任问题，但创造了新的"信任黑洞"——平台可单方面修改规则、冻结资金、滥用用户数据，商家和买方均被锁定在平台中。现有联盟链方案仍为许可制，未能从根本上解决信任问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 量子场论费曼图的形式化方法（引入dNFT对的创造与湮灭机制）、局部相互作用顶点、双世界守恒律、博弈论（折现因子与诚实策略稳定性）
AI.method: 提出"去中心化商业费曼图模型"，将量子场论形式化方法引入商业交易建模，通过dNFT对（+/-信用量子）的创造与湮灭、局部交互顶点、双世界守恒律建立信任成本分析框架。
AI.findings: 1. 信任成本量化：远程交易信任成本比面对面交易高15-30%（佣金5-25%+退货率10-30%+处理时间3-7天）；2. 局部性价值：两个局部顶点（交易合约+收货合约）可将信任成本降至0.50美元/笔；3. 博弈论稳定性：当delta x V_future >= V_fraud时，诚实为最优策略（实证：96%折现因子下年收入$24,000 > 欺诈收益$5,000）；4. 冷启动可行性：三维初始信用生成机制（资产质押+可验证凭证+担保）可为新商家提供75分初始信用分。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将量子场论费曼图的形式化方法引入商业交易信任建模，建立了去中心化场景下信任成本的量化分析框架；通过dNFT对的创造与湮灭机制，为去中心化信用系统提供了形式化的理论基础；双世界守恒律为去中心化交易的因果一致性提供了理论保障。
AI.practical_contributions: 为去中心化商业的监管框架设计、信用系统标准化和跨境交易信任机制提供了理论基础；提出的三维初始信用生成机制（资产质押+可验证凭证+担保）为冷启动问题提供了可行的实践方案；将信任成本从15-30%降至0.50美元/笔，具有显著的经济效益。

title: Trade Finance Gaps in Developing Economies: Barriers and Solutions

detail.title: Trade Finance Gaps in Developing Economies: Barriers and Solutions
detail.abstract: Trade finance is a critical enabler of international commerce, yet developing economies continue to face a persistent and widening gap in access to trade finance instruments. This paper examines the structural, regulatory, and institutional barriers that impede trade finance access in low-and middle-income countries (LMICs), with particular focus on Sub-Saharan Africa, South and Southeast Asia, and Latin America. Drawing on data from the Asian Development Bank, the International Chamber of Commerce, the World Trade Organization, and the International Finance Corporation covering the period 2020-2025, this study estimates the global trade finance gap at approximately USD 2.5 trillion annually, with developing economies accounting for the largest share of unmet demand. Key barriers identified include stringent anti-money laundering (AML) and Know Your Customer (KYC) compliance requirements imposed by correspondent banks, inadequate domestic banking infrastructure, informational asymmetries, and limited collateral frameworks. The paper further analyzes the role of development finance institutions (DFIs), multilateral development banks (MDBs), and fintech-enabled solutions in bridging the gap. Policy recommendations are offered at the national, regional, and multilateral levels, including the adoption of harmonized digital trade documentation standards, expanded risk-sharing mechanisms, and targeted capacity-building programs for local financial institutions. The findings suggest that closing the trade finance gap requires coordinated institutional reform, regulatory recalibration, and strategic public-private investment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了发展中国家面临的约2.5万亿美元贸易融资缺口，分析了结构性、监管性和制度性障碍，并提出了多层次政策建议。
AI.research_question: 中低收入国家在获取贸易融资方面面临哪些结构性、监管性和制度性障碍？如何缩小这一融资缺口？
AI.motivation: 贸易融资是国际贸易的关键支撑，但发展中国家面临的贸易融资缺口持续扩大，亟需系统分析其障碍与解决路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易融资缺口理论、制度经济学中的信息不对称与抵押框架理论、监管合规成本理论。
AI.method: 基于亚洲开发银行、国际商会、世界贸易组织和国际金融公司2020-2025年数据的实证分析，结合多区域比较研究。
AI.findings: 全球贸易融资缺口约2.5万亿美元/年，发展中国家占比最大；主要障碍包括反洗钱/了解你的客户合规要求、国内银行基础设施不足、信息不对称和抵押框架有限；发展金融机构、多边开发银行和金融科技解决方案有缓解作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了监管合规、制度障碍与融资缺口的多维分析框架，揭示了发展中国家贸易融资困境的深层结构性原因。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了协调数字贸易文档标准、扩大风险分担机制、加强地方金融机构能力建设等国家、区域、多边层面的具体政策建议。
