title: Assessing Governance and the Empowerment of the Vulnerable Groups Report on the Relational Evaluation Module of the ALOC Project (Advancement of Land Rights of the Indigenous Communities)
affiliations: LADYSS UMR 7533 - Université Paris Cité, Gustave Eiffel University, IRD,  and CNRS, LAM / Sciences Po Bordeaux

detail.title: Assessing Governance and the Empowerment of the Vulnerable Groups Report on the Relational Evaluation Module of the ALOC Project (Advancement of Land Rights of the Indigenous Communities)

declarations.ethicsApproval: All ethical guidelines for this kind of studies on the field are respected and approved by participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This working paper is part of the partnership between the ARPOP (Public Policy Network Analysis) team at GEMDEV and Caritas Bangladesh on the Advancement of Land Rights of Indigenous Communities (ALOC) project. This partnership, running from September 2024 to September 2025, is part of the CoRe program.

publicationDetails.detailsText: GEMDEV - CONTROVERSIES and DEBATES WORKING PAPERS

detail.abstract:
For nearly three years, GEMDEV (Group for the Study of Globalization and Development) has been supporting the scientific coordination of the CoRe (Communities and Resilience) program. The CoRe program, a multi-year partnership led by Secours Catholique–Caritas France (SC-CF), brings together 23 partners from 18 countries and aims to promote a just ecological transition by strengthening the capacity for action of local actors. This document is part of the partnership between the ARPOP (Public Policy Network Analysis) team at GEMDEV and Caritas Bangladesh on the Advancement of Land Rights of Indigenous Communities (ALOC) project. This partnership, running from September 2024 to September 2025, is part of the CoRe program. Within this framework, the GEMDEV-ARPOP team has developed an experimental relational assessment module: a tool for monitoring and improving project governance, based on the analysis of networks of relationships between partners. The ALOC project, now in its third phase, was chosen as a pilot site for testing this module due to its rich network of stakeholders (community organizations, national NGOs, public institutions, etc.) and its deep roots in the territorial dynamics of land rights and ecological justice. This document reports on the experience of the relational assessment module, from its development and implementation to the results observed and the strengths and weaknesses they reveal in the collective governance of the ALOC project. 

Relational assessment relies on network analysis, which maps the relationships impacting project progress: information exchange, collaboration, perceived impact of collaboration, and ideological affinity. The results include maps of the relationships between all actors identified as project stakeholders. By using measures such as centrality, density, and betweenness, it becomes possible to objectify relational mechanisms such as influence, cohesion, power, information asymmetries, and obstacles hindering effective coordination. The results also include a section on actors' perceptions of a just ecological transition and the defense of Indigenous rights, in order to assess their coherence and impact on network cohesion. The joint interpretation of the results of the relational analysis of the ALOC-3 project's partner network identifies several obstacles and factors promoting coordination and cooperation among stakeholders. A brief summary of the results is presented here; they are detailed in Part 4 of this report.
+ A widely shared ideological foundation on the interdependence between land rights and environmental preservation
+ A moderate but sufficient relational density to ensure information flow and coordination
+ The existence of recognized bridging and central actors who can ensure inter-scale and inter-type connections
+ Participatory governance driven by local organizations, creating a committed "core group"
- Persistent asymmetries in mutual recognition and the perceived impact of collaborations
- A moderate but real segmentation between local and national scales
- Limited and peripheral engagement of government actors, despite their institutional power
- A gap between ideological convergence and effective collaboration among some actors

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了GEMDEV团队为CoRe项目开发的关系评估模块，该模块基于网络分析方法，通过绘制合作伙伴之间的关系图谱（信息交换、协作、感知影响、意识形态亲和力），来监测和改善项目治理。论文以孟加拉国ALOC项目（原住民土地权利项目）为试点，展示了该模块的应用过程与结果，揭示了项目集体治理中的优势（如共同意识形态基础、适度的关系密度、核心行动者）与不足（如互认不对称、地方与国家层面的割裂、政府参与有限）。
AI.research_question: 如何通过关系网络分析方法，开发和实施一个关系评估模块，以监测和改善涉及多利益相关者的发展项目的集体治理？
AI.motivation: 在推动公正生态转型的复杂项目中，多伙伴治理面临协调困难、信息不对称、权力不平衡等挑战。现有评估工具多关注产出指标，缺乏对合作关系网络本身的结构性分析，因此需要开发一种基于关系网络的评估工具来客观化这些关系机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会网络分析（Social Network Analysis），包括中心性（centrality）、密度（density）、中介中心性（betweenness）等网络度量指标；以及关系评估（relational assessment）方法。
AI.method: 以ALOC项目第三阶段为试点，运用关系评估模块收集项目利益相关者之间的多维关系数据（信息交换、协作、协作感知影响力、意识形态亲和力），绘制关系图谱，并运用中心性、密度、中介中心性等网络分析指标进行量化分析。
AI.findings: 研究发现：①各方对土地权利与环境保护的相互依存关系有广泛共识；②关系密度适中，足以保障信息流通与协调；③存在公认的桥梁型和中心型行动者，能连接不同层级和类型；④地方组织驱动的参与式治理形成了核心团体；但也存在：⑤相互认可与感知协作影响力的持续不对称；⑥地方与国家层面之间的中度割裂；⑦政府参与有限且边缘化；⑧意识形态趋同与实际有效协作之间存在差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 将社会网络分析系统地应用于发展项目的治理评估，提出了“关系评估模块”这一首创性方法工具，为项目治理研究提供了新的分析框架和操作化路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展项目（特别是多伙伴合作项目）提供了一套可复用的关系监测与治理改进工具；通过实证案例展示了如何识别项目网络中的结构性问题（如权力不对称、协调障碍），为项目管理者和合作伙伴优化协作提供了数据驱动的决策依据。

title: The Azores Index (A-Index): Balancing Peak Performance and Portfolio Density in Citation Analysis
affiliations: Royal Statistical Society

detail.title: The Azores Index (A-Index): Balancing Peak Performance and Portfolio Density in Citation Analysis
detail.abstract: Although widely adopted, established metrics like the h-index frequently flatten variation beyond the core threshold, while the traditional average citation count remains susceptible to individual outliers and portfolio expansion. We propose the Azores Index (A-index), a novel metric that partitions an author's publication list into three distinct tiers: the top 3 papers, the middle third, and the remainder. The index averages the citations of the top 3 papers, adds the total citations of the middle third, and normalizes the result by the total number of publications. This design simultaneously rewards exceptional impact and consistent mid-level productivity, while strongly penalizing dilution from low-cited papers. We formally define the index, discuss its mathematical properties, and provide illustrative comparisons with established metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Azores Index (A-index)，一种将论文分为三档（前3篇、中间三分之一、其余部分）并加权计算的新引文指标，旨在同时奖励高影响力论文和稳定的中等水平产出，同时严惩低引论文的稀释效应。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种新的引文计量指标，能够同时捕捉学者在顶尖论文上的卓越影响力、中等水平论文的持续产出力，并有效惩罚低引论文的稀释效应？
AI.motivation: 现有指标如h-index会忽略核心阈值以外的差异，而传统平均引文数则容易受异常高引论文或论文数量膨胀的影响，因此需要一种更平衡的学术评价指标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 引文分布的分档分析法、学术评价的加权归一化理论。
AI.method: 对作者的论文列表进行三等分划分（前3篇、中间三分之一篇、其余篇），计算前3篇平均引文数 + 中间三分之一总引文数，再除以总发文数进行归一化处理。
AI.findings: Azores Index能够同时奖励顶尖论文的高影响力和中等水平论文的稳定产出，同时强烈惩罚低引论文带来的稀释效应，在理论上优于h-index和平均引文数等传统指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种新的引文指标构造框架，将论文分为三档差异化处理，丰富了学术评价指标的理论设计空间。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学术机构、基金评审和职称评定提供了更全面的学者影响力评估工具，兼顾顶尖成果与持续产出，避免单一指标对学术绩效的扭曲。

title: Rethinking Monetary Policy
affiliations: Institute of Economic Affairs (IEA)

detail.title: Rethinking Monetary Policy
detail.abstract: Rethinking Monetary Policy: The Case for NGDP Targeting in Britain argues that the Bank of England’s current inflation-targeting framework is ill-suited to managing supply-side shocks and periods of financial instability, contributing to economic volatility and policy errors. The paper proposes replacing inflation targeting with a nominal gross domestic product (NGDP) targeting regime, which focuses on stabilizing total nominal spending in the economy. According to the author, NGDP targeting would better accommodate both demand and supply shocks, reduce uncertainty, and enhance transparency and credibility in monetary policymaking. The paper also advocates the development of a nominal GDP futures market and improved communication mechanisms to facilitate implementation. Overall, it contends that a rules-based NGDP framework would promote long-term economic stability, support sustainable growth, and restore confidence in the Bank of England’s ability to maintain macroeconomic stability.

AI.tldr: 本文批评英国央行当前的通胀目标框架在应对供给侧冲击和金融不稳定方面存在缺陷，提出用名义GDP（NGDP）目标制取代之，并建议建立名义GDP期货市场和完善沟通机制，以增强经济稳定性和政策可信度。
AI.research_question: 英国央行的通胀目标框架是否适合应对供给侧冲击和金融不稳定？用名义GDP目标制替代是否更优？
AI.motivation: 英国央行现行通胀目标制导致经济波动和政策失误，尤其是在供给侧冲击和金融不稳定时期，亟需更优的货币政策框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 名义GDP目标制理论、规则型货币政策理论、理性预期理论
AI.method: 理论分析与政策比较研究
AI.findings: NGDP目标制能更好地同时应对需求冲击和供给侧冲击，降低不确定性，提高政策透明度与可信度；建议发展名义GDP期货市场和改善沟通机制以促进实施。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统论证了名义GDP目标制相较于通胀目标制在应对供给侧冲击和金融不稳定方面的理论优势，拓展了规则型货币政策的研究边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为英国央行乃至其他央行的货币政策框架改革提供了具体可行的替代方案，包括名义GDP期货市场和沟通机制建设建议。

title: Frozen-Opponent Evaluation and Live-Update Continuation in Algorithmic Pricing

detail.title: Frozen-Opponent Evaluation and Live-Update Continuation in Algorithmic Pricing
detail.abstract: Holding a pricing rival fixed and allowing it to continue updating define different evaluation objects. We study this distinction in a Calvano-style Bertrand-logit duopoly. A DQN entrant is trained against ten independently trained mature Q-learning incumbents, with three DQN initializations per incumbent. After training, the same entrant-incumbent pair is evaluated with the incumbent either frozen or permitted to resume Q-updates. The entrant profit advantage is positive in 9 of 10 frozen-checkpoint means but only 6 of 10 live-update means; entrant own profit falls in all 10 matched comparisons. Separately, six configured learners spanning public reward feedback, known-payoff counterfactuals, Q-supervised auxiliary objectives, and direct Q-update-model access remain below the ten-seed mature Q-vs-Q reference in mean own profit and mean market price. These finite-budget results show that evaluation protocol is part of the estimand and that the tested richer configurations do not reproduce the Q-vs-Q high-price convention. Lower logged prices raise model-implied consumer surplus; total-welfare conclusions depend on the learner and on a binned-trajectory approximation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在卡尔沃式伯特利-罗吉特双头垄断市场中，对定价对手采用“冻结”（停止更新）与“实时更新”两种不同评估协议所产生的差异。实验表明，评估协议本身会影响利润估计结果，且更复杂的强化学习配置未能复现Q学习代理之间达成的高价默契。
AI.research_question: 在算法定价的寡头市场中，不同的对手评估协议（冻结对手vs允许对手更新）如何影响对算法盈利能力和市场价格的估计？更丰富的强化学习配置能否复现Q学习代理之间的高价格共谋结果？
AI.motivation: 在算法共谋的实证研究中，评估协议（是否允许对手在评估时继续学习）会影响对算法行为的判断，但这一方法论问题尚未得到系统研究。此外，现有文献多关注简单的Q学习算法，而更复杂的强化学习（如DQN）是否也能达成默契共谋尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 卡尔沃式伯特利-罗吉特双头垄断模型；Q学习与深度Q网络（DQN）强化学习框架；评估协议（冻结vs实时更新）作为估计量的组成部分。
AI.method: 在Bertrand-logit双头垄断设定下，训练DQN进入者与十个独立训练的成熟Q学习在位者对抗（每个在位者三种DQN初始化）。评估阶段比较冻结检查点与允许继续更新的结果。另外测试六种增强型学习者配置（包含公共奖励反馈、已知收益反事实、Q监督辅助目标、直接Q更新模型访问等）。
AI.findings: (1) 冻结检查点评估中，进入者利润优势在10个中有9个为正；而实时更新评估中仅6个为正，且所有10个匹配比较中进入者自身利润均下降。(2) 六种更丰富的学习者配置在平均自身利润和平均市场价格上均低于十种子成熟Q-vs-Q基准。(3) 较低定价日志提高了模型隐含的消费者剩余；关于总福利的结论取决于学习者和轨迹分段近似方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了评估协议本身是估计量的组成部分，不同评估方式会改变对算法行为的结论；揭示了更复杂的强化学习算法不一定能自发复现简单Q学习之间的默契共谋结果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反垄断监管机构评估算法定价行为提供了方法论的警示：评估协议选择会影响对算法是否构成默契共谋的判断；提示监管者不仅应关注算法类型，还应关注评估方法的设计。

title: Multi-Agent Artificial Intelligence for Autonomous Enterprise Automation

detail.title: Multi-Agent Artificial Intelligence for Autonomous Enterprise Automation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The author has no personal or financial relationships with any organizations that could have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animals, or patient data. All data used in this research were obtained from publicly available datasets (BUSI - Breast Ultrasound Images Dataset). Therefore, no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Today's fast-paced digital transformation has dramatically changed the way that businesses operate, driving an unprecedented need to leverage intelligent automation in cloud computing, enterprise resource planning (ERP), customer relationship management (CRM), DevOps, cybersecurity, business process management and enterprise service management. In the same vein, traditional Artificial Intelligence (AI) and robotic process automation (RPA) have enhanced operational efficiency but have been confined due to their narrow autonomy, isolated use of decision making power and low adaptability in dynamic enterprise settings. Agentic Artificial Intelligence (Agentic AI) and Multi-Agent Artificial Intelligence (MAAI) are groundbreaking developments in enterprise automation, empowering multiple intelligent agents to engage in autonomous thinking, joint problem-solving, distributed AI, adaptive learning, and orchestrating workflows and processes. In this study, Agentic AI and Multi-Agent AI are examined in the context of the systematic literature review (SLR), followed by a comparative analysis of the latest academic and industrial research to explore the changing role of AI in the intelligent enterprise automation. The review summarizes the latest advancements, deployment strategies, architectural designs, advantages, and future challenges of enterprise-wide collaborative AI agent deployment. The results show that Multi-Agent AI significantly boosts enterprise automation, yielding benefits in terms of efficiency, scalability, resilience, resource optimization, and cross-functional coordination. Moreover, Agentic AI provides autonomy for planning, ongoing learning, contextual reasoning, and real-time decision-making in intricate enterprise workflows, and multi-agent orchestration boosts cloud operations, DevOps automation, cybersecurity, business process management and enterprise service delivery. Still, there are serious issues of governance, interoperability, explain ability, trust, cyber security, privacy protection, and ethics in the use of AI that must be addressed on the road to broad implementation. The review also points to the growing reliance on enterprise ecosystems in the future, where collaboration-driven AI agents will play a key role, highlighting the need for secure, transparent and well-governed autonomous architectures that will evolve alongside business ecosystems and business priorities. In conclusion, Multi-Agent AI is the future of intelligent enterprise automation, presenting unprecedented opportunities for organizational transformation, yet it comes with its own set of challenges, including the need for robust governance frameworks, standardized orchestration mechanisms, and responsible use of AI in enterprises, to ensure sustainable, secure, and trustworthy adoption (

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统文献综述，探讨了Agentic AI与多智能体AI在企业自动化中的应用，发现多智能体AI能显著提升效率、可扩展性、资源优化等，但面临治理、互操作性、安全与伦理等挑战。
AI.research_question: Agentic AI和多智能体AI如何推动企业智能自动化？它们的优势、架构、部署策略及面临的挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统AI和RPA在自主性、决策能力和适应性方面存在局限，亟需探索更具自主性和协作性的AI智能体来应对企业数字化转型的复杂需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: Agentic AI（自主规划、持续学习、情境推理）、多智能体协作理论、分布式AI、智能企业自动化架构。
AI.method: 系统文献综述（SLR），结合学术与工业研究的最新成果进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 多智能体AI显著提升企业自动化的效率、可扩展性、韧性、资源优化和跨职能协调；Agentic AI赋予企业流程自主决策与实时响应能力；但存在治理、互操作性、可解释性、信任、网络安全、隐私和伦理等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了Agentic AI与多智能体AI在企业自动化中的理论框架，揭示了从传统AI到协作智能体的演进路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业部署智能AI智能体提供了架构设计、部署策略和治理建议，强调未来需要构建安全、透明、可治理的自主架构。

title: Are You being Targeted? Director And Auditor Networks in the SEC Filing Review Process
affiliations: University of Georgia - J.M. Tull School of Accounting, Monash University, Monash University and Colorado State University, Fort Collins - Department of Accounting

detail.title: Are You being Targeted? Director And Auditor Networks in the SEC Filing Review Process

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors do not have any conflicts of interest that are pertinent to the subject matter of this paper. This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This study examines whether SEC comment-letter correspondence exhibits network patterns through shared directors or auditors. Using U.S. public firms from 2004–2020, we find that firms are more likely to receive a comment letter when connected to recent recipients through common directors or audit office, after controlling for established determinants of SEC correspondence and general connectedness. Results are robust to firm fixed effects and hold across high- and low-comparability firm pairs, mitigating concerns that relation is driven by persistent firm similarity or pairwise accounting resemblance. Additional tests suggest these networks are associated with the SEC’s allocation of review effort: correspondence occurs sooner for connected firms, weakens when director or auditor links are severed, and strengthens when SEC workload is higher. Connected firms are also more likely to subsequently restate financial statements. Overall, evidence suggests director and auditor networks complement traditional firm-level risk indicators in the SEC’s allocation of review resources.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，通过与共享董事或审计师相连的企业更有可能收到SEC意见函，这种网络效应在SEC工作负荷高时更强，且连接企业后续更可能进行财务重述，表明董事和审计师网络补充了传统风险指标在SEC审查资源分配中的作用。
AI.research_question: SEC意见函的通信是否通过共享董事或审计师表现出网络模式？即企业是否因与近期收到意见函的企业存在董事或审计师连接而更可能收到SEC意见函？
AI.motivation: SEC审查资源有限，需要有效分配。已有研究关注企业层面风险特征对SEC审查的影响，但尚未探讨董事和审计师网络这一信息传递渠道是否影响SEC的审查决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息网络理论、监管资源配置理论、董事和审计师的信息传播与学习效应
AI.method: 使用2004-2020年美国上市公司数据，通过共享董事或审计办公室定义企业连接，采用Logit回归控制已确定的SEC通信决定因素和一般连接性，包含公司固定效应，并进行多种稳健性检验（高低可比性分组、连接断裂分析、SEC工作负荷交互等）。
AI.findings: (1) 与近期收到意见函的企业通过董事或审计师连接的企业更可能收到意见函；(2) 该效应在公司固定效应下依然成立，且在高、低可比性企业对中均存在；(3) 连接企业的意见函发出更及时；(4) 董事或审计师连接断开后效应减弱；(5) SEC工作负荷高时效应更强；(6) 连接企业后续更可能进行财务重述。
AI.theory_contributions: 将社会网络理论引入SEC监管审查的文献，揭示了董事和审计师网络作为信息传导机制在监管资源配置中的重要作用，拓展了对非正式信息渠道如何影响正式监管过程的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 对SEC优化审查资源分配具有政策启示；对企业治理实践（尤其是董事选任和审计师选择）提供参考；提示投资者关注企业网络连接所隐含的监管风险信号。

title: Technical Efficiency of TAFF Production in Northern Ethiopia: A Stochastic Frontier Approach
affiliations: Adigrat University, Mekelle University, Adigrat University, Adigrat University, Mekelle University and Mekelle University

detail.title: Technical Efficiency of TAFF Production in Northern Ethiopia: A Stochastic Frontier Approach
detail.abstract:
Aim:
Tigray’s agriculture sector is greatly faced with challenges, so much so that productivity levels are beneath the national level. This is largely due to primitive farming practices and high input costs. The persistent issue of low agricultural productivity poses a very dangerous threat to household food security as well as income stability. Thus, this study aims to investigate the level and determinants of technical efficiency in taff production among smallholder farmers in northern Ethiopia using a stochastic frontier approach.

Material and methods:
The current study employs the stochastic frontier production function to estimate the technical efficiency of taff production in northern Ethiopia. Using multi-stage sampling methods, 392 taff farmers made up the sample.

Results:
The average efficiency was found to be 87.3%, which implies that the inefficiency cost for farmers amounted to 49.79 kg (or ETB 1394.12) in yields per tsmdi. The study also shows that the district’s taff production was significantly impacted by plot size, fertilizer, pesticides, and seed.

Conclusions:
Farmers with greater livestock, farm revenue, and high weeding frequency were also more likely to be more productive than their competitors. Moreover, consistent with authors’ expectations, male-headed households produced taff more effectively. In contrast to respondents with lower levels of education, heads of families with higher levels of education, against authors’ expectations and dominant literature, exhibited lower levels of efficiency. To increase taff output, it is therefore essential to align the existing system in such a way that it addresses the supply and availability of fertilizers, pesticides, and agronomic practices (weeding and other improved packages).

AI.tldr: 本研究采用随机前沿生产函数，评估了埃塞俄比亚北部提格雷地区小农户苔麸生产的技术效率及其决定因素。研究发现，样本农户的平均技术效率为87.3%，意味着存在约13%的效率损失；地块面积、化肥、农药和种子显著影响产量；牲畜数量、农业收入、除草频率和男性户主与更高效率正相关，而较高教育水平反而与较低效率相关。
AI.research_question: 埃塞俄比亚北部提格雷地区小农户苔麸生产的技术效率水平如何？影响技术效率的关键决定因素有哪些？
AI.motivation: 提格雷地区农业生产力低于全国平均水平，原始耕作方式和高投入成本导致低产，严重威胁家庭粮食安全和收入稳定。因此，亟需评估苔麸生产的技术效率并识别其决定因素，以制定针对性的政策干预措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机前沿生产函数（Stochastic Frontier Approach, SFA），该模型将产出偏差分解为随机误差和技术无效率两部分，用于估计生产前沿面和各农户的技术效率水平。
AI.method: 采用多阶段抽样方法选取392户苔麸种植农户，运用随机前沿生产函数估计技术效率，并分析影响效率的社会经济与农艺因素。
AI.findings: (1) 平均技术效率为87.3%，效率损失导致每tsmdi产量减少49.79公斤（约合ETB 1,394.12）；(2) 地块面积、化肥、农药和种子对产量有显著正向影响；(3) 牲畜数量、农业收入、除草频率和男性户主与更高效率正相关；(4) 出乎意料的是，较高教育水平的户主反而表现出更低的效率，这与作者预期及主流文献相悖。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在教育水平与农业技术效率关系上的反常发现（教育水平越高效率越低），挑战了传统人力资本理论中教育总是提升生产效率的假设，为特定农业情境下的效率研究提供了异质性证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议政策制定者关注化肥、农药的供应与可获得性，改善耕作方式（如除草等农艺实践），以提升苔麸产量和农户效率；同时需重新审视农业推广教育的内容与方式，确保教育对生产效率产生正向促进作用。

title: Evaluating The Financial Performance and Impact of Primary Agricultural Cooperative Societies on Farmers in Haryana, India
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Chaudhary Devi Lal University and Chaudhary Devi Lal University

detail.title: Evaluating The Financial Performance and Impact of Primary Agricultural Cooperative Societies on Farmers in Haryana, India
detail.abstract: Aim: The study evaluates the financial viability of primary agricultural cooperative societies (PACS) in Haryana and their impact on agricultural costs, returns, and production. It also examines farmers' loan repayment behavior and challenges in accessing credit. Material and Methods: Using both primary and secondary data, the research surveyed 540 respondents and applied methods like averages, compound annual growth rate (CAGR), and cost-benefit analysis. Results: Findings indicate that PACS in Haryana have shown financial growth, with increased owned funds and deposits, yet they remain dependent on borrowings. Loan recovery rates are uneven, and 70-85% of PACS operate at a loss, highlighting the need for financial strengthening and government support. PACS credit significantly improves costs, returns, and the benefit-cost ratio for beneficiary farmers, contributing to financial sustainability and higher agricultural output. Costs and gross returns increased across all beneficiary categories, reinforcing the positive impact of PACS credit. Additionally, while most farmers repay their loans, a small percentage defaults due to restrictive loan conditions and policy expectations. The study also identifies various challenges faced by farmers in accessing PACS credit, underscoring the need for policy reforms. Conclusions: This study will support policymakers in shaping a holistic approach toward securing the long-term viability of PACS.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了印度哈里亚纳邦初级农业合作社（PACS）的财务可行性及其对农业成本、收益和生产的影响，发现PACS虽有财务增长但70-85%处于亏损状态，其信贷能显著改善农户的经济效益，同时揭示了贷款偿还问题和信贷获取挑战。
AI.research_question: 哈里亚纳邦初级农业合作社（PACS）的财务可行性如何？PACS信贷对农业成本、收益和生产有何影响？农户的贷款偿还行为及信贷获取面临哪些挑战？
AI.motivation: PACS在印度农业信贷体系中扮演关键角色，但其财务可持续性和实际效果尚不明确，尤其缺乏对哈里亚纳邦PACS的系统性评估，研究旨在为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农业金融理论、合作经济理论、成本-收益分析框架
AI.method: 混合方法：使用初级和次级数据，调查540名受访者，采用平均值、复合年增长率（CAGR）和成本-收益分析等方法。
AI.findings: （1）PACS自有资金和存款增长，但仍依赖借款，70-85%的PACS处于亏损状态；（2）PACS信贷显著改善了受益农户的成本、收益和收益-成本比；（3）多数农户按时还款，但少数因贷款限制条件和政策预期而违约；（4）农户在获取PACS信贷时面临多重挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 为农业合作社金融可行性研究提供了哈里亚纳邦的实证证据，验证了PACS信贷对农业产出和农户经济效益的正向作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供PACS财务强化、贷款偿还机制优化和信贷获取障碍消除的具体政策建议，助力合作社的长期可持续发展。

title: The Etymology of Mathematics  - How Language Shaped the Evolution and Utility of Mathematical thought
affiliations: University of Birmingham

detail.title: The Etymology of Mathematics  - How Language Shaped the Evolution and Utility of Mathematical thought
detail.abstract: Mathematics is commonly portrayed as a universal language whose truths exist independently of history, culture, and human speech. Yet the historical development of mathematics suggests a more subtle reality. Mathematical revolutions have frequently coincided with linguistic revolutions. New mathematical worlds often emerged only after humanity acquired new conceptual vocabularies with which to speak about reality. This paper argues that the evolution of mathematics cannot be understood solely through the history of symbols, proofs, and formal systems. It must also be understood through the history of words. From the earth-measuring geometry of antiquity, through the algorithmic imagination of the Islamic Golden Age, to the structural abstractions of nineteenth-century Germany and the informational turn of the twentieth century, mathematical language has continually expanded the space of the mathematically conceivable. Language has acted simultaneously as an enabling and constraining force, shaping both what mathematics could become and how useful it could be to civilisation. The paper further argues that contemporary challenges in complexity science and artificial intelligence may represent not merely technical problems but linguistic ones. The future development of mathematics may depend as much upon the invention of new conceptual vocabularies as upon the discovery of new theorems.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨数学与语言之间的深层关系，认为数学的演进不仅依赖于符号和形式系统，更依赖于人类不断发明新的概念词汇。从古代几何到信息时代，语言既是数学思想的催化剂也是约束，当前AI和复杂性科学的挑战本质上是语言学问题。
AI.research_question: 数学的演化在多大程度上受制于人类所拥有的概念性语言？语言是数学发展的推动力还是约束力？
AI.motivation: 传统观点将数学视为超越历史文化的普遍语言，但数学史上重大突破往往伴随语言革命，表明数学发展不能脱离词汇史来理解。当代复杂性科学和人工智能的困境可能并非纯粹技术问题，而是语言表达能力的局限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 语言相对论（语言塑造思维边界）、科学知识社会学（知识的社会建构）、数学哲学中的形式主义与直觉主义之争
AI.method: 历史分析法：梳理从古埃及/巴比伦几何、伊斯兰黄金时代的算法传统、19世纪德国结构主义到20世纪信息转向等关键历史节点的语言变革
AI.findings: 数学概念词汇的每一次扩展都打开了新的数学可能性空间；语言同时起到赋能（enabling）和约束（constraining）的双重作用；历史上数学革命与语言革命高度同步
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战"数学是超越语言的文化普遍物"的传统观念，提出数学语言不仅是表达工具，更是数学思维的构成性要素，将数学哲学讨论从符号系统拓展到自然语言层面
AI.practical_contributions: 为应对复杂性科学和AI挑战提供新视角：推动数学未来发展的关键可能在于发明新的概念性词汇而非仅追求新定理，对跨学科研究和教育有启示意义

title: Engineering Cognitive Differentiation in Professional Military Education: The 3D Framework (DIRECT–DELIVER–DISCERN) and a Design-Science Approach to Aligning a Constrained Strategy Curriculum across a Three-Tier Staff College Tamrongchai Noonpugdee
affiliations: Armed Forces War College

detail.title: Engineering Cognitive Differentiation in Professional Military Education: The 3D Framework (DIRECT–DELIVER–DISCERN) and a Design-Science Approach to Aligning a Constrained Strategy Curriculum across a Three-Tier Staff College Tamrongchai Noonpugdee
detail.abstract: The professional military education system habitually presents a single body of subject matter to cohorts whose graduates will serve at vastly divergent echelons. A single strategy syllabus at Thailand's National Defence Studies Institute writs three courses-a senior staff course, joint staff course and senior officer course-but a binding course specification frozen until 2027 prohibits adding, removing or re-houring any subject The only other free design variables are depth, the method of instruction, and assessment. This paper reconstructs and theorizes the design logic that was invented to address this challenge. It defies two elements: established instructional-design theory (Bloom's revised taxonomy, constructive-alignment, backward design, the ADDIE model plus a knowledge-management cycle) and an original heuristic directing the depth of inquiry applied via its 3D framework to structure-DIRECT-DELIVER-DISCERN-each course with deliberate mapping along their graduate role and a target band of cognitive demand. This claim is measured and baldfacedly modest about novelty: cognitive-level differentiation of instruction is not new, but already galore published syntheses; it eschews an originality-fragging subtype in the build, reusing Lykke's three-legged strategy stool as a schema for strategic-thinker formation, co-suturing it to cohort identity (DIRECT-DELIVER-DISCERN) and a multi-dimension differentiation matrix that pitches one topic for deliberation at three decision levels, such that the whole seems concertinaed through design-science fashions into a single operational artefact: division KM manual-forms system + worked exemplars-what also incorporates an intention tracking even unbroken from objective to scenario to scoring rubric. The paper is honest about its limits: it shows design and theoretical coherence (two out of three bumps in the axial triad), but not yet effectiveness, which remains future work. The pattern is made available for transferability to any tiered education system that is compelled to distinguish between shared content within a controlled specification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在固定课程规范下，通过认知深度、教学方法和评估等自由变量，对同一教学内容进行多层次差异化设计的理论框架，以解决泰国国防研究院多层级军官培养体系中“统一内容、分层输出”的结构性矛盾。
AI.research_question: 如何在课程内容、课时等变量被冻结的前提下，仅通过调整教学深度、教学法和评估方式，实现面向不同层级（高级参谋、联合参谋、高级军官）学员的差异化教学？
AI.motivation: 泰国国防研究院的军事教育体系面对一个困境：不同层级军官所需的能力不同，但课程内容（教学大纲）在2027年前无法修改。因此亟需一种在不改动内容的前提下，对同一主题按照不同认知要求和角色定位进行分层教学的设计逻辑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了布鲁姆修订版分类学、建构性对齐、逆向设计、ADDIE模型、知识管理周期等教学设计理论，并原创性地提出了一个3D框架（DIRECT-DELIVER-DISCERN），结合Lykke战略三脚凳理论，将学员角色身份与认知需求层次匹配。
AI.method: 理论重构与设计科学方法，通过构建多维度差异化矩阵，将同一主题映射到三个决策层级，并保持从教学目标到情景再到评分量规的全链条意图追踪。
AI.findings: 提出了一个可操作的教学设计模式（包括KM手册系统和工作示例），在理论上和设计上证明了连贯性（轴向三元组中的两个维度），但有效性尚未得到实证检验。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Lykke战略三脚凳理论创新性地应用于军事教育中的战略思维塑造，并将其与学员角色身份（DIRECT-DELIVER-DISCERN）进行缝合；提出了一个在固定课程规范下实现认知层级差异化的通用设计逻辑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为任何受限于统一课程规范但需面向不同层级学员的教育系统（尤其是军事教育）提供了一种可迁移、可操作的差异化教学设计模式，包括具体的KM手册表单系统和工作示例。

title: Ifrs S1 And Ifrs S2 Adoption Readiness Among Listed Firms in Subsaharan Africa: A Multi-Country Empirical Assessment
affiliations: University of Benin

detail.title: Ifrs S1 And Ifrs S2 Adoption Readiness Among Listed Firms in Subsaharan Africa: A Multi-Country Empirical Assessment
detail.abstract:
The International Sustainability Standards Board (ISSB) issued IFRS S1 (General Requirements for Disclosure of Sustainability-related Financial Information) and IFRS S2 (Climate-related Disclosures) in June 2023, establishing the first coherent global baseline for investor-focused sustainability reporting. Despite growing urgency of adoption across capital markets worldwide, Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) remains significantly under-researched in terms of firm-level readiness to implement these transformative disclosure standards. This paper addresses that gap through a comprehensive multi-country assessment of IFRS S1 and S2 adoption readiness among listed firms in five SSA jurisdictions: Nigeria, South Africa, Kenya, Ghana, and Rwanda. 
 Drawing on institutional theory, legitimacy theory, stakeholder theory, and the resource-based view, we develop the Sub-Saharan Readiness Index (SSRI), a novel 100-point composite instrument that maps firm-level disclosures against the four ISSB core content pillars: governance, strategy, risk management, and metrics and targets. The paper extends the industry-specific methodology pioneered by Faloore (2025) in his SSRN working paper assessing carbon accounting and ESG adoption in Nigeria's cement sector, and scales it to a cross-country, multi-industry context. We synthesise evidence from documented early adopters across the region — including Nigeria's four trailblazers (MTN Nigeria, Seplat Energy, Access Holdings, and Fidelity Bank) and Kenya's KCB Group — and triangulate this with regulatory data from the FRC Nigeria's four-phased Adoption Roadmap (2024, amended 2026), ICPAK's phased framework (2023), the JSE Sustainability Disclosure Guidance, and Rwanda's ICPAR Roadmap (2025).
Our illustrative analysis reveals three core findings. First, while Nigeria has demonstrated exceptional regulatory leadership — becoming the first country in Africa to declare its intention to adopt ISSB standards at COP27 in November 2022 and the first to produce documented early adopters — the breadth of readiness beyond that pioneering quartet remains narrow, and Scope 3 GHG measurement constitutes a near-universal gap. Second, South Africa's integrated reporting legacy provides the region's most favourable institutional preconditions for adoption, yet formal mandatory timelines remain unset. Third, firm size, Big Four audit engagement, and board-level sustainability expertise are the principal determinants of readiness variance, consistent with institutional and resource-based predictions. The paper concludes with granular, jurisdiction-specific policy recommendations and forward-looking assessment of the structural investments necessary for broad-based compliance.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了撒哈拉以南非洲五国（尼日利亚、南非、肯尼亚、加纳、卢旺达）上市公司对ISSB发布的IFRS S1和S2可持续披露准则的采用准备度，构建了SSRI指数，发现尼日利亚监管领先但Scope 3温室气体测量普遍缺失，南非整合报告基础最好但缺乏强制时间表，企业规模、四大审计和董事会可持续专业能力是准备度差异的主因。
AI.research_question: 撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）五国上市公司对IFRS S1和S2可持续披露准则的采用准备度如何？哪些因素决定了准备度的差异？
AI.motivation: ISSB于2023年6月发布了首个全球可持续报告基线准则，全球资本市场迫切需要采用，但撒哈拉以南非洲地区在企业层面的准备度研究严重不足。本文旨在填补这一空白，为该地区政策制定和合规路径提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论、合法性理论、利益相关者理论、资源基础观（RBV）
AI.method: 开发了SSRI（撒哈拉以南非洲准备度指数），一个100分制的综合工具，将企业披露映射到ISSB四大核心支柱（治理、战略、风险管理、指标与目标）；采用多国多行业比较分析；整合早期采用者证据和监管数据（FRC尼日利亚路线图、ICPAK框架、JSE指引、ICPAR路线图）。
AI.findings: 1) 尼日利亚监管领导力突出（首个在COP27宣布采用ISSB的非洲国家，拥有4家率先采用企业），但准备度范围狭窄，Scope 3温室气体测量近乎普遍缺失；2) 南非整合报告传统提供最佳制度前提，但正式强制时间表未定；3) 企业规模、四大审计参与和董事会可持续专业能力是准备度差异的主要决定因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 将制度理论、合法性理论、利益相关者理论与资源基础观整合应用于新兴市场可持续披露采用情境，验证了企业规模、审计质量和董事会专业能力作为制度压力和资源禀赋代理变量的解释力。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了SSRI指数这一可操作的评估工具，为SSA各国监管机构提供了针对性的政策建议，识别了Scope 3测量等关键能力缺口，为企业和投资者判断区域准备度提供了基准。

title: Competitive Position of the Polish and Ukrainian Dairy Industry
affiliations: Warsaw School of Economics (SGH)

detail.title: Competitive Position of the Polish and Ukrainian Dairy Industry
detail.abstract: Aim: Identification of the competitive position of Poland and Ukraine in foreign trade in selected main products of the dairy industry from 2021 to 2023. Material and Methods: To assess the level of mutual competitiveness of the Polish and Ukrainian dairy industries on foreign markets (EU and non-EU), the export-import coverage index (TC), indicators of revealed comparative advantages, including the index of relative comparative export advantage (XRCA), the index of relative import absorption capacity (MRCA) and the index of relative trade advantage (RTA) were used. Results: From 2021 to 2023, Poland had high comparative advantages in foreign trade in dairy products. The competitive position of the Ukrainian dairy industry in relation to Poland is assessed as moderately high, despite the lack of self-sufficiency in dairy products, underutilization of processing capacity with raw materials, negative balance of foreign trade in dairy products. Ukraine had higher comparative advantages than Poland on foreign markets in the case of trade in butter and milk fat, condensed and powdered milk, and whey. Poland has greater competitive advantages than Ukraine in the production of liquid milk and cream. There is no competition in the field of cheeses and cottage cheeses as well as yogurts and fermented beverages. Conclusions: In order to maintain and increase the competitiveness of dairy production, Poland should implement modern innovative technologies and develop breeding. Polish and Ukrainian dairy industries have opportunities for cooperation at the stage of production and trade in dairy products. This study can be used to create a development strategy for the Polish dairy industry.

AI.tldr: 本文利用多种贸易指数（TC、XRCA、MRCA、RTA），分析了2021-2023年波兰与乌克兰在乳制品（黄油、奶粉、乳清、液态奶等）外贸中的竞争地位，发现波兰整体优势显著，乌克兰在黄油、奶粉和乳清上更具优势，两国在奶酪等品类上不构成竞争，且存在合作空间。
AI.research_question: 2021-2023年期间，波兰与乌克兰在乳制品主要产品的外贸中，各自的竞争地位如何？
AI.motivation: 识别两国乳制品行业在欧盟与非欧盟市场上的相互竞争力水平，为波兰乳制品行业的发展战略提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较优势理论；国际贸易竞争力评价指标体系（出口-进口覆盖率指数TC、相对出口比较优势指数XRCA、相对进口吸收能力指数MRCA、相对贸易优势指数RTA）。
AI.method: 计算并比较TC、XRCA、MRCA、RTA四项贸易竞争力指数，覆盖2021-2023年波兰与乌克兰的乳制品对外贸易数据。
AI.findings: （1）波兰整体在乳制品外贸中具有高比较优势；（2）乌克兰竞争地位为"中等偏高"，但存在产品非自足、加工能力利用不足、外贸逆差等问题；（3）乌克兰在黄油/乳脂、浓缩奶粉、乳清上比波兰更具优势；（4）波兰在液态奶和奶油上更具优势；（5）奶酪、酸奶等品类上两国不存在直接竞争。
AI.theory_contributions: 运用多维度比较优势指数（XRCA、MRCA、RTA）系统评估了俄乌冲突背景下两个邻国乳制品行业的竞争格局，补充了中东欧农产品贸易竞争力研究的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为波兰乳制品行业建议采用创新技术与育种以维持竞争力；指出波乌两国在乳制品生产与贸易环节存在合作机遇；为波兰乳制品行业发展策略制定提供参考依据。

title: Cloud LLMs, Local Models, and the Case for Human-Bounded Scholarship

detail.title: Cloud LLMs, Local Models, and the Case for Human-Bounded Scholarship
detail.abstract: This essay asks where the world is actually putting its compute, its capital, and its trust, and argues that the convergent answer carries a lesson for scholarship. As of mid-2026 the evidence does not show that large models are failing or that scaling has stopped paying; it shows a direction of travel — across the technical substrate, the capital markets, the international landscape, the return-focused analyst class, and the security establishment — toward right-sizing: frontier-scale cloud models reserved for a minority of genuinely hard tasks, with smaller, local, and sovereign models carrying the bulk of practical, sensitive, and high-volume work. Beneath the economics sits an epistemic fact: scaling and retrieval improve fluency, recall, and the provenance a model can display, but they do not reliably close the gap between provenance and veracity. That gap is what human verification exists to close. The prescription that follows is the essay's thesis — a human-bounded, Maestro standard for scholarship in which the human retains intellectual sovereignty and directs the model as an instrument. The claim is calibrated to present evidence and is defeasible: a material advance in scaling, training efficiency, architecture, or a novel compute substrate such as quantum could shift the balance.

AI.tldr: 截至2026年中，证据表明AI发展正走向"适度规模"：前沿模型处理少数困难任务，小型/本地/主权模型承担大量实际工作。在学术领域，应坚持"人机协奏"标准，人类保留智识主权，模型作为工具使用。
AI.research_question: 世界的算力、资本和信任究竟投向何处？这为学术研究带来什么启示？
AI.motivation: 澄清关于大模型是否失败或规模扩展是否失效的争论，指出实际发展方向的转变及其对学术界的含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: "适度规模"（right-sizing）理论：前沿云端模型用于少数困难任务，小型/本地/主权模型承担大多数工作。"协奏"（Maestro）标准：人类保持智识主权，将模型视为工具。
AI.method: 基于截至2026年中期的证据，从技术基础、资本市场、国际格局、分析师群体和安全机构五个维度进行综合分析。
AI.findings: 没有证据表明大模型失败或规模扩展失效；趋势是"适度规模"分布。规模扩展和检索增强能提升流畅性和可追溯性，但无法可靠弥合可追溯性与真实性的差距，这个差距需要人工验证来填补。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"人机协奏"（Maestro）标准作为学术研究的新规范，重新定义了人类与AI在知识生产中的关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学术界提供了一套可操作的标准：人类应保持智识主权，将模型定位为工具而非替代品。同时指出，如果出现规模化效率、架构或量子计算等重大突破，这一结论可能改变。

title: Measuring Enterprise AI Value in the Agentic AI Era: A Closed-Loop Framework for Adoption, Decision Intelligence, and ROI Optimization -Vinay Kumar Polamarasetty
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Measuring Enterprise AI Value in the Agentic AI Era: A Closed-Loop Framework for Adoption, Decision Intelligence, and ROI Optimization -Vinay Kumar Polamarasetty
detail.abstract: One of the biggest questions enterprises face today is whether they are investing in the right AI initiatives and whether those investments are generating meaningful returns. Organizations are spending heavily on artificial intelligence, yet many still lack a clear way to evaluate return on investment (ROI) across the full lifecycle of AI implementation. Existing approaches often rely on isolated metrics such as adoption, model performance, usage, or post-deployment financial ROI, but these signals rarely provide a complete picture of enterprise AI success. In practice, AI value is created through a combination of successful adoption, high-quality decisions during implementation, and continuous optimization of business outcomes. Without a unified framework connecting these stages, enterprises often make critical investment decisions using fragmented or incomplete information. This paper proposes the Enterprise AI Value Optimization Framework (EAVOF), a closed-loop framework for measuring, diagnosing, and optimizing enterprise AI value from adoption through implementation and long-term ROI realization. EAVOF integrates two foundational components from prior work, an adoption readiness model for measuring AI adoption maturity and a decision intelligence framework for evaluating implementation decisions, along with a new dependency-driven ROI optimization layer that closes the enterprise AI value loop. The framework is validated using Monte Carlo simulation across 1,000 simulated enterprise AI project scenarios, sensitivity analysis, stress testing, and public enterprise case studies. Results indicate that enterprise AI value is often constrained by the weakest dependency across adoption, execution, and outcome realization. By explicitly identifying these bottlenecks, EAVOF provides enterprises with a practical framework to improve ROI visibility, reduce investment uncertainty, and make more informed AI investment decisions. Problem Statement Enterprises today are rapidly investing in AI, but many are doing so without a clear structure for measuring success. In practice, organizations often define AI goals using isolated or arbitrary metrics such as adoption rate, usage frequency, number of AI agents deployed, productivity gains, or short-term ROI. While these metrics provide partial signals, they rarely explain whether the enterprise is investing in the right AI initiatives or whether those initiatives are creating meaningful long-term value. As a result, many organizations are optimizing local success metrics without understanding the bigger picture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出企业AI价值优化框架（EAVOF），一个从采用、实施到长期ROI的闭环测量与优化框架，通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证，发现企业AI价值常受最弱依赖环节的制约。
AI.research_question: 企业如何系统性地衡量、诊断和优化AI投资从采用到实施再到长期ROI的全生命周期价值？
AI.motivation: 企业大量投资AI但缺乏统一的成功度量框架，现有方法依赖孤立指标（如采用率、使用频率、模型性能等），无法提供完整的价值图景，导致投资决策基于碎片化信息。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业AI价值优化框架（EAVOF），整合了采用就绪度模型、决策智能框架，以及新增的依赖驱动ROI优化层，形成闭环价值度量体系。
AI.method: 蒙特卡洛模拟（1,000个企业AI项目场景）、敏感性分析、压力测试、公开企业案例研究。
AI.findings: 企业AI价值常受采用、执行与成果实现中最弱的依赖环节制约（木桶效应）；EAVOF能明确识别这些瓶颈，帮助企业提升ROI可见性、降低投资不确定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了连接AI采用、实施决策与长期ROI的闭环理论框架，揭示了企业AI价值创造中的依赖结构瓶颈机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了可操作的AI投资评估工具，帮助识别价值瓶颈、优化投资决策、降低不确定性，实现从碎片化指标到系统性价值管理。

title: Hospital working conditions and perceived usability of electronic health records at different stages of system maturity: a repeated cross-sectional study of medical doctors and nurses

detail.title: Hospital working conditions and perceived usability of electronic health records at different stages of system maturity: a repeated cross-sectional study of medical doctors and nurses
detail.abstract: ABSTRACT Background Sector-wide patient-centred electronic health record (EHR) systems are widely used and implemented in hospital settings. However, little is known about how the perceived usability of these systems vary across different working conditions. This study examines whether medical doctors’ and nurses’ perceptions of the usability of a long-established electronic patient record (EPR) system and a recently adopted EHR system differ according to work schedules, work pace, employment percentage, and the number of clinical sites.Methods This repeated cross-sectional study used data from a university hospital collected during the use of a former facility-centred EPR system and 14 months after the adoption of a recent EHR system. The study included 543 medical doctors and 1,869 nurses who participated in at least one survey during 2021-2022 or in 2024. Perceived usability was assessed using an ease-of-use item in both surveys and the System Usability Scale (SUS) 14 months after adoption of the EHR system.Results In the former EPR system, nurses working rotating shifts or reporting a high work pace had lower odds of better ease-of-use than those working daytime shifts or reporting a low work pace. Medical doctors working across 3-4 clinical sites had higher odds of better ease-of-use than medical doctors working across 1-2 sites. Following adoption of the EHR system, the median and mean SUS scores for both medical doctors and nurses were lower when working under high-paced conditions compared with low-paced conditions. In addition, nurses employed part-time had lower SUS scores than those employed full-time. Nurses working across 3-4 clinical sites had lower SUS scores than nurses working across 1-2 sites.Conclusion This study suggests that health professionals’ perceptions of usability vary across working conditions in a hospital setting and that these associations may depend on the maturity of the system.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了医生和护士在不同工作条件下（轮班、工作节奏、就业比例、临床站点数量）对电子健康记录系统的可用性感知差异，发现工作条件与感知可用性显著相关，且这种关联取决于系统的成熟度。
AI.research_question: 医务人员对电子健康记录系统的感知可用性如何因不同工作条件（工作时间表、工作节奏、就业比例、临床站点数量）而存在差异？
AI.motivation: 尽管以患者为中心的电子健康记录系统在医院广泛应用，但关于这些系统的感知可用性如何因不同工作条件而变化的研究十分有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统可用性感知、人机交互、工作条件因素（轮班制、工作节奏、就业比例、跨站点工作）与系统成熟度的交互作用。
AI.method: 重复横截面研究，数据来自某大学医院，涵盖旧EPR系统使用期间和新EHR系统采用14个月后，共纳入543名医生和1869名护士，采用易用性项目和系统可用性量表（SUS）进行评估。
AI.findings: 旧系统中，轮班或高工作节奏的护士可用性感知较低；跨3-4个站点的医生可用性感知更高。新系统中，高工作节奏下医生和护士的SUS分数均较低；兼职护士SUS分数低于全职；跨3-4个站点的护士SUS分数低于跨1-2个站点。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了工作条件与系统可用性感知之间的关系，并指出这种关系依赖于系统成熟度，为医疗人机交互领域提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医院管理者在实施和优化EHR系统时考虑不同工作条件（如轮班、工作节奏、兼职员工、多站点工作）提供了实践指导，有助于提升系统采用率和用户满意度。

title: EXPLAINABLE ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE FOR TRANSPARENT DECISION-MAKING IN DIGITAL ECONOMIC PLATFORMS
affiliations: Lanzhou University of Finance and Economics and Gansu University of Chinese Medicine

detail.title: EXPLAINABLE ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE FOR TRANSPARENT DECISION-MAKING IN DIGITAL ECONOMIC PLATFORMS
detail.abstract: The rapid changing trends in digital economic platforms, more and more structured data becomes available, requiring more sophisticated and interpretable models for successful decision making. Unfortunately, most current models cannot guarantee transparency and reliable insights to be used in platform-level decisions. Thus, the purpose of this research is to design and develop a transparent deep learning models which is capable of producing highly accurate predictions while remaining fully interpretable in terms of decision-making processes within digital economics. Moreover, this study will attempt to convert predictive results into meaningful information for developing successful platform-level strategies and policies. To this end, the model will use the E-commerce Customer Behavior Dataset (ECBD), which will be preprocessed and then combined with feature engineering and selection to be used as inputs for a TabNet (attention-based tabular neural network) model. In order to optimize the model, we will use Adam optimization algorithm to obtain higher accuracy and better stability of model training. We will also apply SHAP based approach to make the model explanations globally and locally interpretable. It should be noted that in the experimental analysis, a very high level of effectiveness was obtained, with Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-Score, and ROC-AUC equal to 0.9797, 0.9693, 0.9602, 0.9647, and 0.9797, respectively. It can be stated that the proposed algorithm is characterized by increased stability and efficiency when training, as well as better generalizability when compared with the approaches based on the classical machine learning methodology. In addition, the analysis of explainability makes it possible to understand the key influencing factors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于TabNet与SHAP的可解释深度学习模型，用于数字经济平台决策，在电商客户行为数据集上取得了高精度（准确率97.97%），并实现了全局与局部可解释性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种既保持高预测精度又具备完全可解释性的深度学习模型，以支持数字经济平台层面的决策制定？
AI.motivation: 现有模型无法同时保证透明性和可靠洞察，难以用于平台层面的决策；数字平台需要更复杂且可解释的模型来应对快速增长的结构化数据。
AI.theoretical_framework: TabNet（基于注意力的表格神经网络）、SHAP可解释性框架、Adam优化算法
AI.method: 使用电商客户行为数据集（ECBD），进行预处理、特征工程与选择，构建TabNet模型，采用Adam优化器训练，并应用SHAP进行全局与局部可解释性分析。
AI.findings: 模型在准确率、精确率、召回率、F1分数和ROC-AUC上分别达到0.9797、0.9693、0.9602、0.9647和0.9797；相比经典机器学习方法，训练稳定性、效率和泛化性更优；可解释性分析揭示了关键影响因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将TabNet与SHAP结合的可解释深度学习框架，弥合了高精度预测与模型透明性之间的理论缺口，为数字经济平台决策提供了新的方法论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字经济平台提供了可落地的预测与解释工具，能够将预测结果转化为有意义的平台策略与政策制定依据，提升决策的可信度与可操作性。
