detail.title: The Global Green Finance Index 15
detail.abstract: Beginning in March 2018, as part of its Long Finance initiative, Z/Yen published the first five editions of the Global Green Finance Index with the generous support of the MAVA Foundation, and more recently with support from Abu Dhabi Global Market. Z/Yen continues this work and is pleased to present the fourteenth edition of the Global Green Finance Index (GGFI 15). Z/Yen helps organisations make better choices-our clients consider us a commercial think-tank that spots, solves, and acts. Our name combines Zen and Yen-'a philosophical desire to succeed'-in a ratio, recognising that all decisions are trade-offs. One of Z/Yen's specialisms is the development and publication of research combining factor analysis and professional assessments. Long Finance is a Z/Yen initiative designed to address the question "When would we know our financial system is working?" This question underlies Long Finance's goal to improve society's understanding and use of finance over the long-term. In contrast to the short-termism that defines today's economic views the Long Finance time-frame is roughly 100 years.

title: From Curves to Options: A Variational Theory of Optimal Market Making

detail.title: From Curves to Options: A Variational Theory of Optimal Market Making
detail.abstract: We study the problem of optimal automated market maker (AMM) design. Any twoasset constant-function market maker is fully characterized by its liquidity distribution ℓ(p), the density of capital deployed at each marginal price p. We formulate AMM design as an infinite-dimensional optimization over ℓ, maximizing a joint welfare objective that captures liquidity-provider (LP) surplus (fee revenue net of loss-versus-rebalancing) and trader surplus (price-impact costs), subject to a capital budget constraint. Using the calculus of variations, we derive a closed-form optimal liquidity distribution ℓ * (p) under geometric Brownian motion price dynamics and an exogenous trading-volume distribution π. Classical AMM curves emerge as special cases: the constant-product formula of Uniswap v2 corresponds to the log-uniform (scale-invariant) volume prior π(p) ∝ p-1 (the steeper prior π(p) ∝ p-5/4 instead yields the geometric mean market maker with exponent 1/4); the Stableswap invariant corresponds to a prior concentrated near price parity; a single Uniswap v3 tick corresponds to a Dirac volume measure. We establish a duality between AMM design and options portfolio construction via the Carr-Madan representation: every liquidity distribution is equivalent to a short position in a continuum of vanilla options, and ℓ * is the solution to a minimum-cost replication problem under the market-implied riskneutral measure. We extend the framework to a distributionally robust setting, showing that chi-squared ambiguity in the volume distribution acts as a regularizer that spreads optimal liquidity relative to the non-robust solution. Calibrating to on-chain Uniswap v3 data across three structurally distinct pools (ETH/USDC, WBTC/ETH, and USDC/USDT), we document that realized LP liquidity departs systematically from the optimum-a welfare gap that is positive and statistically robust in every pool-while the precise shape of the departure is only partially identified, being confounded by non-stationarity of the volume distribution in the two trending pools.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上推导了自动化做市商（AMM）的最优流动性分布，发现经典AMM曲线（如Uniswap v2、Stableswap）是特定交易量先验下的特例，并建立了AMM设计与期权组合之间的对偶关系。实证发现链上实际流动性分布与理论最优存在显著且稳健的福利差距。
AI.research_question: 如何设计最优的自动化做市商（AMM），即找到使联合福利最大化的最优流动性分布ℓ*(p)？
AI.motivation: AMM是DeFi的核心基础设施，但现有AMM设计（如Uniswap v2、v3、Stableswap等）多为启发式设计，缺乏统一的最优化理论框架。本文旨在填补这一空白，从福利经济学视角给出AMM设计的理论最优解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 变分法（Calculus of Variations）：用于在连续价格空间上求解最优流动性分布；2) 几何布朗运动价格动力学假设；3) Carr-Madan期权组合表示定理：建立流动性分布与期权组合的对偶关系；4) 分布鲁棒优化（Distributionally Robust Optimization）：引入卡方散度刻画交易量分布的不确定性。
AI.method: 理论推导为主，辅以实证校准。理论部分使用变分法求解无限维优化问题；实证部分使用链上Uniswap v3数据（ETH/USDC、WBTC/ETH、USDC/USDT三个结构性不同的池）校准模型，比较实际流动性分布与理论最优的差异。
AI.findings: 1) 经典AMM曲线是最优解的特例：Uniswap v2对应log-uniform先验（π(p)∝p⁻¹），Uniswap v3单个tick对应Dirac测度，Stableswap对应集中在平价附近的先验；2) 最优流动性分布等价于最小成本复制期权组合的解；3) 分布鲁棒优化中的卡方模糊度作为正则化项使流动性分布更分散；4) 实证发现Uniswap v3的实际流动性分布系统性地偏离最优解，福利损失在三个池中均显著且稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次从联合福利最大化视角给出AMM设计的完备理论框架；2) 揭示了AMM设计与期权复制理论之间的深层对偶关系；3) 将分布鲁棒优化引入AMM设计领域，处理交易量分布不确定性问题；4) 统一解释了已有AMM曲线（常数乘积、几何平均、Stableswap等）的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为AMM协议设计者提供了可计算的最优流动性分布公式，指导更高效的流动性部署；2) 实证发现了Uniswap v3实际运行中的系统性福利损失，为协议改进提供方向；3) 为LP（流动性提供者）提供基准参考，帮助理解当前流动性分布的低效程度；4) 鲁棒优化版本为应对交易量分布变化提供了更稳健的AMM设计方案。

title: Valuing American options and Flexible Forwards contracts in time-dependent models
affiliations: Bank of America, New York University (NYU) - NYU Tandon School of Engineering and

detail.title: Valuing American options and Flexible Forwards contracts in time-dependent models

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No potential conflict of interest was reported by the authors
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received

detail.abstract:
A flexible forward (FF) is a customized FX hedging instrument that guarantees a fixed exchange rate while letting the holder choose the delivery date within a pre-agreed window. It is therefore an American-style option on timing, and its valuation must respect the volatility skew of the underlying currency pair. We price FF contracts (and, more generally, American options) under a time-inhomogeneous Heston model which captures the forward-skew term structure while preserving analytical tractability through a recursive (matrix) Riccati solution for the joint characteristic function. Extending the integral-equation (decomposition) approach to time-dependent coefficients, we derive a Volterra equation characterizing the early-exercise surface. The expectation in the decomposition formula is evaluated by two  complementary spectral methods: a double cosine (COS) expansion of the transition density, and a damped-Sinc (DSINC) local-basis scheme that is more accurate and stays robust when a low Feller ratio or large vol-of-vol induces Gibbs oscillations in the COS series. Benchmarked against a penalty-iteration MCS-ADI finite-difference solver, both methods price a contract in about 1-2 seconds, roughly an order of magnitude faster than the finest finite-difference grid, while DSINC improves median accuracy over COS by about a factor of twelve. The experiments also show that the early-exercise surface is a substantially nonlinear function of the variance, contrary to the linear-in-variance
approximation common in earlier work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在时间非齐次Heston模型下为灵活远期（FF）合约（及美式期权）定价的方法，通过递归Riccati解和两种谱方法（COS和DSINC）实现快速准确的计算，并发现提前行权曲面与方差呈显著非线性关系。
AI.research_question: 如何在考虑波动率偏斜（volatility skew）的条件下，对灵活远期（flexible forward）合约（一种美式期权）进行高效且准确的定价？
AI.motivation: 灵活远期合约是定制化的外汇对冲工具，允许持有者在预先约定的窗口内选择交割日期，其定价必须尊重底层货币对的波动率偏斜。现有方法在捕捉前向偏斜期限结构的同时保持解析可追溯性存在困难，且计算效率有待提升。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间非齐次Heston模型（time-inhomogeneous Heston model）；递归矩阵Riccati解（recursive matrix Riccati solution）；积分方程分解方法（integral-equation decomposition approach）；Volterra方程（Volterra equation）描述提前行权曲面。
AI.method: 1. 在时间非齐次Heston模型下推导联合特征函数的递归Riccati解；2. 将积分方程分解方法扩展到时间依赖系数情形，导出刻画提前行权曲面的Volterra方程；3. 采用两种互补谱方法计算期望：双余弦(COS)展开和阻尼Sinc(DSINC)局部基方案；4. 以惩罚迭代MCS-ADI有限差分求解器作为基准进行对比验证。
AI.findings: 1. 两种谱方法（COS和DSINC）均可在约1-2秒内完成定价，比最精细的有限差分网格快约一个数量级；2. DSINC方法的中位数精度比COS方法提升约12倍；3. DSINC在低Feller比率或高波动率波动（vol-of-vol）导致COS产生Gibbs振荡时保持稳健；4. 提前行权曲面是方差的高度非线性函数，与早期研究中常见的线性方差近似相反。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将积分方程分解方法推广到时间依赖系数情形，为美式期权定价提供了新的理论框架；2. 揭示了提前行权曲面与方差之间的本质非线性关系，修正了线性近似假设；3. 证明了阻尼Sinc方法在数值定价中相较于COS方法的优越性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为灵活远期合约（外汇对冲工具）提供了一种快速（约1-2秒）且高精度（DSINC中位数精度优于COS约12倍）的定价方案；2. 提出的方法具有解析可追溯性，便于实际金融工程实施；3. 对波动率偏斜的准确刻画有助于金融机构更精确地管理外汇衍生品风险。

title: Pólya-Gamma Bandits
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Pólya-Gamma Bandits
detail.abstract: Dynamic assortment optimization under a multinomial-logit (MNL) choice model is the canonical combinatorial bandit of revenue management. The optimal index policy-the Gittins index-is intractable here, and the state-of-the-art Thompson sampler keeps only a two-moment Gaussian approximation of the posterior, because the exact MNL posterior under choice feedback has no closed form. We remove the approximation. Following Scott (2010), we treat the bandit by randomized probability matching (Thompson sampling), and we make the matching exact: a stick-breaking representation turns each multinomial choice into a sequence of binary logits whose log-odds are linear in the parameter, so Pólya-Gamma augmentation (Polson et al., 2013) yields a conditionally Gaussian Gibbs sampler with no normalizing offset. The resulting PG-Thompson sampler is exact and cheap. In a reproducible study it attains 4.6× lower cumulative regret than the Gaussianapproximation sampler, and we trace the gap to calibration: under the adaptive, near-separated data a bandit generates, the Laplace-Gaussian posterior over-covers, so Thompson sampling overexplores; exact PG is near-nominal.

AI.tldr: 本文针对MNL选择模型下的动态品类优化问题（组合老虎机），提出了一种精确的PG-Thompson采样算法。通过stick-breaking表示和Pólya-Gamma增广技术，解决了MNL后验无闭式解的难题，实现了精确的概率匹配（而非高斯近似）。实验表明，该算法相比高斯近似Thompson采样器，累计遗憾降低4.6倍，原因在于精确后验校准更好，避免过度探索。
AI.research_question: 如何在MNL选择模型下的组合老虎机问题中，实现精确的Thompson采样（概率匹配），而不是依赖高斯近似？
AI.motivation: MNL模型下的动态品类优化是收益管理的经典组合老虎机问题。最优的Gittins指数策略难以计算；现有Thompson采样器仅采用两矩高斯近似后验，因为精确的MNL后验在选择反馈下没有闭式解。这种近似可能导致遗憾损失，需要无近似的精确方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) MNL选择模型（Multinomial Logit）；2) Thompson采样（概率匹配）；3) Stick-breaking表示（将多项选择转化为一系列二元Logit）；4) Pólya-Gamma增广（Polson等人，2013），实现条件高斯吉布斯采样。
AI.method: 提出PG-Thompson采样器：利用stick-breaking将每个多项选择分解为二元Logit序列（其对数优势比是参数的线性函数），再通过Pólya-Gamma增广得到条件高斯的吉布斯采样器，无需标准化偏移。该采样器是精确的（exact）且计算成本低。
AI.findings: 在可重复研究中，PG-Thompson采样器累计遗憾比高斯近似采样器低4.6倍。原因在于校准：在老虎机生成的自适应、近乎分离的数据下，Laplace-Gaussian后验过度覆盖（over-covers），导致Thompson采样过度探索；而精确的PG后验接近名义水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次实现了MNL组合老虎机中精确的Thompson采样，去除了高斯近似的限制；2) 揭示了近似后验在自适应数据下的过度覆盖（校准偏差）是遗憾损失的根源，为理解近似方法的偏差提供了理论洞见。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了一种精确且计算高效的PG-Thompson采样算法，可以在实际收益管理场景中显著降低累积遗憾（提升4.6倍）；2) 方法可复现，可落地应用于动态定价、推荐系统等组合选择问题。

title: Killing the Inner Loop: Amortized Bayesian Computation for Input Uncertainty
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Killing the Inner Loop: Amortized Bayesian Computation for Input Uncertainty
detail.abstract: Decision making with stochastic simulators must account for input uncertainty: the simulator's parameters are estimated, so a posterior sits over them. The textbook estimator of a risk functional of system performance is nested Monte Carlo-an outer loop over posterior draws, an inner simulation per draw-whose cost is the product of the two loop lengths and whose inner noise biases tail functionals. We replace the nested computation by a single amortized pass. Generative Bayesian computation trains one surrogate from (input, output) pairs, each costing a single short simulation, and propagates the entire posterior through the surrogate with no inner loop. On an M/M/1 queue with a Bayesian posterior over arrival and service rates, the amortized estimator of the 0.9-quantile of mean sojourn time is 2.8× more accurate than nested Monte Carlo at equal budget, and reaches accuracy nested simulation does not attain at any budget we test, because nested inner noise inflates the outer quantile. A sensitivity study shows the advantage is largest in the normal operating regime and narrows as utilization approaches saturation, where the response nears a singularity-an honest guide to when to use the surrogate and when to retain an inner loop. A second study, varying the amount of input data, shows the same boundary from the other side: the surrogate dominates by up to an order of magnitude once the input posterior is even moderately concentrated, and trails nested only when the posterior is so diffuse that it straddles the instability boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用生成式贝叶斯计算（生成式贝叶斯计算）替代嵌套蒙特卡洛（嵌套蒙特卡洛）方法，通过单个摊销前向传播（amortized pass）来估计随机模拟器的风险泛函，显著提高了在小样本和后验分布集中情况下的估计精度和计算效率。
AI.research_question: 如何高效且准确地估计带有输入不确定性的随机模拟器的风险泛函（如分位数），避免嵌套蒙特卡洛方法的高计算成本和内层噪声偏差？
AI.motivation: 嵌套蒙特卡洛方法存在两个主要问题：计算成本是内外循环长度的乘积，且内层模拟噪声会偏差尾部泛函（如高分位数）的估计。需要一种更高效的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生成式贝叶斯计算（Generative Bayesian Computation）；摊销推断（Amortized Inference）；嵌套蒙特卡洛（Nested Monte Carlo）
AI.method: 使用生成式贝叶斯计算训练一个代理模型（surrogate），从（输入, 输出）对中学习映射关系，每个对只需一次短模拟；然后通过代理模型传播整个后验分布，无需内层循环。
AI.findings: 在M/M/1队列实例中：（1）在相同预算下，0.9分位数估计精度比嵌套蒙特卡洛高2.8倍；（2）能达到嵌套蒙特卡洛在任何预算下都无法达到的精度；（3）优势在系统正常运作区间最大，在接近饱和度（利用率接近1）时缩小；（4）当后验数据足够集中时，优势可达一个数量级；仅在后验极其分散（跨越不稳定边界）时才落后于嵌套蒙特卡洛。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种无内层循环的摊销式风险泛函估计方法；揭示了代理方法与嵌套蒙特卡洛方法在不同系统状态下的性能边界，为方法选择提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为随机模拟中的决策问题提供了一种计算效率更高、估计更准确的方法；给出了何时使用代理方法、何时保留内层循环的实践指南。

title: Does Innovation Mitigate Firms' Exposure to Oil Price Shocks?
affiliations: , Tsinghua univeristy and Tokyo Institute of Technology - School of Engineering

detail.title: Does Innovation Mitigate Firms' Exposure to Oil Price Shocks?
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether innovation mitigates firms' exposure to oil price shocks. Using panel data of U.S. publicly listed non-financial firms from 2001 to 2023, we measure firm-level oil price exposure using rolling regressions and construct patent-based innovation knowledge stock to capture firms' accumulated technological capabilities. We find that firms with higher innovation knowledge stock exhibit significantly lower oil price exposure, with a one-unit increase in knowledge stock associated with an approximately 12% reduction in exposure relative to the sample mean. This effect is particularly pronounced in the manufacturing sector. Using earnings call transcripts, we further construct text-based measures of firms' oil dependence and show that innovation reduces firms' operational reliance on oil and energy-related conditions. Mechanism analyses indicate that innovation weakens the pass-through of oil price shocks to production costs and helps stabilize profit margins and markups. To address endogeneity concerns, we exploit exogenous geopolitical and supply-driven oil price shocks as event-based identification strategies and further verify the results using instrumental-variable estimation, propensity score matching, and entropy balancing analyses. The findings are also stable across alternative measures of oil exposure and innovation. Overall, against the backdrop of heightened geopolitical tensions and energy market disruptions, our findings suggest that innovation serves as a non-financial structural mechanism that enhances firms' resilience to oil price shocks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究创新如何降低企业对油价冲击的暴露程度。使用2001-2023年美国上市非金融企业面板数据，发现企业创新知识存量每增加一个单位，油价暴露度平均降低约12%，尤其在制造业中效果更显著。创新通过减少企业对石油的运营依赖、削弱油价向生产成本的传导、稳定利润率等机制发挥作用。
AI.research_question: 创新是否以及如何降低企业面临油价冲击时的暴露程度？
AI.motivation: 在地缘政治紧张和能源市场动荡的背景下，传统上企业应对油价风险多依赖金融对冲工具，但非金融层面的结构性机制（如创新）的作用尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业创新知识存量（基于专利构建）、油价暴露度（滚动回归估计）、油价冲击传导机制（生产成本传导、利润率与加成率稳定效应）
AI.method: 面板数据回归分析，结合文本分析（基于财报电话会议构建企业石油依赖度指标），采用工具变量估计、倾向得分匹配、熵平衡等处理内生性，并利用外生地缘政治和供给驱动的油价冲击作为事件识别策略。
AI.findings: 创新知识存量每增加一个单位，企业油价暴露度比样本均值降低约12%；该效应在制造业尤为显著；创新降低了企业对石油的运营依赖；创新削弱了油价冲击向生产成本的传导，稳定了利润率和加成率。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了创新作为非金融结构性机制在降低企业油价风险暴露中的作用，拓展了企业风险管理和能源经济学领域的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供了应对油价风险的新视角（技术能力积累而非仅依赖金融对冲），为政策制定者在能源危机和地缘冲突背景下推动企业创新提供了实证依据。

title: The Generative Newsvendor
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: The Generative Newsvendor
detail.abstract: The newsvendor's optimal order is a quantile: the conditional critical fractile of demand. We solve the feature-based newsvendor under decision-dependent censoring by targeting that quantile directly with generative Bayesian computation (GBC). Because lost sales are unobserved we record only min(D, q); we fold this censoring into a forward simulator through the survival/density split of the likelihood, so the predictive quantile is learned by simulation without a conjugate update, which fails under censoring. The key structural fact is that the decision is a smooth functional of the predictive law, so what governs regret is getting the shape of that law right. We make this precise: a parametric plug-in carries an O(1) quantile bias under misspecification, while a flexible generative predictive is consistent and conditionally calibrated. Reproducible experiments confirm the theory. When the parametric model is correct, GBC ties an oracle-parametric Bayes rule and both reduce regret by an order of magnitude over empirical risk minimization on censored sales. When demand is multimodal-the regime of Ekin et al. (2014)-GBC is the only calibrated rule and cuts regret by 2.7× over a parametric plug-in; a sensitivity study shows the advantage grows monotonically with the degree of multimodality, from parity at unimodal demand to a near 4× gap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于生成贝叶斯计算的报童问题求解方法，通过直接对条件临界分位数进行模拟推断，有效解决决策依赖型数据删失下的特征驱动库存优化问题。灵活生成式预测模型在需求误设下表现一致且条件校准，而参数模型存在O(1)分位数偏差。实验表明，多峰需求下GBC比参数方法降低2.7倍遗憾，优势随多峰程度增大至近4倍。
AI.research_question: 在决策依赖型删失（缺失销售数据仅记录min(D, q)）条件下，如何通过生成式贝叶斯计算方法直接学习条件临界分位数，实现特征驱动的报童最优订货决策？
AI.motivation: 经典报童问题中，最优订货量是需求分布的条件分位数。但在实际中，缺失销售数据（lost sales）不可观测，仅能记录实际需求量与订货量的较小值min(D, q)，导致传统共轭贝叶斯更新失效。同时，参数模型在误设时存在O(1)量级的分位数偏差，亟需一种灵活且一致的推断框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 报童模型的条件临界分位数决策规则；生成贝叶斯计算（GBC）；似然的生存/密度分解；参数插件法的O(1)分位数偏差理论；灵活生成式预测的一致性（consistency）与条件校准（conditional calibration）。
AI.method: 将删失机制折叠进前向模拟器，通过似然的生存/密度拆分进行仿真推断；使用生成贝叶斯计算直接学习预测分位数，无需共轭更新；对比参数插件法（parametric plug-in）与灵活生成式预测模型；通过可复现实验验证理论结果。
AI.findings: （1）参数模型在误设下存在O(1)量级的分位数偏差，而灵活生成式预测模型一致且条件校准；（2）当参数模型正确时，GBC与神谕参数贝叶斯规则表现相当，两者相比经验风险最小化（ERM）降低一个数量级的遗憾；（3）当需求为多峰分布时（Ekin et al., 2014场景），GBC是唯一校准的决策规则，相比参数插件法降低2.7倍遗憾；（4）敏感性分析表明，GBC的优势随需求多峰程度单调递增，从单峰需求时的持平到接近4倍的遗憾差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次揭示了参数插件法在误设下的O(1)分位数偏差这一结构性缺陷；证明灵活生成式预测在删失报童问题中的一致性与条件校准性，为决策依赖删失下的分位数学习提供了理论保障。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一种可直接应用于缺失销售数据场景的可行算法（GBC），在参数模型正确时与最优贝叶斯规则相当，在需求复杂（多峰）时显著优于现有方法；为企业库存管理中的特征驱动订货决策提供了鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Sovereign Risk Ceilings: Rethinking Methodology Through Risk Disaggregation
affiliations: Columbia University - Columbia Center on Sustainable Investment, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Columbia University - Columbia Center on Sustainable Investment, Columbia University - Columbia Center on Sustainable Investment, Cyberlaw Clinic Berkman Klein Center and Columbia University - Columbia Center on Sustainable Investment

detail.title: Sovereign Risk Ceilings: Rethinking Methodology Through Risk Disaggregation
detail.abstract:
In international debt markets, the credit rating of a sovereign typically acts as a ceiling for all borrowers within that country. This briefing, enabled by the support of the Environmental Defense Fund, argues that the sovereign ceiling compresses meaningful risk differences across borrowers and can misrepresent actual default probabilities. By treating sovereign distress as uniformly transmissible across all domestic entities, it caps the cost of capital for issuers whose own credit position may be substantially stronger than the sovereign’s.

To illustrate both the nature of the problem and the urgency of addressing it, the paper focuses on non-sovereign issuers in EMDEs, particularly in capital-intensive, critical infrastructure sectors reliant on domestic revenue streams, including power and digital infrastructure.

Typical exceptions to the sovereign ceiling rely on structural isolation mechanisms—such as offshore SPVs, future-flow securitizations, or diversified international revenue streams—that are generally inaccessible to domestic infrastructure borrowers earning predominantly local-currency revenues.

Absent demonstrable structural isolation mechanisms, the sovereign ceiling functions more as a heuristic than as an analytical conclusion. We call it methodological foreclosure. It assumes uniform transmission of sovereign distress across domestic borrowers, despite empirical evidence showing substantial variation in transmission channels and outcomes.
Sovereign risk travels through identifiable channels. Once disaggregated into specific transmission mechanisms, the risk to a given borrower becomes tractable rather than monolithic.

Many channels can be contained. Contractual design, financial structuring, and institutional arrangements can mitigate specific transmission risks. Where they do, the sovereign ceiling adds limited analytical value and may distort investment decisions.
Sovereign stress can affect domestic infrastructure borrowers. What matters is whether the pathways can be sufficiently contained to warrant credit differentiation above the sovereign. Where the answer is yes, a rigorous methodology should be able to recognize it.
The paper offers a four-step analytical process to avoid the typical methodological foreclosure of credit rating methodologies.

The four-step framework is a more effective framework to assess credit risk at the level of the individual transaction or issuer, taking into account both exposure to sovereign-related risks and the effectiveness of mitigation measures.

AI.tldr: 本文批判主权信用评级天花板（sovereign ceiling）这一惯例，认为它压缩了不同借款者间的风险差异，尤其对新兴市场和发展中经济体（EMDEs）中依赖国内收入的基础设施借款人造成不公。论文提出一个四步分析框架，主张通过识别和评估主权风险的具体传导渠道及缓解措施，实现对个体借款者信用风险的差异化评估，避免方法论上的"预先封锁"（methodological foreclosure）。
AI.research_question: 主权信用评级天花板是否准确反映了国内非主权借款者的实际违约风险？如何构建更有效的信用风险评估方法？
AI.motivation: 现有主权天花板惯例将主权困境视为对所有国内实体统一传导，忽略了不同借款者在风险暴露和缓解能力上的显著差异，尤其对EMDEs中依赖本地收入的基础设施项目造成融资成本扭曲。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主权风险传导渠道理论、方法论预先封锁（methodological foreclosure）概念、信用风险差异化评估框架
AI.method: 提出四步分析框架：1）识别主权风险传导的具体渠道；2）评估各渠道对特定借款者的影响程度；3）分析合同设计、财务结构、制度安排等缓解措施的有效性；4）综合判断是否可突破天花板进行信用评级差异化。
AI.findings: 主权天花板更多是一种启发式判断（heuristic）而非分析性结论；许多主权风险传导渠道可以通过结构性设计加以控制；在缓解措施有效的情况下，主权天花板增加的分析价值有限且可能扭曲投资决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"方法论预先封锁"概念，批判传统主权天花板方法的机械性；将主权风险从单一假设分解为可分析、可缓解的具体传导渠道。
AI.practical_contributions: 为评级机构和投资者提供四步分析框架，帮助EMDEs中依赖国内收入的基础设施借款者获得更公平的信用评估，降低融资成本，促进关键基础设施投资。

title: Predictive Order Flow Imbalance: Cross-Asset Microstructure Alpha
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Predictive Order Flow Imbalance: Cross-Asset Microstructure Alpha
detail.abstract: This paper examines the predictive power of Order Flow Imbalance (OFI) as an intraday alpha signal across twelve U.S. equity and ETF instruments over a one-year sample period (April 2024 to April 2025). Building on the framework of Cont, Kukanov and Stoikov (2014), we construct OFI from Level-1 NBBO quote data at ten-second bar frequency and evaluate its forward predictive content using walk-forward Ridge regression across 84 monthly test folds. The signal exhibits statistically significant predictive power at short horizons, with a mean Information Coefficient of +0.0044 (pooled t = 3.26, p = 0.0016) and a positive out-of-sample IC of +0.0022. The statistical evidence is robust to ticker-level dependence but sensitive to the short out-of-sample period (seven months), limiting the strength of cross-temporal inference. Sensitivity analyses using ticker-level and month-level aggregation produced qualitatively similar conclusions, although month-level aggregation was not statistically significant owing to the short sevenmonth sample. A two-state Hidden Markov Model identifies calm and stressed volatility regimes. Regime-conditioned models show elevated IC at longer horizons (5m: +0.0148, 10m: +0.0161), but these findings do not survive multiple-testing correction and are treated as exploratory. The strategy does not survive transaction costs at ten-second execution frequency. A gross Sharpe of +0.981 collapses to a net Sharpe of-1.726, with bid-ask crossing costs exceeding the gross signal edge by a factor of 164. NVDA is the only instrument achieving a positive mean net Sharpe (+0.14) after costs. A depth-aware imbalance comparison using Databento XNAS ITCH Market-By-Order (MBO) data provides directional evidence of Level-1 attenuation bias, although the results are not statistically conclusive over the 40-day window.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了订单流不平衡（OFI）作为日内alpha信号在12只美国股票和ETF中的预测能力。基于Cont等人（2014）的框架，使用十秒频率的Level-1 NBBO报价数据，通过滚动岭回归进行测试。OFI在短周期内具有统计显著的预测能力（平均IC=+0.0044），但交易成本吞噬了所有收益，净夏普比率仅为-1.726。深度感知不平衡分析提供了Level-1衰减偏差的方向性证据，但统计上不显著。
AI.research_question: 订单流不平衡（OFI）作为日内alpha信号，在美国股票和ETF市场中是否具有预测能力？该信号能否在考虑交易成本后产生净收益？
AI.motivation: 高频交易中，订单流不平衡被视为重要的价格发现指标。现有研究多聚焦于理论模型或特定市场微观结构，缺乏对OFI信号在实际交易环境中（尤其是考虑交易成本后）系统性的实证检验。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Cont, Kukanov & Stoikov（2014）的订单流不平衡框架；使用Level-1 NBBO报价数据构建OFI；采用两状态隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）划分平静与压力波动率状态。
AI.method: 十秒频率Level-1 NBBO数据构建OFI；滚动岭回归（walk-forward Ridge regression），84个月度测试集；信息系数（IC）评估预测力；两状态HMM识别波动率状态；深度感知不平衡比较使用Databento XNAS ITCH MBO数据。
AI.findings: 1) OFI在短周期具有统计显著的预测能力（平均IC=+0.0044，p=0.0016）；2) 策略在考虑交易成本后净夏普为-1.726，交易成本超出信号边缘收益164倍；3) NVDA是唯一实现正平均净夏普（+0.14）的标的；4) 波动率状态条件模型在较长周期IC更高（5分钟+0.0148，10分钟+0.0161），但未通过多重检验校正；5) 深度感知不平衡分析显示Level-1存在衰减偏差，但统计上不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统验证了OFI在十秒频率下对美股/ETF的预测能力，为订单流不平衡理论提供了实证支持；揭示了Level-1报价数据相对于MBO数据的衰减偏差，补充了市场微观结构文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 明确指出了高频OFI策略在扣除交易成本后不可行（除NVDA外），为量化交易者提供了重要的实操警示；证明了即使统计上显著的alpha信号，在真实交易环境中也可能因成本而失效。

title: Heterogeneous Peer Effects with Endogenous Network Formation
affiliations: and

detail.title: Heterogeneous Peer Effects with Endogenous Network Formation
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a new econometric framework for modeling social interactions with heterogeneous peer responses, addressing endogenous link formation. Our Selectioncorrected Heterogeneous Spatial Autoregressive (SCHSAR) approach jointly models link formation and outcome determination. We incorporate a finite mixture structure to capture heterogeneity in peer effects and account for unobserved individual-specific factors driving both network formation and outcome equations, addressing network endogeneity for credible estimation of heterogeneous spillover effects. We propose a fully Bayesian data augmentation approach for estimation and inference, overcoming challenges posed to standard likelihood-based methods. A simulation study validates our approach. Our empirical application to an innovation network among U.S. firms reveals significant positive, yet heterogeneous, peer effects on corporate R&D investments, after accounting for endogenous network formation. The findings highlight varying firm behaviors in response to exogenous R&D policy shocks and and quantify firm-level direct and spillover effects, offering valuable insights for evidence-based and targeted policy design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种选择修正异质空间自回归（SCHSAR）框架，用于在考虑内生网络形成的情况下估计异质性同伴效应，并应用于企业创新网络中的R&D投资分析。
AI.research_question: 如何在内生网络形成和个体异质性条件下，可靠地估计同伴效应的异质性？
AI.motivation: 现有社会互动模型通常假设同伴效应同质且忽略网络形成的内生性问题，导致估计偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间自回归模型、有限混合模型、贝叶斯数据增强、网络形成与结果方程联合建模。
AI.method: 提出SCHSAR模型，采用有限混合结构刻画异质性，利用贝叶斯数据增强方法进行估计与推断。
AI.findings: 美国企业创新网络中存在显著且异质的正向同伴效应；不同企业对R&D政策冲击的反应存在差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 将网络内生性与同伴效应异质性纳入统一框架，解决了标准似然方法无法处理的技术难题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业R&D政策设计提供了精准的企业层面直接效应与溢出效应估计，支持基于证据的差异化政策制定。

title: Global Capital Reallocation under Geoeconomic Fragmentation
affiliations: Florida International University (FIU) - Department of Economics

detail.title: Global Capital Reallocation under Geoeconomic Fragmentation
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the mechanics of global capital reallocation under geoeconomic fragmentation. Using a dyadic panel dataset constructed from the Bank for International Settlements and the Global Sanctions Database, we estimate a structural gravity model via the Poisson Pseudo-Maximum Likelihood estimator to isolate the compliance behavior of private financial intermediaries managing bilateral sanctions. The empirical results demonstrate that while financial sanctions depress bilateral capital flows on average, a structural institutional asymmetry exists. Aggregate capital flows demonstrate a defensive shield mechanism, where a target economy's market power neutralizes this baseline penalty, allowing lending to persist in structurally integrated markets. However, this protection does not extend to target non-bank financial institutions, as international lenders significantly reduce lending to entities lacking central bank backstops. Falsification tests indicate this shielding effect is specific to financial networks and emerged systematically after 2014, while multilateral diplomatic coalitions provide no marginal economic penalty. This uneven compliance framework concentrates systemic risk within central network nodes, establishing the structural limits of financial weaponization and determining the future boundaries of global economic integration.

AI.tldr: 本文利用双边面板数据和结构引力模型，研究了地缘经济碎片化下全球资本重新配置的机制，发现金融制裁虽然平均抑制双边资本流动，但存在结构性制度不对称：目标经济体的市场力量形成“防御性屏蔽机制”，保护其整体资本流动，但非银行金融机构无法获得同等保护。这种不对称合规框架将系统性风险集中于核心网络节点，揭示了金融武器化的结构性局限。
AI.research_question: 在地缘经济碎片化背景下，金融制裁如何影响全球资本重新配置？私人金融中介在管理双边制裁时的合规行为是否存在结构性不对称？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对金融制裁的经济效应研究不足，尤其是对私人金融中介合规行为的微观机制缺乏深入理解。理解这种结构性不对称对于评估金融武器化的有效性及其对全球经济一体化的影响至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构引力模型（Structural Gravity Model）；防御性屏蔽机制（Defensive Shield Mechanism）；金融网络理论与系统性风险集中理论。
AI.method: 利用国际清算银行和全球制裁数据库构建双边面板数据，采用泊松伪最大似然估计（PPML）估计结构引力模型，并进行安慰剂检验。
AI.findings: （1）金融制裁平均抑制双边资本流动；（2）目标经济体的市场力量形成防御性屏蔽，抵消制裁的基准惩罚，使贷款在结构性整合市场中得以持续；（3）但此保护不延伸至非银行金融机构，国际贷款人显著减少对缺乏央行支持的实体贷款；（4）屏蔽效应特指金融网络，且在2014年后系统性出现；（5）多边外交联盟未带来额外经济惩罚。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了金融制裁合规的结构性不对称机制，提出并验证了“防御性屏蔽”概念，明确了金融武器化的结构性边界，拓展了地缘经济碎片化与国际资本流动的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估金融制裁的有效性和局限性提供实证依据；提示系统性风险集中于核心金融网络节点的风险；为全球经济一体化未来走向提供参考。

title: Inflation Responses to FX Demand and Supply Shocks under Exchange Rate Segmentation: Evidence from Angola

detail.title: Inflation Responses to FX Demand and Supply Shocks under Exchange Rate Segmentation: Evidence from Angola
detail.abstract: We identify FX demand and FX supply shocks using a Bayesian Structural VAR with sign restrictions and employ Local Projections to estimate their dynamic effects on inflation in Angola, comparing results obtained using the official and parallel exchange rates. In addition, State-Dependent Local Projections are used to assess whether the degree of exchange rate segmentation alters the intensity of exchange rate pass-through. The results show that FX demand shocks generate rapid, persistent, and statistically significant inflationary effects, whereas positive FX supply shocks produce weaker disinflationary effects. The findings further suggest that the parallel FX market plays an important role in price formation in some sectors of the economy and that exchange rate segmentation influences the transmission of exchange rate shocks to domestic prices.

AI.tldr: 本文利用贝叶斯结构VAR和局部投影法，研究安哥拉外汇供需冲击对通胀的动态影响，发现外汇需求冲击产生快速持久的通胀效应，而外汇供给冲击的通货紧缩效应较弱，且平行外汇市场在部分经济部门价格形成中起重要作用，汇率分割影响冲击传导。
AI.research_question: 外汇供需冲击如何影响安哥拉的通胀？平行汇率与官方汇率的传导效果有何差异？汇率分割程度如何改变汇率传递强度？
AI.motivation: 安哥拉等新兴经济体存在明显的官方与平行汇率双轨制，理解不同外汇冲击对通胀的影响机制以及汇率分割的作用，对货币政策制定和汇率管理具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 汇率传递理论（Exchange Rate Pass-Through）、外汇市场分割理论、汇率冲击的供需分析框架
AI.method: 贝叶斯结构向量自回归（BSVAR）结合符号约束识别外汇供需冲击；局部投影法（Local Projections）估计动态效应；状态依赖局部投影法（State-Dependent Local Projections）评估汇率分割对传递强度的调节效应。
AI.findings: 1. 外汇需求冲击引发快速、持久且统计显著的通胀效应；2. 外汇供给冲击的通货紧缩效应较弱；3. 平行外汇市场在部分经济部门价格形成中发挥重要作用；4. 汇率分割程度影响外汇冲击向国内价格的传导强度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将外汇市场分割纳入汇率传递分析框架，揭示了平行汇率市场在通胀传导中的独特作用，丰富了新兴经济体汇率传递异质性的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为安哥拉及其他存在双重汇率体系的新兴经济体提供了货币政策与汇率管理建议，提示央行需关注平行外汇市场对价格稳定的影响，并考虑汇率分割程度在政策传导中的作用。

title: AI In Education: Balancing Quality Education (SDG-4) and Ethical Governance (SDG-16) toward Sustainable Development
affiliations: STAI Miftahul Ulum Mukomuko

detail.title: AI In Education: Balancing Quality Education (SDG-4) and Ethical Governance (SDG-16) toward Sustainable Development

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a conceptual policy analysis and did not involve human participants or animal subjects requiring formal ethical approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This study does not involve any clinical trials on human or animal subjects.

detail.abstract: The development of artificial intelligence (AI) over the past five years has transformed the way educationalinstitutions design learning processes, assessments, and institutional management. While AI offers significantopportunities to improve pedagogical effectiveness and expand access, its use also raises critical questions regardingethics, fairness, and institutional governance. This research aims to analyze how AI can contribute to achieving this. QualityEducation (SDG-4) while ensuring that the principles are met Peace, Justice, and Strong Institutions (SDG-16). By using theapproach Systematic Literature Review (SLR) This study examines 50 open-access articles published between 2020 and2025 and relevant to the application of AI in education. Thematic analysis identified three main patterns: improving thequality of learning through personalization and administrative efficiency; the presence of ethical risks in the form ofalgorithmic bias, data privacy, and weak transparency; and the need for a balanced model that combines technologicalinnovation with adaptive and participatory governance. The results show that the sustainability of digital transformationin education depends heavily on the integration of AI technical capabilities and a strong institutional ethical framework.This study contributes by formulating a conceptual model that connects technology and governance as two pillars thatmust be achieved simultaneously to realize equitable, inclusive, and sustainable education.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统性文献综述方法，分析了2020-2025年间50篇开放获取文章，探讨人工智能如何助力优质教育（SDG-4）的同时维护和平、正义与强大机构（SDG-16）。研究发现三大主题：通过个性化和行政效率提升学习质量；算法偏见、数据隐私和透明度不足等伦理风险；以及需要将技术创新与适应性、参与式治理相结合的平衡模式。研究构建了一个技术与治理并重的概念模型，以实现公平、包容和可持续的教育。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何在促进优质教育（SDG-4）的同时，确保符合和平、正义与强大机构（SDG-16）的原则？
AI.motivation: 过去五年AI快速发展深刻改变了教育机构的学习设计、评估和管理方式，但AI在教育中的应用带来了伦理、公平和治理方面的关键问题。因此需要系统分析AI如何平衡教育质量提升与伦理治理之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续发展目标框架（SDG-4优质教育与SDG-16和平、正义与强大机构）；技术创新与制度治理的平衡模型
AI.method: 系统性文献综述（SLR），对2020-2025年间50篇开放获取文章进行主题分析
AI.findings: 三个主要模式：1）通过个性化和行政效率提升学习质量；2）存在算法偏见、数据隐私和透明度不足等伦理风险；3）需要结合技术创新与适应性、参与式治理的平衡模型。数字教育转型的可持续性取决于AI技术能力与强大制度伦理框架的整合。

title: The Doctrine of Constitutional Temporal Continuity: Supreme Court Tenure, Judicial Stabilization, and the Preservation of Long-Horizon Constitutional Order

detail.title: The Doctrine of Constitutional Temporal Continuity: Supreme Court Tenure, Judicial Stabilization, and the Preservation of Long-Horizon Constitutional Order
