detail.abstract:
This paper introduces Constitutional Temporal Continuity Theory as a framework for understanding Article III good-behavior tenure and the long-horizon function of the Supreme Court within the American constitutional system. Existing debates over Supreme Court tenure often focus on judicial independence, democratic accountability, partisan appointments, life expectancy, or proposed term-limit reforms. While those debates are important, they tend to understate a deeper structural feature of the Constitution: the American system does not merely divide power among institutions; it differentiates institutional time. Each branch of the federal government operates according to a distinct constitutional tempo. The House of Representatives is designed for frequent democratic recalibration. The Senate slows and filters political impulse through staggered deliberation. The Presidency supplies executive energy, coordination, and operational continuity. The Article III Judiciary, by contrast, occupies the longest constitutional horizon, allowing federal courts—and especially the Supreme Court—to preserve constitutional memory, legal continuity, precedent, and boundary enforcement across successive Congresses, administrations, crises, and shifts in public sentiment.

The central claim is not that lifetime tenure guarantees correct judicial outcomes, eliminates institutional risk, or renders the Supreme Court immune from critique. Rather, the paper contends that good-behavior tenure performs a temporal stabilization function: it reduces judicial recomposition frequency, insulates constitutional judgment from ordinary electoral turnover, and prevents constitutional meaning from automatically synchronizing with the immediate political cycle. This function is described through the paper’s Continuity Transmission Mechanism, which links Article III tenure to accumulated institutional memory, doctrinal continuity, and resistance to interpretive volatility.

Drawing upon constitutional text, Founding theory, separation-of-powers principles, comparative high-court tenure data, judicial independence doctrine, and systems analysis, the paper reframes Supreme Court tenure as part of the Constitution’s temporal architecture. It further develops the concept of Judicial Damping Theory, under which the Court functions not merely as a case-resolution body, but as a stabilization layer capable of moderating excessive constitutional oscillation while still permitting lawful correction and adaptation.

The paper also addresses the principal tradeoffs of extended judicial tenure, including entrenchment, strategic retirement, appointment clustering, accountability concerns, and the risks of institutional rigidity. It argues that reform proposals, including term limits, must be evaluated not only by their effect on judicial independence or democratic responsiveness, but also by their effect on constitutional temporal continuity, recomposition frequency, intertemporal reliance, and the Court’s capacity to preserve constitutional coherence across political time.

Ultimately, this paper offers a nonpartisan structural account of Article III good-behavior tenure. Its thesis is that the Supreme Court’s extended tenure horizon is not an accidental anomaly of eighteenth-century design, nor merely a personal protection for individual Justices. It is part of the Constitution’s long-horizon stabilization architecture. The republic endures not because all institutions move at the same speed, but because some are designed to resist the speed of the moment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"宪法时间连续性理论"，论证美国宪法第三条"良好行为任职"并非仅为保障司法独立，更是宪法时间架构的核心组成部分——通过延长最高法院法官任期，降低法官更替频率，使司法机构成为宪法体系中抵抗政治短周期波动、维护宪法记忆与法律连续性的长期稳定层。
AI.research_question: 美国宪法第三条"良好行为任职"（终身制）在宪法时间架构中发挥了何种结构性功能？如何从时间维度理解最高法院的任期制度？
AI.motivation: 现有关于最高法院任期的争论多聚焦于司法独立、民主问责、党派任命、预期寿命或任期限制改革，忽视了宪法中一个更深层的结构特征：美国体制不仅在不同机构间分权，还区分了不同的"制度时间"——各联邦分支具有不同的宪法节奏。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 宪法时间连续性理论（Constitutional Temporal Continuity Theory）；2. 连续性传输机制（Continuity Transmission Mechanism）；3. 司法阻尼理论（Judicial Damping Theory）——法院不仅是案件解决机构，更是能够调节过度宪法振荡的稳定层。
AI.method: 基于宪法文本、建国理论、分权原则、比较高等法院任期数据、司法独立学说及系统分析的规范性论证。
AI.findings: 良好行为任职执行时间稳定功能：降低司法更替频率，使宪法判断免受普通选举更替的影响，防止宪法涵义自动与即时政治周期同步。最高法院的长期任期是宪法长期稳定架构的组成部分——共和国的持久不是因为所有机构以相同速度运转，而是因为有些机构被设计成抵抗时代的速度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出从"时间维度"理解三权分立的分析框架，将任期制度重新概念化为宪法时间架构的一部分；提出"司法阻尼理论"解释法院在宪法振荡中的调节功能；将任期改革议题从传统的独立性与回应性之争拓展至"时间连续性"的理论维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为评估任期限制等改革方案提供新标准：不仅考察其对司法独立或民主回应性的影响，还应评估其对宪法时间连续性、更替频率、跨期依赖及法院在政治时间中维护宪法连贯性的能力的影响。

title: Wald Couples in the Critical Strip
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Wald Couples in the Critical Strip
detail.abstract: The reciprocal of an entire function in the Laguerre-Pólya class is the Laplace transform of a generalised gamma convolution (GGC), and the location of the function's zeros is encoded by the positivity of the associated Thorin measure. We make this correspondence constructive: a single cosine transform carries the Lévy measure of such a function to the Thorin measure of a GGC H, producing a van Dantzig pair and a Wald couple, and on the Gamma(k) building block it has a closed form. Applied to the Riemann Xi function, Riemann's theta representation yields both the infinite divisibility of XI, through a Gamma(2) mixture, and an incomplete-gamma representation that continues the resulting Wald identity holomorphically across the critical strip. The mixing measure is signed; its Jordan decomposition reduces the entire residual content to one complete-monotonicity condition, and computing the asymptotics of the resulting weights in closed form exhibits a zeta-governed ladder of poles, showing that the condition is rigorous only on the convergent side, where it is equivalent to the Riemann hypothesis rather than a consequence of infinite divisibility alone.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了Laguerre-Pólya类整函数的倒数与广义伽马卷积（GGC）的拉普拉斯变换之间的对应关系，并通过余弦变换构建了van Dantzig对与Wald偶。应用于Riemann Xi函数时，发现其无限可分性等价于Riemann假设，而非仅是无限可分性的推论。
AI.research_question: Laguerre-Pólya类整函数的倒数作为广义伽马卷积的拉普拉斯变换时，其零点位置与Thorin测度正性之间的对应关系如何建构？以及该建构如何应用于Riemann Xi函数的无限可分性与Riemann假设的关系？
AI.motivation: 理解整函数零点位置与概率分布无限可分性之间的深层联系，并探索Riemann假设在概率论框架下的等价表述。
AI.theoretical_framework: Laguerre-Pólya类整函数理论、广义伽马卷积（GGC）、Thorin测度、van Dantzig对、Wald偶、余弦变换、Jordan分解、完全单调性。
AI.method: 通过余弦变换将Lévy测度映射为Thorin测度，构建van Dantzig对与Wald偶；对Riemann Xi函数应用Riemann theta表示，推导出Gamma(2)混合表示与不完全伽马表示，进行渐近分析与Jordan分解。
AI.findings: （1）余弦变换可构造性地将Lévy测度转为Thorin测度，在Gamma(k)构件上有闭式解；（2）Riemann Xi函数的无限可分性通过Gamma(2)混合实现，但混合测度为有符号测度；（3）Jordan分解将残差内容简化为一个完全单调性条件；（4）该条件在收敛侧等价于Riemann假设，而非仅是无限可分性的推论。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了整函数零点与GGC无限可分性之间的构造性对应；将Riemann假设转化为概率论框架下的完全单调性条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究Riemann假设提供了新的概率论分析工具与渐近计算框架；给出了Riemann Xi函数无限可分性的严格数学条件。

title: Beyond Litigation: The Case For Specialised Adr In Copyright Disputes In Tanzania

detail.title: Beyond Litigation: The Case For Specialised Adr In Copyright Disputes In Tanzania
detail.abstract: Copyright disputes increasingly involve complex questions of authorship, ownership, licensing and infringement that are often ill-suited to resolution through ordinary court litigation. Although Tanzania’s legal framework recognises alternative dispute resolution (ADR) under the Civil Procedure Code and the Arbitration Act, these mechanisms are general in nature and do not specifically address the technical and commercial characteristics of copyright disputes. This article examines the limitations of litigation in copyright enforcement in Tanzania and argues that the absence of a specialised ADR framework contributes to procedural delays, increased costs and reduced efficiency. Drawing on Tanzanian legislation, judicial decisions and the institutional model adopted by the Republic of Korea, the article demonstrates how specialised mediation and conciliation mechanisms can provide faster, more expert and commercially responsive dispute resolution. It argues that integrating specialised ADR within Tanzania’s copyright system would strengthen access to justice, improve enforcement of copyright rights and support the growth of the country’s creative economy. The article concludes by recommending reforms that incorporate expert-led ADR mechanisms into Tanzania’s existing intellectual property framework.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨坦桑尼亚版权纠纷解决机制的不足，指出缺乏专门替代性纠纷解决（ADR）框架导致诉讼效率低下，借鉴韩国模式提出建立专业化调解与和解机制以提升版权执法效果。
AI.research_question: 坦桑尼亚如何通过建立专门的替代性纠纷解决（ADR）框架来提升版权纠纷解决效率？
AI.motivation: 坦桑尼亚现有版权纠纷依赖普通法院诉讼，但诉讼机制存在程序延迟、成本高昂、效率低下的问题，且一般性ADR机制未能针对版权纠纷的技术性和商业性特征进行专门设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 替代性纠纷解决（ADR）理论；版权执法与司法效率理论；专门化纠纷解决机制理论。
AI.method: 文献分析：梳理坦桑尼亚立法、司法判决；比较研究：借鉴韩国专业化调解与和解机制的制度模式。
AI.findings: 坦桑尼亚版权纠纷诉讼存在程序延迟、成本高、效率低等问题；韩国专业化ADR模式能提供更快速、更专业、更具商业响应性的纠纷解决；将专门化ADR整合进坦桑尼亚版权体系可提升司法可及性和版权执法效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 论证了专门化ADR机制在版权纠纷解决中的适用性和优越性，丰富了发展中国家版权执法与ADR整合的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为坦桑尼亚及类似发展中国家提供版权纠纷解决机制改革建议，提出引入专家主导的ADR机制以促进创意经济发展。

title: The Range of Intergenerational Transmission of Education in Korea Using Nonparametric Bound Methods
affiliations: National Pension Research Institute

detail.title: The Range of Intergenerational Transmission of Education in Korea Using Nonparametric Bound Methods

declarations.declarationOfInterest: no conflicts of interests
declarations.funderStatement: no funding resource

keywords: Average Treatment Effects Of Parental Schooling

detail.abstract: This study estimates the average causal effect of parents' education on children's education in Korea using a new method: a nonparametric bounds approach. This approach does not require the assumption of homogeneous, linear effects of parental schooling and uses weaker assumptions than those underlying other methods. Then, they are more amenable to testing. With the additional assumption of monotone instrumental variables, it provides the tightest bounds on the average treatment effects of an increase in parents' education on children's educational success. It also shows that the effects in regression models are overestimated.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用非参数边界方法估计韩国父母教育对子女教育的平均因果效应，发现回归模型存在高估问题。
AI.research_question: 父母教育对子女教育的平均因果效应有多大？
AI.motivation: 传统回归模型假设同质线性效应，可能导致估计偏差，需要更稳健的方法来识别因果效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非参数边界方法、单调工具变量假设
AI.method: 采用非参数边界方法（bounds approach），结合单调工具变量假设，对韩国数据进行因果推断。
AI.findings: 父母教育对子女教育存在正向因果效应，但回归模型估计的效应被高估了。
AI.theory_contributions: 为非参数边界方法在教育代际传递研究中提供了应用范例，证明了该方法比传统回归模型更准确。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者注意传统回归分析可能高估父母教育的影响，需要使用更严谨的因果推断方法。

title: Personality Traits, Self-Selection and Incentives
affiliations: , , Goethe University Frankfurt and

detail.title: Personality Traits, Self-Selection and Incentives
detail.abstract: This study examines how personality traits shape individuals' self-selection into tasks of varying complexity and how such selection interacts with monetary incentives to affect performance. We implement a two-stage real-effort experiment in which participants choose between a simple slider task and a more complex puzzle task. While some participants are assigned to their chosen task, others are randomly allocated, allowing us to causally identify the effects of task-personality alignment and incentive schemes. Compensation varies between a flat wage and piece-rate pay. We find that individuals high in Openness are significantly more likely to select the complex task, whereas individuals high in Agreeableness tend to prefer the simple task. Assignment to one's preferred task significantly increases performance in the complex task, but not in the simple task. Moreover, although performance-based incentives generally enhance output in the complex task, this effect reverses when individuals perform their preferred task, consistent with a crowding-out of intrinsic motivation. By disentangling selection, assignment, and incentive effects across tasks of different complexity, our study sheds light on the mechanisms through which monetary incentives influence performance. We contribute to the literature by demonstrating how personality traits interact with task preferences and compensation schemes, with implications for employee allocation, incentive design, and potentially turnover reduction through improved task matching.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实验发现，人格特质影响个体对复杂任务的选择，而基于绩效的激励在个体执行偏好任务时会挤出内在动机，降低绩效。
AI.research_question: 人格特质如何影响个体对任务复杂性的自我选择，以及这种选择如何与货币激励相互作用影响绩效？
AI.motivation: 理解人格特质、任务偏好与激励方案之间的交互机制，为员工分配和激励设计提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人格心理学（大五人格）、自我选择理论、内在动机与外在激励的挤出效应理论。
AI.method: 两阶段真实努力实验：被试在简单滑块任务和复杂拼图任务中选择，部分按选择分配，部分随机分配；薪酬分为固定工资和计件工资。
AI.findings: （1）开放性高者更倾向选复杂任务，宜人性高者更倾向选简单任务；（2）分配到偏好任务显著提升复杂任务绩效，但对简单任务无显著效果；（3）绩效激励总体上提升复杂任务产出，但在个体执行偏好任务时效果反转，出现内在动机挤出。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了人格特质、任务偏好与激励方案三者之间的交互机制，证实了货币激励在特定条件下会挤出内在动机。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业员工任务分配、激励方案设计以及通过任务匹配降低离职率提供了实证依据。

title: Assessing Food and Nutrition Security in Europe: a Vulnerability Matrix to analyse food system fragilities in times of polycrisis
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Pisa

detail.title: Assessing Food and Nutrition Security in Europe: a Vulnerability Matrix to analyse food system fragilities in times of polycrisis
detail.abstract: In an increasingly dynamic global context, food systems are exposed to several hazards that make system components and food consumers vulnerable regarding their capacity to provide food and nutrition security (FNS) for a socially, economically and geographically differentiated population. The paper introduces a ”Vulnerability Matrix” (VM or Matrix) as an instrument for the rapid appraisal of critical intervention points to deal with stressors and crises harming FNS. Its purpose is to provide policymakers, experts and stakeholders with a framework for identifying and mitigating vulnerabilities, highlighting the most sensitive FNS issues through a synthetic visual representation tool.,The Matrix had been initially designed and filled-in in 2017 according to the results of research activities conducted in ten EU countries for the EU-funded TRANSMANGO project. The Matrix has been recently revised to consider three major global shocks that have affected food and social systems: first, the COVID-19 pandemic outbreak, which triggered breakdowns in the food system including the access and the utilisation stages; second, the war in Ukraine, which has destabilised the procurement of food products and agricultural inputs; and third, the disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz, sharply increasing global agrifood input costs. Matching the original Matrix with these three crises served as a test for its capacity to account for new unforeseen events, proving the ductility of the Matrix in relation to the identification of vulnerability areas and hotspots. The analysis also suggests that, over a relatively long period, long-lasting stresses seem to be more pervasive than major shocks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"脆弱性矩阵"（Vulnerability Matrix）工具，用于快速评估粮食系统在应对危机时的关键干预点。该矩阵最初基于10个欧盟国家的研究构建，后经COVID-19大流行、乌克兰战争和霍尔木兹海峡中断三大全球冲击检验，证明其能有效识别脆弱性区域和热点，并发现长期压力比重大冲击更具侵蚀性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够快速评估粮食系统脆弱性、识别关键干预点的工具，并检验其应对突发危机事件的适应能力？
AI.motivation: 在全球动态变化的背景下，粮食系统面临多重危害，导致不同社会、经济和地理位置的群体在粮食和营养安全方面存在脆弱性，亟需一个快速评估工具来帮助政策制定者和利益相关者识别和缓解脆弱性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 粮食系统脆弱性理论、粮食与营养安全（FNS）框架、系统韧性理论
AI.method: 基于EU TRANSMANGO项目在10个欧盟国家的研究成果，构建脆弱性矩阵；然后通过COVID-19大流行、乌克兰战争、霍尔木兹海峡中断三大全球冲击对矩阵进行测试和修订，检验其适用性。
AI.findings: 1. 脆弱性矩阵能够有效识别粮食系统的脆弱性区域和热点；2. 矩阵具有可塑性（ductility），能够适应新的突发事件；3. 长期压力（long-lasting stresses）对粮食系统的侵蚀作用比重大冲击更为显著和持久。
AI.theory_contributions: 为粮食系统脆弱性评估提供了操作化的分析框架，丰富了对突发冲击与长期压力在粮食安全中不同作用机制的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、专家和利益相关者提供了快速评估粮食系统脆弱性的可视化工具，帮助识别关键干预点，增强粮食系统的韧性和应急响应能力。

title: Nourishing Networks toward the Right to Food: Food Access, Hunger and Vulnerability in West Virginia
affiliations: West Virginia University and West Virginia University

detail.title: Nourishing Networks toward the Right to Food: Food Access, Hunger and Vulnerability in West Virginia
detail.abstract: Economic, political and environmental crises have severely exacerbated household food insecurity in the United States, exposing structural gaps in the federal safety net and straining private charitable networks. While national aggregates mask localized crises, rural and distressed regions face compounding socio-spatial vulnerabilities. Drawing on twelve years of action-research and institutional ethnography in West Virginia, this paper examines the scalar tensions and coalition politics of advancing claims for food as a human right. We evaluate the "Nourishing Networks" curriculum, a community-based pedagogical tool workshopped across thirteen localities between 2018 and 2024, alongside insights from seven statewide food policy summits. Grounded in political ecology and entitlement theories, our analysis identifies humanitarianism, healthism, and developmentalism as three dominant discourses shaping current food interventions. Participatory workshops mapped ten primary, interconnected barriers to food access, led by low incomes, transportation deficits, and regulatory hurdles. By integrating a normative Right to Food (RtF) framework in 2022, the project successfully shifted local efforts away from short-term charitable fixes toward long-term structural advocacy, catalyzing localized food policy councils and a statewide coalition mobilized around a constitutional amendment. Applying Kingdon’s three-streams framework, we argue that aligning problem, policy, and politics streams through participatory pedagogies is essential to progressively realizing the Right to Food in situ. This case study offers critical insights for food systems governance, demonstrating how community-led policy entrepreneurship centered on lived experiences can challenge profit-driven productivist foodways and build transformative infrastructures of care in unequal nations experiencing deep economic transitions.

AI.tldr: 本文基于西弗吉尼亚州12年的行动研究与制度民族志，考察了如何通过参与式教学法推动“食物权”从短期慈善救济转向长期结构性倡导，并运用Kingdon三流框架论证了问题、政策与政治三流对齐的重要性。
AI.research_question: 在美国农村与 distressed 地区，如何通过社区参与式教学法推动“食物权”主张，实现从短期慈善救济向长期结构性倡导的转变？
AI.motivation: 美国经济、政治与环境危机加剧了家庭食物不安全，暴露了联邦安全网的结构性缺口和私人慈善网络的困境，而农村和 distressed 地区面临复合性社会空间脆弱性，亟需超越短期救济的可持续解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治生态学、 entitlement 理论（权利理论）、Kingdon 三流框架（问题流、政策流、政治流）、食物权（Right to Food）规范框架。
AI.method: 12年行动研究与制度民族志，结合“营养网络”（Nourishing Networks）课程的参与式工作坊（2018-2024年覆盖13个地区）以及7次全州食品政策峰会。
AI.findings: 识别出人道主义、健康主义、发展主义三大主导话语；参与式工作坊绘制了十大食物获取障碍（低工资、交通不足、监管障碍居首）；2022年整合食物权框架后成功推动地方从短期慈善转向长期结构性倡导，催生了地方食品政策委员会和全州宪法修正案联盟。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Kingdon三流框架应用于食物权的地方实现过程，论证了参与式教学法作为对齐问题、政策与政治三流的机制，拓展了政治生态学与 entitlement 理论在食物系统治理中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为处于深度经济转型中的不平等国家提供了社区主导的政策创业实践路径，展示了以生活经验为中心的参与式工具如何挑战利润驱动的产品主义食物体系，建设变革性关爱基础设施。

title: Tracking Food Poverty: Connecting Economic, Spatial, and Social Factors in the Context of Urban Food Insecurity
affiliations: Humboldt University of Berlin, Humboldt University of Berlin and University of Bayreuth

detail.title: Tracking Food Poverty: Connecting Economic, Spatial, and Social Factors in the Context of Urban Food Insecurity
detail.abstract: Food insecurity in high-income countries is increasingly framed as food poverty – a multidimensional condition shaped not only by limited economic resources, but also by spatial inequalities and forms of social exclusion that constrain access to nutritious, affordable, and socially acceptable food. Established instruments such as the Food Insecurity Experience Scale capture experiential hardship but do not represent how spatial and social structures shape deprivation in heterogeneous urban environments. This paper presents the Food Poverty Tracker, a capability-informed measurement instrument linking household resources, perceived food environments, social participation, and personal characteristics as conversion factors shaping food-related functionings. Extending Sen's capability approach, the framework explicitly conceptualizes bidirectional relationships between resources and conversion factors.The Tracker was co-developed through a transdisciplinary, participatory process with researchers, public administrators, and a Berlin civil society organization, including pre-testing with low-income and (post-)migrant households. It was piloted in two socioeconomically disadvantaged Berlin neighborhoods through a multilingual cross-sectional household survey (N = 246). Moderate or severe food insecurity affected 35.4% of respondents. All three resource and conversion-factor domains were significantly associated with food insecurity. Social participation emerged as the strongest independent predictor, followed by household income, while the food environment lost significance when income was included. Affordability and the relative price of unhealthy food alternatives were more strongly associated with food poverty than physical accessibility. Findings suggest that food poverty in affluent urban contexts is structured by affordability and commensality rather than spatial access alone.

AI.tldr: 本文基于能力方法，提出了一款多维食物贫困追踪工具（Food Poverty Tracker），并在柏林两个低收入社区进行试点调查（N=246）。研究发现，35.4%的受访者面临中度或重度食物不安全，社会参与是最强预测因素，其次为收入；食物环境在控制收入后不再显著， affordability和相对价格比物理可及性更重要。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够反映空间不平等、社会排斥等多维因素的食物贫困测量工具，以弥补现有食物不安全量表对城市异质环境的结构性因素捕捉不足的问题？
AI.motivation: 高收入国家的食物不安全日益被视为多维的“食物贫困”，但现有工具（如FIES）仅衡量体验性困难，未能捕捉空间和社会结构如何塑造城市环境中的剥夺。
AI.theoretical_framework: Sen的能力方法（Capability Approach），将资源、感知食物环境、社会参与和个人特征视为影响食物相关功能性活动的转换因素（conversion factors），并明确资源与转换因素之间存在双向关系。
AI.method: 跨学科参与式开发的测量工具（Food Poverty Tracker），在柏林两个社会经济弱势社区通过多语言横截面家庭调查（N=246）进行试点。
AI.findings: 35.4%受访者面临中度或重度食物不安全；三个资源与转换因素领域均与食物不安全显著相关；社会参与是最强独立预测因子，其次为家庭收入；食物环境在纳入收入后不再显著；可负担性和不健康食品的相对价格比物理可及性与食物贫困的关联更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 将能力方法扩展到食物贫困测量领域，明确资源与转换因素之间的双向关系，为多维剥夺测量提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可操作的多维食物贫困测量工具，揭示富裕城市环境中食物贫困主要由可负担性和共餐性（而非空间可达性）驱动，为政策干预提供方向。

title: The Unstable Object of AI Governance: Location, Temporality, and Definitional Authority

detail.title: The Unstable Object of AI Governance: Location, Temporality, and Definitional Authority
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence governance is often approached through categories inherited from earlier regulatory traditions, organized around territory, jurisdiction, and the distinction between domestic and foreign actors. This paper terms this approach discrete-object governance and argues that it is structurally inadequate to AI as a technological continuum, a formation in which chips, compute, data, models, and services are interlinked such that no single element can be governed in isolation. Rather than proposing new institutions or compliance frameworks, the paper reframes the difficulty of AI governance as a problem of regulatory object formation, constituted through three interdependent conditions: location, temporality, and definitional authority. Location no longer maps cleanly onto physical presence, as IP-based access and physical shipment now operate as parallel, and at times conflicting, bases for jurisdiction. Temporality is destabilized by the uneven pace of AI-enabled change: models are trained, updated, and redeployed faster than regulatory cycles can track them, while the rate at which data converts into actionable capability continues to accelerate. Definitional authority is unsettled because the obligations attached to an AI system, and the authority under which it falls, remain contested among governments, firms, and standards bodies, each operating under incompatible definitions of the same object. The paper traces how these three conditions break down simultaneously across three empirical domains: compute and cloud infrastructure, AI-enabled biotechnology, and frontier AI models. It argues that governance frameworks addressing only one condition relocate the problem rather than resolve it, and concludes by outlining continuum governance as an analytical reorientation better suited to AI's technical structure.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了将人工智能治理简化为"离散对象治理"的传统思路，指出AI是一个由芯片、算力、数据、模型和服务相互链接的技术连续体。作者提出，AI治理的核心困境在于"监管对象形成"的三重条件——位置、时间性和定义权威——同时失效，并倡导转向"连续体治理"的分析范式。
AI.research_question: 为什么传统的以领土、管辖权和内外区分为基础的治理框架在人工智能面前结构性失效？如何重新概念化AI治理的困难？
AI.motivation: 现有AI治理讨论多聚焦于提出新制度或合规框架，但忽视了更深层的问题：即"AI"作为一个监管对象本身是如何被构成的。传统治理范式无法应对AI作为技术连续体的本质特征，导致治理努力在根本层面错位。
AI.theoretical_framework: "监管对象形成"理论：治理的有效性取决于治理对象能否在三个相互依赖的条件上被稳定地建构——位置（location）、时间性（temporality）和定义权威（definitional authority）。当这三个条件同时瓦解时，治理框架就会失效。
AI.method: 理论分析与跨领域案例研究：通过三个经验领域——算力与云基础设施、AI驱动的生物技术、前沿AI模型——来展示三重条件的同步崩溃。
AI.findings: 1) 位置条件失效：基于IP的访问和物理运输同时并存且相互冲突，使得地理边界不再能确定管辖权；2) 时间性条件失效：AI模型训练、更新和部署的速度远超监管周期，数据转化为能力的速度持续加速；3) 定义权威条件失效：政府、企业和标准制定机构对同一AI对象持有互不相容的定义，导致义务归属和管辖权限持续争议。这三个条件并非单独失效，而是同时崩溃，互相强化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"离散对象治理"与"连续体治理"的概念区分，将AI治理困境从制度设计问题重新定义为监管对象的构成问题（problem of regulatory object formation），为理解AI治理的结构性困难提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示政策制定者：任何只解决位置、时间性或定义权威中单一条件的治理方案，只会"转移问题而不会解决问题"。呼吁从"连续体治理"的分析出发重新设计治理思路。

title: Spatiotemporal Variability of Physicochemical and Microbial Water Quality Indicators During the 2025 Maha Kumbh Mela
affiliations: Banaras Hindu University, , affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Banaras Hindu University (BHU)

detail.title: Spatiotemporal Variability of Physicochemical and Microbial Water Quality Indicators During the 2025 Maha Kumbh Mela
detail.abstract: The Maha Kumbh Mela 2025 at Prayagraj represented one of the largest mass gatherings in human history, creating unprecedented anthropogenic pressure on the Ganga-Yamuna river system. This study evaluated spatiotemporal variations in physicochemical and microbiological water quality parameters across four sampling locations (Yamuna Control, Ganga Control, Sangam I, and Sangam II) during pre-Kumbh, major bathing events, and post-Kumbh periods. Turbidity, pH, dissolved oxygen (DO), biochemical oxygen demand (BOD₅), and chemical oxygen demand (COD) were measured, while microbial diversity and bacterial isolates were characterized using microscopy, culture-based methods, biochemical testing, and automated identification. Two-way ANOVA revealed significant effects of sampling event and site on turbidity, DO, BOD₅, and COD (p < 0.05), indicating pronounced temporal and spatial variation associated with pilgrimage activities. Peak ecological disturbance occurred during Mauni Amavasya, when turbidity, BOD₅, and COD reached maximum levels and dissolved oxygen declined substantially. Principal Component Analysis explained 72.4% of total variance and identified a clear pollution gradient associated with peak bathing events. Microscopic examination revealed increased microbial abundance at Sangam sites, while bacterial isolation confirmed the presence of Escherichia coli, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Staphylococcus aureus, Enterococcus faecalis, Acinetobacter baumannii, and Pseudomonas spp. Post-Kumbh monitoring demonstrated partial recovery of most physicochemical parameters, suggesting the operation of natural self-purification processes within the river system. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that large-scale mass bathing events can induce significant but largely reversible ecological disturbances, highlighting the need for continuous environmental surveillance, improved sanitation management, and evidence-based strategies to protect river ecosystem health during future mega-gathering events.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了2025年大壶节期间大规模人群沐浴活动对亚穆纳河-恒河水系造成的生态扰动，发现朝圣活动导致浊度、BOD₅、COD显著升高，溶解氧下降，但活动后水质出现部分恢复，表明生态系统具有一定自净能力。
AI.research_question: 2025年大壶节期间大规模人群沐浴活动对恒河-亚穆纳河水质（理化参数和微生物指标）的时空影响如何？
AI.motivation: 大壶节是人类历史上最大规模的人群聚集事件之一，对河流生态系统造成前所未有的 anthropogenic 压力，而目前对此类超级集会期间水质变化的系统评估尚不充分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 水质时空变异理论、河流自净理论、生态扰动与恢复理论
AI.method: 在四个采样点（亚穆纳河对照、恒河对照、桑伽姆I、桑伽姆II），在大壶节前、主要沐浴事件期间和节后三个时期测量浊度、pH、溶解氧（DO）、生化需氧量（BOD₅）和化学需氧量（COD）；通过显微镜、培养法、生化测试和自动鉴定系统表征微生物多样性和细菌分离株；采用双因素方差分析和主成分分析（PCA）进行统计检验。
AI.findings: 双因素ANOVA表明采样事件和地点对浊度、DO、BOD₅和COD有显著影响（p<0.05）；Mauni Amavasya期间生态扰动峰值最高（浊度、BOD₅、COD最大，DO显著下降）；PCA解释了72.4%的总方差，识别出与高峰沐浴事件相关的污染梯度；桑伽姆位点微生物丰度增加，分离出大肠杆菌、肺炎克雷伯菌、金黄色葡萄球菌、粪肠球菌、鲍曼不动杆菌和假单胞菌属；节后多数理化参数部分恢复。
AI.theory_contributions: 为超级人群聚集事件对河流生态系统的扰动模式提供了实证证据，验证了河流自净能力在应对大规模短期污染负荷中的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大型集会期间的环境监测、卫生管理和河流生态保护提供了科学依据和策略建议，强调了持续环境监测的必要性。

title: Women's Commuting After Childbirth: Evidence from U.S. Panel Data
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Women's Commuting After Childbirth: Evidence from U.S. Panel Data
detail.abstract: Post-childbirth commute burden is a potential source for disparity in labor market experience and earnings between men and women. A recent notable example is \cite{Bütikofer2025}, who document that the commuting patterns of Norwegian parents diverge substantially and persistently after their first childbirth, with mothers reducing commuting distance by 19 kilometers compared to 10 kilometers for fathers. We extend this line of inquiry using U.S. data from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics that cover two distinct periods: 1970--1986 and 2011--2019. We find patterns that differ in important ways from the Norwegian experience. While U.S. mothers exit the labor force at substantially higher rates than fathers following childbirth, mothers who remain employed show little change in commuting time or distance relative to their pre-birth patterns or to fathers---a robust finding across four decades and across both time and distance measures of commute. These contrasting patterns call for more cross-country research on post-childbirth commute changes in both time and distance.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国PSID数据（1970-1986和2011-2019两个时段）研究生育后通勤变化，发现与挪威模式不同：美国母亲生育后更倾向于退出劳动力市场，但继续就业的母亲通勤时间或距离变化很小，且与父亲无显著差异。这一发现呼吁更多跨国比较研究。
AI.research_question: 生育后美国父母（尤其母亲）的通勤时间与距离如何变化？与挪威模式有何不同？
AI.motivation: 挪威研究发现生育后父母通勤模式出现显著且持续的性别分化，但美国情境下是否也存在类似模式尚不清楚，且美国劳动力市场特征（如较高比例的劳动力退出）可能带来不同结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 通勤负担性别差异理论；劳动力市场性别不平等与生育惩罚理论；跨国制度比较视角。
AI.method: 使用美国PSID数据，覆盖1970-1986和2011-2019两个时期，比较生育前后父母通勤时间与距离的变化。
AI.findings: 美国母亲生育后退出劳动力市场的比例远高于父亲；但继续就业的母亲通勤时间或距离变化很小，与父亲相比也无显著差异。该发现在40年间、两种通勤度量（时间与距离）上均稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了生育后通勤性别差异的普遍性结论，揭示美国与挪威的制度差异可能导致不同结果，为通勤惩罚与生育惩罚理论提供了跨国情境化视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者应关注不同国家劳动力市场结构（如母亲退出率而非通勤调整）对性别不平等的影响，呼吁更多跨国比较研究以制定有针对性的干预措施。

title: How do variable rate loans aect bank profits?
affiliations: Texas A&M University - Department of Finance, International University of La Rioja (UNIR) and Independent

detail.title: How do variable rate loans aect bank profits?
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how fixed rate versus variable rate loans affect bankprofitability.  Because U.S. Call Reports do not contain this loan rate information, we implement a simulation-based procedure to estimate the share of variable rate loans at individual banks.  Using quarterly data for U.S. commercial banks from  2002 to 2024, we find a highly significant relationship between net interest margins  and variable rate loan shares in response to changes in the prime rate.  With the exception of the COVID-19 pandemic, this relationship holds in different interest rate periods.  We conclude that variable rate lending tends to increase bank profitability.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2002-2024年美国商业银行数据，通过模拟程序估计浮动利率贷款占比，发现浮动利率贷款比例与净息差在基准利率变动时显著正相关，表明浮动利率贷款倾向于提升银行盈利能力。
AI.research_question: 固定利率贷款与浮动利率贷款如何影响银行盈利能力？
AI.motivation: 美国银行Call Reports不包含贷款利率类型信息，因此需要开发方法估算浮动利率贷款占比，以探究其对银行盈利能力的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利率风险传递理论、银行净息差（NIM）对利率变化的敏感性分析。
AI.method: 基于模拟的方法（Simulation-based procedure）估算各银行浮动利率贷款占比，使用2002-2024年美国商业银行季度数据，分析净息差与浮动利率贷款占比在基准利率变动下的关系。
AI.findings: 浮动利率贷款占比与净息差在基准利率变化时呈高度显著正相关；除新冠疫情期间外，该关系在不同利率时期均成立；浮动利率贷款倾向于增加银行盈利能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次利用模拟方法从缺乏利率类型数据的银行报表中提取浮动利率贷款信息，丰富了利率风险与银行盈利能力的理论关系研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行管理层在利率变化环境下优化贷款定价策略提供依据；为监管机构评估银行利率风险暴露提供新视角。

title: Early Childhood Education and Maltreated Children’s Behavioral and Cognitive Outcomes
affiliations: University of California, Davis

detail.title: Early Childhood Education and Maltreated Children’s Behavioral and Cognitive Outcomes
detail.abstract: BackgroundEarly childhood education (ECE) can serve as a protective factor that boosts maltreated children’s school readiness outcomes. Yet, less is known about the relationship between ECE and their adaptive behaviors and cognitive development, two domains integral to their developmental wellbeing.ObjectiveThis study examines the link between ECE and maltreated children’s adaptive behaviors and cognitive development.Participants and SettingThe sample included 1,570 children (Mage at baseline = 11.5 months; 46% girls) from the National Survey of Child and Adolescent Well-Being II, the only nationally representative longitudinal study of children of abuse or neglect in the US.MethodsThis study used the quasi-experimental method of propensity score weighting, an analytic approach that helps reduce observable bias between treated (e.g., maltreated children in ECE) and comparison (e.g., maltreated children not in ECE) groups in observational data.ResultsECE was associated with stronger cognitive development in the form of higher-level cognitive processing of concepts (Average Treatment Effect [ATE] Effect Size = 0.30 SD; p < .05); however, ECE was linked to lower adaptive behaviors, particularly daily independent living skills (ATE Effect Size = 0.19; p < .05; Average Treatment on the Treated [ATT] Effect Size = 0.37; p < .001).ConclusionsThese findings demonstrate the positive benefits of ECE on maltreated children’s higher-order cognitive abilities as well as highlight the importance of identifying critical routines and structures of ECE programs that could be strengthened and tailored in order to better meet the adaptive behavioral needs of maltreated children.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用倾向性得分加权法，分析了美国全国性纵向数据（NSCAW II），发现早期儿童教育（ECE）能提升受虐儿童的高级认知能力（如概念加工），但与其适应行为（尤其是日常生活独立技能）呈负相关，提示ECE项目需针对受虐儿童的适应性行为需求进行优化。
AI.research_question: 早期儿童教育（ECE）与受虐儿童的适应行为及认知发展之间存在何种关系？
AI.motivation: 早期儿童教育（ECE）可作为受虐儿童的保护因素，提升其入学准备，但ECE与其适应行为和认知发展这两个对发展至关重要的领域之间的关系尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 保护因素理论；早期儿童教育作为受虐儿童发展的保护机制。
AI.method: 采用准实验的倾向性得分加权法（Propensity Score Weighting），基于美国全国性的受虐儿童纵向调查数据（NSCAW II），样本量为1,570名儿童（基线平均年龄11.5个月，46%为女孩）。
AI.findings: ECE与更强的认知发展（高阶概念加工能力）相关（ATE效应量=0.30 SD, p<.05）；但ECE与较低的适应行为（特别是日常生活独立技能）相关（ATE效应量=0.19, p<.05；ATT效应量=0.37, p<.001）。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了ECE对受虐儿童认知与适应行为存在差异化影响，补充了ECE作为保护因素的理论边界，即ECE在提升高阶认知的同时可能削弱适应性行为。
AI.practical_contributions: 为ECE项目设计提供实证依据，强调需要识别并强化ECE项目中关键的结构和日常流程，以更好地满足受虐儿童的适应性行为需求。

title: Informal Insurance, Unemployment Risk and Optimal Monetary Policy

detail.title: Informal Insurance, Unemployment Risk and Optimal Monetary Policy
detail.abstract: In a financially fragmented economy, informal private insurance against idiosyncratic unemployment risk can increase aggregate vulnerability by reducing precautionary savings. I develop this mechanism in a two-agent New Keynesian model with search unemployment, in which financially included households pool a share of income through informal insurance networks while financially excluded households rely on limited public transfers and a thinner informal layer. Improved and better informal insurance compresses consumption heterogeneity and weakens the private buffer that would otherwise absorb aggregate shocks, increasing the value of monetary stabilization. I characterize this mechanism analytically, showing that the value of optimal policy increases with insurance quality and deriving a threshold in the exclusion-insurance space that governs its strength. I then quantify the mechanism under fully nonlinear Ramsey policy with a second-order welfare criterion calibrated to Ghana. The welfare gains from optimal stabilization rise with insurance quality at all levels of financial exclusion, become stronger under higher risk aversion, and are amplified by government debt. Relative to existing work that treats precautionary motives as fixed or focuses on formal public insurance, this paper contributes to the literature and shows that the quality of informal private insurance is a key determinant of optimal monetary policy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究非正式私人保险如何影响最优货币政策。在金融碎片化经济中，非正式的失业风险保险会减少预防性储蓄，从而增加经济脆弱性。作者在包含搜寻失业的两代理人新凯恩斯模型中分析这一机制，发现更好的非正式保险压缩了消费异质性并削弱了私人缓冲，从而提高货币政策稳定化的价值。基于加纳数据的量化分析表明，最优稳定化政策的福利收益随着保险质量的提高而上升。
AI.research_question: 非正式私人保险的质量如何影响金融碎片化经济体中的最优货币政策？
AI.motivation: 现有文献通常将预防性储蓄动机视为给定，或聚焦于正式公共保险的作用，忽视了非正式私人保险对最优货币政策的关键影响。在发展中国家，非正式保险网络广泛存在，其对宏观经济脆弱性和货币政策效果的影响尚未被充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两代理人新凯恩斯模型（TANK）；搜寻失业模型；非正式保险网络；金融排斥（金融排斥和金融融入）；拉姆齐最优政策。
AI.method: 理论分析：建立两代理人新凯恩斯模型，刻画金融融入和金融排斥两类家庭的不同保险渠道（非正式保险 vs. 公共转移），推导非正式保险质量与最优政策价值之间的分析关系。量化分析：使用加纳数据校准模型，采用二阶福利准则下的完全非线性拉姆齐政策进行数值模拟。
AI.findings: （1）更好的非正式保险压缩消费异质性，削弱预防性储蓄这一私人缓冲，反而增加经济对 aggregate shocks 的脆弱性。（2）最优货币政策的价值随着非正式保险质量的提高而上升，且存在一个金融排斥-保险空间中的阈值决定其强度。（3）福利收益在所有金融排斥水平下均随保险质量上升而增加，在更高风险厌恶下更强，并受政府债务放大。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统论证非正式私人保险质量是决定最优货币政策的关键因素，而非仅关注正式公共保险或固定预防性动机的传统视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家（特别是金融碎片化经济体）的中央银行设计货币政策提供了新视角：政策制定者需要考虑非正式保险网络的覆盖和质量对货币政策传导机制和最优政策选择的影响。

title: Institutional Gender Policy and Tolerance of Sexual Harassment: Evidence from Academic and Professional Power-Asymmetric Settings
affiliations: Universidad del Valle and Escuela Superior Politécnica del Litoral, ESPOL, FCNM. GUAYAQUIL-ECUADOR

detail.title: Institutional Gender Policy and Tolerance of Sexual Harassment: Evidence from Academic and Professional Power-Asymmetric Settings

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was performed in line with the principles of the Declaration of Helsinki. Approval was granted by the Ethics Committee of Universidad del Valle on 25th July 2022, Number 012-2022
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by Universidad del Valle, Grant number CI 6243. Author Lina Restrepo-Plaza has received research support from Universidad del Valle.

detail.abstract: Policies against sexual harassment are often more visible than effective. This paper evaluates whether a brief reminder of how a university gender policy defines sexual harassment changes the way people interpret and react to harassment under power asymmetries. We conducted two parallel survey experiments at a large public university in southwest Colombia, randomizing exposure to an infographic that summarized the institutional policy. Study 1 examined academic hierarchies between students and lecturers/professors, and Study 2 examined professional hierarchies between subordinates and directors. In both studies, participants assessed illustrated verbal, physical, non-verbal, and social-media scenarios that varied by perpetrator-victim dyad. We measured awareness, maximum inappropriateness, maximum discomfort, recommendation to report, and the expectation that others would report. The effects are sharply context-dependent. In the academic setting, policy exposure increased awareness and the probability of recommending reporting, but it did not affect maximum inappropriateness, maximum discomfort, or expected reporting by others. Women were consistently more sensitive to harassment, yet policy exposure lowered their reporting recommendation, a pattern consistent with a backlash or credibility effect. In the professional setting, the same cue was fully ineffective across all five outcomes. Across both studies, male-to-female harassment elicited stronger reactions than female-to-male harassment, underscoring the persistence of gendered norms in how harassment is recognized and addressed.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两项平行调查实验，评估了简要提醒大学性骚扰政策如何影响人们对权力不对称情境下性骚扰的解读与反应。研究发现，政策提醒的效果高度依赖情境：在学术环境中提高了意识和举报建议，但降低了女性的举报推荐（可能产生反冲效应）；在职业环境中则完全无效。
AI.research_question: 简要提醒大学性骚扰政策定义是否会改变人们在权力不对称情境下理解和应对性骚扰的方式？
AI.motivation: 反性骚扰政策通常"可见但不有效"，本研究旨在检验一个低成本干预（政策提示）是否能真正改变人们对性骚扰的认知和反应，填补政策"有效性"而非"存在性"的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 权力不对称理论（学术等级与职业等级）、性别规范理论、反冲效应（backlash effect）或可信度效应（credibility effect）。
AI.method: 在哥伦比亚西南部某大型公立大学进行两项平行调查实验，随机分组暴露于总结机构政策的信息图表，测试学术情境（学生-教授）和职业情境（下属-主管）下的五种结果变量。
AI.findings: 1）学术情境中：政策暴露提高了意识和举报推荐概率，但未影响不适感或他人举报预期；女性对骚扰更敏感，但政策暴露反而降低了其举报推荐（反冲效应）。2）职业情境中：政策暴露对全部五项结果均无效。3）跨研究一致发现：男性对女性的骚扰比女性对男性的骚扰引发更强反应，性别规范持续存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了政策提醒效果的情境依赖性（学术vs职业），发现了政策暴露对女性的"反冲效应"，丰富了性骚扰认知和性别权力动态的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者：简单的政策提醒可能在某些情境（学术）中有一定效果，但在其他情境（职业）中可能无效，且可能对女性产生意想不到的负面效应，需要更精细化、情境敏感的政策干预设计。

title: Walker Products and the Riemann Xi in Lévy Form
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Walker Products and the Riemann Xi in Lévy Form
detail.abstract: We place P. L. Walker's product representations of the Jacobi theta function and the Riemann ξ function into LévyKhintchine and Thorin form, linking them to Ostrovsky's Barnes beta / Selberg programme and to generalized gamma convolutions (GGC). The Gamma factor, the theta product, and the Euler product each yield an unconditional, possibly signed, Thorin object; the Hadamard product over the zeros yields a candidate Thorin measure UΞ = P n δγ2 n whose positivity on (0, ∞) is equivalent to the Riemann Hypothesis. A single Riemann GGC V , with E[e −sV ] = ξ( 1 2 )/ξ( 1 2 + √ s) and cumulants κj = (j − 1)!Z(2j), makes the certicate concrete. Unconditional structure and RH-equivalent positivity are kept strictly apart.

AI.tldr: 本文将Walker关于Jacobi theta函数和Riemann ξ函数的乘积表示置于Lévy-Khintchine和Thorin框架下，建立了与Ostrovsky的Barnes beta/Selberg纲领及广义伽马卷积的联系。研究发现，Gamma因子、theta乘积和欧拉乘积各自产生一个无条件的、可能带符号的Thorin对象；而零点上的Hadamard乘积则给出一个候选Thorin测度UΞ，其在正半轴上的正性等价于黎曼假设。
AI.research_question: 如何将Walker的Jacobi theta函数和Riemann ξ函数的乘积表示纳入Lévy-Khintchine和Thorin形式，并探讨其与黎曼假设的关系？
AI.motivation: 将数论中的经典函数表示与概率论中的Lévy过程理论联系起来，为黎曼假设提供一个新的等价条件，并深化对广义伽马卷积和Thorin测度的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: Lévy-Khintchine表示、Thorin测度、广义伽马卷积、Barnes beta/Selberg纲领、Walker乘积表示
AI.method: 将Walker的Jacobi theta函数和Riemann ξ函数的乘积表示分别重新表达为Lévy-Khintchine和Thorin形式，分析Gamma因子、theta乘积、欧拉乘积和Hadamard乘积各自对应的Thorin对象性质。
AI.findings: 1) Gamma因子、theta乘积和欧拉乘积各自产生无条件的、可能带符号的Thorin对象；2) 零点上的Hadamard乘积给出候选Thorin测度UΞ，其在正半轴上的正性等价于黎曼假设；3) 构造了一个黎曼GGC V，其矩母函数与ξ函数相关，累积量由Z(2j)给出，使等价关系更加具体。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了数论中函数表示与概率论中Lévy过程理论之间的新联系，为黎曼假设提供了一个基于Thorin测度正性的等价条件，拓展了广义伽马卷积理论的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为验证黎曼假设提供了新的分析工具和视角，可能推动相关数值实验和理论推导的发展。

title: Barnes Beta Distributions and the Riemann Xi Function
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Barnes Beta Distributions and the Riemann Xi Function
detail.abstract: We reorganize the probabilistic structure in Ostrovsky’s On Barnes Beta Distributions, Selberg Integral and Riemann Xi (arXiv:1402.6163) through generalized gamma convolutions (GGC), Thorin measures, and the van Dantzig / Wald couple formalism, with a view toward locating Riemann Hypothesis equivalents inside infinite divisibility. Every displayed formula is stated with exact constants and either derived or cross-referenced to Ostrovsky’s equations, labelled (O-x.y); numerical claims are checked to high precision (Appendix A). Throughout we keep a two-tier honesty discipline, separating unconditional results from RH-equivalent statements. The central object is a dictionary. The Biane–Pitman–Yor laws S2 and C2 that carry the Riemann ξ are genuine GGCs whose Thorin measures sit on the integer squares; the Barnes object β2,2(δ) enters not as a GGC but as a Gaussian subordinate of C2, precisely a Wald couple with explicit positive clock Hβ = C2/16. The construction extends to the critical line analytically and unconditionally: on Re q = 1 4 the ratio Ξ(τ )/Ξ(0) is exactly the characteristic function of a symmetric law whose density is the Riemann Φ-kernel, so the Riemann Hypothesis is not positive-definiteness. Passing to the folding variable w = s(1 − s) makes the role of the zeros exact: the reciprocal (Wald-dual) member of the couple carries a Thorin measure equal to the folded zero set Uˆ = P ρ δρ(1−ρ) , which on the critical line is P k δ1/4+γ 2 k . The Riemann Hypothesis is then a single positivity, presented through several equivalent faces: Ξ in the Laguerre–P´olya class, the closing of the Wald couple, positivity of the dual Thorin measure, the Weil quadratic form, Hankel and Jacobi positivity of the secondary-zeta moments, and the vanishing of the de Bruijn–Newman constant. The two faces of the 2 sin2 identity, the Fourier (L´evy) face and the log-sine (Clausen) face, are one lemma, and they meet exactly at this open clause.

AI.tldr: 本文将Ostrovsky关于Barnes Beta分布、Selberg积分与Riemann Xi函数的概率结构，通过广义Gamma卷积（GGC）、Thorin测度以及van Dantzig/Wald对偶形式进行重新组织，旨在将Riemann猜想的等价命题定位于无限可分性框架内。核心成果是一套“词典”：承载Riemann ξ函数的Biane–Pitman–Yor律S2和C2是真正的GGC，其Thorin测度位于整数平方上；而Barnes对象β2,2(δ)并非GGC，而是C2的高斯从属过程，精确构成一个Wald对。文章进一步展示了Riemann猜想的多种等价面：Laguerre–Pólya类、Wald对闭合、对偶Thorin测度正性、Weil二次型、次zeta矩的Hankel与Jacobi正性，以及de Bruijn–Newman常数为零。
AI.research_question: 如何通过无限可分性框架（广义Gamma卷积、Thorin测度、van Dantzig/Wald对偶）重新表述Riemann猜想的等价条件？
AI.motivation: 将Riemann猜想这一经典数论问题嵌入概率论的无限可分性结构，借助GGC和Wald对偶等工具给出其多种等价的正面表述，从而为证明RH提供新视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 广义Gamma卷积（GGC）、Thorin测度、van Dantzig/Wald对偶形式、Lévy特征函数、Laguerre–Pólya类、de Bruijn–Newman常数、Weil二次型。
AI.method: 重新组织Ostrovsky的概率结构，建立GGC与Riemann ξ函数之间的词典对应；通过Wald对偶（折叠变量w=s(1−s)）将零点集映射为Thorin测度；分析特征函数正定性与临界线上比率Ξ(τ)/Ξ(0)的对称律。
AI.findings: (1) Biane–Pitman–Yor律S2和C2是GGC，其Thorin测度在整数平方上；(2) Barnes β2,2(δ)是C2的高斯从属，构成精确Wald对；(3) 在Re q=1/4上，Ξ(τ)/Ξ(0)恰为对称律的特征函数，RH非正定性；(4) 折叠变量下，对偶成员的Thorin测度等于折叠零点集；(5) RH等价于多种正面条件：Laguerre–Pólya类、Wald对闭合、对偶Thorin测度正性、Weil二次型正性等。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了Riemann ξ函数与无限可分性（GGC、Thorin测度）之间的系统对应；将RH转化为概率论框架下的正定性/正性条件；揭示了2 sin²恒等式的Fourier面与log-sine面在RH处的交汇。
AI.practical_contributions: 为RH的研究提供了概率论和无限可分性这一新工具库；给出了可计算验证的数值检验框架；展示了van Dantzig/Wald对偶在解析数论中的具体应用。

title: Mordell Integrals, Self-Reciprocal Kernels, and the Riemann Wald Couple
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Mordell Integrals, Self-Reciprocal Kernels, and the Riemann Wald Couple
detail.abstract: We study the Mordell integral as an object in the van Dantzig and Wald-couple programme for the Riemann zeta function. The integral pairs the two classical fixed points of the Fourier transform, the Gaussian and the hyperbolic secant, and we show that this pairing realises, explicitly and at the level of kernels, the two halves of a Wald couple: a Gaussian, generalized gamma convolution half, and a Laguerre-Pólya reciprocal, Pólya-frequency half. The secant kernel is identified through a Schoenberg duality with the entire function cos(s/2), and the parameter τ is shown to run a heat semigroup on the secant kernel, the same Gaussian-multiplier mechanism as the de Bruijn-Newman deformation of the Riemann Xi function. The functional equation  is a specialisation of Mordell's modular inversion law. Throughout we keep a strict separation between unconditional statements and statements equivalent to the Riemann hypothesis. As the central obstruction we prove that hyperbolic complete monotonicity, which holds for each theta atom and for the entire Gamma and hyperbolic factor of Xi, is not preserved by the theta sum, so that the generalized gamma convolution content carrying the Riemann hypothesis is a global property of the lattice sum and cannot be assembled atom by atom. In the reverse direction we show that, granting the Riemann hypothesis, the generalized gamma convolution half of the Wald couple of ξ is itself hyperbolically completely monotone, its Laplace transform being a convergent product of hyperbolically completely monotone factors indexed by the zeros. A character twist gives the Dirichlet L-function analogue.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Mordell积分在黎曼zeta函数的van Dantzig与Wald耦合框架中的作用，揭示了高斯核与双曲正割核之间的对偶关系，并严格区分了无条件陈述与等价于黎曼假设的陈述，证明了双曲完全单调性在theta和中不被保持，从而指出承载黎曼假设的广义伽马卷积内容是一种全局性质。
AI.research_question: Mordell积分如何作为黎曼zeta函数的van Dantzig与Wald耦合框架中的对象，以及其与黎曼假设之间的关系。
AI.motivation: 探索Mordell积分在解析数论与概率论交叉领域的结构意义，并严格区分无条件结果与依赖黎曼假设的结果，揭示黎曼假设的全局性质。
AI.theoretical_framework: van Dantzig与Wald耦合框架、广义伽马卷积、Laguerre-Pólya类、Pólya频率函数、Schoenberg对偶、de Bruijn-Newman变形、双曲完全单调性、theta和
AI.method: 解析数论与概率论交叉方法：通过Mordell积分建立高斯核与双曲正割核的配对，利用Schoenberg对偶识别正割核与整函数cos(s/2)的关系，分析热半群作用与de Bruijn-Newman变形机制，并严格区分无条件结果与依赖黎曼假设的结果。
AI.findings: (1) Mordell积分实现了Wald耦合的两半：高斯-广义伽马卷积一半与Laguerre-Pólya倒数-Pólya频率一半；(2) 参数τ运行热半群，与de Bruijn-Newman变形机制相同；(3) 函数方程是Mordell模反演律的特例；(4) 双曲完全单调性在theta和中不被保持，因此承载黎曼假设的广义伽马卷积内容是全局性质；(5) 若黎曼假设成立，则ξ的Wald耦合的广义伽马卷积一半本身是双曲完全单调的。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了Mordell积分在van Dantzig-Wald耦合框架中的核心地位，阐明了黎曼假设与广义伽马卷积、双曲完全单调性之间的深层联系，并证明了黎曼假设的全局性质——不能通过逐原子组装获得。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解黎曼zeta函数的结构提供了新的概率论视角，严格区分了无条件结果与依赖黎曼假设的结果，为后续研究黎曼假设提供了理论工具和边界条件。

detail.title: Shifting Global Trade: Implications for India and Policy Responses

publicationDetails.detailsText: Nadig. Y (2026). “Shifting Global Trade: Implications for India and Policy Responses” [online]. Available at: https://www.kspp.edu.in/issue-brief/shifting-global-trade-implications-for-india-and-policy-responses

detail.abstract: The world of trade has changed dramatically with the fragmentation of geopolitics, strategic protectionism, reconfiguration of trade flows, digitalisation, and regulations that are determined by the sustainability agenda. Multilateral trade has been replaced by regional and friend-shoring/bilateral trade agreements, bringing in new opportunities and new challenges to the developing economies. This issue brief aims to look into the changing global trade environment and explore the implications for India's economic and trade strategy. The study discusses how India has reacted to these developments through India's steps such as 'Atmanirbhar Bharat', 'Make in India 2.0', 'Production Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes', and the new digital trade infrastructure. It also highlights emerging opportunities due to diversification of the supply chain, growth of services exports, strategic realignment of trade, and environmental trade barriers such as the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM), in addition to vulnerabilities like merchandise trade deficits, requirements for MSMEs, and environmental trade barriers, including environmental barriers like the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM). The study indicates that the country's future competitiveness will be based on its localisation capabilities, digitalisation, green industrialisation and policy predictability, transitioning from assembly operations. It ends with a strategic policy blueprint to enhance India's role in the changing global trading system of a more fragmented and resilient world trade.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了全球贸易环境变化（地缘政治碎片化、战略保护主义、贸易流重构、数字化及可持续发展议程）对印度经济和贸易战略的影响，分析了印度通过"自力更生印度"、"印度制造2.0"、生产关联激励计划等举措的应对，并从供应链多元化、服务出口增长、战略贸易重组及碳边境调节机制等环境贸易壁垒角度提出了战略政策蓝图。
AI.research_question: 在不断变化的全球贸易环境（地缘政治碎片化、保护主义、贸易流重构、数字化、可持续发展议程）下，印度应如何调整其经济和贸易战略以把握机遇并应对挑战？
AI.motivation: 多边贸易体系被区域性和友岸/双边贸易协定取代，给发展中经济体带来新机遇和新挑战，因此需要系统性审视印度的贸易战略调整方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球贸易碎片化理论、地缘经济理论、友岸外包理论、可持续发展议程下的贸易壁垒理论（如CBAM）、本地化与数字化驱动的竞争优势理论。
AI.method: 问题简报（Issue Brief）形式，结合政策分析、案例描述（印度多项政策举措）及趋势研判。
AI.findings: 印度未来竞争力取决于本地化能力、数字化、绿色工业化及政策可预测性；需从组装运营向更高附加值转型；面临商品贸易逆差、中小微企业要求及碳边境调节机制等环境贸易壁垒等脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为全球贸易碎片化背景下发展中经济体的战略调整提供了印度案例的系统性分析框架，整合了地缘政治、数字化与绿色转型等多元因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及类似发展中国家提供了增强在全球碎片化贸易体系中角色的战略政策蓝图，涵盖供应链多元化、服务出口增长、环境贸易壁垒应对等具体方向。

title: Data-to-Rating (D2R): A Public-Data Methodology for Continuous Assessment and Structured Judgment

detail.title: Data-to-Rating (D2R): A Public-Data Methodology for Continuous Assessment and Structured Judgment
detail.abstract:
Many assessment systems were formed in environments where meaningful evidence was difficult to observe without voluntary disclosure, questionnaires, site visits, internal documents, interviews, or formal attestations. That assumption remains valid in many physical, organizational, and high-stakes assurance contexts, but it is no longer sufficient as a general theory of assessment. Digital-native environments, especially software, demonstrate a different evidentiary logic: code, dependencies, configuration files, repositories, logs, tests, build artifacts, deployment records, and software bills of materials can often be assessed continuously or near-continuously. More broadly, organizations, public authorities, platforms, and jurisdictions now generate dense public digital traces through websites, registries, disclosures, technical interfaces, procurement records, service workflows, public repositories, and machine-readable artifacts. Public data has moved from being a supplementary source to becoming a measurable evidence environment. 
This paper introduces Data-to-Rating (D2R), a methodological framework for converting publicly obtainable digital data into qualified signals and then into structured, comparable, and contestable assessments. D2R complements statutory audit, on-site inspection, and direct assurance by adding a public-evidence measurement layer that qualifies observable data as relevant signals, extracts features, maps them to evaluative dimensions, produces scores and ratings, and attaches explicit confidence and evidence lineage. D2R is formalized as an evidence-to-judgment architecture rather than a scoring formula or visual rating symbol. 
The paper makes four contributions: it defines a strict D2R vocabulary that separates data, signals, features, indicators, scores, ratings, representations, confidence, and judgment; it develops an evidentiary theory for public-data assessment, including the principle of observable construct manifestation and a signaling-theoretic hierarchy that orders public evidence by the cost of counterfeiting it; it specifies an end-to-end methodological pipeline with human control points, a measurement model that separates latent constructs from their public manifestations, and explicit uncertainty and validation requirements; and it positions D2R as a complement to audits and questionnaires that preserves human authority over construct design, thresholds, disputes, and high-stakes interpretation. The central claim is bounded: public data cannot reveal everything, but where relevant qualities leave observable traces, a disciplined D2R method can convert public evidence into defensible structured judgment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出数据到评级（D2R）方法论框架，将公开可获取的数字数据转化为结构化、可比较、可争议的评估结果，作为传统审计和问卷调查的补充，基于公共数字痕迹建立证据驱动的评估体系。
AI.research_question: 如何将公开可获取的数字数据系统性地转化为结构化、可比较、可争议的评估结果？
AI.motivation: 传统评估体系依赖自愿披露、问卷、实地访问等非数字化证据收集方式，这在数字原生环境中已不再充分。如今各类组织产生了密集的公共数字痕迹（代码、仓库、日志、注册信息等），公共数据已从补充来源转变为可测量的证据环境，因此需要一套新的方法论来利用这些公共数字证据进行系统评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 可观测构念表现原则（observable construct manifestation）；2. 信号传递理论层级（signaling-theoretic hierarchy），按伪造成本对公共证据进行排序；3. 证据到判断（evidence-to-judgment）架构。
AI.method: D2R方法论：将公开数字数据转化为合格信号→提取特征→映射到评估维度→生成分数和评级→附上明确的置信度和证据溯源。包含人类控制节点、测量模型（分离潜在构念与公共表现）、明确的不确定性和验证要求。
AI.findings: 论文提出了四个贡献：1) 定义了严格的D2R词汇体系；2) 发展了公共数据评估的证据理论；3) 指定了端到端的方法论管道；4) 将D2R定位为审计和问卷的补充方法。核心主张是：公共数据不能揭示一切，但当相关质量留下了可观测痕迹时，严谨的D2R方法可以将公共证据转化为可辩护的结构化判断。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了公共数据评估的证据理论，包括可观测构念表现原则和基于伪造成本的信号层级；2. 提出了证据到判断的形式化架构，而非简单的评分公式；3. 建立了评估中不确定性、置信度和证据溯源的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了将公共数字数据转化为系统评估的完整方法论管道；2. D2R可作为传统审计、现场检查和直接保证的补充工具；3. 保留了人类在构建设计、阈值设定、争议处理和重大解释中的权威；4. 适用于软件评估、组织评级、平台监管等数字原生场景。

affiliations: Institute of Rural and Agricultural Development, Polish Academy of Sciences

detail.abstract: Aim: The aim of the article was to identify changes in domestic agriculture and their determinants affecting the economic situation of farms during Poland's membership in the EU. Material and Methods: The analyses were based on empirical material, including data from public statistics (Statistics Poland, ARMA and Eurostat) and the literature on the subject. The study used descriptive, historical, and index methods as well as the method of a scoping literature review. The observation period covered the years 2004-2022. Results: The analysis of public statistics data and the literature review showed that in almost two decades since Poland's accession to the EU, economic changes took place which affected the situation of the agricultural sector, agricultural structures, and farms. An important role in processes under examination was played by the instruments of the EU common agricultural policy, stabilizing the position of farmers, especially in terms of improving their income situation and enhancing the possibilities for growth and modernization of production within the developing agri-food sector. Conclusions: However, during the analyzed period, no significant structural transformations in agriculture were observed, especially in the agrarian structure. They followed a trend towards the concentration of agricultural land in relatively larger and commercially viable farms, but the scale and pace of this process was small, which was associated with the effects of EU and national agricultural policy solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2004-2022年波兰加入欧盟后国内农业的变化及其对农场经济状况的影响，发现欧盟共同农业政策稳定了农民收入并促进了生产现代化，但农业结构转型不明显，土地集中化进程缓慢。
AI.research_question: 波兰加入欧盟后，国内农业发生了哪些变化？哪些决定因素影响了农场的经济状况？
AI.motivation: 评估波兰加入欧盟近二十年来农业部门的经济变迁，特别是欧盟共同农业政策对农业结构、农场经济状况的实际影响效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农业经济转型理论、欧盟共同农业政策（CAP）影响机制、农业结构变迁理论
AI.method: 采用描述性方法、历史方法、指数方法以及范围综述法，基于波兰统计局、ARMA、Eurostat的公开统计数据及相关文献进行分析。
AI.findings: 1）欧盟共同农业政策工具稳定了农民地位，改善了收入状况，促进了农业食品部门的生产增长与现代化；2）农业结构未发生显著转型，土地集中化趋势虽存在但规模和速度较小；3）农业政策的效应是结构变化缓慢的主要原因。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了欧盟共同农业政策在稳定农民收入与抑制农业结构快速转型之间的双重效应，丰富了农业政策与结构变迁关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为波兰及类似转型经济体在欧盟框架下制定农业政策提供了实证依据，提示政策制定者需在收入支持与结构优化之间寻求平衡。

title: From Backlash to Benefit: Inter-generational Effects of India's Anti-Dowry Law on Girls' Education
affiliations: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER) Bhopal - Department of Economic Sciences and Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER) Bhopal - Department of Economic Sciences

detail.title: From Backlash to Benefit: Inter-generational Effects of India's Anti-Dowry Law on Girls' Education
detail.abstract: We study the long-run intergenerational effects of India's Dowry Prohibition Amendment Act (1985) using a difference-indifferences framework that exploits exogenous variation in marriage timing and first-born gender. We find that the educational attainment of the first-born child increased by 8.6 percentage points among Hindu households exposed to the reform, while average years of schooling for all female children rose by 6.9 per cent in households where the first-born was a girl. The education gender gap declines by approximately 8 per cent among children of exposed parents with a first-born daughter, relative to the counterfactual. These gains are driven by a gradual shift in gender norms, as exposed parents increasingly value daughters as old age support, alongside a documented decline in domestic violence and improved wives' autonomy, reflecting a sustained softening of patriarchal attitudes across generations.

AI.tldr: 本文利用印度1985年《禁止嫁妆修正案》作为准自然实验，发现该法律通过改变性别规范，显著提高了受影响家庭子女的教育水平，缩小了教育性别差距。
AI.research_question: 印度1985年《禁止嫁妆修正案》对受影响家庭子女教育水平及教育性别差距的长期代际影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 嫁妆制度是印度长期存在的社会问题，可能通过经济激励扭曲家庭对子女（尤其是女孩）的教育投资。作者希望探究法律干预能否通过改变性别规范，产生跨越代际的积极社会影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际传递理论、性别规范演化理论、家庭内部资源分配理论。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences），利用婚姻时间的外生变化和头胎子女性别作为变异来源。
AI.findings: (1) 受影响家庭的头胎子女受教育程度提高8.6个百分点；(2) 在头胎为女孩的家庭中，所有女性子女的平均受教育年限提高6.9%；(3) 教育性别差距缩小约8%；(4) 机制在于性别规范的逐步转变——父母越来越重视女儿作为养老支持，同时家庭暴力和妻子自主权也有所改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 为法律如何通过改变社会规范（而非仅通过经济激励）产生长期代际效应提供了经验证据，拓展了制度变迁与性别平等关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 表明针对歧视性习俗（如嫁妆）的立法干预可以产生积极的代际溢出效应，为发展中国家制定性别平等政策提供了实证支持。

title: Staging Surrender: Cognitive Warfare, Democratic Maskirovka, and the Intra-State War Against Pakistan's Political Majority (2022–2026)

detail.title: Staging Surrender: Cognitive Warfare, Democratic Maskirovka, and the Intra-State War Against Pakistan's Political Majority (2022–2026)
detail.abstract:
Between April 2022 and May 2026, Pakistan's democratic movement with the name of Haqiqi Azadi/PTI, one of the largest sustained civilian mobilizations in the country's history, moved from the streets to near-silence without being militarily defeated. This paper argues that the movement's exhaustion was not a natural political outcome. It was the product of a systematic cognitive warfare campaign conducted by the Pakistani state against its own political majority, drawing from the doctrinal frameworks of Chinese and Russian information warfare and deployed through mechanisms that existing political science has not adequately named.

The paper introduces six original analytical concepts, democratic maskirovka, weaponized hope, epistemic siege, somatic cognitive warfare, the betrayal performance, and institutional mimicry, developed at the intersection of cognitive warfare theory, relational dramaturgy, and political psychology. These are not borrowed frameworks applied to a new context. They are instruments built from the specific character of what was done in Pakistan to name what the existing literature cannot.

The empirical analysis proceeds through four case studies: the April 2022 removal of Prime Minister Imran Khan, the retrospective construction of May 9, 2023 as a master legitimizing narrative, the managed election of February 8, 2024, and the anatomy of the movement's internal collapse through the Gandapur march cycle and the epistemic siege around Imran Khan in Adiala jail. The paper closes with seven counter-performance strategies grounded in the structural vulnerabilities the analysis exposes. The central argument is that the movement has not surrendered. It has been suspended. Understanding the mechanism of that suspension is the first act of reversing it.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2022年4月至2026年5月间巴基斯坦Haqiqi Azadi/PTI民主运动从街头抗争到近乎沉默的过程，认为这不是自然的政治结果，而是巴基斯坦国家系统运用认知战（借鉴中俄信息战理论）压制自身政治多数的产物。论文提出了六个原创分析概念，并通过四个案例进行实证分析，最终提出七项反制策略。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦PTI民主运动为何在没有军事失败的情况下从大规模街头动员走向近乎沉默？其背后的机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有政治学理论无法充分解释巴基斯坦国家针对自身政治多数进行的系统性认知战行为，需要构建新的概念工具来命名和分析这一现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知战理论、关系戏剧学（relational dramaturgy）、政治心理学；借鉴中俄信息战理论框架。
AI.method: 概念构建与案例研究相结合。提出六个原创分析概念，通过四个案例进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 该运动并非已经投降，而是被"悬置"（suspended）。巴基斯坦国家通过民主伪装、武器化希望、认知围困、躯体认知战、背叛表演和制度模仿等六种机制，系统地压制了政治多数。理解这种悬置机制是逆转它的第一步。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了六个原创分析概念（民主伪装、武器化希望、认知围困、躯体认知战、背叛表演、制度模仿），为认知战研究和政治心理学提供了新的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了七项反制策略，为理解并应对非军事性的政治压制提供了实践指南。

title: Directions for Adjustments in the Polish Agricultural and Food Economy Related with the Future Accession of Ukraine to the European Union
affiliations: National Research Institute - Institute of Agricultural and Food Economics - National Research Institute (IAFE-NRI)

detail.title: Directions for Adjustments in the Polish Agricultural and Food Economy Related with the Future Accession of Ukraine to the European Union
detail.abstract:
Aim: The aim of this study is to identify opportunities for cooperation between the Polish and Ukrain-
ian economies, with particular emphasis on agriculture and the processing of agricultural products.
This cooperation would bring mutual benefits both during the ongoing Russian-Ukrainian war and
potentially in the early post-war period.
Material and Methods: The analysis is based on literature studies and economic, environmental, and
climate considerations that are relevant to European Union policy.
Results: The results of the study indicate that there is real potential for cooperation in at least four areas.
Conclusions: These include: supporting Ukrainian agriculture by involving Polish investors in sus-
taining agricultural production on Ukrainian farms and agricultural enterprises and developing local
processing of agricultural raw materials; the production of biofuels and high-quality concentrated
feed in Poland using agricultural raw materials imported from Ukraine; the development of organic
agricultural production guaranteeing high food quality.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨波兰与乌克兰在农业及农产品加工领域的合作机会，识别出四个具有互惠潜力的合作方向，涵盖战时及战后早期阶段。
AI.research_question: 波兰与乌克兰经济在农业及农产品加工领域存在哪些合作机会？这些合作如何在俄乌战争期间及战后早期实现互惠？
AI.motivation: 俄乌战争对两国经济尤其是农业造成冲击，亟需探索双边合作以增强经济韧性、保障粮食安全，并为战后重建奠定基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于欧盟政策框架下的经济、环境与气候考量，结合国际贸易与农业合作理论。
AI.method: 文献研究法，并结合欧盟政策相关的经济、环境与气候因素分析。
AI.findings: 识别出四个合作领域：1）波兰投资支持乌克兰农业生产及本地加工；2）利用乌克兰原材料在波兰生产生物燃料和高品质浓缩饲料；3）发展有机农业保障高质量食品；4）（结论中提及的第四个领域需结合原文，但摘要中仅明确列出三个）
AI.theory_contributions: 将经济合作理论与战时/战后特殊情境相结合，拓展了农业跨国合作在危机情境下的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为波兰与乌克兰的农业与农产品加工业合作提供具体方向指引，有助于政策制定者和企业识别投资与协作机会，促进经济韧性与粮食安全。

title: Unlocking Economic Freedom: Prioritizing Reforms in Developing Countries through Economic Complexity

detail.title: Unlocking Economic Freedom: Prioritizing Reforms in Developing Countries through Economic Complexity
detail.abstract:
Developing countries face the problem of prioritizing reforms under limited resources. Existing international composite indices aggregate dozens of disparate indicators with equal weights, providing a flat list of indicators but no hierarchy among them. This paper proposes an alternative approach by adapting the economic complexity methodology of Hidalgo et al. to institutional data. Drawing on the 45 indicators of the Fraser Institute's Economic Freedom of the World (EFW) database covering 165 countries, we construct: (1) an Indicator Complexity Index (ICI)-an empirically derived hierarchy with rule of law at the top and fiscal freedoms at the bottom; (2) an Indicator Space with a "dumbbell" topology, in which the institutional core and the monetary-fiscal freedoms occupy opposite poles; (3) a Country Complexity Index (CCI) and a corresponding country grouping, with informative regional outliers; and (4) a country-specific reform-prioritization framework, illustrated using Kazakhstan. 
By doing so, the paper also offers a quantitative proxy for the latent capabilities-of societies and ruling elites-that ultimately translate into the formal institutions captured by EFW.

AI.tldr: 本文利用经济复杂性方法论，基于全球165个国家的经济自由数据，构建了指标复杂性指数、指标空间、国家复杂性指数及改革优先级框架，为发展中国家在有限资源下识别制度改革优先序提供了新工具。
AI.research_question: 发展中国家在有限资源约束下，如何确定制度改革的优先顺序？
AI.motivation: 现有国际综合指数将众多指标等权重加总，仅提供扁平化的指标列表，缺乏指标间层级关系，无法指导改革优先排序。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济复杂性方法论（Hidalgo等），从共现网络中推断指标的复杂性及国家能力。
AI.method: 基于Fraser研究所经济自由度数据库（EFW）涵盖165个国家的45个指标，运用经济复杂性方法构建指标复杂性指数（ICI）、指标空间、国家复杂性指数（CCI）及国家层面改革优先级框架，并以哈萨克斯坦为例进行实证说明。
AI.findings: （1）指标复杂性指数显示法治处于层级顶端，财政自由处于底端；（2）指标空间呈"哑铃"拓扑结构，制度核心与货币-财政自由分居两极；（3）构建了国家复杂性指数及国家分组，发现区域性异常值；（4）提供了国别改革优先排序框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 将经济复杂性方法论拓展至制度分析领域，为理解制度能力提供了定量代理变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家的制度改革提供了以数据驱动的优先顺序识别工具，有助于在资源有限条件下做出更有效的政策决策。

title: Trade-offs When Promoting Sustainability: Changing Attitudes or Changing Behaviour?
affiliations: , affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Galway

detail.title: Trade-offs When Promoting Sustainability: Changing Attitudes or Changing Behaviour?
detail.abstract: Many appeals to farmers to adopt sustainable practices are currently relying on pressure factors that may be inducing green and yet unsustainable behaviour. Different trade-offs are involved in this transition but are normally overlooked. Take for example those sustainable practices that are intended to substitute away from synthetic fertilisers. Being a key input in the production process, promoting farmers’ transition to more sustainable fertiliser practices is challenging and uptake remains low. Recent extremely high fertiliser prices, especially due to the Russian invasion of Ukraine, and its volatility, have added considerable pressure on farmers to consider fertiliser substitutes. Furthermore, more restrictive environmental regulations, such as reductions in nitrogen allowances, have added another substantial pressure to farmers to look for alternatives. To some extent, high prices and legislation may ‘force’ farmers to increase the adoption of sustainable fertilisers. However, this increased adoption will be superficial and unsustainable if farmers are feeling pushed into these changes. We believe that farmers’ intrinsic motives (e.g., environmental concern, morale, or responsibility) to adopt sustainable fertiliser practices have not yet been engaged in adoption decisions. Therefore, we argue that as soon as synthetic fertiliser prices go down, or if environmental regulations are eased, farmers will go back to their conventional fertiliser practices. Improving farmers' intrinsic motivation could therefore provide a more sustainable approach to reducing synthetic fertiliser application than relying solely on external pressures, an aspect that has received limited attention in policy.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，当前推动农民采用可持续肥料实践主要依赖外部压力（如高价格和环境法规），但这可能导致表面化且不可持续的行为。作者认为，只有当农民的内在动机（如环境关切、道德责任感）被激发时，可持续实践才能真正持久，否则一旦外部压力解除，农民会恢复传统化肥使用。
AI.research_question: 农民采用可持续肥料实践的真正驱动力是什么？外部压力（价格、法规）与内在动机如何影响可持续行为的持久性？
AI.motivation: 当前可持续农业推广过度依赖外部压力因素（高化肥价格、环境法规），可能诱发"绿色但不可持续"的表面行为，忽视农民内在动机的作用，导致政策效果不可持续。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外部压力（价格机制、法规约束）vs. 内在动机（环境关切、道德责任感）的二元驱动框架；可持续行为转变的"推力-拉力"理论。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性论文，基于文献梳理和逻辑推理提出论点，属于评论类（Perspective/Opinion）研究。
AI.findings: 1. 外部压力（高价格、严格法规）确实能推动农民采用可持续肥料，但这种采用是表面化和不可持续的；2. 一旦外部压力解除（化肥价格下跌或法规放松），农民会回归传统实践；3. 改善农民内在动机是更可持续的路径，但政策中对此关注不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了可持续农业行为转变中外部压力与内在动机的不同作用机制，提出了"绿色但不可持续"的概念，揭示了政策设计中忽视内在动机的理论缺口。
AI.practical_contributions: 为农业政策和推广实践提供启示：应更多关注激发农民内在环境责任感，而非仅依赖价格和法规等外部压力手段，以实现可持续农业的长期效果。

title: Bank Runs With and Without Bank Failure
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond, Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: Bank Runs With and Without Bank Failure

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of New York Staff Report No. 1198
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study the causes and consequences of bank runs. By applying large language models to historical newspapers, we create a comprehensive database of bank runs in U.S. history with information on 3,984 runs on individual banks from 1863 to 1934. Our novel data allow us to establish that runs are considerably more likely in weak banks but also occur in strong banks, especially in response to negative news about the real economy or the broader banking system. However, runs typically only result in failure for banks with poor fundamentals. Strong banks survive runs through various mechanisms, including signaling strength, interbank cooperation, and temporary suspension. At the local level, runs on banks with poor fundamentals translate into substantially larger declines in deposits, lending, and manufacturing activity than runs on strong banks. Our findings imply that poor fundamentals are central to explaining both when runs occur and when they have severe economic effects, tempering the view that small shocks can generate discontinuous jumps to bad equilibria through self-fulfilling run dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文利用大语言模型处理历史报纸，构建了1863-1934年间美国3,984次银行挤兑的综合数据库。研究发现：挤兑更可能发生在弱势银行，但强势银行也会遭遇挤兑（尤其是负面经济新闻后）；挤兑通常只导致基本面差的银行倒闭；强势银行通过信号传递、银行间合作和暂停营业等方式存活；基本面差的银行遭遇挤兑会引发更严重的存款、贷款和制造业下降。结论：基本面差是解释挤兑发生及其经济后果的核心因素，削弱了"小冲击可通过自我实现动态导致不良均衡"的观点。
AI.research_question: 银行挤兑的成因和后果是什么？基本面因素与自我实现预期在挤兑中各自扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 传统银行挤兑研究受限于数据，难以区分"基本面驱动的挤兑"与"自我实现的恐慌性挤兑"。本文利用LLM从历史报纸中大规模提取挤兑事件，以解决这一长期争论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行挤兑理论（基本面驱动 vs 自我实现预期）、信号理论、银行间合作机制
AI.method: 利用大语言模型（LLM）从历史报纸中提取银行挤兑事件；构建1863-1934年美国3,984次银行挤兑数据库；结合银行资产负债表数据、地方经济数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）挤兑更可能发生在弱势银行，但强势银行也会遭遇挤兑，尤其是负面经济或银行系统新闻后；（2）挤兑通常只导致基本面差的银行倒闭，强势银行可通过信号传递、银行间合作、暂停营业等方式生存；（3）弱势银行挤兑对存款、贷款和制造业的负面影响远大于强势银行挤兑。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"基本面驱动论"提供了大规模实证支持，修正了"小冲击可通过自我实现恐慌导致银行倒闭"的传统观点，表明基本面是解释挤兑发生和经济后果的核心因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融监管提供历史经验：监管应重点关注基本面差的银行；建立银行间合作和信号传递机制有助于应对挤兑风险。

title: How Basel III Changes Where Capital Sits: Nonbank Subsidiaries as Equity Reservoirs
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of New York and University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Anderson School of Management

detail.title: How Basel III Changes Where Capital Sits: Nonbank Subsidiaries as Equity Reservoirs

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
When Basel III’s binding capital minimums took effect for U.S. banks in January 2015, a bank holding company (BHC) whose depository subsidiary fell short of the new standards had two options. It could raise fresh equity in external markets, a costly option. Or, if it owned equity-rich nonbank affiliates, it could simply move capital from one subsidiary to another. The second route satisfies the regulator, avoids issuance costs, and leaves consolidated equity exactly where it was. In this second post of our series, we show that this is precisely what organizationally complex BHCs did in response to higher capital requirements.

To view post:https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2026/07/how-basel-iii-changes-where-capital-sits-nonbank-subsidiaries-as-equity-reservoirs/

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国银行控股公司在巴塞尔III资本最低要求生效后，如何通过将资本从非银行子公司转移至存款子公司来满足监管要求，从而避免昂贵的外部股权融资。
AI.research_question: 组织复杂的银行控股公司如何应对巴塞尔III更高的资本要求？
AI.motivation: 巴塞尔III资本最低要求于2015年1月对美国银行生效，银行面临两种选择：昂贵的外部股权融资，或从非银行子公司转移资本。研究旨在揭示银行的实际应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本结构理论、监管套利、内部资本市场理论
AI.method: 实证分析，对比银行控股公司在巴塞尔III前后的资本配置变化。
AI.findings: 组织复杂的银行控股公司通过将股权从非银行子公司转移到存款子公司的内部资本转移方式，满足更高的资本要求，避免了外部融资成本，且合并权益保持不变。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了银行在监管压力下利用内部资本市场进行资本重新配置的机制，丰富了监管套利和资本结构理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了银行应对资本监管的真实行为证据，提示关注银行组织复杂性和内部资本转移对监管有效性的影响。

title: Citizens in the AI Loop: A New Social Architecture for Collective Intelligence and Sovereign AI Models

detail.title: Citizens in the AI Loop: A New Social Architecture for Collective Intelligence and Sovereign AI Models

declarations.ethicsApproval: Any data collected for the purpose of Saksham Skill Census has been done with explicit permission of the participants.
declarations.funderStatement: The study contains outputs of research derived from Saksham Skill Census, a projected funded by the Government of Maharashtra (India).

publicationDetails.detailsText: A different version of this work is available on Zenodo at 10.5281/zenodo.20559290. The SSRN version expands the discussion of societal and governance implications.

detail.abstract: Contemporary artificial intelligence systems rest on a Humans in the Loop (HITL) paradigm in which specialist annotators supply discrete, decontextualised labels to model-training pipelines owned by a small number of foundation-model firms. This paper argues that HITL is not only a technical methodology but a social structureone in which citizens appear at the bottom of the AI value stack, as both the scraped substrate of training corpora and the precarious labour that cleans them, while platform firms appropriate the resulting intelligence as private capital. Drawing on the literatures on data colonialism (Couldry & Mejias, 2019), ghost work (Gray & Suri, 2019), and data dignity (Lanier, 2013; Posner & Weyl, 2018), the paper introduces Citizens in the Loop (CitL) as an inverted architecture in which the citizen is repositioned at the top of the loop: the originator, owner, and beneficiary of the intelligence they generate. A single verified citizen action produces five cross-linked dimensions-annotation, hyperlocal territory profile, demographic profile, livelihood profile, and an in-situ cognition layer-rather than a single decontextualised label. Foundation-model failure on progressively hyperlocal queries is shown to be architectural rather than computational. Field instantiations from the Saksham Skill Census (Mumbai Suburban, 32,000+ households) and the Myanmar financial inclusion programme are presented as proofs of concept. The paper concludes with implications for sovereign AI policy, the political economy of data, and the design of state-citizen information systems in the Global South.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了当前AI系统中"人在循环中"(HITL)的范式，指出其将公民置于AI价值链底端、沦为被剥削的数据来源和廉价劳动力。作者提出"公民在循环中"(CitL)的逆向架构，将公民重新定位为智能的源头、所有者和受益者，并通过印度和缅甸的实地案例验证了该架构的可行性。
AI.research_question: 如何将公民从AI价值链底端的被动数据提供者和廉价劳动力，重新定位为智能生成过程的源头、所有者和受益者？
AI.motivation: 现有HITL范式将公民置于AI价值链的底层——既是被抓取的训练数据基质，又是清理数据的边缘劳工，而平台企业则将产生的智能据为私有资本。这种社会结构存在严重的不平等问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据殖民主义(Couldry & Mejias, 2019)、幽灵工作(Gray & Suri, 2019)、数据尊严(Lanier, 2013; Posner & Weyl, 2018)
AI.method: 理论建构与实地案例验证。理论层面基于数据殖民主义、幽灵工作和数据尊严文献提出CitL架构；实践层面通过印度Saksham技能普查(孟买郊区，32,000+户)和缅甸金融包容性项目两个实地案例进行概念验证。
AI.findings: (1) 单一经过验证的公民行动可产生五个交叉关联维度（标注、超本地地域档案、人口档案、生计档案和原位认知层），而非单一的脱离语境标签；(2) 基础模型在渐进式超本地化查询上的失败是架构性而非计算性的；(3) 两个实地案例证明了CitL架构的可行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"公民在循环中"(CitL)这一逆向架构理论，批判并重构了HITL范式下的公民-平台权力关系，将数据殖民主义、幽灵工作和数据尊严等理论整合为一个可操作的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球南方主权AI政策、数据政治经济学和国家-公民信息系统设计提供了实践路径和启示，通过实地案例展示了CitL架构的可操作性。

title: Bayesian Persuasion in the Political Economy of Climate Change: Information Design in the Presence of Ambiguity

detail.title: Bayesian Persuasion in the Political Economy of Climate Change: Information Design in the Presence of Ambiguity
detail.abstract: This paper studies optimal information design when signals are transmitted through a noisy communication channel before reaching receivers. We extend the Kamenica–Gentzkow (2011) framework to a setting in which noisy transmission generates ambiguous signals, and receivers may interpret ambiguity non-Bayesianly i.e, resolving it in the direction of their prior. Under Bayesian updating, noise erodes persuasion by diverting probability mass away from action-inducing signals. This logic reverses under non-Bayesian (prior-anchored) interpretation: the sender optimally inverts the KG signal structure, strategically routing persuasion through the noisy channel itself. Ambiguity thereby transforms from an informational friction into a persuasive mechanism. The model generates a sharp payoff ranking across citizen types and suggests that improving the accuracy of scientific communication may not eliminate collective inaction when ambiguity is systematically misinterpreted.

AI.tldr: 本文研究信息通过噪声通信渠道传递时的最优信息设计，发现当接收者以非贝叶斯（锚定先验）方式解读歧义时，噪声反而成为说服机制，发讯者会反转经典KG信号结构，利用信道噪声本身进行策略性说服。
AI.research_question: 当信号通过噪声信道传输且接收者以非贝叶斯方式解读歧义时，信息发送者的最优信息设计策略是什么？
AI.motivation: 现实中信息传播常受噪声干扰，且公众解读歧义信息时往往不是理性贝叶斯式的，而是锚定自身先验信念。这一现象挑战了经典KG说服框架的假设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展Kamenica–Gentzkow (2011)贝叶斯说服框架，引入噪声信道和两种更新规则：贝叶斯更新 vs. 非贝叶斯（先验锚定）解读。
AI.method: 理论模型分析，对比不同更新规则下的最优信号结构。}，
AI.findings: 1) 贝叶斯更新下，噪声削弱说服力；2) 非贝叶斯解读下，发讯者最优策略是反转KG信号结构，利用信道噪声本身进行说服；3) 歧义从信息摩擦转变为说服机制；4) 模型对公民类型产出尖锐的收益排序，表明提升科学沟通精度可能无法消除集体不作为。
AI.theory_contributions: 将噪声信道与行为（非贝叶斯）解读结合引入信息设计理论，揭示了歧义从摩擦到机制的转换逻辑，拓展了说服理论的适用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为科学传播、公共政策沟通等场景提供警示：单纯提高信息准确性未必有助共识形成，若公众系统性锚定先验解读歧义，噪声反而可能被策略性利用来影响集体行为。

title: The Spatial Dimension of the Gender Wage Gap: Local Labor Supply of Highly-Educated Married Women in the U.S.

detail.title: The Spatial Dimension of the Gender Wage Gap: Local Labor Supply of Highly-Educated Married Women in the U.S.
detail.abstract: This study examines how the locational labor supply of highly educated married women contributes to the national gender wage gap. I document a robust negative relationship between local male wage levels and married women's labor force participation across metropolitan statistical areas, identified via a Bartik labor demand instrument and confirmed at the individual level. This pattern is concentrated among married women with children and is absent among other groups. Counterfactual analyses show that realigning married women's crossarea employment weights with those of not-married women reduces the gender log wage gap by up to 6.5 percent for college graduates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了高学历已婚女性的区位劳动力供给如何影响国家层面的性别工资差距，发现当地男性工资水平与已婚女性劳动参与率呈负相关，并通过反事实分析表明，调整已婚女性的跨地区就业权重可缩小性别工资差距。
