AI.research_question: 高学历已婚女性的区位劳动力供给如何影响国家层面的性别工资差距？
AI.motivation: 理解已婚女性（尤其是有孩子的已婚女性）因配偶工资水平而限制自身劳动参与的地理模式，从而揭示性别工资差距的来源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区位劳动力供给理论、性别工资差距理论、家庭内部劳动分工理论
AI.method: 使用Bartik劳动力需求工具变量进行计量分析，结合个体层面验证，并进行反事实模拟分析。
AI.findings: 当地男性工资水平与已婚女性劳动参与率呈稳健负相关，该模式集中体现在有孩子的已婚女性中，其他群体则不显著；调整已婚女性的跨地区就业分布可缩小大学毕业生性别工资差距高达6.5%。
AI.theory_contributions: 将区位选择与家庭内部劳动力供给决策纳入性别工资差距分析框架，揭示了空间劳动力市场摩擦对性别不平等的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了缩小性别工资差距的新视角，即通过改善已婚女性跨地区就业流动性来缓解工资差距。

title: Exchange Rate Pass-through and Trade Balance Dynamics in India: An Empirical Analysis (2010–2025)

detail.title: Exchange Rate Pass-through and Trade Balance Dynamics in India: An Empirical Analysis (2010–2025)
detail.abstract: The Indian rupee depreciated from approximately ₹45 per US dollar in 2010 to around ₹85–87 by mid-2025, a nominal decline of roughly 90% over fifteen years. Yet headline consumer price inflation averaged approximately 5% over the same period, a modest outcome by historical and emerging-market standards. This paper investigates two connected questions. First, how much of a rupee depreciation passes through to domestic wholesale and consumer prices (exchange rate pass-through, ERPT)? Second, does a weaker rupee narrow India's trade deficit through the J curve mechanism? Using monthly data from January 2010 to December 2025, the study estimates a vector autoregression (VAR) model to measure ERPT and a distributed-lag model to test for the J-curve. Rolling regressions reveal that the ERPT coefficient to consumer prices has declined from approximately 0.28 in the early 2010s to 0.12 by 2023–2025, consistent with the credibility gains achieved under the Flexible Inflation Targeting (FIT) framework formally enacted in 2016. Trade balance evidence is more ambiguous: the deficit initially widens for two to three months following a real depreciation before a modest, statistically insignificant improvement appears at the six-to nine-month horizon, indicating a weak J-curve at best. The paper concludes that lower ERPT affords the Reserve Bank of India greater monetary policy flexibility, while the limited trade balance response suggests that depreciation alone is insufficient to address India's structural current-account deficit. Policy recommendations focus on non-price export competitiveness: logistics reform, free trade agreement expansion, and targeted support for MSME exporters.

AI.tldr: 本文研究印度卢比贬值对国内价格的传导效应（ERPT）及对贸易逆差的J曲线效应。发现：ERPT系数从2010年代初的0.28下降至2023-2025年的0.12（归功于弹性通胀目标制）；贸易逆差在贬值后短期扩大，6-9个月后虽有改善但统计不显著（弱J曲线）。建议通过物流改革、自贸协定和中小企业支持来提升非价格出口竞争力。
AI.research_question: 两个核心问题：1）卢比贬值在多大程度上传导至国内批发和消费价格（汇率传导效应，ERPT）？2）卢比贬值是否通过J曲线机制缩小印度贸易逆差？
AI.motivation: 卢比在过去15年贬值约90%，但同期通胀仅平均5%（历史上表现温和），这一看似矛盾的现象需要解释。同时，印度持续面临结构性经常账户赤字，需评估贬值是否有助于改善贸易平衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 汇率传导效应（ERPT）理论、J曲线理论、弹性通胀目标制（FIT）下的货币政策 credibility 理论。
AI.method: 使用2010年1月至2025年12月的月度数据，采用向量自回归（VAR）模型估计ERPT，采用分布滞后模型检验J曲线效应，并通过滚动回归观察ERPT系数的时变特征。
AI.findings: 1）ERPT系数从0.28降至0.12，FIT框架增强了央行可信度，削弱了贬值对通胀的传导；2）贬值后2-3个月贸易逆差先扩大，6-9个月后出现微弱且统计不显著的改善，表明J曲线效应极弱；3）较低的ERPT赋予印度央行更大的货币政策灵活性。
AI.theory_contributions: 实证更新了新兴市场汇率传导效应的时变估计，验证了通胀目标制对降低ERPT的效果；对J曲线假设进行了严谨检验并发现其在新兴大国中的局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度央行提供了ERPT下降可增强货币政策独立性的实证依据；指出单纯依赖贬值无法解决结构性的贸易逆差问题；建议政策应转向提升非价格竞争力，包括物流改革、扩大自贸协定和支持中小出口企业。

title: Longitudinal Trends and Horizontal Differentiation: The Micro-foundations of the Tendential Fall in the Rate of Profit --Based on Panel Data of Chinese Industrial A-share Listed Firms
affiliations: Xihua University

detail.title: Longitudinal Trends and Horizontal Differentiation: The Micro-foundations of the Tendential Fall in the Rate of Profit --Based on Panel Data of Chinese Industrial A-share Listed Firms

keywords: Law of the Tendential Fall in the Rate of Profit

detail.abstract: In his study of the capitalist order of production, Marx advanced a core insight-the law of the tendential fall in the rate of profit (TRPF). However, the microfoundations of the TRPF remain insufficiently tested empirically in the literature. Using financial panel data of Chinese industrial A-share listed firms, this paper constructs Marxist indicators. Employing mean-regression and quantile regression with two-way fixed effects, we find that the rate of turnover of capital influences the profit rate by moderating the organic composition of capital. This moderating effect, together with the directional and magnitude effects of the organic composition itself, jointly shapes the impact on firms at different profit-rate quantiles. This finding provides new empirical evidence for the short-run micro-level mechanism of profit-rate changes, indicating that the rate of turnover of capital is a key to understanding the link between the organic composition of capital and the profit rate, while also lending support to Shaikh's theory of real competition.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中国工业A股上市公司财务面板数据，通过均值回归和分位数回归方法，实证检验了资本周转速度通过调节资本有机构成影响利润率的作用机制，为利润率下降规律提供了微观层面的新证据，并支持了沙伊赫的真实竞争理论。
AI.research_question: 利润率下降规律（TRPF）的微观基础是什么？资本周转速度、资本有机构成与利润率之间存在怎样的作用机制？
AI.motivation: 马克思提出的利润率趋于下降规律是资本主义批判的核心洞见，但现有文献对其微观基础缺乏充分的实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马克思的利润率趋于下降规律（TRPF）；沙伊赫的真实竞争理论。
AI.method: 采用中国工业A股上市公司的财务面板数据，构建马克思主义指标；运用均值回归和双向固定效应分位数回归方法进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 资本周转速度通过调节资本有机构成来影响利润率；该调节效应与资本有机构成自身的方向和幅度效应共同塑造了不同利润率分位数上企业所受的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为TRPF的短期微观层面的利润率变化机制提供了新的实证证据；揭示了资本周转速度是理解资本有机构成与利润率之间联系的关键；支持了沙伊赫的真实竞争理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 对中国工业企业的利润率变化提供了微观层面的实证解释，有助于理解资本周转速度在调节生产效率与盈利水平之间的实际作用。

title: Common Correlated Effects Estimation of Dynamic Three-Dimensional Heterogeneous Panel Data Models

detail.title: Common Correlated Effects Estimation of Dynamic Three-Dimensional Heterogeneous Panel Data Models
detail.abstract: Cross-section average-augmented panel regressions introduced by Pesaran (2006) have become a popular empirical tool for estimating panel data models with common factors, but the corresponding common correlated effects (CCE) framework has been developed only for static and two-dimensional panels. When bilateral data exhibit persistent dynamics and a hierarchical dependence structure in which global, origin-specific, and destination-specific factors operate simultaneously, neither static three-dimensional CCE estimators nor dynamic two-dimensional CCE estimators recover the short-run and long-run responses consistently. This paper shows that the CCE mean group approach extends to dynamic three-dimensional panels once each pair regression is augmented with current and lagged cross-section averages over three margins. Consistency and asymptotic normality follow from the joint expansion of both cross-sectional dimensions and the time dimension, with the convergence rate governed by the smaller dimension. Because the naive pair-dispersion variance estimator is inconsistent in this setting, a margin-based estimator is proposed and shown to be the only consistent choice. As standard plug-in estimators cannot account for all sources of estimation uncertainty, a cross-section bootstrap is suggested for inference on the persistence coefficient in moderate samples. An application to bilateral export flows recovers a small but precisely estimated idiosyncratic persistence once the hierarchical factor structure is absorbed, and Monte Carlo experiments confirm the theoretical results.

AI.tldr: 本文将CCE均值组方法扩展到动态三维面板数据（含全局、来源国和目的国三层因子），证明在三维边际上加入当前及滞后截面均值可一致估计短期和长期响应，并提出了边际方差估计量和截面bootstrap推断方法。
AI.research_question: 如何估计具有层次因子结构（全局、来源特定、目的特定因子）的动态三维面板数据模型的短期和长期响应？
AI.motivation: 现有CCE框架仅适用于静态/二维面板或动态二维面板，但双边数据（如贸易流）具有动态性和三维层次依赖结构，现有方法无法一致估计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 共同相关效应(CCE)均值组估计量、层次因子结构、动态面板、截面均值增强回归、联合渐近理论
AI.method: 理论推导动态三维CCE均值组估计量的一致性、渐近正态性；提出边际方差估计量和截面bootstrap方法；蒙特卡洛模拟验证；双边出口数据实证应用。
AI.findings: 1) 动态三维CCE估计量在三维截面均值增强后一致且渐近正态；2) 收敛速度受最小维度控制；3) 朴素成对方差估计量不一致，边际方差估计量是唯一一致选择；4) 标准plug-in无法捕捉所有估计不确定性，截面bootstrap有效；5) 实证发现吸收层次因子后出口持久性较小但精确估计。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将CCE方法推广到动态三维面板数据，解决了层次因子结构下的估计和推断问题；提出新的方差估计和bootstrap推断方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为双边贸易流等具有三维层次结构的面板数据提供了有效的因果推断工具，帮助实证研究者更准确地估计动态关系。

title: Real Problem, Misguided Fix: Insights from the EU ETS on Carbon Capture and Utilisation under Cap and Trade Systems
affiliations: Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research (PIK), Potsdam-Institut für Klimafolgenforschung (PIK), Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research (PIK) and Ruhr-University Bochum

detail.title: Real Problem, Misguided Fix: Insights from the EU ETS on Carbon Capture and Utilisation under Cap and Trade Systems

declarations.funderStatement: Funding from the German Federal Ministry of Education and Research under the Kopernikus-Projekt Ariadne (FKZ 03SFK5A) is gratefully acknowledged. All errors and views expressed in this article are solely those of the authors.

detail.abstract: Emissions trading systems are expanding globally, and a recurring policy challenge is how to treat non-permanent carbon capture and utilisation (CCU) within cap-and-trade schemes. Using the European Emissions Trading System’s fifth-phase review as a case study, we identify four stakeholder claims for granting allowance-surrender exemptions: that CCU delays emissions, delivers carbon removal, substitutes virgin fossil feedstocks, and forms a defossilisation pathway for hard-to-abate sectors. We find that none justifies broad allowance exemptions for non-permanent fossil CCU. Most CCU products store carbon for too short a time to deliver material climate benefits; the removal claim applies only to a narrow biogenic subset; and ETS waterbed effect neutralises the substitution effect. Finally, while fossil CCU may serve as an infrastructural precursor to CCS in hard-to-abate sectors, the EU ETS lacks the coordinating capacity to manage such a transition effectively. We identify more suitable policy instruments than allowance exemptions, including feedstock carbon pricing, the careful expansion of recognised permanent CCU applications, the inclusion of waste incineration in the EU ETS, and industrial policy to align CCU infrastructure with long-term carbon management.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧盟碳排放交易体系（EU ETS）第五阶段修订中关于非永久性碳捕集与利用（CCU）是否应豁免配额的问题。研究发现，四项主要的利益相关方主张均无法为非永久性化石基CCU提供广泛的配额豁免理由，并提出了更合适的政策工具替代方案。
AI.research_question: 在限额与交易机制下，如何对待非永久性碳捕集与利用（CCU）？非永久性化石基CCU是否应获得配额豁免？
AI.motivation: 全球排放交易体系正在扩展，但如何处理非永久性CCU在总量控制与交易体系中的地位是一个反复出现的政策挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 配额豁免主张分析框架：延迟排放、碳移除、替代化石原料、硬减排行业的脱碳路径。
AI.method: 以EU ETS第五阶段修订为案例，识别并分析四种利益相关方的主张。
AI.findings: 1) 大多数CCU产品储存碳的时间过短，无法带来实质性气候效益；2) 碳移除主张仅适用于少数生物基CCU；3) ETS的水床效应抵消了替代效应；4) 化石基CCU虽可作为硬减排行业CCS的基础设施前体，但EU ETS缺乏协调管理能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地驳斥了非永久性化石基CCU在排放交易体系中获得配额豁免的合理性，揭示了水床效应对替代效应的抵消机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了更合适的政策工具替代方案：原料碳定价、审慎扩展认可的永久性CCU应用、将垃圾焚烧纳入EU ETS，以及通过产业政策使CCU基础设施与长期碳管理目标对齐。

title: AI-driven Modeling of Socio-Economic Dynamical Systems: Operator-centric Intelligence and Computational Delegation
affiliations: Tsinghua University and

detail.title: AI-driven Modeling of Socio-Economic Dynamical Systems: Operator-centric Intelligence and Computational Delegation
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a unified theoretical framework for AI-driven socio-economic modeling as high-dimensional complex dynamical systems. Its core thesis: all AI systems are universal approximators and controllers for such systems, with the same mathematical principles applicable to socio-economic modeling. Building on continuous flow operator (CFO), we propose Operator-Centric Intelligence (OCI), a dual-engine adaptive architecture beyond the Turing computability boundary. Instead of perfectly replicating physical reality digitally, OCI treats the real system as a natural hypercomputation oracle: it adaptively triggers computational delegation when epistemic uncertainty exceeds a threshold, injecting policy interventions and feeding observations back to the local operator. We prove the Extensional Alignment Theorem: macro-level functional agreement with physical reality suffices for valid modeling, obviating perfect micro-level replication. We compare six leading AI approaches and integrate them into the OCI-MM-MAWM architecture with a dual master operator design (World Master Operator for continuous environmental evolution, Decision Master Operator for functional policy optimization), and further introduce the Functional Memory Bank paradigm storing trajectory data as Sobolev-regularized continuous functional triples to replace traditional static data lakes. We analyze five core dimensions—algorithms, data, parameters, computing power, and energy—with quantitative cross-scale resource estimates, and rigorously examine core feasibility boundaries including the spectral truncation bound and thermodynamic Pareto efficiency of computational delegation, arguing that fuzzy correctness outperforms precise error, and probabilistic forecasting of massive trajectories offers greater feasibility and value than deterministic single-path prediction. Finally, we propose a three-stage evolutionary roadmap from proof-of-concept toy models to full socio-economic digital twins. While perfectly accurate simulation is theoretically impossible, OCI dual-engine models already deliver valuable probabilistic predictions for decision support. The field’s future lies not in pure digital determinism, but in adaptive human-AI-physics collaboration via computational delegation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的理论框架，将AI驱动的社会经济建模视为高维复杂动力系统。核心主张是所有AI系统都是此类系统的通用逼近器和控制器。作者提出超越图灵计算边界的双引擎自适应架构——算子中心智能（OCI），将真实系统视为自然超计算预言机，通过自适应计算委派、策略干预注入与观测反馈来建模。论文证明了外延对齐定理，提出OCI-MM-MAWM双主算子架构与函数记忆库范式，并分析了算法、数据、参数、算力、能耗五大维度，最后提出了三阶段演进路线图。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个超越传统图灵计算边界、能够有效建模高维复杂社会经济系统的统一理论框架与计算架构？
AI.motivation: 传统数字孪生追求完美复制物理现实既不可能也不必要；社会经济系统作为高维复杂动力系统，需要新的理论基础和架构来超越纯数字决定论的局限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续流算子（CFO）；算子中心智能（OCI）；外延对齐定理；超计算（hypercomputation）；Sobolev正则化；热力学帕累托效率
AI.method: 理论推导与证明（外延对齐定理）、架构设计（OCI-MM-MAWM双主算子架构）、定量跨尺度资源估计、可行性边界分析（谱截断界、热力学帕累托效率）
AI.findings: 宏观层面的功能一致性足以实现有效建模，无需完美的微观复制；模糊正确性优于精确错误；海量轨迹的概率性预测比确定性单路径预测更具可行性和价值；纯数字决定论不可行，未来在于自适应的人机物协作计算委派。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出算子中心智能（OCI）框架，将社会经济建模问题重新定义为高维复杂动力系统的超计算问题；2）证明外延对齐定理，为"不求完美复制"的建模策略提供理论合法性；3）引入函数记忆库范式和双主算子架构，从数学上严格化了社会经济建模的方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提出OCI-MM-MAWM架构可作为实际数字孪生系统的设计蓝图；2）提供定量跨尺度资源估算，指导实际部署的资源分配；3）给出三阶段演进路线图（概念验证→原型验证→全规模数字孪生），为研究者和实践者提供可操作的路径规划。

title: When Violence Strikes: The Effects of Mass Shootings on Local Economies and Migration
affiliations: Miami University of Ohio - Richard T. Farmer School of Business Administration and University at Buffalo - School of Management

detail.title: When Violence Strikes: The Effects of Mass Shootings on Local Economies and Migration
detail.abstract: This paper examines the economic consequences of mass shootings for local communities. Using a stacked difference-in-differences design, we find that mass shootings lead to a deterioration in local economic activity. Affected counties experience declines in entrepreneurship and in the number of local establishments, especially medium- and large-sized  establishments. We also find that local bank deposits decline, small-business lending falls, and borrowing costs rise. We identify household out-migration as an important channel. Following a mass shooting, households are more likely to leave affected counties, especially for out-of-state destinations. The migration is stronger when shootings are more severe, receive greater public attention, and occur in politically liberal counties. Overall, the findings suggest that mass shootings impose persistent economic costs by inducing households to move away and weakening the local business and credit environment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现大规模枪击事件会导致当地经济活动恶化，包括创业活动减少、中小企业数量下降、银行存款减少、小企业贷款下降和借贷成本上升。家庭外迁是重要传导渠道，且这种效应在更严重、受公众关注更多和发生在政治自由派县的案件中更为显著。
AI.research_question: 大规模枪击事件对当地社区的经济后果是什么？
AI.motivation: 大规模枪击事件在美国日益频发，但其对地方经济的持久影响尚未被充分量化研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭外迁渠道理论：大规模枪击事件通过促使居民迁出受影响地区，进而削弱当地商业和信贷环境，造成持续性经济成本。
AI.method: 采用堆叠双重差分法（stacked difference-in-differences）进行研究设计。
AI.findings: （1）受影响县的经济活动恶化，创业活动和本地企业数量（尤其是中大型企业）下降；（2）银行存款减少，小企业贷款下降，借贷成本上升；（3）家庭外迁是重要渠道，尤其倾向于迁往州外目的地；（4）当枪击更严重、受公众关注更多、发生在政治自由派县时，迁移效应更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了大规模枪击事件通过"家庭外迁"这一机制对地方经济产生持续性负面影响的因果链条，丰富了灾害经济学和社区经济韧性领域的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了量化证据，表明大规模枪击不仅造成人身伤亡，还会通过居民外迁和企业环境恶化对当地经济造成持久损害，从而支持加强枪支管控和社区恢复政策的必要性。

title: A Qualitative Action Research on Licensed Professional Teachers’ Reflections and Coping Strategies in Balancing Graduate Studies and Continuing Professional Development at Negros Oriental State University Graduate School

detail.title: A Qualitative Action Research on Licensed Professional Teachers’ Reflections and Coping Strategies in Balancing Graduate Studies and Continuing Professional Development at Negros Oriental State University Graduate School
detail.abstract: This qualitative action research explored the reflections, challenges, and coping strategies of licensed professional teachers balancing graduate studies and continuing professional development (CPD) at Negros Oriental State University Graduate School, with the aim of identifying reflective and practical interventions to support teachers' wellbeing, academic performance, and professional growth. Eight (8) licensed professional teachers enrolled in a Master of Arts program were purposively selected, with four (4) participating in a focus group discussion and four (4) in individual in-depth interviews. Data were collected using a validated interview guide and thematically analyzed, yielding two themes describing lived experiences, four themes outlining challenges, three themes reflecting coping strategies and reflective practices, and two themes presenting proposed interventions. Findings indicated that teacher-learners face substantial academic, professional, and emotional demands but remain engaged through sustained motivation, strong support networks, and intentional strategies for balancing responsibilities. Participants highlighted the value of flexibility, peer collaboration, and technology-enabled systems in managing dual academic and professional roles. The study recommends strengthening personal strategies such as structured time management, reflective practice, and peer support, alongside institutional mechanisms including flexible scheduling, blended CPD modalities, mentoring, and improved academic advisement. It further underscores the importance of context-sensitive CPD policies and workloadconsiderate requirements to ensure the sustainability and accessibility of graduate education for working teachers.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过质性行动研究，探讨了在研究生学习与持续专业发展中取得平衡的持证教师的反思、挑战与应对策略，并提出了支持教师福祉、学业表现与专业成长的反思性与实践性干预措施。
AI.research_question: 持证专业教师在兼顾研究生学习与持续专业发展过程中面临哪些反思、挑战与应对策略？如何设计干预措施支持教师的福祉、学业表现与专业成长？
AI.motivation: 在职教师同时承担研究生学习与持续专业发展的双重角色，面临巨大的学术、专业和情感压力，但现有研究对这类教师群体的具体困境与有效支持机制关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 质性行动研究；反思性实践理论；成人学习理论（自我导向学习、经验学习）
AI.method: 质性行动研究。通过焦点小组讨论（4人）和一对一深度访谈（4人）收集数据，使用验证后的访谈指南，进行主题分析。
AI.findings: 识别出2个关于生活经历的主题、4个关于挑战的主题、3个关于应对策略与反思性实践的主题、2个关于拟议干预措施的主题。教师学习者面临显著的学术、专业和情感压力，但通过持续动机、强大支持网络和有意策略保持投入；灵活性、同伴协作和技术支持系统在管理双重角色中发挥关键作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了成人学习理论与反思性实践理论在在职教师研究生教育情境中的应用，揭示了教师学习者在双重角色下的反思机制与应对路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出个人层面（结构化时间管理、反思性实践、同伴支持）与制度层面（灵活排课、混合式CPD模式、导师制、改善学术咨询）的双重干预建议；强调制定情境敏感的CPD政策与工作量友好型要求，以保障在职教师研究生教育的可持续性与可及性。

title: Balancing the Load: A Qualitative Action Research on Teacher Workload and Instructional Quality
affiliations: Negros Oriental State University and

detail.title: Balancing the Load: A Qualitative Action Research on Teacher Workload and Instructional Quality
detail.abstract: This qualitative action research examined the workload experiences of eight graduate student-teachers at Negros Oriental State University in Dumaguete City and its impact on instructional quality. Guided by the Job Demands-Resources (JD-R) Model, the study explored how teacher-learners balanced professional teaching responsibilities, graduate studies, and personal obligations, as well as the challenges, coping strategies, and institutional support associated with workload management. Data were collected using a structured survey questionnaire with both closed-ended and open-ended items and analyzed through thematic analysis, supported by member checking to ensure credibility. Findings revealed that participants experienced heavy workloads due to multiple responsibilities, including lesson preparation, assessment, administrative tasks, graduate school requirements, and personal obligations, often resulting in extended working hours and occasional stress. Time constraints, excessive documentation, high expectations, and limited resources emerged as primary challenges, while participants employed strategies such as task organization, prioritization, collaboration, use of technology, and self-care to maintain instructional effectiveness and well-being. The study also highlighted that strong institutional support, including reduction of administrative tasks, provision of teaching resources, mentorship, and collaborative school environments, was perceived as essential for sustaining instructional quality and teacher well-being. These findings emphasize the complex interplay between workload, professional resilience, and systemic support, providing practical insights for schools and higher education institutions to enhance teacher performance, work-life balance, and instructional outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对菲律宾内格罗斯东方国立大学8名研究生实习教师的定性行动研究，探讨了多重角色（教学、研究生学习、个人生活）带来的工作负荷体验及其对教学质量的影響。基于JD-R模型，研究发现高工作负荷导致压力与时间不足，教师通过任务整理、协作、技术应用和自我照顾等策略应对，同时，制度支持（如减少行政任务、提供资源、导师指导和协作环境）对维持教学质量和教师福祉至关重要。
AI.research_question: 研究生实习教师如何平衡专业教学、研究生学习与个人义务？工作负荷对教学质量有何影响？他们在工作量管理中面临哪些挑战、采用哪些应对策略，以及需要怎样的制度支持？
AI.motivation: 研究生实习教师同时承担教师、学生和个人角色，工作负荷过重可能影响教学质量和教师自身福祉。现有研究对这类双重角色群体的工作负荷体验关注不足，亟需深入理解其挑战与支持机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工作需求-资源模型（JD-R Model），该模型认为工作特征分为需求（如工作量、时间压力）和资源（如支持、自主性），两者平衡影响员工倦怠与投入。
AI.method: 定性行动研究，采用结构化问卷调查（含封闭式和开放式问题），对8名研究生实习教师进行数据收集，通过主题分析处理数据，并采用成员检验确保可信度。
AI.findings: （1）参与者面临备课、评估、行政、研究生课程和个人义务等多重责任导致的沉重工作负荷，常需延长工作时间，偶尔感到压力；（2）主要挑战包括时间约束、过度文档工作、高期望和有限资源；（3）应对策略包括任务整理、优先排序、协作、技术应用和自我照顾；（4）制度支持（减少行政任务、提供教学资源、导师指导和协作环境）被视为维持教学质量和教师福祉的关键。
AI.theory_contributions: 将JD-R模型应用于研究生实习教师这一特殊群体，揭示了多重角色带来的工作需求与可利用资源之间的动态平衡机制，拓展了该模型在教师教育领域的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学校和教育机构提供了具体建议：减少行政负担、提供教学资源、建立导师制度和协作环境，以帮助研究生实习教师更好地平衡多重角色，提升教学质量和工作生活平衡。

title: Asymmetric Consumer Preferences and Platform Pricing

detail.title: Asymmetric Consumer Preferences and Platform Pricing
detail.abstract: This paper studies information design in a differentiated-products duopoly with asymmetric consumer preferences. Consumers choose between two firms after receiving private information about their relative match values, and firms then compete in prices. Unlike symmetric benchmarks, the prior distribution of consumer preferences may favor one firm, allowing asymmetry to arise from the full shape of the preference distribution rather than from a single demand or quality parameter. The paper characterizes how asymmetric priors affect firm-optimal, consumer-optimal, and platform-optimal information policies. Firm-optimal information relaxes competition by amplifying perceived differentiation, while consumer-optimal information disciplines prices by making products appear more substitutable. A fee-charging platform faces a different trade-off: it uses information to shape residual demand and extract seller surplus, subject to Bayes plausibility, pricing incentives, and participation constraints. The analysis shows how asymmetric consumer preferences determine equilibrium price gaps, surplus division, and the limits to competition.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了不对称消费者偏好下差异化双寡头市场的信息设计，分析了不对称先验如何影响企业最优、消费者最优和平台最优的信息政策，揭示了信息设计如何影响价格竞争、剩余分配和竞争边界。
AI.research_question: 在不对称消费者偏好的差异化双寡头市场中，不同主体（企业、消费者、平台）的最优信息设计策略是什么？不对称先验如何影响这些信息政策？
AI.motivation: 已有文献多关注对称市场的信息设计，而现实中消费者偏好往往不对称地偏向某一企业。本文旨在探讨这种不对称性如何从偏好分布的完整形状中产生，而非仅由单一的需求或质量参数决定，并分析其对信息设计的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: Bayesian persuasion（贝叶斯说服）、信息设计理论、Hotelling差异化产品竞争模型、平台经济学
AI.method: 理论模型分析。构建差异化双寡头市场模型，消费者获得关于相对匹配价值的私人信息后选择企业，企业进行价格竞争。分析不同信息设计主体（企业、消费者、平台）的最优信息政策。
AI.findings: （1）企业最优信息通过放大感知差异化来放松竞争；（2）消费者最优信息通过使产品看起来更具替代性来约束价格；（3）收费平台面临不同的权衡：利用信息塑造剩余需求并抽取卖家剩余，受贝叶斯合理性、定价激励和参与约束的限制；（4）不对称消费者偏好决定了均衡价格差距、剩余分配和竞争边界。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信息设计理论扩展到不对称偏好市场，揭示了不对称先验从分布的完整形状中产生的机制，丰富了Bayesian persuasion在产业组织中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台如何设计信息政策（如推荐算法、信息披露规则）以协调买卖双方利益提供了理论指导；为企业制定信息策略以影响竞争格局提供了参考。

title: Has the Time Come for the us to Adopt an Excess Profits Tax?
affiliations: University of Michigan Law School and College of Management

detail.title: Has the Time Come for the us to Adopt an Excess Profits Tax?
detail.abstract: Excess profit taxes have reemerged as a popular fiscal response to crisis driven corporate windfalls. While historically effective in raising revenue, traditional EPT designs suffer from arbitrariness, susceptibility to avoidance, and adverse distributional effects. This article argues for a reimagined EPT framework that treats excess profit taxation as a permanent, corrective instrument aligned with optimal tax principles. Properly designed, EPTs can regulate corporate power, preserve innovation incentives, reduce inequality, and function effectively in a globalized economy.

AI.tldr: 本文主张将超额利润税（EPT）从危机应对的临时工具重新构想为永久性的矫正性税收工具，认为合理设计的EPT能够规范企业权力、保护创新激励、减少不平等，并在全球化经济中有效运作。
AI.research_question: 如何重新设计超额利润税（EPT），使其从临时性的危机应对工具转变为符合最优税收原则的永久性矫正工具？
AI.motivation: 传统的EPT设计存在随意性、易避税和分配效应不良等问题，需要重新构想一个更有效的EPT框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最优税收原则、企业权力规制理论、创新激励理论、不平等减少理论
AI.method: 理论论证与规范性分析
AI.findings: 合理设计的EPT可以作为永久性矫正工具，有效规范企业权力、保护创新激励、减少不平等，并在全球化经济中发挥功能。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将EPT从临时危机工具转变为永久性矫正工具的理论框架，拓展了最优税收原则在企业超额利润领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重新设计EPT的具体方向，使其更公平、更高效、更适应全球化经济环境。

title: Bank deposit pricing in the euro area
affiliations: ECB -DG Monetary Policy, European Central Bank (ECB), London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE) - Department of Economics, European Central Bank (ECB) and Banque de France

detail.title: Bank deposit pricing in the euro area
detail.abstract: We investigate the supply and demand drivers of bank deposit pricing in the Euro area during the period 2007–2024. We document that the pass-through of policy rates to sight deposit rates is low, asymmetric, varies across the monetary policy regimes, and decreases over time. We build and estimate an equilibrium model of bank deposit markets, and find that the price sensitivity of depositors exhibits large heterogeneity between households and firms, across countries, and over time. Our estimates suggest that rate-sensitive depositors increasingly switched to alternative, higher-yielding savings products over time, thereby decreasing the average rate-sensitivity of the remaining pool of sight deposits. In turn, banks’ market power over sight deposits increased, thereby accounting for the sluggish increase in overnight deposit rates following the 2022 European Central Bank’s policy rate hikes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2007-2024年欧元区银行存款定价的供需驱动因素，发现政策利率向活期存款利率的传导不完全且不对称，并构建均衡模型揭示了存款人利率敏感性的异质性及其对银行市场势力的影响。
AI.research_question: 欧元区银行存款定价的供需驱动因素是什么？政策利率向活期存款利率的传导机制如何？
AI.motivation: 2007-2024年间，欧元区经历了多轮货币政策周期，尤其是2022年欧洲央行加息后活期存款利率上升缓慢，这一现象背后的供需因素尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行存款市场均衡模型，考虑存款人利率敏感性异质性（家庭与企业之间、跨国别、跨时间）及银行市场势力。
AI.method: 构建并估计银行存款市场均衡模型，利用2007-2024年欧元区数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1. 政策利率向活期存款利率的传导率低、不对称，且随货币政策制度变化；2. 存款人利率敏感度在家庭与企业、不同国家、不同时期存在高度异质性；3. 利率敏感型存款人逐渐转向高收益替代储蓄产品，降低了活期存款池的平均利率敏感性；4. 银行对活期存款的市场势力增强，导致2022年加息后活期存款利率上升缓慢。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了存款人利率敏感性异质性如何影响银行市场势力及货币政策传导，为存款定价的非完全传导提供了理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行理解货币政策传导机制、监管机构评估银行竞争格局以及储户优化存款配置提供了参考。

title: A Forward-Looking Sonnenschein-Mantel-Debreu Theorem
affiliations: Stanford University

detail.title: A Forward-Looking Sonnenschein-Mantel-Debreu Theorem
detail.abstract: The Sonnenschein–Mantel–Debreu theorem implies that aggregate excess demand can behave in almost any way, regardless of how well-behaved individual preferences are. Lorenzoni and Werning (2026) introduce a forward-looking equilibrium framework in which local dynamics decompose into Frisch substitution effects and spillover propagation. This paper asks which local equilibrium dynamics can arise in their framework. We show that substitution structure alone imposes no restriction: when propagation is unrestricted, any local Jacobian is possible. The binding constraint is bounded propagation. We characterize exactly which Jacobians satisfy it: those admitting a dissipative transformation that reveals an underlying Frisch substitution system. This condition strictly generalizes diagonal stability and has direct equilibrium implications. Every admissible Jacobian has positive local equilibrium index. In economies where the global equilibrium degree equals one, bounded propagation everywhere implies uniqueness.

AI.tldr: 本文证明在Lorenzoni和Werning（2026）的前瞻性均衡框架中，当传播不受限时，任何局部雅可比矩阵都能实现；但受限于有界传播时，只有那些能够通过耗散变换揭示潜在弗里希替代系统的雅可比矩阵才被允许。这一条件严格推广了对角稳定性，并蕴含每个可容许雅可比矩阵具有正的局部均衡指数，且在全球均衡度为1时，有界传播意味着唯一性。
AI.research_question: 在Lorenzoni和Werning（2026）的前瞻性均衡框架中，哪些局部均衡动态（雅可比矩阵）是可能出现的？
AI.motivation: Sonnenschein–Mantel–Debreu定理表明加总超额需求几乎可以是任何形式，本文想探究在Lorenzoni和Werning引入的前瞻性均衡框架中，局部均衡动态是否也受到类似的"无限制"结论，或者存在结构性的约束条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: Lorenzoni和Werning（2026）的前瞻性均衡框架；局部动态分解为弗里希替代效应和溢出传播效应；耗散变换；对角稳定性；局部均衡指数；全局均衡度。
AI.method: 理论建模与数学推导：通过构建耗散变换条件来刻画有界传播约束下的可容许雅可比矩阵集合，并与对角稳定性条件进行比较。
AI.findings: (1) 当传播不受限时，任何局部雅可比矩阵都可能出现；(2) 有界传播是真正的约束条件，它要求雅可比矩阵能够通过耗散变换揭示潜在弗里希替代系统；(3) 该条件严格推广了对角稳定性；(4) 每个可容许雅可比矩阵具有正的局部均衡指数；(5) 在全球均衡度为1的经济中，有界传播处处成立意味着均衡唯一性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次刻画了前瞻性均衡框架中局部动态的结构性约束条件，将SMD定理的"无限制"结论与有界传播的约束统一到一个框架中，并建立了与对角稳定性和均衡指数的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为宏观经济学中多均衡问题的分析提供了理论工具：有界传播条件可用于判断均衡的唯一性，并为政策制定者评估经济系统在局部扰动下的行为提供了可检验的约束条件。

title: The Limits of Judicial Intervention in Contractual Penalties: Ukraine as a Case Study in European Private Law

detail.title: The Limits of Judicial Intervention in Contractual Penalties: Ukraine as a Case Study in European Private Law
detail.abstract: The extent to which courts may revise contractually agreed remedies remains one of the unresolved tensions of modern private law. Civil law systems have developed mechanisms for reduction that sit in uneasy equilibrium with party autonomy; the common law has replaced a binary penalty rule with an open-textured proportionality standard; transnational instruments have opted for mandatory reduction notwithstanding contrary agreements. Behind these divergent technical solutions lies a shared structural problem: the general principles of private law-good faith, fairness, proportionality-constitute a residual source of judicial intervention that no specific statutory provision can fully displace. This article argues that the foundational tension between party autonomy and judicial control of agreed remedies is not resolvable through statutory drafting alone, and uses Article 551(3) of the Ukrainian Civil Code and its proposed reform as a case study that makes this structural constraint particularly clear. The comparison with French, German, English, and transnational approaches reveals that Article 551(3) applies the lowest intervention threshold of any system examined, leaves the question of contractual exclusion unresolved, and-unlike its comparators-provides no mechanism for managing the residual discretion that operates through the general principles of civil law even where statutory reduction is excluded. The proposed recodification addresses the threshold and codifies the criteria but leaves the foundational architectural questions unanswered, illustrating a structural tendency in Ukrainian legal reform to refine existing mechanisms without resolving the questions that give analogous mechanisms their predictive force in the systems from which they are borrowed. The article thereby contributes to the broader debate on legal transplantation and EU-oriented private law reform. It argues that the structural tendency identified in the Ukrainian context-the importation of institutional forms without resolving the foundational questions that determine their operation-illustrates a challenge frequently encountered in EU-oriented legal reform and one whose implications extend beyond the Ukrainian case.

AI.tldr: 本文以乌克兰《民法典》第551(3)条及其改革为案例，揭示当事人自治与法院对约定救济控制之间的结构性张力无法仅通过立法技术解决，并指出法律移植中常见的问题：引入制度形式而未解决决定其运作的基础性问题。
AI.research_question: 当事人自治与法院对合同约定救济的司法控制之间的结构性张力如何体现，以及法律移植（特别是面向欧盟的法律改革）中为何难以通过立法技术解决这一张力？
AI.motivation: 尽管大陆法系、普通法系和跨国法律文件在法院调整合同约定救济上存在不同的技术方案，但它们都面临一个共同的结构性问题：私法的一般原则（善意、公平、比例原则）构成了司法干预的剩余来源，任何具体法条都无法完全排除。乌克兰民法典的改革案例使这一结构性约束尤为清晰。
AI.theoretical_framework: 私法一般原则（善意、公平、比例原则）作为司法干预的剩余来源理论；法律移植理论；当事人自治与司法控制之间的结构性张力理论。
AI.method: 比较法分析：将乌克兰民法典第551(3)条与法国、德国、英国及跨国法律路径进行系统比较，并以乌克兰的立法改革作为案例研究。
AI.findings: 1. 乌克兰第551(3)条是所考察体系中介入门槛最低的；2. 该条款未解决合同排除适用的问题；3. 与其他体系不同，乌克兰法未提供管理剩余自由裁量权的机制（即使法定削减被排除，一般原则仍运作）；4. 拟议的改革调整了介入门槛并编纂了标准，但未回答基础性的架构问题；5. 乌克兰法律改革存在结构性倾向：引入制度形式而未解决决定其运作的基础性问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了当事人自治与司法控制之间的张力无法仅通过立法技术解决的结构性本质；为法律移植理论提供了新的案例证据，指出"制度形式移植"与"基础性问题未解决"之间的张力是欧盟导向法律改革中的常见挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 为乌克兰民法典第551(3)条的未来改革提供了比较法视角的批判性分析；对欧盟导向的法律改革具有警示意义，提示改革者不能仅关注制度形式的移植，还需解决决定制度运作的基础性架构问题。

title: The changing geography of banking in CESEE. Branch closures outpace openings
affiliations: Oesterreichische Nationalbank (OeNB) and Oesterreichische Nationalbank (OeNB)

detail.title: The changing geography of banking in CESEE. Branch closures outpace openings
detail.abstract: We study the evolution of bank branch networks in ten CESEE countries between 2013 and 2021. Using a manually compiled dataset of all branches and their geocoordinates, we document a decline exceeding 30%, with substantial heterogeneity across and within countries. We show that banking market consolidation is a key driver of closures, while profitability and local economic growth mitigate them. Branches in highly urban or very rural areas close more often. Competitive effects are nonlinear: moderate clustering lowers closure risk, but intense competition increases it. These patterns differ markedly across CESEE banking systems during the entire period we analyze.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2013-2021年间10个中东欧及东南欧国家银行分支网络的变化，发现分支数量下降超过30%，且国内外差异显著。银行市场整合是关店的主要驱动因素，而盈利能力和地方经济增长则有缓解作用。高度城市化或偏远地区的分支更易关闭，竞争效应呈非线性：适度聚集降低风险，激烈竞争则增加风险。
AI.research_question: 2013-2021年间，中东欧及东南欧国家银行分支网络如何演变？其关闭的关键驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解银行分支网络在数字化和金融整合背景下的演变规律，尤其是新兴欧洲市场分支关闭的异质性和驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行业市场结构理论、竞争与集聚理论、区域经济发展理论
AI.method: 手动编译包含所有分支及其地理坐标的数据集，采用计量经济模型（如面板回归）分析分支关闭的相关因素。
AI.findings: 1）分支数量下降超30%，国内外差异大；2）银行市场整合是分支关闭的主要驱动力；3）盈利能力和地方经济增长缓解关闭风险；4）高城市化或偏远地区分支更易关闭；5）竞争效应非线性：适度聚集降低风险，激烈竞争增加风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了新兴欧洲市场银行分支网络演变的异质性模式，丰富了银行业空间结构和竞争理论，提出了非线性竞争效应的新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行管理者优化分支网络布局提供参考，为监管机构评估市场整合与金融包容性之间的平衡提供依据。

title: The Impact of the Brexit Referendum on UK Fertility: Evidence from a Country-Level DID Analysis
affiliations: University of Macedonia

detail.title: The Impact of the Brexit Referendum on UK Fertility: Evidence from a Country-Level DID Analysis
detail.abstract: This study revisits the Brexit-fertility hypothesis. It assesses whether uncertainty surrounding the 2016 referendum affected fertility rates in the United Kingdom (UK). Existing evidence remains limited and mixed. Building on the country-level analysis of Macmillan and Hannan (2025), we reformulate the original specification to account for country and year fixed effects, relevant covariates, and, crucially, potential contamination of the control group arising from Brexit-related uncertainty spillovers. Using standard Difference-InDifferences (DID), synthetic control DID, and dynamic event-study methods, we find robust evidence of a negative short-run effect of Brexit on UK fertility, which intensifies over time and peaks in 2021. Consistent with contamination effects, the estimated coefficients are larger in the less contaminated control group.

AI.tldr: 本研究重新审视英国脱欧-生育率假说，通过改进实验设计（控制组污染问题）发现英国脱欧公投确实对英国生育率产生了显著的短期负面影响，且效应随时间增强，2021年达到顶峰。
AI.research_question: 2016年脱欧公投带来的不确定性是否影响了英国的生育率？
AI.motivation: 现有关于脱欧对生育率影响的证据有限且结论不一，本研究旨在通过方法论改进（解决控制组污染问题）提供更可靠的因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不确定性-生育率理论：经济和政治不确定性会抑制生育决策；DID因果识别框架；控制组污染概念（Brexit不确定性可能溢出到控制组）。
AI.method: 标准双重差分（DID）、合成控制DID、动态事件研究法，并特别考虑控制组污染问题。
AI.findings: Brexit对英国生育率存在显著的短期负面影响，效应随时间增强并在2021年达到峰值；在污染程度较低的控制组中，估计系数更大，证实了控制组污染的存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了重大政治不确定性事件对生育率的因果影响；揭示了DID研究中控制组污染问题的严重性及处理方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了Brexit对人口结构影响的经验证据；提醒未来类似政策冲击的研究需注意控制组污染问题。

title: A Theory of Ghosting
affiliations: University of Michigan, Stephen M. Ross School of Business and

detail.title: A Theory of Ghosting
detail.abstract: This paper develops a dynamic model where agents are matched and gradually learn about their compatibility while encountering new partnership opportunities. A lack of progress in a relationship is ambiguous: it may reflect continued learning or a partner's decision to disengage, either because the match was unattractive or because a better opportunity emerged. This unannounced disengagement-colloquially referred to as ghosting-generates inefficiencies by delaying exit from doomed relationships and accelerating exit from promising ones. Improving match quality can reduce welfare, and in heterogeneous markets the threat of ghosting can cause less attractive agents to achieve better outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个动态匹配模型，研究在逐步了解匹配兼容性过程中出现的"鬼影"行为（未告知的突然中断联系）如何导致效率损失：延迟了本应结束的失败关系，却加速了有前途的关系的终结。
AI.research_question: 在动态匹配市场中，当代理人逐步了解匹配兼容性并面临新机会时，未告知的中断联系（鬼影）如何影响匹配效率和福利？
AI.motivation: 现实中广泛存在"鬼影"现象（突然失联），但其对匹配效率和福利的影响缺乏理论分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态匹配模型、贝叶斯学习、搜索理论
AI.method: 动态博弈模型构建与理论分析
AI.findings: （1）鬼影行为导致双重效率损失：延迟退出失败关系、加速退出有前途关系；（2）提高匹配质量可能降低福利，存在非单调性；（3）在异质性市场中，鬼影威胁可使吸引力较低的代理人获得更好的匹配结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从理论层面系统分析了"鬼影"行为的经济学机制，揭示了信号模糊性（缺乏进展可能意味着持续学习或对方已退出）导致的效率扭曲。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解在线约会、劳动力市场等动态匹配场景中的"鬼影"现象提供理论洞见，提示减少信息摩擦或改善匹配机制可能产生反直觉的福利效应。

title: Corporate Bond Dealers and Price Discovery

detail.title: Corporate Bond Dealers and Price Discovery
detail.abstract: This paper studies the informational role of dealers in corporate bond markets using novel data on dealer "axes", non-binding indicative buy and sell interests. I find that dealer axes predict future bond returns beyond inventory management and liquidity effects. Bonds with high dealer buy interest earn higher subsequent excess returns, while bonds with high dealer sell interest underperform, with effects strongest in the high-yield segment. Return patterns following dealer axes exhibit persistence rather than reversal, distinguishing informational effects from inventory-driven price pressure. The predictive power is not fully explained by anticipated future flows and is consistent with dealers learning from informed client trading. The results suggest that dealers play an active informational role in price discovery in corporate bond markets.

AI.tldr: 本文利用交易商"axes"（非约束性指示性买卖兴趣）数据，发现交易商在公司债券市场中扮演信息角色，其买卖兴趣能够预测未来债券回报，且这种预测力无法被库存管理和流动性效应完全解释，表明交易商从知情客户交易中学习并促进价格发现。
AI.research_question: 交易商在公司债券市场中是否扮演信息角色？其"axes"（非约束性指示性买卖兴趣）能否预测未来债券回报？
AI.motivation: 已有研究通常认为交易商仅提供流动性，但对其是否传递私有信息关注不足。本文利用独特的交易商"axes"数据，试图区分信息效应与库存管理/流动性效应，填补对交易商信息角色理解的空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、价格发现理论、交易商中介理论。核心逻辑：交易商通过与知情客户交易获取私有信息，并将其反映在"axes"中，进而影响价格发现过程。
AI.method: 利用公司债券市场中交易商发布的"axes"（非约束性买卖兴趣）数据，通过回归分析检验axes对未来债券超额收益的预测能力，并控制库存管理、流动性等替代性解释。
AI.findings: （1）交易商axes能预测未来债券回报：高买入兴趣的债券获得更高超额收益，高卖出兴趣的债券表现较差；（2）该效应在高收益债券中最为显著；（3）回报模式呈现持续性而非反转，排除了库存驱动的价格压力假说；（4）预测力无法被预期未来资金流动完全解释，与交易商从知情客户交易中学习的机制一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次利用交易商"axes"数据实证证明交易商在公司债券市场中发挥积极的信息角色，拓展了交易商中介理论，丰富了价格发现和信息传递的文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场参与者提供利用交易商信号进行投资决策的参考；为监管者理解债券市场信息效率及交易商行为提供实证依据。

title: Wald Couples in the Critical Strip
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Wald Couples in the Critical Strip
detail.abstract: The reciprocal of an entire function in the LaguerrePólya class is the Laplace transform of a generalised gamma convolution (GGC), and the location of the function's zeros is encoded by the positivity of the associated Thorin measure. We make this correspondence constructive: a single cosine transform carries the Lévy measure of such a function to the Thorin measure of a GGC H, producing a van Dantzig pair and a Wald couple, and on the Gamma(k) building block it has the closed form. Applied to the Riemann ξfunction, Riemann's theta representation yields both the infinite divisibility of ξ(σ +is), through a Gamma(2) mixture, and an incomplete-gamma representation that continues the resulting Wald identity holomorphically across the critical strip. The mixing measure is signed; its Jordan decomposition reduces the entire residual content to one complete-monotonicity condition, and computing the asymptotics of the resulting weights in closed form exhibits a zeta-governed ladder of poles, showing that the condition is rigorous only on the convergent side, where it is equivalent to the Riemann hypothesis rather than a consequence of infinite divisibility alone.

AI.tldr: 该论文建立了整函数零点位置与广义伽马卷积（GGC）Thorin测度正性之间的构造性对应关系，通过余弦变换将Lévy测度映射为Thorin测度，生成van Dantzig对与Wald耦合。应用于Riemann ξ函数时，从theta表示推导出ξ(σ+is)的无限可分性，并通过Jordan分解将残差归约为一个完全单调性条件，该条件在收敛侧等价于Riemann假设。
AI.research_question: 如何构造性地建立Laguerre-Pólya类整函数的倒数与广义伽马卷积（GGC）的Thorin测度之间的对应关系，并将这一框架应用于Riemann ξ函数，探究其无限可分性与Riemann假设的关系。
AI.motivation: 深化对整函数零点分布与概率测度（特别是GGC）之间联系的理解，并试图从新的分析视角（无限可分性与Wald恒等式）重新审视Riemann假设这一经典难题。
AI.theoretical_framework: Laguerre-Pólya类整函数理论、广义伽马卷积（GGC）与Thorin测度、van Dantzig对与Wald耦合、余弦变换、Jordan分解、完全单调性。
AI.method: 通过余弦变换建立Lévy测度与Thorin测度之间的显式映射；利用Riemann ξ函数的theta表示推导Gamma(2)混合下的无限可分性；通过Jordan分解将残差分解为正负部分，并计算闭合形式的渐近权重，分析zeta函数控制的极点阶梯。
AI.findings: (1) 余弦变换可将整函数的Lévy测度构造性地映射为GGC的Thorin测度，并生成van Dantzig对与Wald耦合；(2) Riemann ξ函数在临界带内具有通过Gamma(2)混合表达的无限可分性；(3) 混合测度为有符号测度，其Jordan分解将残差归约为一个完全单调性条件；(4) 该条件的成立在收敛侧等价于Riemann假设，而非仅由无限可分性导出。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了整函数理论与概率测度（GGC）之间的新构造性桥梁；揭示了Riemann ξ函数的无限可分性与其零点分布之间的深层联系；将Riemann假设等价地表述为一个完全单调性条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为分析整函数零点分布提供了新的概率论工具（Wald耦合、van Dantzig对）；为研究Riemann假设提供了新的分析路径和可检验的条件。

reference: Journal of Applied Youth Studies, volume 8, issue 3, 2025[10.1007/s43151-025-00177-y]
title: Voter Evaluations of Youth Politicians: A Conjoint Experiment of Candidates' Young Age in Japan

detail.title: Voter Evaluations of Youth Politicians: A Conjoint Experiment of Candidates' Young Age in Japan

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Applied Youth Studies, volume 8, issue 3, 2025[10.1007/s43151-025-00177-y]

detail.abstract: The age of candidacy acts as a barrier that prevents youth from participating in politics as representatives. While the candidacy age has become a widely debated issue worldwide in recent years, little empirical research has examined how voters perceive youth politicians. What do voters think about very young politicians? This study investigates public attitudes toward the lower age limit for politicians. In Japan, simple public opinion polls have suggested limited support for reforming the candidacy age. However, using an experimental approach, this study finds a high level of public acceptance of youth politicians. Specifically, using a conjoint survey experiment, this study explores how candidate age influences Japanese voters' preferences for politicians, with a particular focus on youth ages 19, 23, and 25. Participants were repeatedly presented with fictitious profiles of two candidates consisted of seven attributes including age and were asked to choose between them. While older candidates aged 79 and 66 were unpopular, voters generally accepted youth candidates-even those below Japan's current age of candidacy-across all the three legislative bodies examined (the House of Representatives, 25; the House of Councilors, 30; and municipal councils, 25). Youth voters especially showed a strong preference for youth candidates. These findings support lowering the candidacy age in Japan from the perspective of public attitudes toward politicians, contributing to discussions on age reform. Furthermore, this article contributes methodologically to youth studies by offering an experimental approach to provide empirical evidence for policy-and law-making concerning youth political participation.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过联合分析实验发现，日本选民对青年政治家（19、23、25岁）接受度很高，甚至支持低于现行参选年龄的候选人，这为降低参选年龄提供了实证依据。
AI.research_question: 选民如何看待非常年轻的政客？公众对政治家最低年龄限制的态度是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管参选年龄作为限制青年参政的障碍已在全球引发广泛讨论，但鲜有实证研究考察选民对青年政治家的看法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公众态度理论、选民偏好理论
AI.method: 联合分析实验（conjoint survey experiment）：向参与者反复呈现包含年龄等七项属性的两位虚构候选人资料，要求其在两者间做出选择。
AI.findings: （1）79岁和66岁的年长候选人不受欢迎；（2）选民普遍接受青年候选人，甚至包括低于日本现行参选年龄的候选人；（3）青年选民尤为偏好青年候选人。这一结果在众议院（25岁）、参议院（30岁）和市议会（25岁）三个立法机构中一致成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 为青年研究提供了实验方法学贡献，为涉及青年政治参与的政策和法律制定提供实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果支持从公众态度角度降低日本参选年龄，为年龄改革讨论提供依据。

title: Soft Assets, Hard Credit: Corporate Intangibles and Nonbank Borrowing
affiliations: University of Bristol and

detail.title: Soft Assets, Hard Credit: Corporate Intangibles and Nonbank Borrowing
detail.abstract: Corporate intangible capital and nonbank financial institutions (NBFIs) have both risen sharply in the U.S. economy. Intangible-intensive firms, however, are known to face financing frictions where intangible assets make poor collateral and are difficult for traditional banks to lend against. We ask whether intangible-intensive firms systematically sort toward nonbank lenders, and, if so, what happens on the loan side in terms of spreads, maturity, and collateral. For U.S. publicly listed borrowers, we show that intangible-intensive firms migrate toward NBFIs, and that this migration is costly such that they pay higher spreads and face stricter collateral requirements when they borrow from nonbanks. A heterogeneity analysis reveals a price-quantity asymmetry across firm size, with large firms sorting extensively into nonbank credit while small intangible-intensive firms face more restricted access yet pay the largest rate premiums. We use the U.S. Basel III Final Rule, a regulatory tightening associated with a larger role for nonbank lenders, to examine how the intangible-NBFI relationship is shaped around such a reform. Difference-indifferences estimates show that high-intangible firms shifted disproportionately toward nonbank credit relative to low-intangible firms, and that, while they took on more nonbank credit, they also faced higher loan rates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国经济中企业无形资本与非银行金融机构（NBFIs）同步增长的现象，发现无形资产密集型企业系统性地转向非银行贷款，且这一转移成本高昂——它们需支付更高利差、面临更严格抵押要求。大型企业大量转向非银行信贷，而小型无形资产密集型企业则面临更受限的融资渠道和最高利率溢价。美国巴塞尔III最终规则加剧了这一趋势。
AI.research_question: 无形资产密集型企业是否系统性地转向非银行金融机构借款？这一转移在贷款利差、期限和抵押要求方面带来什么后果？
AI.motivation: 无形资产作为抵押品质量差，传统银行难以据此放贷，但无形资产密集型企业与非银行金融机构同步增长的现象尚未被系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 融资摩擦理论、企业融资结构理论、监管变化对信贷市场影响理论
AI.method: 对美国上市公司贷款数据进行实证分析，采用异质性分析（按企业规模），并利用美国巴塞尔III最终规则作为外生冲击进行双重差分（DiD）估计。
AI.findings: 无形资产密集型企业倾向于向非银行金融机构借款，且需支付更高利差和面临更严格抵押要求。大型企业大量转向非银行信贷，小型企业融资受限但支付最高利率溢价。巴塞尔III规则实施后，高无形资产企业更大幅度地向非银行信贷转移，同时面临更高贷款利率。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了无形资产密集型企业融资渠道的系统性迁移模式，阐明了监管变化如何影响企业融资结构与成本。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解监管改革（如巴塞尔III）对非银行信贷市场的影响提供实证依据，为无形资产密集型企业融资决策提供参考。

title: A Brief History of Financial Risk
affiliations: Boston College - Carroll School of Management and Boston College - Carroll School of Management

detail.title: A Brief History of Financial Risk
detail.abstract: Finance models typically reflect the prevailing understanding of the world today, but the asset prices they attempt to explain reflect the understanding at the time. We explore the evolution of thought relating to equity risk. In the early 20th century, equities were largely viewed as "speculations" that were not even an investment, or were viewed as a hedge against inflation. Once stocks were considered legitimate investments, they were mostly understood by imprecise metaphors about bonds. "Risk" meant the chances of losing money in the long run, similar to bond defaults. This conception of risk means that higher average returns reduce risk, instead of being compensation for risk, and leads to inconsistent evaluations of the same assets at different horizons. Performance was mostly long-run cumulative performance (like bond yields), and investors mostly did not focus on intermediate prices, lacking theories about such prices when they did. The idea of risk as standard deviation of single period returns was pioneered by Markowitz (1952), and not popular until the 1960s. The idea of risk as coming from correlation with consumption was absent until Lucas (1978). We argue for taking seriously the idea of "model discovery" when understanding equity prices.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了金融模型中关于股权风险认知的历史演变，指出早期将股票视为投机或通胀对冲，风险概念从"长期亏损概率"逐步演变为Markowitz的收益率标准差和Lucas的消费相关性，并主张在理解股权价格时应重视"模型发现"概念。
AI.research_question: 金融模型如何反映不同历史时期对股权风险的认知演变？
AI.motivation: 现代金融模型反映的是当下的理解，但资产价格反映的是彼时的理解，二者存在时间错位，因此有必要追溯股权风险认知的历史演化路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融思想史、资产定价理论、风险认知的演进。
AI.method: 历史文献分析与概念梳理，追踪从20世纪初至今关于股权风险和定价的关键理论转变。
AI.findings: 1) 早期股权被视为投机或通胀对冲；2) 风险被理解为长期亏损概率，高回报被视为降低风险而非补偿风险；3) Markowitz(1952)将风险定义为单期收益率标准差，但直到1960年代才被广泛接受；4) Lucas(1978)引入消费相关性的风险概念；5) 投资者长期缺乏关于中间价格的理论。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了股权风险概念的四个阶段演变（投机→长期亏损风险→方差风险→消费协方差风险），提出"模型发现"概念，强调模型本身是历史产物。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒研究者注意金融模型的历史局限性，理解资产价格时需考虑当时主导的认知范式，避免用今天的模型去套用历史数据。

title: Structuring Product Management Theory for AI Reasoning: A Knowledge Graph Schema and Compilation Pattern for Domain-specific Intelligence
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Structuring Product Management Theory for AI Reasoning: A Knowledge Graph Schema and Compilation Pattern for Domain-specific Intelligence
detail.abstract: Large language models are now routinely used as decision-support tools in product management, but their reasoning over domain knowledge is only as good as the format that knowledge arrives in, and that format is almost always unstructured prose. The dominant workaround, retrievalaugmented generation (RAG), slices text into arbitrary chunks and, in doing so, discards the very thing that makes a product recommendation useful: the relationships among constructs, frameworks, and lifecycle phases. This paper sets out a formal ontology and knowledge graph schema for encoding product management theory as machine-actionable knowledge that keeps those relationships intact through retrieval. The schema defines four entity types (Concepts, Frameworks, Artifacts, Metrics), a set of directed relations (phase_requires, mechanism_produces, construct_extends, among others), and provenance links back to source material. Alongside it I describe a compilation pattern, the LLM-Wiki approach, which turns linear scholarly prose into interlinked, structured pages that a model can actually reason across. My claim is narrow but, I think, consequential: domain-specific AI needs structured knowledge representations, accumulated institutional memory, and outcome feedback loops if it is to give phase-aware, context-sensitive advice, and current prompt-based tools have none of the three. Though the worked example here is product management, the argument travels to any domain where AI reasoning has to be grounded in accumulated organizational knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于本体论和知识图谱的模式，将产品管理领域的理论编码为机器可操作的结构化知识，以替代传统RAG方法中任意切分文本造成的语义断裂，从而实现阶段感知、上下文敏感的产品管理决策支持。
AI.research_question: 如何构建结构化的知识表示模式，使大语言模型能够保留产品管理中概念、框架和生命周期阶段之间的内在关系，从而提供更有效的领域推理？
AI.motivation: LLM已被广泛用于产品管理决策支持，但主流方法RAG将文本随意切分成片段，破坏了构成有用产品推荐的关键要素——各构念、框架和生命周期阶段之间的关联关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本体论（Ontology）、知识图谱（Knowledge Graph）
AI.method: 定义了四种实体类型（概念、框架、产物、指标），一组有向关系（阶段需要、机制产生、构念扩展等），以及溯源链接；同时设计了"LLM-Wiki"编译模式，将线性学术文本转化为相互链接的结构化页面。
AI.findings: 领域特定AI需要（1）结构化知识表示、（2）累积的制度化记忆、（3）结果反馈循环，才能提供阶段感知和上下文敏感的建议，而当前的基于提示的工具缺乏这三者。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个正式的产品管理本体论和知识图谱模式，为将领域理论编码为机器可操作的知识提供了标准化框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了"LLM-Wiki"编译模式，可将线性学术文本转化为结构化知识，提升LLM在产品管理等领域决策支持的质量；该模式可推广到任何需要基于积累的组织知识进行AI推理的领域。

title: Digital Preservation of Local Cultural Heritage: A Turnkey, Mobile-Optimized Geospatial Platform for Haiku Monuments in Mie Prefecture
affiliations: Nanzan University

detail.title: Digital Preservation of Local Cultural Heritage: A Turnkey, Mobile-Optimized Geospatial Platform for Haiku Monuments in Mie Prefecture

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no relevant financial or non-financial interests to disclose.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses publicly available open government data and does not involve human participants, animal subjects, or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for conducting this study.

detail.abstract: Geographically dispersed cultural heritage assets-such as haiku monuments-present persistent challenges for systematic documentation and public engagement, particularly in resource-constrained municipalities. This study presents a reproducible, infrastructure-free web-GIS platform for the digital discovery, preservation, and promotion of such heritage, developed entirely in R (Shiny, Leaflet, dplyr) and grounded in open government data. Integrating 302 haiku monument records from Mie Prefecture, Japan, the platform delivers GPS-linked fieldwork capabilities through a two-step spatiotemporal rendering design optimized for bandwidth-limited outdoor environments, a field-oriented cluster suppression algorithm that exposes individual 2 markers at landscape scale, and attribution-compliant GSI tile layer integration. Poemlevel pop-ups with full historical metadata are accessible directly from smartphones and tablets in situ. All code and verification assets are archived in Zenodo under CC BY 4.0, enabling immediate horizontal deployment to any scattered cultural asset type without specialized infrastructure. The platform further establishes a turnkey template for future Participatory GIS (PPGIS) and emotional mapping frameworks through which communities can overlay place attachment narratives onto the geospatial record. Grounded in open science principles, this study contributes to SDG 11 (Sustainable Cities and Communities) and advances interdisciplinary planning agendas at the intersection of Digital Humanities, spatial data infrastructure, and heritage-led regional development.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于R语言（Shiny, Leaflet, dplyr）的开源Web-GIS平台，利用开放政府数据对日本三重县302个俳句纪念碑进行数字化记录、保护与推广，实现了在带宽受限环境下的GPS联动田野调查功能，并为分散式文化遗产的数字化管理提供了可复制的模板。
AI.research_question: 如何利用开源工具和开放政府数据，构建一个无需专门基础设施、可复制的Web-GIS平台，以解决地理分散的文化遗产（如俳句纪念碑）在系统化记录和公众参与方面面临的持续性挑战？
AI.motivation: 地理分散的文化遗产（如俳句纪念碑）在资源有限的市政条件下，长期面临系统性记录困难与公众参与不足的问题，亟需一种低成本、可复制、无需专门基础设施的数字化解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开源科学原则、数字人文、空间数据基础设施、遗产导向的区域发展、参与式GIS（PPGIS）与情感映射框架
AI.method: ①全R语言开发（Shiny、Leaflet、dplyr）；②两步时空渲染设计（适应带宽有限的户外环境）；③田野导向的聚类抑制算法（在景观尺度上暴露单个标记）；④符合归属要求的GSI瓦片图层集成；⑤Zenodo归档（CC BY 4.0协议）以确保可复现性。
AI.findings: 成功构建了整合302条俳句纪念碑记录的Web-GIS平台，支持智能手机和平板电脑在现场直接访问带有完整历史元数据的诗级弹出窗口，实现了在带宽受限环境下的高效运行，并形成了可直接横向部署到其他分散式文化遗产类型的模板。
AI.theory_contributions: ①提出了面向分散式文化遗产的开源Web-GIS方法论框架；②为PPGIS和情感映射框架提供了即用型模板，使社区能够将地方依恋叙事叠加到地理空间记录上；③推进了数字人文、空间数据基础设施与遗产导向区域发展的跨学科交叉议程。
AI.practical_contributions: ①为资源有限的市政部门提供了无需专门基础设施的文化遗产数字化工具；②实现了在带宽受限的户外环境下进行GPS联动的田野调查；③通过开放数据和开源代码（CC BY 4.0）确保平台的可复制性与可扩展性；④为SDG 11（可持续城市与社区）做出了实质性贡献。

title: The Architecture of American Financial Power: SWIFT, Dollar Hegemony, and Global Trade Governance

detail.title: The Architecture of American Financial Power: SWIFT, Dollar Hegemony, and Global Trade Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that there are no known competing financial interests, personal relationships, or affiliations that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a conceptual and literature-based research article that does not involve human participants, animals, personal data, surveys, interviews, or experimental procedures. Therefore, ethics committee approval and informed consent were not required for this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The contemporary international economic order is deeply influenced by the financial architecture developed and sustained by the United States. At the center of this architecture lie three interrelated pillars: the global dominance of the U.S. dollar, the extensive use of the Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT), and the institutional mechanisms governing international trade and finance. Together, these elements have enabled the United States to exercise unprecedented influence over global trade flows, capital movements, financial markets, and geopolitical relations. This conceptual paper examines the architecture of American financial power through the interconnected roles of SWIFT, dollar hegemony, and global trade governance. Drawing upon theories of hegemonic stability, financial statecraft, network power, and international political economy, the paper develops an integrated conceptual framework explaining how financial infrastructures translate into economic and geopolitical influence. The study further evaluates emerging challenges arising from de-dollarization efforts, BRICS financial initiatives, central bank digital currencies (CBDCs), and alternative payment systems. The paper concludes that while American financial dominance remains substantial, the future global financial order is likely to become increasingly multipolar, requiring adaptation in international governance mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文通过整合霸权稳定论、金融国家权力、网络权力和国际政治经济学理论，构建了一个分析美国金融权力架构的概念框架，探讨美元霸权、SWIFT系统和全球贸易治理机制如何共同塑造国际经济秩序，并评估去美元化、金砖国家金融倡议、央行数字货币和替代支付系统带来的挑战，认为未来全球金融秩序将趋向多极化。
AI.research_question: 以SWIFT系统、美元霸权和全球贸易治理为核心的美国金融权力架构如何运作？新兴挑战（去美元化、金砖国家金融倡议、央行数字货币、替代支付系统）对这一架构有何影响？
AI.motivation: 当代国际经济秩序深受美国主导的金融架构影响，但学界缺乏一个整合性的概念框架来解释美元霸权、SWIFT系统和全球贸易治理机制三者如何协同运作并转化为经济和地缘政治影响力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 霸权稳定论、金融国家权力理论、网络权力理论、国际政治经济学理论
AI.method: 概念性论文（Conceptual Paper），通过理论整合构建分析框架
AI.findings: 美国金融权力架构通过美元霸权、SWIFT系统和贸易治理机制的相互强化来行使全球影响力；尽管目前美国金融主导地位依然强劲，但去美元化、金砖国家金融倡议、央行数字货币和替代支付系统等新兴挑战正在推动全球金融秩序走向多极化。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了一个整合霸权稳定论、金融国家权力、网络权力和国际政治经济学的综合概念框架，系统解释了金融基础设施如何转化为经济和地缘政治影响力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和国际治理机构提供了关于美国金融权力可持续性及未来多极化趋势的分析参考，提示需要调整国际治理机制以适应全球金融秩序的变化。

title: The Sound of Silence: Does Competition Decrease Whistleblowing? Evidence From a Preregistered Experiment

detail.title: The Sound of Silence: Does Competition Decrease Whistleblowing? Evidence From a Preregistered Experiment
detail.abstract: We investigate whether market competition suppresses whistleblowing, using a highpowered, preregistered experiment (N = 240). In a setting where firms either operate independently or compete in a tournament for market revenue, managers choose between a productive task and breaking the law to double firm surplus at the expense of the public, while employees decide whether to report misconduct at a personal cost. Aggregate results indicate that competition has a statistically null effect on whistleblowing. While we observe a directional increase in manager lawbreaking under competition, this does not translate into a significant erosion of the propensity to report misconduct. Exploratory analysis reveals heterogeneous treatment effects by population: whistleblowing decreased significantly in our Birmingham pool, but remained unaffected in Cambridge.

AI.tldr: 本文通过预注册实验（N=240）研究市场竞争是否抑制举报行为。在独立运营或锦标赛式竞争的市场中，管理者选择生产性任务或违法获利，员工决定是否举报。总体结果显示竞争对举报无显著统计效应，但探索性分析发现不同地区存在异质性影响。
AI.research_question: 市场竞争是否会抑制员工的举报（whistleblowing）行为？
AI.motivation: 市场竞争可能促使管理者违法获利，而员工举报行为对遏制企业 misconduct 至关重要。然而，竞争是否通过增加员工顾虑或降低举报意愿来抑制举报，现有证据不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于锦标赛理论（tournament theory）和举报行为的经济学模型，探讨市场竞争如何影响管理者的违法倾向和员工的举报决策。
AI.method: 高功效预注册实验（N=240），设置独立经营与锦标赛式竞争两种市场条件，观察管理者违法选择和员工举报行为。
AI.findings: 1. 竞争对举报行为总体无显著统计效应；2. 竞争条件下管理者违法倾向有所上升（方向性），但并未显著降低员工举报意愿；3. 探索性分析发现异质性：伯明翰地区举报行为显著下降，剑桥地区无显著变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"市场竞争必然抑制举报"的直觉，揭示了竞争与举报之间关系的复杂性，并指出人口异质性的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和企业合规设计提供启示：竞争环境下的举报机制可能需要因地因人群制宜，而非一刀切地假设竞争会降低举报率。

title: Private-Wire Economics Without Private Wires: Reimagining Future Nigerian Mini-Grids for Industrial Clusters Through a Bankability Lens

detail.title: Private-Wire Economics Without Private Wires: Reimagining Future Nigerian Mini-Grids for Industrial Clusters Through a Bankability Lens
detail.abstract: Nigeria's electricity sector faces a structural paradox. Despite successive market reforms, persistent reliability deficits continue to erode industrial competitiveness and suppress private investment in productive infrastructure. Mini-grid development has emerged as a significant decentralised response, yet existing structures remain overwhelmingly organised around geographically defined communities rather than concentrated commercial demand centres, a design choice that constrains their revenue architecture, limits their bankability, and forecloses their potential contribution to industrial development. This paper advances a targeted argument: that future Nigerian mini-grid development may benefit materially from a reorientation toward industrial clusters and anchor customers, including Free Trade Zones (FTZs), Special Economic Zones (SEZs), manufacturing corridors, and agroprocessing hubs. In developing this argument, the paper draws on commercial principles underlying private wire arrangements in the United Kingdom, not as a regulatory template for direct transplantation, but as an analytical lens for examining how concentrated demand, direct supply relationships, and long-term contractual revenue structures can improve project economics in emerging market contexts. Using infrastructure finance and bankability theory as the primary analytical framework, the paper stress-tests the proposed model against six adverse scenarios: industrial demand contraction, anchor customer insolvency, foreign exchange depreciation, inflation escalation, regulatory and network integration risk, and stranded asset exposure. Illustrative financial modelling, drawing on publicly available NERC tariff data and World Bank energy finance benchmarks, demonstrates that while industrial mini-grid structures can materially improve debt service coverage ratios (DSCRs) under baseline conditions, concentrated offtaker dependence introduces new bankability vulnerabilities requiring deliberate contractual and structural responses. The paper concludes that Nigeria does not require a wholesale private wire regime. Rather, selective adaptation of private wire economics within Nigeria's evolving regulatory framework, anchored in the NERC Mini-Grid Regulations 2026, offers a credible pathway toward more resilient, scalable, and bankable energy delivery infrastructure. The contribution of this paper lies in bridging comparative energy law, project finance practice, and Nigerian regulatory analysis to produce a framework that is both analytically grounded and practically actionable.

AI.tldr: 本文主张尼日利亚微型电网应从以地理社区为导向转向以工业集群和锚定客户为中心，借鉴英国私人线缆安排的经济逻辑，探索一条更具韧性和可融资性的能源交付路径。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚微型电网如何通过重新定位至工业集群和锚定客户（如自贸区、经济特区、制造业走廊、农产品加工中心）来改善项目经济性和可融资性？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚电力行业存在结构性悖论：市场改革未能解决可靠性赤字，削弱了工业竞争力和私人投资；现有微型电网以地理社区而非商业需求中心组织，限制了收入架构、可融资性和工业发展潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基础设施融资与可融资性理论（bankability theory）；英国私人线缆安排（private wire arrangements）的商业原则作为分析透镜。
AI.method: 概念性论证与压力测试：提出工业微型电网模型，基于NERC电价数据和世界银行能源融资基准进行示意性财务建模，在6种不利情景（工业需求收缩、锚定客户破产、外汇贬值、通胀上升、监管与并网风险、搁浅资产风险）下测试模型韧性。
AI.findings: 工业微型电网结构可在基准条件下显著改善偿债覆盖率（DSCR），但集中化的承购方依赖引入新的可融资性脆弱性，需要审慎的合同和结构性应对措施。尼日利亚不需要全盘移植私人线缆制度，而是在现有监管框架（NERC微型电网条例2026）中选择性适配私人线缆经济学。
AI.theory_contributions: 桥接比较能源法、项目融资实践与尼日利亚监管分析，构建一个既有分析基础又具实践可操作性的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚微型电网开发商、政策制定者及融资机构提供具体的商业模式重构方向，包括选择性采纳私人线缆经济逻辑、优化合同结构以应对集中承购风险，以及在不颠覆现有监管体系的前提下提升项目可融资性。

title: Variability of Profitability of Commercial Farms in the European Union
affiliations: Poznań University of Life Sciences

detail.title: Variability of Profitability of Commercial Farms in the European Union
detail.abstract: The main aim of the article is to determine the level and variability of income obtained on EU farms, classified according to the FADN methodology into eight agricultural types, and the share of subsidies for operational activities in the income obtained. The analysis covers the variability of the total number of farms in the EU keeping FADN accounting, their structure, and the level of income obtained in individual types of farming from 2004 to 2022. Absolute and relative increases were used to determine changes in the total number of farms. They showed that from 2004 to 2022, number of farms under FADN observation field decreased by 36%. The next step was to analyze the level of income obtained from the farm. The highest level of income in the examined period was recorded by farms specialized in the breeding of granivores. Then, the average value for a given year, standard deviation, and coefficient of variation were used to assess the level and variability of income in individual agricultural types. From 2004 to 2022, farms specialized in rearing and breeding granivores and mixed farms were characterized by strong variability in the income obtained from a family farm between 2004 and 2022. Average variability in the level of income was observed on farms specialized in rearing and breeding other grazing livestock, which also had the highest share of subsidies for operating activities.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2004-2022年欧盟FADN农场按农业类型划分的收入水平与变异，以及运营补贴在收入中的占比。研究发现农场总数下降36%，谷物饲养和混合型农场收入波动最大，而草食畜牧农场补贴占比最高。
AI.research_question: 2004-2022年间，欧盟不同类型农场的收入水平、变异程度以及运营补贴在收入中的占比如何？
AI.motivation: 了解欧盟不同类型农场的收入状况及补贴依赖程度，为农业政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农业经济学中的收入变异分析、补贴效应理论
AI.method: 采用FADN数据，使用绝对增长量、相对增长率分析农场数量变化；使用均值、标准差和变异系数分析收入水平与变异程度。
AI.findings: 1）2004-2022年FADN观测农场数量下降36%；2）谷物饲养农场收入最高；3）谷物饲养和混合型农场收入变异最大（强变异）；4）草食畜牧农场收入变异中等，但运营补贴占比最高。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不同类型农场收入变异与补贴依赖之间的结构关系，丰富了农业收入变异性的实证研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟农业补贴政策的精准化提供数据支持，提示政策制定者关注收入波动大的农场类型和补贴依赖度高的农场类型。

title: Fiscal Rules, Public Spending, and Migration Flows in Japan
affiliations: Musashi University and Nagoya City University

detail.title: Fiscal Rules, Public Spending, and Migration Flows in Japan
detail.abstract: Fiscal rules are widely used to improve fiscal discipline and constrain fiscal imbalances, but their effects on local economies remain unclear. This paper examines how fiscal rules affect migration flows, local economic activity, and fiscal adjustment using a nationwide fiscal rule reform in Japan and variation in municipalities' exposure to the reform under the previous fiscal regime. We show that fiscal rules reduce both in-and out-migration, leading to a decline in migration turnover while leaving net migration largely unchanged. Fiscal rules also reduce local economic activity, including business establishments, employment in the construction sector, land prices, and property tax revenues. We further show that fiscal rules affect the composition of fiscal adjustment. In particular, municipalities exposed to the reform reduce investment-related expenditures directed toward private firms and government-affiliated entities, including capital contributions and lending. These reductions are accompanied by lower construction activity and reduced migration turnover. Overall, the findings suggest that fiscal rules affect local economic adjustment through reductions in economic activity and population mobility rather than through changes in overall population levels.

AI.tldr: 本文利用日本全国性财政规则改革及 municipalities 在原有财政体制下对改革暴露程度的差异，研究了财政规则如何影响人口流动、地方经济活动和财政调整。研究发现，财政规则减少了迁入和迁出人口，导致人口流动周转率下降，但净迁移变化不大；同时降低了地方经济活动水平，包括商业机构、建筑业就业、地价和财产税收入。财政规则还改变了财政调整的构成，减少了面向私营企业和政府关联实体的投资性支出，进而导致建筑活动减少和人口流动周转率下降。
AI.research_question: 财政规则如何影响地方经济中的人口流动、经济活动以及财政调整方式？
AI.motivation: 财政规则被广泛用于改善财政纪律和约束财政失衡，但其对地方经济的实际影响尚不明确，尤其是对人口流动和地方经济活动的传导机制缺乏实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政联邦主义、财政纪律与地方经济调整理论；财政规则影响地方支出结构与经济活动的理论机制。
AI.method: 利用日本全国性财政规则改革作为准自然实验，借助 municipalities 在改革前不同财政体制下的暴露程度差异，采用双重差分或类似识别策略进行实证分析。
AI.findings: (1) 财政规则同时减少迁入和迁出人口，降低人口流动周转率，但净迁移基本不变；(2) 财政规则降低地方经济活动水平，包括商业机构数量、建筑业就业、地价和财产税收入；(3) 财政规则改变财政调整构成，削减面向私营企业和政府关联实体的投资性支出（如资本出资和贷款），进而导致建筑活动减少和人口流动周转率下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了财政规则影响地方经济的新机制——通过降低经济活动和人口流动性而非改变总人口水平；区分了净迁移与人口周转率的不同效应，丰富了财政纪律与地方经济调整的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估财政规则的全面经济后果提供了实证依据，提示在实施财政纪律约束时需关注其对地方经济活力（商业活动、建筑业就业、土地市场）和人口流动性的潜在负面影响。

title: Domestic Violence Laws in Pakistan and the Culture of Impunity
affiliations: University of London

detail.title: Domestic Violence Laws in Pakistan and the Culture of Impunity
detail.abstract: The growing culture of impunity in Pakistan has enabled perpetrators and demonstrates how despite the existence of laws, justice often remains out of reach for survivors. While provincial legislatures have introduced laws to offer protection and legal recourse, the measures fall short due to the indoctrination of societal norms, patriarchal values and institutional inertia. The Aurat Foundation (2023) reports a concerning rise in gender-based violence, with over 5,000 reported cases of domestic violence across Pakistan, the majority from Punjab and Sindh. Remedies exist, but they remain inaccessible to many victims due to multiple factors, including weak implementation, lapse in law enforcement assistance, and most importantly, lack of awareness about their rights. Cultural practices enforcing silence in the name of honour, as well as family coercion through religious and emotional manipulation, further exacerbate this inaccessibility. This is not just about the failure in enforcement of the law, rather about impunity being embedded within the system. Our institutions, both legal and cultural, often prioritise the reputation of a family over the protection of the survivor and their right to justice. Even the progressive legislation falls short when it comes to implementation, not because they are inconsistent or there is a systemic lapse but because these laws do not account for the lived realities of these victims, especially those from rural areas or ethno-marginalised backgrounds. Most don't know what rights they are entitled to, let alone have access to legal aid or safe shelters. The issue runs deeper than a mere lack of enforcement. Political will is often missing and reforms are resisted by conservative traditions. While accountability as a whole is weak, these patterns are not random nor coincidental; they reflect a broader pattern of neglect and a resistance to change. This article argues that while legal reform is essential, it requires a structural and pragmatic shift; a transformation in how institutions, public awareness function to protect victims and most importantly, a cultural reckoning that challenges and exposes the social norms abetting or shielding abusers. Through an examination of relevant legal provisions and high-profile cases, this article aims to expose the practices that impede victims and give a rise to perpetrator exoneration. The legal system in Pakistan is undeniably defeated as the wealthy or popular manipulate loopholes to delay and derail justice but it is also worth acknowledging the sociocultural factors that influence law enforcement and courts.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了巴基斯坦性别暴力受害者难以获得司法公正的结构性原因，指出法律存在但执行不力，核心问题在于有罪不罚文化已嵌入制度体系，需要法律改革、机构转型与社会文化反思三者并重的根本性转变。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦性别暴力受害者为何在存在法律保护的情况下仍难以获得司法公正？有罪不罚文化如何嵌入制度体系并阻碍法律实施？
AI.motivation: 巴基斯坦性别暴力案件持续上升，但受害者在法律存在的情况下仍难以获得正义，现有法律实施效果不佳。作者试图揭示法律失败背后的深层结构性原因，而非仅归咎于执法不力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有罪不罚文化理论、制度惯性与父权价值观分析框架、法律与现实脱节的结构性分析。
AI.method: 法律条文分析、高知名度案例研究、社会文化因素分析。
AI.findings: 巴基斯坦性别暴力受害者难以获得正义的原因包括：法律实施薄弱、执法不力、受害者权利意识缺乏、以"名誉"为名的文化沉默机制、家庭通过宗教和情感施压、制度优先保护家庭声誉而非受害者权利、法律未考虑农村和边缘群体的现实处境、政治意愿缺失、保守传统抵制改革。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了有罪不罚文化如何在巴基斯坦制度层面系统性运作，挑战了仅将问题归因于法律执行不力的传统解释，提出了需要法律改革、机构转型与文化反思三重变革的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦性别暴力治理提供了结构性改革建议，包括转变机构职能、提升公众权利意识、推动文化观念变革以挑战纵容施暴者的社会规范。

title: On Sample Kurtosis for Time Series Data
affiliations: and Peking University - Guanghua School of Management

detail.title: On Sample Kurtosis for Time Series Data
detail.abstract:
Bai and Ng [2005] propose a test of kurtosis for time series data. To evaluate the size and
power performance of the test, in their simulation exercise, they consider an AR(1) process
with autoregressive coefficient ρ ∈ {0, 0.5, 0.8}, where the innovation terms are drawn from
15 different distributions, like normal, t5, χ2, and distributions from the generalized lambda
family. Our claim is that the interpretations of the simulation exercise for the kurtosis test
ˆπ4(κ) in their Table 2, which test the true population values of κ, can be misleading in the
cases where ρ ∈ {0.5, 0.8}.

We can observe in Table 2 by Bai and Ng [2005], column 3, that the true value of κ for
all the 15 distributions considered in their simulation is the same across all the choices of
ρ ∈ {0, 0.5, 0.8}. They write “Because the kurtosis of all 15 distributions are known (and
are given in Table 2), the size and power of ˆπ4, as well as the normality test can be easily
obtained” page 55. Bao [2013] shows that the excess of kurtosis of an AR(1) process depends on the autoregressive coefficient, and hence the correct value of kurtosis, except when κ = 3,
will be different depending on ρ.

AI.tldr: 本文指出Bai & Ng (2005)在检验时间序列峰度时，错误地假设AR(1)过程的峰度与自回归系数ρ无关，导致当ρ≠0时，对检验的模拟结果解读存在误导。
AI.research_question: Bai & Ng (2005)提出的峰度检验在AR(1)过程中的模拟结果是否存在误导性解读？
AI.motivation: 纠正Bai & Ng (2005)在峰度检验模拟中因忽略自回归系数对峰度影响而产生的错误结论。
AI.theoretical_framework: AR(1)过程的超额峰度依赖于自回归系数ρ（Bao, 2013）。
AI.method: 重新审视Bai & Ng (2005)的模拟设计，指出其错误假设——即不同ρ下各分布的峰度真实值相同，并引用Bao (2013)的理论结果进行反驳。
AI.findings: Bai & Ng (2005)在ρ=0.5和0.8时，使用的峰度真实值κ是错误的，除κ=3（正态）外，其余分布的峰度会随ρ变化，因此其表2中关于检验大小和功效的解读存在误导。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了AR(1)过程中自回归系数对峰度的影响，纠正了既有文献中的错误认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒研究者在使用峰度检验时，需考虑时间序列的自相关结构对高阶矩的影响，避免错误设定检验的零假设值。

title: Political Uncertainty and Artificial Intelligence Innovation: Evidence from U.S. Patent Data *
affiliations: Tohoku University - Graduate School of Economics & Management, Tohoku University - Graduate School of Economics & Management, Tohoku University - Graduate School of Economics & Management and Tohoku University - Graduate School of Economics & Management

detail.title: Political Uncertainty and Artificial Intelligence Innovation: Evidence from U.S. Patent Data *
detail.abstract: This study examines the impact of political uncertainty on artificial intelligence (AI) innovation. Using data from the Artificial Intelligence Patent Dataset released by the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office and U.S. House election data from 2008 to 2023, we show that increases in political uncertainty significantly inhibit AI development, as reflected in a declining share of AI-related technological components in patents. This result remains robust across a wide range of robustness checks. Our analysis further indicates that the effect of political uncertainty on AI innovation varies with political environment, levels of AI task exposure and market concentration. Furthermore, by exploring the underlying mechanisms, we find that labor unions, entrepreneurial activity and labor mobility play important roles in shaping the relationship between political uncertainty and AI innovation. Our results show that while the presence of labor unions is associated with enhanced AI innovation, under conditions of political uncertainty, unionization exacerbates the negative impact of political uncertainty on AI development. We further show that labor mobility mitigates the negative effects of political uncertainty on AI innovation, potentially suggesting that enhancing labor market flexibility may help reduce the negative influence of political uncertainty and potentially offers implications to both the government and firms.

AI.tldr: 研究发现政治不确定性显著抑制了AI创新，劳动力工会加剧这一负面效应，而劳动力流动性则能缓解其影响。
AI.research_question: 政治不确定性如何影响人工智能（AI）创新？
AI.motivation: AI是关键技术领域，但政治不确定性作为重要的宏观环境因素，其对AI创新的影响尚未得到充分实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政治不确定性、创新经济学、劳动力市场制度等理论，探讨政治不确定性对AI创新的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用美国专利商标局的AI专利数据集（2008-2023年）和美国众议院选举数据，采用实证回归分析，并进行一系列稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 政治不确定性显著抑制AI创新（专利中AI相关技术成分下降）；该效应因政治环境、AI任务暴露度和市场集中度而异；工会加剧负面效应，劳动力流动性可缓解负面效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统实证政治不确定性对AI创新的抑制作用，并揭示了劳动力工会和劳动力流动性的调节机制，丰富了政治不确定性与技术创新关系的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府和企业在政治不确定性环境下制定AI发展策略提供参考，提示增强劳动力市场灵活性可能有助于缓解政治不确定性的负面影响。

title: The Digital Markets Act: Three Years Into the EU's Platform Regulation Experiment
affiliations: Tilburg University - TILT

detail.title: The Digital Markets Act: Three Years Into the EU's Platform Regulation Experiment
detail.abstract: By adopting the Digital Markets Act (DMA), the EU was one of the first jurisdictions to shift its policy on platform competition from antitrust law to regulation. The new law went from proposal to entry into force in less than two years (December 2020-November 2022) and has, at the time of writing, applied for three years (May 2023-April 2026). This chapter traces the EU's regulatory shift on platform competition, examines the regulation, and evaluates its first years of application. In particular, it analyses the genealogy of the DMA (Section 1), its dual goal of fairness and contestability (Section 2), the 'gatekeepers' that form its regulatory object (Section 3), its list of substantive obligations and responsive model to ensure compliance (Section 4), and its convergence/divergence with other regulation in and outside of the EU (Section 5). It adds some reflections on the legal and political challenges the DMA is facing (Section 6) before concluding (Section 7).

AI.tldr: 本文追踪了欧盟从反垄断法转向数字市场法（DMA）监管的政策变迁，分析了DMA的诞生背景、双重目标、监管对象、实质性义务与合规模式，并评估了其前三年实施效果与面临的挑战。
AI.research_question: 欧盟在平台竞争领域从反垄断法转向事前监管的政策变迁是怎样的？DMA在最初三年实施中表现如何？面临哪些法律与政治挑战？
AI.motivation: 欧盟是首批将平台竞争政策从反垄断法转向专门监管的司法管辖区之一，DMA从提案到生效不到两年，但截至写作时已实施三年，有必要对其政策转向的动因、制度设计和实施效果进行系统评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公平性（fairness）与可竞争性（contestability）作为DMA的双重监管目标框架；事前监管与事后反垄断执法的制度比较；规制趋同/趋异理论。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析与制度追踪（genealogy analysis）相结合，对DMA的立法历程、制度条款和实施案例进行系统梳理与评估。
AI.findings: DMA快速立法并实施三年，确立了以"守门人"为监管对象的事前规则体系；在执行中面临界定守门人范围、实质性义务适用等法律挑战，以及来自美国科技巨头和地缘政治因素的持续压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 为平台监管从反垄断事后执法转向事前规制提供了制度分析框架；揭示了公平性与可竞争性双重目标的内在张力与协调路径；丰富了规制趋同/趋异理论在数字平台领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他司法管辖区（如中国、美国、印度等）设计平台竞争监管制度提供了欧盟经验的实证参考；为DMA的后续修订与完善提供了具体的法律与政治挑战清单。

title: The State of Living on Crypto 2025
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The State of Living on Crypto 2025

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors are affiliated with Genghis Research, the research imprint of Genghis, a commercial company that operates a marketplace for spending cryptocurrency. Genghis funded and published the report. The methodology, scoring rubric, and full dataset are public, so every ranking is reproducible and independently checkable. The authors received no external payment for this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study uses public, country-level data on crypto regulation, infrastructure, and adoption. It involves no human participants, patient data, or personal data, so ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: Funded internally by Genghis Research (Genghis), London. No external or third-party funding was received.

detail.abstract:
