AI.method: 基于IEA、OPEC和BP三大机构的预测数据进行对比分析，结合俄罗斯对中国和印度两个市场的煤炭出口数据进行竞争态势评估。
AI.findings: 1) 全球煤炭消费将在2030年代初达峰，中国是主要驱动因素；2) 俄罗斯在中国动力煤市场竞争优势减弱，但在炼焦煤市场具有稳定且增长的优势；3) 俄罗斯在印度市场因价格优势实现增长，但面临制裁、物流风险和印度进口替代政策的制约。
AI.theory_contributions: 细化了全球煤炭达峰背景下不同细分市场（动力煤vs炼焦煤）的差异化竞争格局分析，揭示了地缘政治因素（制裁）与能源转型对出口国战略调整的交互影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为俄罗斯煤炭出口战略提供了具体建议：转向中国和印度的炼焦煤市场、多元化物流路线、消除关税壁垒，以维持出口潜力。

title: The Artisan Paradox: Effort Signaling, Market Bifurcation, and Workforce Implications of Generative AI
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Artisan Paradox: Effort Signaling, Market Bifurcation, and Workforce Implications of Generative AI

declarations.funderStatement: The author declares no conflict of interest. No funding was received for this research. This paper was produced independently and does not represent the views of any institution, organization, or employer

detail.abstract:
The majority of current articles, academic papers and policy discussions focus exclusively on aggregate labour metrics, asking relatively predictable questions like ‘Will AI take my job?’ This narrow focus is a major blind spot. 

In my opinion, the real economic frontier in the age of automation is not just about whether a specific job survives, it is a psychological and structural rewrite of how human beings define worth. Market actors leverage high-quality presentation as a costly signal to communicate unobservable competence to uninformed parties  Researchers are ignoring how consumers completely restructure their valuation metrics when that signal is differentiated from actual human labour. This paper fills that gap by looking past employment statistics to analyse how consumer behaviour and pricing power shift when technical execution is transformed from a signal of quality into a free commodity.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前研究和政策过度聚焦于"AI是否会取代工作"这一宏观就业问题，忽视了自动化时代更根本的经济变革——当技术执行从质量信号变为免费商品时，消费者的价值评估体系发生结构性重构，定价权和市场行为随之改变。
AI.research_question: 当技术执行从质量信号转变为免费商品时，消费者的价值评估体系、定价权及市场行为如何重构？
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多关注就业总量指标（如"AI是否会取代工作"），忽视了自动化时代消费者如何重新定义价值这一心理和结构性的经济前沿问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号传递理论（高质量呈现作为成本信号传递不可观测的能力）；价值重构理论（消费者在信号与人工劳动分离时调整估值指标）。
AI.method: 概念性/理论分析，超越就业统计数据，聚焦消费者行为与定价权变化的分析框架。
AI.findings: 当技术执行从质量信号变为免费商品时，消费者的价值评估指标发生彻底重构，定价权从技术执行者发生转移。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信号理论延伸至自动化情境，提出"信号-商品转化"概念，解释了技术执行去稀缺化如何改变消费者的价值判断逻辑。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒政策制定者和研究者勿仅关注就业替代问题，应聚焦消费者行为重构和定价权转移带来的经济结构变革。

title: Closed Circles: Is AI Infrastructure the Next Systemic Risk?
affiliations: William & Mary Law School

detail.title: Closed Circles: Is AI Infrastructure the Next Systemic Risk?
detail.abstract:
Global AI infrastructure investment is projected to exceed $5 trillion by 2030. In 2026 alone, U.S. tech groups’ AI-specific outlays are expected to total  2.1% of GDP — more than the relative cost of the railroads, interstate highway system, and Apollo space program. One of the largest capital cycles in history is being led by a small group of tightly held firms operating largely outside the regulatory perimeter. That makes one of the most important policy questions of the decade strikingly simple: what happens if things go south?

The inquiry has been missing from the literature. AI-focused legal scholarship has largely focused on the software story while financial-regulatory scholarship has not yet grappled with the potential that AI infrastructure may create systemic risk.

This Article fills that gap with two original empirical analyses. The first uses a novel methodology and data set to systematically map the AI infrastructure sector's most significant financial relationships. It surfaces structural features with financial-stability concerns, including circular transactions and unsustainable contractual commitments masked by uniformly low disclosure quality. The second analysis shows that the AI buildout is being financed not only by borrowing and investment, but also by accounting adjustments that soften near-term costs while boosting earnings by hundreds of billions.

Assessment of recent financial calamities – the late-1990s telecommunications overbuild and pre-2008 structured-finance wave – finds that the AI infrastructure build out simultaneously exhibits dangerous aspects of both. The Article suggests a calibrated regulatory response focused on enhancing disclosure, right sizing the regulatory perimeter and improving macroprudential supervision.

The central claim is not that a crash is inevitable, but that today's funding models and policy choices are generating the conditions under which one could occur – and that existing frameworks are poorly equipped to detect the risks or contain the resulting externalities.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，全球AI基础设施投资预计到2030年将超过5万亿美元，但这一巨大资本周期由少数在监管范围之外运营的紧密控股公司主导。现有文献缺乏对此系统性风险的关注。文章通过两项原创实证分析——系统性绘制AI基础设施行业的金融关系网络，以及揭示会计调整如何软化短期成本、虚增收益——发现AI建设同时呈现出1990年代末电信过度建设和2008年前结构化金融浪潮的危险特征。文章建议加强披露、调整监管边界和改进宏观审慎监管。
AI.research_question: AI基础设施投资可能产生的系统性金融风险是什么？现有监管框架能否有效检测和应对这些风险？
AI.motivation: AI基础设施投资规模巨大（预计到2030年超5万亿美元），由少数在监管范围之外运营的公司主导，但文献中缺乏对此系统性风险的关注：AI法律研究聚焦于软件层面，金融监管研究尚未关注AI基础设施可能带来的系统性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统性金融风险理论；历史类比分析（1990年代末电信过度建设与2008年结构化金融灾难）。
AI.method: 两项原创实证分析：第一项采用新方法和数据集系统绘制AI基础设施行业最重要的金融关系网络，揭示结构性问题（循环交易、不可持续的合同承诺、低披露质量）；第二项分析AI建设如何通过会计调整软化短期成本并虚增收益。
AI.findings: AI基础设施行业存在循环交易、不可持续的合同承诺、低披露质量等金融稳定隐患；AI建设的融资不仅来自借贷和投资，还通过会计调整软化短期成本、虚增数百亿收益；AI基础设施同时呈现出1990年代末电信过度建设和2008年结构化金融浪潮的危险特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了AI法律研究（关注软件层面）与金融监管研究（未关注AI基础设施系统性风险）之间的空白，首次系统识别和分析了AI基础设施投资可能产生的系统性金融风险。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出校准式监管应对方案：加强信息披露、调整监管边界、改进宏观审慎监管，为政策制定者提供风险预警和监管建议。

title: Exchange Rate Risk and Exposure: Concepts, Determinants, Management Strategies, and Corporate Implications Hani

detail.title: Exchange Rate Risk and Exposure: Concepts, Determinants, Management Strategies, and Corporate Implications Hani
detail.abstract: In the era of globalization, international trade and cross-border investments have increased significantly, exposing businesses to various financial risks, particularly exchange rate risk. Exchange rate fluctuations can influence corporate cash flows, profitability, competitiveness, and overall firm value. This article examines the concept of exchange rate risk and exchange rate exposure, identifies the major factors contributing to exchange rate volatility, discusses strategies for managing foreign exchange risk, and analyzes the implications of exchange rate movements on corporate performance. The study employs a descriptive literature review approach by synthesizing theories and findings from international finance literature. The results indicate that exchange rate risk is an unavoidable aspect of international business activities, and effective risk management through financial and operational hedging strategies is essential for maintaining corporate stability and competitiveness in global markets.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文献综述方法，分析了汇率风险的概念、成因、管理策略及其对企业绩效的影响，指出有效的外汇风险管理对跨国企业维持稳定性和竞争力至关重要。
AI.research_question: 汇率风险如何影响企业绩效？企业应如何有效管理外汇风险？
AI.motivation: 全球化背景下，国际贸易和跨境投资大幅增加，企业面临显著的汇率波动风险，亟需系统理解汇率风险的影响与管理策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 汇率风险与汇率暴露理论；金融对冲与经营对冲理论；国际金融文献中的风险管理框架。
AI.method: 描述性文献综述法，综合国际金融领域的理论与研究发现。
AI.findings: 汇率风险是国际商业活动中不可避免的；金融对冲和经营对冲等有效风险管理策略对于维持企业稳定性和全球市场竞争力至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了汇率风险暴露、波动成因与对冲策略的理论框架，为后续实证研究提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供了应对汇率波动的策略指导，强调了金融和经营双重对冲手段的重要性。

title: Notes on the Categorial-logic of Capital

detail.title: Notes on the Categorial-logic of Capital
detail.abstract: The validity of the "method applied in Capital " as an external toolkit is one of the main issues that follows the publication of the first volume in 1867. The proposal presented here is based on the premise that this problem rests on a basic formal misunderstanding of the Marxian legacy. The hypothesis herein is as follows: the presentation found in Capital imposes that the method must conform to the object by the latter's necessity.

AI.tldr: 本文认为，《资本论》中的方法并非可以随意套用的外部工具，而是必须根据研究对象的内在必然性而展开的呈现方式。作者指出，将《资本论》方法视为外部工具包的做法源于对马克思遗产的基本形式误解。
AI.research_question: 《资本论》中的方法是作为可外部套用的工具包，还是必须与研究对象内在统一的呈现方式？
AI.motivation: 自1867年《资本论》第一卷出版以来，关于其方法能否作为外部工具包套用的争论一直存在，作者认为这一问题的根源在于对马克思遗产的形式性误解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马克思辩证法中形式与内容的统一性原理；《资本论》的"呈现方式"（Darstellungsweise）理论。
AI.method: 文本分析与哲学论证，通过对《资本论》呈现方式的形式分析来论证方法必须服从于对象自身的必然性。
AI.findings: 《资本论》的方法论并非外部可套用的工具包，方法必须依据研究对象的内在必然性而展开呈现。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了《资本论》方法论的实质，纠正了将马克思方法工具化的形式误解，深化了对马克思辩证法中方法与对象统一性的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为后续研究者正确运用《资本论》方法论提供理论指导，避免方法论上的形式主义错误。

title: The Transformation of Russian Coal Exports: Global Demand Trends and Market Positions in China and India
affiliations: Gaidar Institute for Economic Policy and Gaidar Institute for Economic Policy

detail.title: The Transformation of Russian Coal Exports: Global Demand Trends and Market Positions in China and India
detail.abstract: An analysis of forecasts by the International Energy Agency (IEA), the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC), and BP indicates a consensus on the long-term trend of declining global coal consumption, with consumption peaking no later than the early 2030s. China is the main driver of this decline. At the same time, Russian coal exports are facing mixed trends in two key Asian markets. In China, Russia’s competitive position is weakening in the thermal coal segment but remains strong and is growing in the higher-margin coking coal segment, where Russia occupies an intermediate niche between cheap Mongolian and expensive Australian coal. In India, by contrast, Russian exports are showing steady growth thanks to a significant price advantage. However, further expansion is hampered by sanctions and logistical risks, as well as India’s import substitution policy, which aims to reduce coal purchases. Thus, to preserve Russia’s export potential, a consistent reorientation toward markets and segments with stable demand (coking coal in China and India) is necessary, while simultaneously diversifying logistics routes and removing tariff barriers.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了IEA、OPEC和BP的预测，指出全球煤炭消费将在2030年代初达峰，中国是主要驱动因素。俄罗斯对华动力煤竞争力下降，但焦煤出口增长；对印出口因价格优势增长，但受制裁和物流风险制约。建议俄罗斯转向中印焦煤市场并多元化物流。
AI.research_question: 在全球煤炭消费达峰趋势下，俄罗斯煤炭出口在亚洲关键市场（中国和印度）的竞争态势如何？未来应如何调整出口策略？
AI.motivation: 全球能源转型背景下，俄罗斯作为重要煤炭出口国面临需求结构性变化，需明确其在亚洲市场的竞争定位与应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际贸易竞争理论、能源市场结构分析、地缘政治经济学
AI.method: 基于IEA、OPEC和BP的长期预测数据，结合俄罗斯对华、对印煤炭出口的竞争态势进行定性比较分析
AI.findings: 1）全球煤炭消费2030年代初达峰，中国是主因；2）俄对华动力煤竞争力减弱，焦煤保持增长且处于蒙古和澳大利亚之间的价格/质量中间位；3）俄对印出口因价格优势增长，但受制裁、物流风险和印度进口替代政策制约；4）建议转向中印焦煤市场并多元化物流。
AI.theory_contributions: 为全球煤炭达峰背景下出口国竞争策略提供了具体案例分析，丰富了能源转型与国际贸易交叉领域的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为俄罗斯煤炭出口战略调整提供政策建议，也为其他资源型国家应对能源转型提供参考。

title: ToyBox-AI: e-commerce Toy Platform, Analysis & Research using UML  Diagrams

detail.title: ToyBox-AI: e-commerce Toy Platform, Analysis & Research using UML  Diagrams
detail.abstract: This research presents the analysis and design and research of ToyBox-AI, a web-based e-commerce platform for toy retail integrated with a rule-based conversational assistant. Traditional toy stores remain constrained by geographic limitations, manual ordering workflows, and the absence of automated customer support. ToyBox-AI addresses these gaps through a five module architecture covering profile management, toy browsing, order processing, payment handling, and a structured chatbot assistant. Using a UML-driven design methodology, this study models the complete system through ER, class, use case, activity, sequence, component, and hierarchy diagrams, providing a rigorous and replicable blueprint for implementation. The research demonstrates how systematic application of UML modeling produces a scalable, maintainable, and clearly documented architecture for intelligent toy retail management. Empirical usability evaluation of the implemented platform is identified as a concrete direction for future work, with a structured evaluation protocol proposed for subsequent studies.

AI.tldr: 本文设计并分析了ToyBox-AI，一个集成了基于规则的对话助手的玩具零售电商平台，通过UML建模构建了包含五大模块的系统架构，为智能玩具零售管理提供了可复制的蓝图。
AI.research_question: 如何通过UML驱动的设计方法构建一个集成了规则型对话助手的玩具零售电商平台，以解决传统玩具店的地理限制、手动订购流程和缺乏自动客服等问题？
AI.motivation: 传统玩具店受限于地理位置、手动订购流程以及缺乏自动化客户支持，亟需一个可扩展、可维护且文档清晰的智能电商解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: UML驱动的设计方法论、规则型对话系统（Rule-based Conversational Assistant）、五模块架构设计
AI.method: 采用UML驱动设计方法，通过实体关系图、类图、用例图、活动图、时序图、组件图和层次图对系统进行完整建模。
AI.findings: 通过系统性UML建模，生成了一个可扩展、可维护且文档清晰的智能玩具零售管理架构蓝图；提出了未来进行可用性评估的结构化评估方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了如何系统性地应用UML建模方法构建智能电商平台，为类似电商平台的设计提供了可复制的理论框架和建模范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为玩具零售行业提供了一个集成了规则型对话助手的电商平台设计蓝图，包含配置管理、玩具浏览、订单处理、支付处理和聊天机器人五大模块，可直接指导实际开发。

title: Ecological Capitalism 3.0: A Market-Based Monetary Architecture for Systemic Biosphere Restoration

detail.title: Ecological Capitalism 3.0: A Market-Based Monetary Architecture for Systemic Biosphere Restoration
detail.abstract: All existing approaches to the ecological crisis share a structural limitation: they depend on continuous political will, international coordination, or voluntary behavioral change. This paper presents Ecological Capitalism 3.0 (EC 3.0), a monetary-ecological architecture that makes biosphere restoration economically more profitable than destruction-without requiring legislation, international agreements, carbon taxes, or altruistic actors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出生态资本主义3.0（EC 3.0），一种通过货币-生态架构使生物圈恢复在经济上比破坏更有利可图的方案，无需立法、国际协议、碳税或利他行为。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种经济机制，在不依赖持续政治意愿、国际协调或自愿行为改变的前提下，使生态恢复比生态破坏在经济上更有利可图？
AI.motivation: 现有应对生态危机的方法都受限于对持续政治意愿、国际协调或自愿行为改变的依赖，这些因素在实践中往往不可持续或难以实现，亟需一种不依赖这些条件的替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态资本主义3.0（EC 3.0）理论，一种货币-生态架构设计。
AI.method: 理论建构与概念设计。
AI.findings: EC 3.0通过重新设计货币与生态系统的关系，使得生物圈恢复行为在经济激励上优于破坏行为，且无需外部强制或利他动机。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种超越传统环境经济学的全新范式，将生态逻辑内嵌于货币体系，解决了"集体行动困境"中搭便车与协调失败的结构性问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为应对生态危机提供了一种不依赖政治意愿和国际协调的可操作方案，降低了实施门槛，有望从根本上改变经济行为体的激励结构。

title: Emerging Hybrid Monetary-Fiscal Framework: Supply-Side Sound Money Economics (SSSM) -Institutional Signals, Historical Parallels, and Illustrative Scenario Analysis (2026)
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Emerging Hybrid Monetary-Fiscal Framework: Supply-Side Sound Money Economics (SSSM) -Institutional Signals, Historical Parallels, and Illustrative Scenario Analysis (2026)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not require ethics approval as it did not involve human participants, animal subjects, or the collection of sensitive personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Persistent post-2021 inflation, elevated U.S. debt-to-GDP ratios, and leadership changes at the Federal Reserve have exposed limits of the post-1971 discretionary monetary regime. This paper examines early signals from the second Trump administration and Chair Kevin Warsh's Federal Reserve (May 2026 onward) as evidence of an emerging pragmatic hybrid: Supply-Side Sound Money Economics (SSSM). The framework selectively combines supply-side incentives for output expansion, monetarist discipline on prices and balance sheets, and sound-money principles favoring market signals over discretion. We integrate primary statements, institutional actions, and macroeconomic data with historical parallels from the Volcker-Reagan era and illustrative forward scenario modeling through 2030. The analysis is conditional on early 2026 institutional signals, including internal reviews of communications, the balance sheet, data practices, productivity, and inflation frameworks. Descriptive comparative analysis shows that monetary restraint paired with supply-side measures has historically delivered lower inflation alongside subsequent growth recovery. Forward scenarios suggest that stronger implementation of balance-sheet normalization and supply-side alignment could facilitate inflation convergence near target while stabilizing debt dynamics, while limited progress would likely amplify existing risks. The paper highlights implementation risks and the "debt wall" constraint, and supports gradual, institutionally driven evolution toward the hybrid rather than abrupt regime change.

AI.tldr: 本文提出美国正在从后1971年的相机抉择货币体制转向一种名为"供给侧稳健货币经济学"（SSSM）的务实混合体制，该体制结合供给侧激励、货币主义纪律和稳健货币原则。基于2026年初的特朗普第二任期与Warsh美联储的早期信号，通过历史比较和情景建模，发现货币政策紧缩结合供给侧措施历史上能实现低通胀与增长复苏；更强有力的资产负债表正常化与供给侧配合可使通胀趋近目标并稳定债务，反之则风险加剧。文章强调渐进式制度演变而非激进变革。
AI.research_question: 2021年后持续通胀、高债务-GDP比率及美联储领导层更迭是否催生了美国货币体制向"供给侧稳健货币经济学"（SSSM）这一新型混合体制的转型？该体制的前景与风险如何？
AI.motivation: 后2021年通胀持续、美国债务比率高企以及美联储领导层变动暴露了1971年以来相机抉择货币体制的局限性，亟需探索潜在的新体制方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供给侧经济学（产出扩张激励）、货币主义（价格与资产负债表纪律）、稳健货币原则（市场信号优先于相机抉择），以及Volcker-Reagan时代的历史经验比较。
AI.method: 整合特朗普第二任期与Warsh美联储的早期制度信号（内部沟通审查、资产负债表、数据实践、生产力与通胀框架审查），结合Volcker-Reagan时代的历史平行分析，以及至2030年的前瞻性情景建模。
AI.findings: 历史上货币政策紧缩配合供给侧措施可带来低通胀与后续增长复苏。前瞻情景显示：更强力的资产负债表正常化与供给侧配合可使通胀趋近目标并稳定债务动态；进展有限则会放大现有风险。存在"债务墙"约束和实施风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并系统阐述了"供给侧稳健货币经济学"（SSSM）这一新型货币-财政混合体制框架，丰富了货币体制转型理论，连接了供给侧经济学、货币主义与稳健货币理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了从相机抉择体制向混合体制渐进转型的具体路径与风险评估，强调了资产负债表正常化、供给侧配套及"债务墙"约束的实际意义。

title: Regime-Dependent Synchronization of Mexican Regional Business Cycles with US and Chinese Industrial Shocks: A Markov-Switching Approach, 2005-2025
affiliations: Universidad Anáhuac México Norte and Universidad Anahuac Mexico

detail.title: Regime-Dependent Synchronization of Mexican Regional Business Cycles with US and Chinese Industrial Shocks: A Markov-Switching Approach, 2005-2025

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest
declarations.funderStatement: No funding

detail.abstract: This paper examines regime-dependent business cycle synchronization across all 32 Mexican states using quarterly ITAEE data from 2005Q1 to 2025Q3, combined with US Industrial Production (INDPRO), Chinese industrial output (PRINTO01CNQ663N), and state-level labor market data from MTPTREF. We estimate two-state Markov switching dynamic regression models independently for each state, fixed-effects panel regressions with cluster interactions, and a Filardo (1994) regime transition analysis. Five results emerge. First, all 32 states are synchronized with the US industrial cycle; full-sample correlations of ITAEE growth with US GDP growth range from 0.63 to 0.79, averaging 0.73 for maquiladora states and 0.71 for nearshoring statesmore than four times the corresponding China correlations. Second, Markov switching models converge for all 32 states and identify persistent asymmetric regimes with recession durations of 3 to 4 quarters and expansion durations exceeding 10 years. Third, the post-2022 tariff shock generated a statistically significant 2.3 percentage point acceleration across all state clusters, but without differential concentration in manufacturing statesconsistent with investment gestation lags. Fourth, manufacturing labor productivity is declining in both the traditional maquiladora cluster (-0.00222 per quarter, p=0.051) and the nearshoring cluster (-0.00117 per quarter, p=0.048), while manufacturing real wages rise uniformly at policy-determined rates; the maquiladora decline predates the 2019 minimum wage acceleration by fourteen years, placing the origin in the structural design of enclave manufacturing. Fifth, the regime transition analysis reveals that Chinese industrial expansion suppresses nearshoring state expansion probabilities with greater statistical precision (p=0.001) than maquiladora states (p=0.087), inverting the assumption that the new industrial cluster is less exposed to Chinese competition.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2005-2025年墨西哥32个州的季度数据，发现所有州都与美国工业周期同步，但与中国周期相关性极低；2022年关税冲击带来2.3个百分点的增长加速但未集中体现在制造业州；制造业劳动生产率持续下降而实际工资政策性地上升；中国工业扩张对近岸外包州的扩张概率抑制效应比传统客户加工州更强。
AI.research_question: 墨西哥各州的商业周期与美中两国周期的同步性如何？关税冲击、劳动生产率、工资动态以及中国竞争对墨西哥不同制造业集群的影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 在美中贸易摩擦和近岸外包（nearshoring）兴起的背景下，墨西哥作为北美供应链重组的核心受益者，其内部区域异质性（传统客户加工州 vs. 新兴近岸外包州）尚未被系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马尔可夫区制转换动态回归模型、固定效应面板回归、Filardo (1994) 区制转换分析
AI.method: 对每个州独立估计两状态马尔可夫转换模型，辅以固定效应面板回归（含聚类交互项），以及Filardo区制转换概率分析。
AI.findings: 1. 所有32州与美国周期同步，与中国周期相关性极低（近岸州0.71 vs 客户加工州0.73）；2. 马尔可夫模型收敛，衰退持续3-4季度，扩张超10年；3. 2022年关税冲击使各州增长加速2.3个百分点，但未在制造业州集中；4. 制造业劳动生产率下降（客户加工州-0.00222/季度，近岸州-0.00117/季度），实际工资政策性上升，且客户加工州的下降早于2019年最低工资加速14年；5. 中国工业扩张对近岸州扩张概率的抑制效应（p=0.001）强于客户加工州（p=0.087），颠覆了"近岸外包更不受中国竞争影响"的假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了墨西哥内部近岸外包州与传统客户加工州在中国竞争暴露度上的反直觉差异，挑战了"新产业集群更安全"的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为墨西哥区域产业政策、美墨供应链风险管理以及近岸外包可持续性评估提供了实证依据。

title: Residential Mobility Responses to Local Tax Cuts: Evidence from a Metropolitan City in Japan
affiliations: Musashi University and Nagoya City University

detail.title: Residential Mobility Responses to Local Tax Cuts: Evidence from a Metropolitan City in Japan
detail.abstract: This study examines how a permanent local tax cut affects metropolitan adjustment through residential mobility, asset markets, and local public finances, in a setting with enhanced local tax autonomy. We exploit a setting created by Japan's fiscal decentralization reform, in which a single municipality introduced a discretionary tax reduction within an otherwise uniform nationwide local tax system. Using the synthetic control method combined with origin-specific in-migration data, we analyze residential mobility and distinguish relocation across nearby administrative jurisdictions from broader interregional migration. The results show that the tax cut induces a relative increase in in-migration from within the same prefecture and neighboring prefectures, with persistent effects, but no statistically significant change in in-migration from other major metropolitan prefectures. These localized mobility responses are followed by gradual increases in residential land prices and property tax revenues, consistent with capitalization mechanisms emphasized in urban spatial equilibrium frameworks. Although these effects partially offset the fiscal impact of the tax reduction, they do not generate revenues beyond what would have occurred in the absence of the reform.

AI.tldr: 本文利用日本财政分权改革中一个市町村自主减税的自然实验，结合合成控制法和来源地特定的迁入数据，发现地方永久性减税主要吸引同县及邻近县的居民迁入，但对远距离大都市圈的迁移没有显著影响；减税后住宅地价和财产税收入逐步上升，体现了城市空间均衡中的资本化机制，但这些效应仅部分抵消减税的财政影响，并未产生额外的净收益。
AI.research_question: 地方永久性减税如何通过居民迁移、资产市场和地方公共财政影响大都市调整？
AI.motivation: 在地方税收自主权增强的背景下，理解减税对人口流动、地价和财政收入的动态影响，尤其是区分近距离行政边界迁移与远距离跨区域迁移的不同反应，以及资本化机制在其中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市空间均衡框架（capitalization mechanisms）
AI.method: 合成控制法（Synthetic Control Method）结合来源地特定的迁入数据
AI.findings: （1）减税带来同县及邻近县迁入的相对增加，且效应持久；（2）对其他主要大都市县的迁入无显著影响；（3）迁入增加后住宅地价和财产税收入逐步上升；（4）这些效应仅部分抵消减税的财政影响，未产生超出反事实水平的额外收入。
AI.theory_contributions: 为城市空间均衡框架中的资本化机制提供了微观实证证据，揭示了地方减税的迁移效应在空间上的异质性（近距离有效、远距离无效）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方税收自主权改革提供了政策启示：地方减税虽能吸引邻近人口并提升地价与税基，但不足以完全自偿，需谨慎评估财政可持续性。

title: Risk Attribution in Rebalanced Characteristic Portfolios

detail.title: Risk Attribution in Rebalanced Characteristic Portfolios
detail.abstract: A rebalanced characteristic portfolio is a constructed object, but asset-pricing tests often attribute its exposure to the static label used to name it. Monthly rebalancing creates implementation roles: incumbents, entrants, exits, and boundary-crossing stocks through which the rule is actually held. This paper develops a role-based attribution correction and shows, in a pre-specified strict-OOS test block and a longer stress-rich evaluation block within one fixed pricing system, that the Baa-Aaa state-price component is located in boundary-crossing transition stocks rather than in the static liquidity label. The correction matters for risk attribution, benchmark construction, and portfolio monitoring because portfolio construction can change which stocks an asset-pricing test actually prices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于角色归因的修正方法，发现Baa-Aaa状态价格成分存在于边界穿越的过渡股票中，而非静态流动性标签中。组合构建方式会改变资产定价测试实际定价的股票，这对风险归因、基准构建和组合监控至关重要。
AI.research_question: 再平衡特征组合的收益暴露究竟是来自其静态标签（如流动性），还是来自组合构建过程中产生的交易角色（如边界穿越股）？
AI.motivation: 月度再平衡使特征组合产生不同角色（在组者、新进者、退出者、边界穿越者），而传统资产定价测试往往将组合暴露归因于其命名所用的静态标签，忽视了组合构建本身带来的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 特征组合再平衡的角色分解理论；资产定价测试中的归因偏差纠正理论。
AI.method: 基于角色的归因校正方法，在预设的严格样本外测试块和更长的高压评估块内，使用单一固定定价系统进行验证。
AI.findings: Baa-Aaa状态价格成分位于边界穿越的过渡股票中，而非静态的流动性标签中；组合构建方式会改变资产定价测试实际定价的股票。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了特征组合再平衡角色对资产定价测试的重要影响，提出了角色归因校正方法，修正了传统归因中将组合暴露简单归于静态标签的做法。
AI.practical_contributions: 对风险归因、基准构建和组合监控具有实际指导意义，提醒从业人员注意组合构建方式对定价测试结果的影响。

title: Bank Stocks and Multifactor Models
affiliations: Texas A&M University - Department of Finance,  Texas A&M University, Illinois Institute of Technology and University of Karachi - Institute of Business Administration (IBA), Karachi

detail.title: Bank Stocks and Multifactor Models
detail.abstract: Multifactor models have been developed over time to price nonfinancial stocks. This paper investigates their ability to price widely-perceived anomalous bank stocks. Based on standard cross-sectional regression tests, we find that, as factors are added to multifactor models, their ability to price bank stocks substantially improves. Even so, a recently proposed two-factor model normally outperforms other multifactor models with relatively high goodness-of-fit and statistical significance. Further graphs of average mispricing errors confirm these findings. We conclude that traditional multifactor models well explain the cross section of average bank stock returns.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多因子模型对银行股票定价的能力，发现随着因子增加，定价能力显著提升，其中双因子模型表现最优，传统多因子模型能很好地解释银行股票收益的横截面差异。
AI.research_question: 多因子模型能否有效定价被普遍视为"异常"的银行股票？
AI.motivation: 多因子模型主要用于非金融股票定价，但银行股票因其特殊性常被视为"异常"，研究这些模型对银行股票的定价能力有助于检验模型的普适性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多因子定价模型（如Fama-French系列模型），横截面回归检验方法。
AI.method: 采用标准横截面回归检验，并辅以平均错误定价图进行可视化分析，比较不同多因子模型的表现。
AI.findings: 随着因子数量增加，模型对银行股票的定价能力显著提升；一个近期提出的双因子模型在拟合优度和统计显著性方面优于其他多因子模型；平均错误定价图进一步验证了这一结论。
AI.theory_contributions: 将多因子定价模型的适用范围从非金融股拓展到银行股，证明传统多因子模型能够解释被视为"异常"的银行股票收益横截面特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和研究人员在银行股定价和组合管理中选择合适的定价模型提供了实证依据，尤其推荐双因子模型。

title: Fraud Detection in Nigerian Banking: Temporal, Behavioral, and Geographic Patterns in One Million Transactions
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Fraud Detection in Nigerian Banking: Temporal, Behavioral, and Geographic Patterns in One Million Transactions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. This research was conducted independently with no financial relationships with any organization that could influence the findings.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses a publicly available synthetic dataset (Owolabi, 2025) hosted on Kaggle under CC BY-SA 4.0 licence. No human participants were involved and no personally identifiable information was accessed. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently by the author.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This study does not involve clinical trials.

detail.abstract: Nigeria's digital banking sector processed over one trillion naira in transactions during 2025, yet fraud continues to erode consumer trust and impose measurable financial losses on customers and institutions alike. Despite widespread investment in rule-based detection systems, older adults and digitally inexperienced users remain disproportionately vulnerable. This paper presents the first large-scale empirical analysis of fraud patterns across ten Nigerian commercial banks using one million transactions drawn from a representative simulation of Nigerian Inter-Bank Settlement System (NIBSS) data. This paper documents three principal findings. First, fraudsters exhibit time-aware velocity manipulation: transaction speeds drop 7-15% during business hours to evade detection, then surge 45-58% between midnight and 3 AM when victims are asleep. Second, mobile banking is the sole channel where fraudulent velocity exceeds legitimate velocity (+4.2%), constituting evidence of automated or bot-driven attacks. Third, fraud rates vary by as much as 3.6-fold for the same bank across geographic locations, challenging the industry assumption of uniform national risk. On the modelling side, a Random Forest classifier achieves AUC-ROC of 0.82, improving on Logistic Regression (0.70) while detecting 64% of fraud cases. The paper discusses the fundamental precision-recall tension in low-prevalence fraud detection (0.3% base rate) and offers a prioritized set of policy recommendations for Nigerian banks.

AI.tldr: 基于尼日利亚十家商业银行的100万笔模拟交易数据，首次大规模实证分析了数字银行欺诈模式，发现欺诈者存在时间感知的速率操控、移动端成为唯一欺诈速率超过正常速率的渠道、同一银行不同地区欺诈率差异高达3.6倍，并提出随机森林模型（AUC-ROC=0.82）及政策建议。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚数字银行欺诈有哪些模式特征？如何有效检测欺诈交易？
AI.motivation: 尽管尼日利亚数字银行交易规模庞大，欺诈行为持续侵蚀消费者信任并造成经济损失，传统规则检测系统效果有限，且缺乏针对该国银行体系的大规模实证分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欺诈检测理论、时间感知的速率操控理论、渠道差异化风险理论、地理差异化风险理论、低患病率分类问题的精度-召回率权衡理论。
AI.method: 基于100万笔模拟NIBSS交易数据的大规模实证分析；对比随机森林与逻辑回归分类器的检测性能（AUC-ROC指标）。
AI.findings: 1) 欺诈者存在时间感知的速率操控：交易速度在营业时间下降7-15%以规避检测，午夜至凌晨3点飙升45-58%；2) 移动端是唯一欺诈速率超过正常速率的渠道（+4.2%），表明存在自动化或机器人攻击；3) 同一银行不同地区欺诈率差异高达3.6倍；4) 随机森林AUC-ROC达0.82，优于逻辑回归的0.70，检出64%欺诈案件。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供了非洲数字银行欺诈模式的大规模实证证据；揭示了时间感知速率操控、渠道差异化风险、地理差异化风险等新型欺诈特征；验证了随机森林在低患病率欺诈检测中的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚银行及监管机构提供了基于证据的政策建议；有助于改进欺诈检测系统的时间动态策略、渠道风险分级和区域化风险管理；保护易受欺诈的老年人和数字经验不足的用户群体。

title: Remittances and Inclusive Growth: Evidence from the MENA Region

detail.title: Remittances and Inclusive Growth: Evidence from the MENA Region
detail.abstract: This paper examines the role of workers' remittances in promoting inclusive growth in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region. Using panel-data techniques for Egypt, Morocco, and Tunisia over the period 1985-2014, the study investigates the relationships among GDP per capita, remittances, foreign direct investment (FDI), gross domestic savings, gross fixed capital formation, and labour-market participation. The empirical strategy accounts for cross-sectional dependence, panel unit roots, cointegration, and causality. The findings indicate a positive long-run relationship between remittances and growth in the selected MENA economies. The results suggest that the growth effects of remittances are likely to be stronger when financial markets are developed, macroeconomic policy is stable, and recipient economies create incentives for formal, productive, and sustainable remittance transfers.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1985-2014年埃及、摩洛哥和突尼斯的面板数据，研究工人汇款对中东和北非地区包容性增长的作用，发现汇款与经济增长之间存在长期正向关系，且这种效应在金融发达、宏观政策稳定、经济激励充足时更强。
AI.research_question: 工人汇款如何促进中东和北非地区的包容性增长？
AI.motivation: 中东和北非地区面临经济增长不稳定和包容性不足的问题，而工人汇款是该地区重要的跨境资金流，但其对增长的影响及其作用条件尚需实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 增长理论、汇款与金融发展、宏观经济稳定性的交互作用理论
AI.method: 面板数据技术，考虑截面依赖、面板单位根、协整和因果关系检验，分析GDP人均、汇款、FDI、国内储蓄、固定资本形成和劳动力市场参与之间的关系。
AI.findings: 汇款与经济增长之间存在长期正向关系；当金融市场发达、宏观经济政策稳定、经济体为正规和可持续汇款创造激励时，汇款的增长效应更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了汇款促进经济增长的边界条件，即金融发展水平和宏观政策稳定性的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为MENA地区政策制定者提供了建议：应发展金融市场、维持宏观政策稳定、创造激励机制引导正规汇款渠道，以最大化汇款对包容性增长的促进作用。

title: Crate or Crib: (Some) Economics of Pet Ownership
affiliations: Claremont McKenna College, Claremont McKenna College - Robert Day School of Economics and Finance, Colby College - Department of Economics and University of Richmond - E. Claiborne Robins School of Business - Economics

detail.title: Crate or Crib: (Some) Economics of Pet Ownership
detail.abstract: From water bowls for dogs on restaurant patios to the booming pet "daycare" industry, pets play a historically unprecedented role in the American family of the 21st century. We channel Gary Becker in studying the economics of pet ownership and spending. We document how pet ownership and expenditure vary by household composition. Beyond specific anecdotes, we find examples of expenditure patterns consistent with pet owners treating their pets as one would treat a child. Our theoretical framework illustrates that pet ownership serves as a medium through which changes in other economic variables, such as the time cost of children and returns to experience, affect the timing of fertility and, ultimately, fertility rates themselves. Taken together, we argue that studying pet ownership is interesting not only in its own right but also for a more complete understanding of the economics of fertility.

AI.tldr: 本文运用Becker的经济学框架研究宠物拥有与支出模式，发现宠物主人在消费行为上将宠物视为"孩子"，并论证宠物拥有作为中介变量，影响生育时机和生育率。
AI.research_question: 宠物拥有和支出如何随家庭结构变化？宠物消费模式是否与育儿消费模式一致？宠物拥有如何影响生育决策？
AI.motivation: 宠物在21世纪美国家庭中扮演前所未有的重要角色，但经济学视角的研究尚不充分；研究宠物拥有有助于更全面理解生育经济学。
AI.theoretical_framework: Gary Becker的家庭经济学理论，特别是关于时间成本、人力资本回报与生育决策的分析框架。
AI.method: 实证分析宠物拥有与支出的家庭结构差异，并构建理论模型分析宠物拥有如何作为中介影响生育决策。
AI.findings: 宠物消费模式与育儿消费模式一致（"将宠物当孩子养"）；宠物拥有是经济变量（如育儿时间成本、经验回报）影响生育时机和生育率的传导机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 将宠物拥有纳入Becker生育经济学框架，揭示宠物作为"替代性养育对象"影响生育决策的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解低生育率现象提供新视角；对宠物产业及家庭消费政策具有启示意义。

title: Crate or Crib: (Some) Economics of Pet Ownership
affiliations: University of Richmond - E. Claiborne Robins School of Business - Economics, Claremont McKenna College - Robert Day School of Economics and Finance, Claremont McKenna College and Colby College - Department of Economics

detail.title: Crate or Crib: (Some) Economics of Pet Ownership
detail.abstract: From water bowls for dogs on restaurant patios to the booming pet "daycare" industry, pets play a historically unprecedented role in the American family of the 21st century. We channel Gary Becker in studying the economics of pet ownership and spending. We document how pet ownership and expenditure vary by household composition. Beyond specific anecdotes, we find examples of expenditure patterns consistent with pet owners treating their pets as one would treat a child. Our theoretical framework illustrates that pet ownership serves as a medium through which changes in other economic variables, such as the time cost of children and returns to experience, affect the timing of fertility and, ultimately, fertility rates themselves. Taken together, we argue that studying pet ownership is interesting not only in its own right but also for a more complete understanding of the economics of fertility.

AI.tldr: 本文从经济学角度研究宠物拥有与消费，发现宠物主人在消费模式上将宠物视同子女，并构建理论框架说明宠物拥有通过影响生育时机进而影响生育率。
AI.research_question: 宠物拥有和消费如何随家庭结构变化？宠物消费模式是否与养育子女相似？宠物拥有如何影响生育决策和生育率？
AI.motivation: 21世纪宠物在美国家庭中扮演着前所未有的重要角色，但鲜有研究从经济学视角系统分析宠物拥有与消费，以及宠物如何通过影响生育时机进而影响整体生育率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借鉴Gary Becker的家庭经济学理论，将宠物拥有视为影响生育时机和生育率的中介变量，分析时间成本、经验回报等经济变量如何通过宠物拥有渠道影响生育决策。
AI.method: 文献分析结合实证数据，对家庭构成与宠物拥有、消费之间的关系进行统计分析，并通过理论模型推导宠物拥有对生育决策的影响机制。
AI.findings: 宠物消费模式与养育子女的消费模式具有一致性；宠物拥有作为中介变量，影响生育时机和生育率；不同家庭构成下宠物拥有和消费存在显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 将宠物拥有纳入家庭经济学分析框架，拓展了Becker生育经济学理论，揭示宠物作为理解生育决策的重要经济变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解低生育率现象提供新视角，对家庭消费、宠物产业及相关政策制定具有启示意义。

title: The Commission's Art. 5(2) DMA Meta Decision Between Data Protection Law and Competition Policy: A Missed Opportunity?

detail.title: The Commission's Art. 5(2) DMA Meta Decision Between Data Protection Law and Competition Policy: A Missed Opportunity?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: I do not get funding for this research.

detail.abstract: The application of Art. 5(2) DMA is difficult due to its objectives of achieving both more contestability and data protection regarding data combination of gatekeepers. This paper analyses from a law & economics perspective the Meta implementation decision (April 2025), in which the Commission rejects the binary "consent or pay" model of Meta and requires an additional free equivalent option without behavioural advertising ("third option"), as suggested in the innovative EDPB Opinion 08/2024. Economically, this additional third option can lead to far-reaching effects of reducing the "data price" of end users, to less data accumulation and less behavioural advertising. However, it is unclear whether this choice architecture is sufficient for achieving significant positive effects on contestability through inducing many end users to reject the familiar option with behavioural advertising. The analysis of the Meta decision shows that the Commission uses only data protection reasoning in its assessment of the "consent or pay" model of Meta, whereas the effects on contestability do not play any role. With this one-sided focus the Commission is in danger of reducing the role of Art. 5(2) DMA to a pure instrument of better enforcement of data protection law. It has missed the opportunity to develop an own approach for Art. 5(2) DMA with a better combination of stricter rules against the data combination and data power of gatekeepers for achieving more contestability and data protection. In the paper some ideas are discussed how such an approach can be developed. It would also allow Art. 5(2) DMA and the Commission to play an independent role in the interplay between competition policy and data protection law.

AI.tldr: 本文从法律经济学视角分析欧盟委员会2025年4月关于Meta的《数字市场法》第5(2)条实施决定，批评委员会仅使用数据保护理由拒绝Meta的"同意或付费"模式，忽视了该条款促进可竞争性的目标，未能充分发挥其在竞争政策与数据保护法之间的独立作用。
AI.research_question: 欧盟委员会在Meta实施决定中如何适用《数字市场法》第5(2)条？该适用方式是否能同时实现促进可竞争性与数据保护的双重目标？
AI.motivation: 《数字市场法》第5(2)条在适用中面临困难，因其需要同时实现促进可竞争性和数据保护两个目标。Meta的"同意或付费"模式引发了数据保护与竞争政策的交叉争议，需要厘清如何在实践中平衡这两个目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律经济学分析框架，结合竞争政策（可竞争性）与数据保护法（GDPR）的交叉视角，以及"数据价格"概念和选择架构理论。
AI.method: 案例分析法，对2025年4月欧盟委员会关于Meta的实施决定进行法律与经济学交叉分析。
AI.findings: （1）委员会仅使用数据保护理由评估Meta的"同意或付费"模式，未考虑可竞争性效果；（2）委员会的"第三选项"（免费无行为广告版本）可能降低终端用户的"数据价格"，减少数据积累和行为广告；（3）但这种选择架构能否诱导足够多用户放弃熟悉的行为广告选项从而实现显著的可竞争性效果尚不明确。（4）委员会的单边关注有将第5(2)条降格为纯粹的数据保护执行工具的危险。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了《数字市场法》第5(2)条在适用中的数据保护与可竞争性目标失衡问题，提出了法律经济学视角下更好结合这两个目标的分析路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟委员会和立法者提供了如何改进第5(2)条适用方式的政策建议，帮助其在竞争政策与数据保护法的互动中发挥独立作用，而非沦为数据保护法的附庸。

title: Equity-Implied Consumer Credit Stress: Why Consumer-Lender Equities Fail to Track the Consumer Credit Cycle

detail.title: Equity-Implied Consumer Credit Stress: Why Consumer-Lender Equities Fail to Track the Consumer Credit Cycle

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. The views expressed are solely the author's and do not represent any current or former employer. This research was conducted independently of the author's employment and relies exclusively on publicly available data.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses only publicly available aggregate market and economic data; it involves no human participants, animals, or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Corporate-bond markets are known to price the credit cycle: spread-based measures such as the excess bond premium lead real activity and forecast downturns. This paper asks whether the analogous signal exists on the consumer side-whether the equity of publicly traded card issuers and consumer lenders encodes the consumercredit cycle. I construct the Equity-Implied Consumer Credit Stress Index (ECCSI), a daily, fully public, marketbased measure built from the market-adjusted returns, volatility, and co-movement of eight U.S. consumer lenders over 1995-2026, and validate that it captures a coherent common factor (the first principal component explains 51.6% of cross-sectional variance and the index correlates 0.98 with it). I then test the index against the Federal Reserve's quarterly delinquency and charge-off series across multiple cycles. The result is a robust null: ECCSI does not cointegrate with the official series, adds essentially nothing to a persistence nowcast (incremental R² = 0.001), Granger-causes neither delinquencies nor charge-offs, and exhibits a rolling correlation with delinquencies that wanders between-0.86 and +0.92 with no stable sign and no significant structural break. The index discriminates recessions contemporaneously (AUC 0.77) but not at horizon. The central contribution is the documented asymmetry: unlike corporate-bond spreads, consumer-lender equity does not reliably track the consumer-credit cycle-because diversified lender equity is a residual claim driven by rates, capital returns, franchise value, and policy interventions, not by consumer loss content alone. The finding is a cautionary result for the common practitioner shortcut of reading consumer-credit health off lender stock performance.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了基于消费贷款机构股票市场的ECCSI指数，发现与官方消费者信用周期指标没有可靠关联，与公司债市场能预测信用周期形成鲜明对比。
AI.research_question: 消费贷款机构的股票价格是否隐含了消费者信用周期的信号？即能否像公司债市场的利差度量（如超额债券溢价）预测经济衰退那样，用消费贷款机构的股票表现来预测消费者信用周期？
AI.motivation: 公司债市场已知能够定价信用周期，但消费者信用周期能否从股票市场中提取信号尚不清楚。实践中存在用消费贷款机构股票表现推断消费者信用健康的常见做法，但缺乏严谨验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融中介理论、多元化贷款机构股权作为剩余索取权的理论、信用周期理论、市场有效性理论。
AI.method: 构建ECCSI指数（基于8家美国消费贷款机构的市场调整收益、波动率和联动性），使用主成分分析提取共同因子，运用协整检验、格兰杰因果检验、滚动相关性分析、增量R²检验、AUC判别力分析等方法进行时间序列验证。
AI.findings: ECCSI与美联储官方违约率和核销率序列不存在协整关系，对持续性nowcast的增量R²仅为0.001，不格兰杰因果导致违约或核销，滚动相关性在-0.86至+0.92之间大幅波动且无稳定符号，同期衰退判别AUC为0.77但无预测能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了公司债市场与消费贷款机构股票市场在信用周期信号上的不对称性：多元化贷款机构的股权是受利率、资本回报、特许经营价值和政策干预驱动的剩余索取权，而非仅由消费者损失内容驱动。
AI.practical_contributions: 对从业者常见做法（通过消费贷款机构股票表现推断消费者信用健康）提出警示，表明该做法缺乏实证支持，不能可靠追踪消费者信用周期。

title: Redefining GDP per Capita : Capturing the Economic Reality of Ordinary Citizens

detail.title: Redefining GDP per Capita : Capturing the Economic Reality of Ordinary Citizens
detail.abstract: Standard GDP per capita metrics fail to accurately capture the true economic reality and annual income of ordinary citizens on a global scale. This paper introduces a new definitive metric, GDP per capita Real Adjusted Average (RAA), designed to redefine how we measure global prosperity. By analyzing worldwide data, this framework provides a clearer, more accurate picture of an individual's average annual income. The findings suggest that this new metric offers a superior alternative for policymakers and economists seeking to evaluate true economic progress and citizen well-being across nations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的经济衡量指标——人均GDP实际调整平均值（RAA），旨在更准确地反映全球普通公民的真实年均收入和经济状况，为政策制定者和经济学家评估经济进步与民生福祉提供了更优选择。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个更准确衡量全球普通公民真实年均收入和经济现实的新指标？
AI.motivation: 标准的人均GDP指标无法准确捕捉普通公民的真实经济现实和年均收入，存在局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于对传统人均GDP指标的批判性分析，提出人均GDP实际调整平均值（RAA）这一新概念框架。
AI.method: 通过分析全球范围内的数据，构建并验证RAA指标的有效性。
AI.findings: 新提出的RAA指标能够更清晰、更准确地反映个人的平均年收入，为评估国家间的经济进步和公民福祉提供了更优的替代方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种全新的经济衡量指标（RAA），修正了传统人均GDP在反映个体经济现实方面的不足，拓展了经济福祉测量的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和经济学家提供了更准确的工具来评估真正的经济进步和公民福祉，有助于制定更具针对性的经济政策。

title: The Urban Brain in the Networked Transformation of City Governance: An Evolutionary Path from Efficiency-First to Value Reconstruction

detail.title: The Urban Brain in the Networked Transformation of City Governance: An Evolutionary Path from Efficiency-First to Value Reconstruction
detail.abstract: This study systematically examines the evolutionary pathway and underlying mechanisms of "Urban brain" in urban governance networking transformation, shifting from an "efficiency-first" model to "value reconfiguration." Grounded in urban innovation ecosystem theory, we develop an analytical framework encompassing four dimensions: governance objectives, governance structure, data governance, and technological architecture. Using a mixed-methods approachincluding qualitative comparative analysis (QCA), large-sample quantitative measurement, and in-depth case study of Hangzhouwe find that this evolution represents a profound paradigm shift, moving beyond using technology as a tool for internal efficiency toward institutionalizing it as a platform for public value co-creation. Key drivers include economic development level, R&D investment, and institutional innovation. The study contributes a systematic framework for analyzing smart city governance dynamics, challenges the notion of technological neutrality, and offers practical insights for fostering inclusive governance ecosystems and robust data governance to support sustainable urban development.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了城市治理网络化转型中"城市大脑"从"效率优先"到"价值重构"的演变路径与机制，基于城市创新生态系统理论，通过混合方法（QCA、大样本定量、杭州案例）发现这是一场深刻的范式转变，关键驱动因素包括经济发展水平、研发投入和制度创新。
AI.research_question: 城市治理网络化转型中，"城市大脑"如何从"效率优先"模式演变为"价值重构"模式？其背后的驱动机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多将城市大脑视为技术效率工具，忽视了其在公共价值共创中的制度性角色转变，缺乏对演变路径和驱动机制的系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市创新生态系统理论；"治理目标、治理结构、数据治理、技术架构"四维分析框架。
AI.method: 混合方法：定性比较分析（QCA）、大样本定量测量、杭州深度案例分析。
AI.findings: 城市大脑演进是一场从技术效率工具向公共价值共创平台转型的范式转变；经济发展水平、研发投入和制度创新是关键驱动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了分析智慧城市治理动态演变的系统框架；挑战了技术中立性假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为构建包容性治理生态系统和稳健的数据治理体系提供了实践启示，以支持可持续城市发展。

title: Where Unions Fell: The Geography and Demography of Union Organizing in the U.S.
affiliations: Colorado State University

detail.title: Where Unions Fell: The Geography and Demography of Union Organizing in the U.S.

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicts of interest to report
declarations.funderStatement: Russell Sage Foundation, grant # 5340856

detail.abstract: Despite a deepening literature on the how and why of union decline in the US, less is known about the who and where. This study features an expansive dataset on National Labor Relations Board (NLRB) representation elections that offers a novel perspective on the patterns and consequences of union decline. By leveraging newly available county disaggregation, I reveal a significant shift in the spatial distribution of elections, with rural areas experiencing a more pronounced decline compared to urban areas. A shift share decomposition shows that this result is not driven by urbanization or sectoral shifts. Instead, evidence suggests unions have strategically redirected efforts towards higher value targets in urban regions, leaving workers in rural areas isolated and more vulnerable to monopsony power. The study also explores demographic and economic factors associated with union organizing, shedding light on evolving trends since the 1970s.

AI.tldr: 本文利用NLRB选举数据的新县级分解，发现美国工会选举活动显著从农村向城市地区转移，并非由城镇化或产业转移驱动，而是工会策略性转向城市高价值目标，导致农村工人更易受垄断力量影响。
AI.research_question: 美国工会衰退中，谁（哪些工人群体）和哪里（哪些地理区域）发生了变化？工会选举活动的空间分布如何演变及其后果是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有文献深入探讨了美国工会衰退的“如何”和“为什么”，但对“谁”和“哪里”知之甚少，需要从地理空间维度理解工会衰退的模式与后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工会策略选择理论、空间经济学、劳动力市场垄断权力理论
AI.method: 利用NLRB代表选举的县级分解数据，采用Shift-Share分解法分析空间分布变化，并考察人口及经济因素与工会组织活动的关联。
AI.findings: 农村地区工会选举下降幅度显著高于城市地区；这一结果并非由城镇化或产业结构转移驱动；工会策略性地将组织努力转向城市高价值目标；农村工人更孤立且更易受雇主垄断权力影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了工会衰退的空间维度，将工会策略选择与地理不平等联系起来，为工会组织行为提供新的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者关注农村地区工人权益受损提供实证依据；提示工会组织需重新审视其战略分配，避免进一步加剧城乡劳动市场不平等。

title: The Space Dividend: Human Space Exploration and its Benefits for Human Life

detail.title: The Space Dividend: Human Space Exploration and its Benefits for Human Life
detail.abstract: The phrase “space dividend” refers to the overall social and economic benefits society derives from space investment. These advantages are not random. They are the outcome of a well-established economic mechanism known as “technology spillover”, the process by which engineering and technological advances developed for space missions make their way into everyday civilian life. Space science has left its mark on everything from the basic memory foam mattress to life-saving cardiac monitoring devices, from GPS navigation on our phones to satellite-driven weather alerts that shield millions of Indian farmers. The numbers provide an interesting narrative. Every dollar spent on the space program returns about seven dollars to the overall economy, according to NASA’s economic impact assessments. By 2040, the global space economy is expected to have grown from its estimated $546 billion in 2023 to over $1 trillion. India has established itself as one of the most economically and strategically significant participants in this quickly growing industry through the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO). This research examines the full range of benefits from space exploration, including economic multipliers and technology spillovers, improvements in agriculture enabled by satellite data, disaster management enabled by remote sensing, advancements in healthcare, effects on education, and geopolitical implications. India’s special structure of efficient space innovation—achieving more with fewer resources—as well as the policy reforms required to ensure that India gains a larger share of the global space economy in the coming decades, are given special attention. The research study includes material from development studies, public policy, economics, and space science. It makes the fact-based argument that space investment is, above all, smart economics by using actual facts, verified case studies, and honest analysis. It does not exaggerate the concept of space. The last section provides a specific policy proposal for India’s space budget, technology transfer, foreign collaborations, and the development of the human capital pipeline necessary for a space-age economy

AI.tldr: 本文系统阐述了太空投资的经济回报机制（技术溢出效应），分析了太空探索在农业、灾害管理、医疗、教育和地缘政治等方面的广泛收益，并重点关注印度太空研究组织（ISRO）以较低资源实现高效创新的独特模式，最后提出印度太空预算、技术转移、国际合作和人才培养的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 太空投资如何通过技术溢出等机制产生社会经济回报？印度如何在全球太空经济中获取更大份额？
AI.motivation: 太空经济正快速增长（预计2023年5460亿美元增至2040年超1万亿美元），但太空投资的社会经济回报机制尚未被系统梳理，尤其缺乏针对印度高效创新模式的政策分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术溢出效应（technology spillover）——太空任务开发的工程技术进步向民用领域扩散的经济机制。
AI.method: 跨学科综合研究，涵盖发展研究、公共政策、经济学和空间科学；采用实际数据、经验证的案例研究和坦诚分析。
AI.findings: NASA经济影响评估显示，每1美元太空投入约带来7美元经济回报；太空技术已渗透至记忆棉床垫、心脏监测设备、GPS导航、气象预警等民用领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了太空投资的全面收益框架（经济乘数、技术溢出、农业、灾害管理、医疗、教育、地缘政治），并以事实为基础论证太空投资是明智的经济决策。
AI.practical_contributions: 针对印度提出具体的政策建议，涵盖太空预算、技术转移、国际合作和人力资本培养，帮助印度在全球太空经济中占据更大份额。

title: A Quantum-informed Governance Protocol for Transparent Civilization
affiliations: Sekyor Intelligence Tantra Foundation

detail.title: A Quantum-informed Governance Protocol for Transparent Civilization

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper presents a governance protocol and does not involve human participants, animal studies, or clinical trials. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded by SITA Foundation (Sekyor Intelligence Tantra Foundation), a not-for-profit organization registered under the Companies Act, 2013. No external funding was received.

detail.abstract:
Human civilization stands at a critical juncture. Despite unprecedented technological and
material progress, governance systems at every level—from villages to nations—remain
plagued by corruption, opacity, inequality, ecological destruction, and the manipulation of
democratic processes. These failures are not accidental; they are structural consequences of
centralized, unaccountable power.
This white paper introduces Qumanity, a decentralized governance protocol designed to
address these systemic failures by embedding transparency, accountability, and participatory
decision-making into the architecture of governance itself. Built at the intersection of Vedic
eternal principles and modern quantum information theory, Qumanity operationalizes the insight
that consciousness, interconnectedness, and self-correction are fundamental to sustainable
human organization.
The protocol implements four interconnected timelines—Private, Personal, Public, and
Global—that allow individual reflection to escalate naturally into collective action. A nested
governance structure (Village → Tehsil → District → State → Zone → Country → Continent →
Earth) ensures that decisions are made at the appropriate scale, by those most affected by
them. A dual-key identity system (Public and Private IDs) separates public accountability from
personal privacy. A transparent Karma Points ledger rewards verified positive actions and
enables participatory governance.
Qumanity is delivered through two interconnected interfaces: a public-facing website
(qumanity.in) that provides global transparency and real-time governance statistics for
researchers and citizens, and a native iOS/macOS application for village kiosks that provides
full governance services—including biometric authentication, offline-first operation, voting,
elections, marketplace, justice module, health and education services, and family tree
management. At the foundation of the ecosystem lies the Planetary Ledger Node Network
(PLNN)—a decentralized, offline-first, council-governed data infrastructure distributed across
Indian states, ensuring data sovereignty, security, and long-term preservation.
Built with Flask and SQLite/PostgreSQL, Qumanity is designed for deployment in
resource-constrained environments, making it accessible to rural communities in India and
beyond. The protocol is open-source, auditable, and permissionless—any community can adopt
and adapt it.
This paper presents the philosophical foundations, technical architecture, implementation
roadmap, and future vision for Qumanity. It concludes with an invitation to collaborate through
the SITA Foundation (Sekyor Intelligence Tantra Foundation).

AI.tldr: 本文介绍Qumanity，一个基于吠陀永恒原则和量子信息理论构建的去中心化治理协议，旨在通过四层时间线、嵌套治理结构、双钥身份系统和Karma Points账本，解决从村庄到国家各级治理中的腐败、不透明和不平等问题。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个去中心化、透明、可问责且参与式的治理协议，以解决现有集中式治理系统的结构性失败？
AI.motivation: 当前各级治理系统普遍存在腐败、不透明、不平等、生态破坏和民主操纵等问题，这些是集中化、不可问责权力的结构性后果，亟需从架构层面进行根本性改革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 吠陀永恒原则（意识、互联性、自我修正）与现代量子信息理论交叉融合，作为协议设计的哲学与科学基础。
AI.method: 设计并实现一个包含四条时间线（Private、Personal、Public、Global）、嵌套治理层级（村庄至地球）、双钥身份系统（公钥和私钥）以及透明Karma Points账本的去中心化治理协议。技术栈为Flask + SQLite/PostgreSQL，支持离线优先和资源受限环境部署。通过面向公众的网站（qumanity.in）和iOS/macOS村庄信息亭应用交付。
AI.findings: 提出了一套完整的技术架构：Planetary Ledger Node Network (PLNN)作为去中心化数据基础设施；四个时间线实现个人反思到集体行动的自然升级；嵌套治理确保决策由最受影响的人做出；双钥身份分离公共问责与个人隐私；Karma Points激励正向行为并赋能参与式治理。
AI.theory_contributions: 将吠陀哲学中的意识、互联性和自我修正概念与现代量子信息理论相结合，为去中心化治理提供了跨范式的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供一个开源、可审计、无许可的完整治理协议，可在资源受限环境中部署，特别适用于印度农村社区；包含村庄信息亭应用、离线优先操作、生物识别认证等实用功能；通过SITA基金会开放合作。

title: Brown Shocks, Green Stocks: Oil Exposure in Lithium Producer Stocks
affiliations: The University of Western Australia and University of Western Australia - Business School

detail.title: Brown Shocks, Green Stocks: Oil Exposure in Lithium Producer Stocks

declarations.funderStatement: This research is funded by the Digital Finance CRC which is supported by the Cooperative Research Centres program, an Australian Government initiative, and made possible by CSIRO’s Next Generation Emerging Technologies Graduates Programme (GA221786) funded by the Australian Government.

detail.abstract: This paper examines how oil price returns are related to lithium producer equity returns. We document heterogeneous exposure dependent on the type of lithium deposit. Oil returns are positively associated with lithium producer returns, consistent with oil prices capturing demand-related channels. By decomposing oil price movements into demand- and supply-driven shocks, we show that lithium producers are exposed to both green demand channels and brown cost channels. Hard-rock producers respond less positively to supply-driven oil shocks, indicating higher exposure to energy cost pressures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究石油价格回报与锂生产商股票回报之间的关系，发现不同类型锂矿床的生产商对石油价格波动的反应存在异质性。硬岩锂生产商对供给驱动的石油冲击反应更弱，表明其面临更高的能源成本压力。
AI.research_question: 石油价格回报如何影响锂生产商的股票回报？不同类型的锂矿床生产商对这一影响是否存在异质性？
AI.motivation: 随着全球能源转型推进，锂作为新能源汽车和储能的关键原材料，其生产商的盈利能力可能同时受到绿色需求（如电动汽车推广）和棕色成本（如化石能源价格）的双重影响。石油价格波动是连接这两条渠道的重要变量，因此有必要探究其与锂生产商回报的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 石油价格通过需求驱动渠道（绿色需求）和供给驱动渠道（棕色成本）影响锂生产商。石油需求冲击反映了整体经济活动和绿色转型需求；石油供给冲击则反映了能源成本压力，影响生产成本。
AI.method: 采用实证分析方法，将石油价格变动分解为需求驱动和供给驱动的冲击，研究不同类型锂生产商（硬岩锂 vs. 盐湖卤水锂）对这些冲击的异质性反应。
AI.findings: （1）石油回报与锂生产商回报呈正相关，表明石油价格通过需求渠道发挥作用；（2）锂生产商同时暴露于绿色需求渠道和棕色成本渠道；（3）硬岩锂生产商对供给驱动的石油冲击反应更不积极，表明其面临更高的能源成本压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了石油价格与锂生产商回报之间的异质性关系，区分了需求驱动和供给驱动的传导机制，丰富了大宗商品金融化和能源转型背景下资产定价的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为锂生产商、投资者和政策制定者提供了风险管理参考：硬岩锂生产商更易受能源成本冲击，投资者需关注石油供给冲击对不同类型锂企的差异化影响，政策层面需考虑能源转型过程中的成本传导效应。

title: Network General Equilibrium as a Threat to Identification: The Failure of Time Fixed Effects
affiliations: and University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - Finance Area

detail.title: Network General Equilibrium as a Threat to Identification: The Failure of Time Fixed Effects
detail.abstract: Time fixed effects are not a general-equilibrium control. In connected economies, aggregate shocks do not enter firm outcomes uniformly: they propagate through equilibrium prices, costs, and demand, leaving a residual network gradient after time demeaning. When an instrument, treatment, or exposure design even partially aligns with this gradient, standard panel estimators recover the direct effect plus an endogenous network-leakage component. We develop a tractable framework that signs and quantifies this Network-SUTVA bias in closed form, showing how network topology governs its magnitude. Weak instruments magnify the leakage. Difference-in-differences designs are similarly contaminated because controls can be untreated by assignment but treated in equilibrium. Calibrated to the U.S. production network, the distortion can exceed 130% of the true direct effect. We propose observed- and hidden-network diagnostics and remedies, and test them on canonical difference-in-differences designs, showing that standard estimators can confound direct policy responses with systemic network leakage.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，在相互关联的经济体中，时间固定效应无法控制一般均衡影响。由于冲击通过均衡价格、成本和需求在网络中传播，标准的面板估计量（如事件研究、DID）会捕捉到“网络泄漏”偏差。作者开发了一个可解析的框架来量化这一偏差，并提出诊断与修正方法。校准至美国生产网络后，偏差可达真实直接效应的130%。
AI.research_question: 在存在生产网络关联的经济体中，标准面板固定效应估计量（如时间固定效应、DID）在识别因果效应时，是否会因忽略一般均衡的网络传播机制而产生偏差？如何量化、诊断并修正这一偏差？
AI.motivation: 传统面板计量方法（如时间固定效应）假设加总冲击对所有企业的影响是均匀的，但在网络经济中，冲击通过投入产出关联、价格传导和需求溢出等渠道非均匀传播。现有文献对这类“网络SUTVA违背”导致的偏差缺乏系统性的解析刻画和诊断工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡网络模型、SUTVA（稳定单位处理值假设）违背、网络泄漏偏差、工具变量与DID识别假设。
AI.method: 理论推导：构建一个包含生产网络的一般均衡框架，推导网络SUTVA偏差的闭式表达式；校准分析：使用美国投入产出表数据量化偏差大小；实证检验：在经典的DID设定中应用所提出的诊断与修正方法。
AI.findings: 时间固定效应不能消除一般均衡的网络传播效应；当处理变量与网络梯度相关时，标准面板估计量估计的是直接效应与网络泄漏效应之和；弱工具变量会放大这一泄漏；DID设计中，“未处理组”可能因均衡传导而实质上被“处理”；校准显示美国生产网络中的偏差可超过真实直接效应的130%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在一般均衡网络框架下系统推导了面板固定效应估计的“网络SUTVA偏差”闭式解，揭示了网络拓扑结构（如中心度、关联密度）如何调节偏差的大小与方向，拓展了因果识别理论在网络经济中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了可操作的观测网络与隐藏网络诊断工具和修正策略，为使用面板数据（如DID、事件研究、IV）的应用研究者提供了识别网络泄漏偏差的步骤指南，有助于提高实证因果推断的可信度。

title: Housing and Economic Informality in Dharavi: Implications for Political Society and Urban Citizenship

detail.title: Housing and Economic Informality in Dharavi: Implications for Political Society and Urban Citizenship
detail.abstract:
In the year 2003-4, the Government of Maharashtra has pursued the Dharavi Redevelopment Project (DRP), an ambitious urban regeneration initiative aimed at providing formal housing, infrastructure, and economic opportunities while integrating residents into a planned urban system. Following multiple failed redevelopment attempts including DRP initiative, a new Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) based redevelopment model was adopted, and the Adani Group was selected as the lead private partner in 2023. The project is now regarded as one of the largest and most ambitious slum redevelopment projects in the Global South.

Dharavi presents an unusual case in which policymakers explicitly seek to formalize both housing and economic activities. The central question therefore is not whether livelihoods are considered, but whether urban redevelopment plans can successfully transform deeply embedded informal systems of production networks, labor arrangements, and livelihood systems.

Using Partha Chatterjee’s conceptual distinction between political society and civil society, this paper examines to what extent the Dharavi Redevelopment Project can be understood as a transition from political society to civil society. The paper concludes that housing formalization may not automatically produce civil society when the institutional conditions that generate dependence on state recognition and political mediation continue to exist even after residential formalization.

AI.tldr: 本文以达拉维重建项目为例，运用Partha Chatterjee的政治社会与公民社会概念区分，探讨城市非正规住区重建能否真正实现从政治社会向公民社会的转型。研究发现，住房正规化并不会自动产生公民社会，只要产生对政府承认和政治中介依赖的制度条件在居住正规化后依然存在。
AI.research_question: 城市重建计划能否成功地将深层嵌入的非正规生产网络、劳动力安排和生计体系加以正规化？达拉维重建项目在多大程度上可被理解为从政治社会向公民社会的转型？
AI.motivation: 达拉维呈现了一个不寻常的案例——政策制定者明确寻求将住房和经济活动同时正规化，这为研究非正规性转型提供了独特窗口。此前多次重建尝试的失败也凸显了理解这一问题的紧迫性。
AI.theoretical_framework: Partha Chatterjee的政治社会与公民社会的概念区分。政治社会指依赖国家承认和政治中介的非正规生存领域，公民社会则指正规的法律和制度框架下的社会生活。
AI.method: 案例研究，以印度孟买达拉维重建项目（DRP）为分析对象，考察其从2003-4年启动到2023年引入SPV模式、选定阿达尼集团为私人合作伙伴的发展历程。
AI.findings: 住房正规化不会自动产生公民社会。即使居住空间得以正规化，只要产生对政府承认和政治中介依赖的制度条件依然存在，非正规的生计体系和生产网络仍会延续，市民社会的转型难以自动完成。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了Chatterjee政治社会/公民社会框架在城市重建研究中的应用，阐明了正规化进程的非线性特征——物质空间的正规化并不等同于社会关系的正规化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球南方大型贫民窟重建项目提供政策启示：单纯提供正规住房不足以实现真正的转型，必须同时解决生成非正规性的制度条件，特别是生计体系的系统性问题。

title: The FRTB Coordination Crisis: Why Game Theory Explains Regulatory Fragmentation and How to Fix It
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The FRTB Coordination Crisis: Why Game Theory Explains Regulatory Fragmentation and How to Fix It
detail.abstract: The Fundamental Review of the Trading Book (FRTB) stands at a crossroads. FRTB started as a standardised post-crisis reform of market risk regulation, but its execution has resulted in multiple delays and regulatory deviations. The current level of implementation fragmentation has reached a critical point. Canada, Singapore and Hong Kong have already gone live. The EU implementation has been delayed to 2027, its second postponement. The UK will implement SA in 2027 and IMA in 2028 while the United States maintains complete uncertainty about its timelines. This paper demonstrates that the implementation fragmentation represents a coordination problem, more accurately modelled as an Assurance Game rather than a Prisoner's Dilemma, where jurisdictions prefer coordinated implementation but fear being first movers. This creates incentives for delay that produce collectively suboptimal outcomes. Game theory and the analysis of Basel II implementation show that countries will coordinate when they establish verification systems, binding agreements, and progressive response protocols. This paper develops a structured FRTB implementation framework based on synchronized start dates, open monitoring systems, consultative bodies, and enforcement measures to create focal points for cooperation. In addition, it delivers a practical framework which enables financial institutions to develop strategic plans for capital management, system deployment, and jurisdictional positioning during periods of regulatory ambiguity.

AI.tldr: 本文指出FRTB实施碎片化本质上是协调问题（保证博弈而非囚徒困境），各国因害怕成为先行者而延迟实施，导致集体次优结果。基于博弈论和巴塞尔II经验，提出包含同步启动、开放监控、协商机制和强制措施的协调框架，并为金融机构提供战略规划指南。
AI.research_question: 如何理解FRTB实施碎片化的本质，以及如何通过协调机制解决这一困境？
AI.motivation: FRTB实施面临严重碎片化——不同司法管辖区（加拿大、新加坡、香港已实施；欧盟延迟至2027；英国2027-2028；美国不确定）导致集体次优结果，亟需分析其根本原因并提供解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论（保证博弈 Assurance Game vs. 囚徒困境），巴塞尔II实施经验
AI.method: 理论建模（博弈论分析）与历史案例比较分析（巴塞尔II实施经验）
AI.findings: 1) FRTB实施碎片化是保证博弈而非囚徒困境，各司法管辖区偏好协调实施但害怕成为先行者；2) 建立验证系统、约束性协议和渐进响应协议可促成协调；3) 同步启动、开放监控、协商机构和强制措施可创造合作焦点。
AI.theory_contributions: 将FRTB实施碎片化重新概念化为保证博弈问题，丰富了金融监管协调的理论视角；提出结构化协调框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供协调实施的操作框架（同步启动、监控、协商、强制）；为金融机构提供在监管模糊期内的资本管理、系统部署和司法管辖区定位的战略规划指南。

title: Assessing The Congruence Between Ecological, Aesthetic and Commercial Values of Reef Fishes in Southeast Brazil
affiliations: Federal University of Santa Maria (UFSM), Federal University of Santa Maria (UFSM), Universidade de São Paulo, Federal University of Goias and Federal University of Santa Maria (UFSM)

detail.title: Assessing The Congruence Between Ecological, Aesthetic and Commercial Values of Reef Fishes in Southeast Brazil
detail.abstract: Reef ecosystems provide essential services to millions of people worldwide, while reef fishes sustain key ecological processes linked to reef growth, health, and persistence under increasing anthropogenic impacts. Nature-based tourism and fisheries are among the main cultural and provisioning services derived from reef fishes. Yet, the congruence between species’ ecological, aesthetic and economic values remains unclear. We compiled the ecological (C, N and P fluxes g/day), aesthetic, and economic (the mean kilo price) values of 168 reef fish species from four reef sites along the Southeast Brazilian coast: Guarapari (ES), Arraial do Cabo (RJ), Ilhabela (SP), and Florianópolis (SC). Species were ranked according to each of the three value dimensions and classified into multidimensional value archetypes (i.e., cryptic, specialist, dual value, and flagship species) based on the combination of ecological, aesthetic, and commercial rankings, while site-scale rankings incorporated species abundance and biomass. Among the three indices, ecological and aesthetic values were generally congruent, but we also found congruence between ecological and economic ones, mainly in Arraial do Cabo. The three main flagship species Haemulon aurolineatum, Holocentrus adscensionis, and Anisotremus surinamensis were found to have the highest importance for ecosystem functioning and services in Southeast Brazilian reefs. Importantly, species with lower multidimensional prominence still supported distinct ecological and socioeconomic functions, highlighting that reef conservation strategies should extend beyond flagship species alone. Assessing species' underwater and out-of-the-water values concomitantly is a step towards a common currency, which may help identify conservation priorities for the maintenance of ecosystem functioning, guaranteeing sustainable use of fish stocks and promoting reef resilience.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了168种珊瑚礁鱼类的生态价值（碳、氮、磷通量）、美学价值和经济价值，发现生态与美学价值高度一致，但生态与经济价值仅在部分地点一致。研究识别出三种旗舰物种，同时指出价值较低的物种也承担重要生态功能，保护策略不应只聚焦旗舰物种。
AI.research_question: 珊瑚礁鱼类的生态价值、美学价值和经济价值之间是否存在一致性？不同价值维度的组合如何形成不同的价值类型（如旗舰物种、隐秘物种等）？
AI.motivation: 珊瑚礁鱼类同时支撑生态过程（如礁体生长与健康）和人类福祉（旅游业与渔业），但生态、美学和经济价值之间的对应关系尚不明确，亟需统一评估框架以指导保护优先级的设定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多维价值评估框架：将物种的生态价值（营养通量）、美学价值和经济价值进行排序，并基于组合识别出四种价值原型：隐秘物种、专家物种、双重价值物种和旗舰物种。
AI.method: 收集巴西东南沿海四个礁区的168种鱼类数据，计算其生态价值（每日C、N、P通量）、美学价值和经济价值（平均公斤价格）。对物种按三个维度分别排序，并结合丰度和生物量进行站点尺度的排序分析。
AI.findings: (1) 生态价值与美学价值总体一致；(2) 生态价值与经济价值仅在部分地点（如Arraial do Cabo）存在一致性；(3) 识别出三种旗舰物种（Haemulon aurolineatum, Holocentrus adscensionis, Anisotremus surinamensis），其在生态系统功能和服务中均具有最高重要性；(4) 多维价值较低的物种仍承担独特的生态和社会经济功能。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"多维价值类型"分类框架，系统揭示了生态、美学和经济价值之间的复杂关系，为理解物种多重价值提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议保护策略不应仅聚焦旗舰物种，应兼顾多维价值较低的物种以维持生态系统功能完整性；为珊瑚礁可持续管理和渔业资源利用提供了可操作的价值评估工具。

title: Adoption Trajectories of Sustainable Agricultural Practices among Ethiopian Smallholder Farmers: Pathways to Climate Resilient Agriculture
affiliations: Jimma University, Bayero University, Jimma University and Jimma University

detail.title: Adoption Trajectories of Sustainable Agricultural Practices among Ethiopian Smallholder Farmers: Pathways to Climate Resilient Agriculture
detail.abstract: This study examines the factors shaping smallholder farmers’ adoption trajectories-persistent adoption, new adoption, and non-adoption of three key sustainable agricultural practices in Ethiopia: crop rotation, chemical fertilizer use, and soil and water conservation. This study fills this gap by shifting the analytical lens from static adoption to adoption trajectories specifically analyzing persistence, new adoption, and dis-adoption. Using two waves of nationally representative panel data from the Living Standards Measurement Study-Integrated Surveys on Agriculture (2018/19 and 2020/21), the analysis explores how demographic, institutional, economic, and geographic factors influence farmers’ movement across adoption pathways. This paper contributes to the literature in three specific ways. First, it moves beyond static snapshot analysis to track longitudinal trajectories, providing rare evidence on the drivers of technology dis-adoption. Second, it introduces a comparative framework by linking the intrinsic technical attributes of SAPs (capital vs. labor intensity) to their divergent adoption determinants. Third, it utilizes the most recent 2021 LSMS data to provide a contemporary perspective on smallholder constraints. The results show that access to credit and extension services, livestock ownership, household labor availability, and market access play important roles in sustaining or initiating adoption. These findings highlight that adoption is dynamic rather than static and underscore the need for targeted policies that expand rural credit, strengthen extension systems, and improve market access to support long-term uptake of sustainable practices among Ethiopian smallholders.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用埃塞俄比亚两轮全国代表性面板数据，分析了小农户对三种可持续农业实践（轮作、化肥使用、水土保持）的采纳轨迹（持续采纳、新采纳、放弃采纳），发现信贷、推广服务、劳动力、牲畜拥有量和市场准入是影响采纳动态的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素影响小农户对可持续农业实践的采纳轨迹（持续采纳、新采纳、放弃采纳）？不同技术属性（资本密集型 vs. 劳动密集型）的采纳决定因素有何差异？
AI.motivation: 已有研究多将采纳视为静态一次性决策，忽视了农户采纳行为的动态变化（如放弃采纳）。填补这一缺口对理解可持续农业技术的长期推广至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采纳轨迹理论（持续采纳、新采纳、放弃采纳）；技术属性框架（资本密集型 vs. 劳动密集型）；农户决策的人口、制度、经济和地理因素分析框架。
AI.method: 使用埃塞俄比亚LSMS-ISA两轮（2018/19和2020/21）全国代表性面板数据，分析农户在不同采纳路径间的动态转变。
AI.findings: 信贷获取、推广服务、牲畜拥有量、家庭劳动力可用性和市场准入是维持或启动采纳的关键因素。不同技术属性（资本 vs. 劳动密集型）的采纳决定因素存在差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 超越静态采纳分析，追踪纵向轨迹，提供技术放弃采纳驱动因素的稀缺证据；引入比较框架，将可持续农业实践的内在技术属性与不同采纳决定因素联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供针对性建议：扩大农村信贷、加强推广服务、改善市场准入，以支持小农户长期采纳可持续农业实践。

title: Tokenizing Infrastructure: A Bank-Intermediated Model for Vietnam

detail.title: Tokenizing Infrastructure: A Bank-Intermediated Model for Vietnam

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animals, or identifiable personal data. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded and supported by the University of Economics Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam (UEH).

detail.abstract: Emerging Asia's infrastructure gap exceeds $1 trillion a year, yet asset-backed tokens carry no credible loss-sharing rule when cash flow disappoints. We model a bank-intermediated design as a three-player Stackelberg game: a bank sets the guarantee ratio, an issuer chooses unobservable effort, and investors price the token competitively. The optimal guarantee trades fee income against expected payout cost and convex capital cost. Because the guarantee raises the issuer's own collateral exposure, it increases effort rather than inducing moral hazard. Vietnam's 2025-2026 digital-asset reform makes bank intermediation a regulatory necessity and gives regulators a template for governing tokenized infrastructure debt. Although the model is developed in a Vietnamese institutional setting, the mechanism generalizes to any jurisdiction where a wellcapitalized institution can simultaneously commit a balance sheet, operate a licensed trading venue, and conduct a credible project audit.

AI.tldr: 本文通过三阶段Stackelberg博弈模型，研究银行中介化的资产支持代币设计，发现最优担保机制能激励发行人努力而非引发道德风险，并为越南及类似司法管辖区提供了代币化基础设施债务的监管模板。
AI.research_question: 在银行中介化的资产支持代币设计中，如何设定最优担保比例以平衡各方激励？
AI.motivation: 亚洲新兴市场基础设施投资缺口超1万亿美元/年，但现有资产支持代币缺乏可信的损失分担机制，亟需设计有效的担保结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三阶段Stackelberg博弈模型：银行设定担保比例→发行人选择不可观察的努力水平→投资者竞争性定价。整合了费用收入、预期赔付成本与凸性资本成本。
AI.method: 理论建模（三阶段博弈论模型），并结合越南2025-2026数字资产改革的制度背景进行应用分析。
AI.findings: 最优担保机制通过增加发行人自身的抵押品风险暴露，提高了其努力水平，而非引发道德风险。银行担保在费用收入与赔付成本及资本成本之间取得平衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了银行中介化担保在代币化资产中抑制道德风险、激励努力的机制，拓展了担保契约理论在数字金融领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为越南及类似司法管辖区提供了银行中介化代币基础设施债务的监管框架模板，为缩小亚洲基础设施投资缺口提供了可行路径。

title: The Fed's Hidden Ledger: Reading Warsh's "Regime Change" Through the Fiscal-Financial Temporal Entropy Index

detail.title: The Fed's Hidden Ledger: Reading Warsh's "Regime Change" Through the Fiscal-Financial Temporal Entropy Index

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or non-financial interests that could have appeared to influence the research, analysis, or conclusions of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study, as it does not involve human participants, patient data, animal subjects, or personally identifiable private information.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: On June 17, 2026, Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh announced five independent task forces, including a balance-sheet task force charged with reviewing the benefits and risks of the current amplereserves regime, the composition of the Federal Reserve's balance sheet, and alternative frameworks for the conduct and operation of monetary policy. This paper applies the Fiscal-Financial Temporal Entropy Index (FFTEI) framework to three concrete Warsh-era policy objects: the reserves-regime review, the late-2025 end of balance-sheet runoff and subsequent reserve-management Treasury purchases, and the parallel capital-and liquidity-rule reform debate. It shows that each object maps onto a distinct FFTEI failure mode or boundary condition: respectively, the conflation of joint buffer stock with joint disposal capacity, the Deferred Stability Illusion, and the Collateral Swap boundary. Using FFTEI's three-layer identification system, the paper ranks these exposures by structural urgency rather than headline salience and proposes four observable proxy variables for tracking them before any task-force report is released. The central claim is diagnostic: reserves are a stock, disposal capacity is a time-conditioned flowgenerating structure, and policy aimed at the former does not necessarily repair the latter unless it explicitly addresses the conversion channels that make capacity operational within the relevant time window.

AI.tldr: 本文运用财政-金融时间熵指数（FFTEI）框架分析沃什时代的三个政策对象（准备金制度审查、缩表结束后的储备管理国债购买、资本与流动性规则改革），指出准备金是存量而处置能力是受时间约束的流量生成结构，前者不等于后者。
AI.research_question: 沃什时代的三项具体货币政策操作（准备金制度审查、缩表结束后的储备管理购债、资本与流动性规则改革）分别映射到FFTEI框架的何种失败模式或边界条件？如何通过结构性紧迫性而非表面显著性对这些风险暴露进行排序和追踪？
AI.motivation: 2026年6月美联储主席沃什宣布成立独立工作组审查准备金充裕制度及资产负债表演进方案，但政策讨论常混淆"准备金存量"与"处置能力"这两个概念。作者认为这种混淆可能导致政策失效，需要引入更精确的分析框架来识别真正的结构性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政-金融时间熵指数（FFTEI）框架，包含三层识别系统（失败模式、边界条件、转换渠道），以及三个关键概念：联合缓冲存量与联合处置能力的混淆、延迟稳定幻觉、抵押品互换边界。
AI.method: 理论应用与概念映射分析：将FFTEI框架的三个失败模式/边界条件分别映射到沃什时代的三个具体政策对象，并通过四个可观测代理变量进行追踪。
AI.findings: 三个政策对象分别映射到不同的FFTEI失败模式或边界条件：（1）准备金制度审查→联合缓冲存量与联合处置能力的混淆；（2）缩表结束后的储备管理国债购买→延迟稳定幻觉；（3）资本与流动性规则改革→抵押品互换边界。这些风险暴露可按结构性紧迫性排序，并通过四个代理变量进行事前追踪。
AI.theory_contributions: 将FFTEI框架应用于具体货币政策操作场景，展示了该框架在分析央行资产负债表政策时的诊断能力；提出准备金是存量、处置能力是时间条件化流量生成结构的核心区分，丰富了货币政策传导机制的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市场参与者提供了一套事前识别和追踪结构性风险的指标体系（四个代理变量），帮助在沃什工作组报告发布前提前识别风险暴露，避免将"充足的准备金存量"误判为"充足的处置能力"。

title: Bayes TurboQuant
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Bayes TurboQuant
detail.abstract: We identify rotation sampling (Fishman and Huang, 1983) as a randomized optimal quantizer: its O(1/n 2) variance matches the Zador (1982) rate for n-point quantization distortion, and integrating out the random phase yields the deterministic Bayesian quantizer. We embed this observation in Generalized Bayesian Computation (gbc) (Polson and Sokolov, 2023b, 2024b; Nareklishvili, Polson, and Sokolov, 2025), characterizing the Bayesian quantizer as the minimizer of a regularized Wasserstein loss. A central theorem shows that every scale mixture of normals (smn) posterior, including the Polya Gamma logistic model (Polson, Scott, and Windle, 2013) and the horseshoe (Carvalho, Polson, and Scott, 2010), admits an optimal Gauss Hermite codebook at Zador rate O(1/n 2). In R d a Haar rotation decouples quantization error from covariance structure (Theorem 8), recovering the PolarQuant guarantee of TurboQuant (Zandieh and Mirrokni, 2026). A softmax bias-variance theorem (Theorem 10) yields a closed-form learning rate w ⋆ that improves attention-score MSE by up to 45% over TurboQuant on heavy-tailed keys.

AI.tldr: 本文发现旋转采样是一种随机最优量化器，其方差率与Zador最优量化失真率匹配。通过将这一发现嵌入广义贝叶斯计算框架，证明了所有正态尺度混合后验分布都存在最优Gauss-Hermite码本，并推导出softmax注意力分数均方误差的闭式最优学习率，相对TurboQuant可提升高达45%。
AI.research_question: 旋转采样如何被重新解释为随机最优量化器，以及如何将其嵌入广义贝叶斯计算框架以推导出注意力机制的优化方案？
AI.motivation: 连接量化理论（Zador率）与贝叶斯后验推断，揭示旋转采样、贝叶斯量化器与注意力机制之间的深层数学联系，从而优化Transformer中softmax注意力的计算效率。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 旋转采样（Fishman & Huang, 1983）作为随机最优量化器
2. 广义贝叶斯计算（GBC）框架
3. 贝叶斯量化器作为正则化Wasserstein损失的极小化器
4. 正态尺度混合（SMN）后验与Gauss-Hermite码本
5. Haar旋转解耦量化误差与协方差结构
6. Softmax偏差-方差定理
AI.method: 理论推导：建立旋转采样与Zador最优量化率之间的联系；证明SMN后验存在最优Gauss-Hermite码本；基于Haar旋转的误差解耦；推导softmax注意力分数偏差-方差分解的闭式最优学习率。
AI.findings:
1. 旋转采样的O(1/n²)方差与Zador最优量化率匹配，消去随机相位后得到确定性贝叶斯量化器
2. 所有正态尺度混合后验（含Polya Gamma逻辑模型、马蹄先验）均存在Zador率O(1/n²)的最优Gauss-Hermite码本
3. Haar旋转可解耦量化误差与协方差结构，恢复TurboQuant的PolarQuant保证
4. 闭式最优学习率w*可改善注意力得分MSE最多45%（重尾键场景）
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 首次建立旋转采样与Zador最优量化理论之间的等价关系
2. 将贝叶斯量化器刻画为正则化Wasserstein损失的极小化器
3. 证明所有正态尺度混合后验统一具有最优Gauss-Hermite码本
4. 提出Haar旋转解耦定理，揭示量化误差与协方差结构的独立性
5. 推导softmax注意力的偏差-方差分解及闭式最优学习率
AI.practical_contributions: 为Transformer注意力机制提供一种量化友好的优化方案，闭式最优学习率可在重尾键场景下将注意力分数MSE降低45%，有望提升大语言模型推理效率和精度。

title: Option-Implied Dependence and Correlation Risk Premia in Currency Markets
affiliations: John Molson School of Business, Concordia University

detail.title: Option-Implied Dependence and Correlation Risk Premia in Currency Markets
detail.abstract: This paper develops a generalized rearrangement algorithm (GRA) to recover a joint risk-neutral distribution of exchange rates from option-implied marginal distributions while imposing the full set of triangular no-arbitrage relations across exchange rates. The recovered distribution provides a model-free characterization of option-implied dependence across currencies. Using this distribution, option-implied correlations are shown to be strongly state dependent with respect to broad movements in the U.S. dollar. While the unconditional correlation risk premium is small, the premium is positive during broad dollar depreciations and negative during dollar appreciations.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种广义重排算法（GRA），从期权隐含的边际分布中恢复汇率的联合风险中性分布，同时施加完整的三角无套利关系。恢复的分布提供了跨货币期权隐含依赖性的无模型描述。研究发现期权隐含相关性对美国美元的整体走势具有强烈的状态依赖性，且相关性风险溢价在美元贬值时为正、升值时为负。
AI.research_question: 如何从期权隐含的边际分布中恢复汇率的联合风险中性分布，同时施加三角无套利约束，并利用该分布刻画货币间的依赖性？
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以同时满足三角无套利约束和期权隐含的边缘分布信息，缺乏一个无模型框架来刻画跨货币的期权隐含相关性及其状态依赖性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 广义重排算法（GRA）；风险中性分布；三角无套利关系；期权隐含相关性。
AI.method: 提出广义重排算法（GRA），从期权隐含的边际分布中恢复联合风险中性分布，并施加完整的三角无套利约束。
AI.findings: （1）期权隐含相关性对美元整体走势具有强烈的状态依赖性；（2）无条件相关性风险溢价较小；（3）美元贬值时相关性风险溢价为正，美元升值时相关性风险溢价为负。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个在三角无套利约束下恢复联合风险中性分布的无模型方法（GRA），为研究跨货币期权隐含依赖性提供了新的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了期权隐含相关性的状态依赖性及其与美元走势的关系，为外汇风险管理、资产定价和投资组合构建提供了实证依据。

title: Quantile GBC for RL with Verifiable Rewards
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, George Mason University and

detail.title: Quantile GBC for RL with Verifiable Rewards
detail.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is the standard procedure for post-training reasoning models.
