We show that RLVR is exponential tilting of a reference policy by a verifier likelihood: the KL-regularized optimum is a Gibbs posterior. A noise-outsourcing theorem then states that if the posterior admits , the Gibbs posterior admits  a representation with the same generator and a one-dimensional re-parameterization. Best-of-N , rejection sampling, and group relative policy optimization (GRPO) are each sample-based estimators. We develop the consequences using Parzen's quantile methodology and generative Bayesian computation (GBC). Five contributions: the Gibbs-Lagrangian identification; the noise-outsourcing theorem and its corollaries for trajectory-level, multivariate, and adapter-style RLVR; a large-deviation rate for the reward excess of best-of-N ; a clipped-Gibbs Euler equation for CVaR-regularized RLVR with a Yaari dual-utility representation; and a Fenchel duality between RLVR and the constrained Bayesian moment problem, where Sanov identifies the Gibbs policy as the conditional law of a rollout given a reward-target event. Sanov and Donsker-Varadhan supply the rate theory throughout.

AI.tldr: 本文证明带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）本质上是参考策略的指数倾斜（Gibbs后验），通过噪声外源定理、大偏差理论和Fenchel对偶等工具，揭示了Best-of-N、拒绝采样和GRPO等方法的统一理论框架，并提出了五方面的理论贡献。
AI.research_question: RLVR的统计本质是什么？不同样本估计方法（Best-of-N、拒绝采样、GRPO）之间有何理论联系？
AI.motivation: RLVR是推理模型后训练的标准程序，但其理论基础尚未被充分揭示。本文旨在从信息论和贝叶斯计算的角度，建立RLVR的严格统计理论。
AI.theoretical_framework: Gibbs后验、指数倾斜、噪声外源定理、Parzen分位数方法、生成式贝叶斯计算（GBC）、大偏差理论（Sanov定理、Donsker-Varadhan）、Fenchel对偶、Yaari对偶效用、CVaR正则化
AI.method: 理论推导与证明，结合大偏差理论、贝叶斯计算、凸分析（Fenchel对偶）等数学工具。
AI.findings: (1) RLVR的KL正则化最优解是Gibbs后验；(2) 噪声外源定理表明Gibbs后验可通过一维重参数化表示；(3) Best-of-N的奖励超出量满足大偏差率；(4) CVaR正则化RLVR的截断Gibbs欧拉方程及其Yaari对偶表示；(5) RLVR与约束贝叶斯矩问题之间的Fenchel对偶关系，Sanov定理识别Gibbs策略为给定奖励目标事件下的 rollout 条件分布。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了RLVR的Gibbs-拉格朗日识别、噪声外源定理及其在轨迹级/多变量/适配器式RLVR中的推论、Best-of-N的大偏差率、CVaR正则化的截断Gibbs欧拉方程、RLVR与贝叶斯矩问题之间的Fenchel对偶。
AI.practical_contributions: 为推理模型后训练中的RLVR方法提供了统一的理论基础，揭示了不同采样估计方法（Best-of-N、GRPO等）的统计性质，指导更高效的算法设计。

title: The FRTB Coordination Crisis: Why Game Theory Explains Regulatory Fragmentation and How to Fix It
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The FRTB Coordination Crisis: Why Game Theory Explains Regulatory Fragmentation and How to Fix It
detail.abstract: The Fundamental Review of the Trading Book (FRTB) stands at a crossroads. FRTB started as a standardised post-crisis reform of market risk regulation, but its execution has resulted in multiple delays and regulatory deviations. The current level of implementation fragmentation has reached a critical point. Canada, Singapore and Hong Kong have already gone live. The EU implementation has been delayed to 2027, its second postponement. The UK will implement SA in 2027 and IMA in 2028 while the United States maintains complete uncertainty about its timelines. This paper demonstrates that the implementation fragmentation represents a coordination problem, more accurately modelled as an Assurance Game rather than a Prisoner's Dilemma, where jurisdictions prefer coordinated implementation but fear being first movers. This creates incentives for delay that produce collectively suboptimal outcomes. Game theory and the analysis of Basel II implementation show that countries will coordinate when they establish verification systems, binding agreements, and progressive response protocols. This paper develops a structured FRTB implementation framework based on synchronized start dates, open monitoring systems, consultative bodies, and enforcement measures to create focal points for cooperation. In addition, it delivers a practical framework which enables financial institutions to develop strategic plans for capital management, system deployment, and jurisdictional positioning during periods of regulatory ambiguity.

AI.tldr: FRTB实施碎片化本质上是协调问题（保证博弈而非囚徒困境），本文通过博弈论和Basel II经验提出同步实施框架，并给出金融机构在监管模糊期的战略规划建议。
AI.research_question: FRTB实施碎片化的根本原因是什么？如何通过协调机制解决这一全球市场风险监管改革的分裂问题？
AI.motivation: FRTB作为后危机时代市场风险监管改革的核心，目前面临严重的实施碎片化——各国进度参差不齐，美国甚至完全不确定时间表。这种碎片化已到临界点，亟需理论解释和解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论中的保证博弈（Assurance Game），区别于囚徒困境；借鉴Basel II实施经验。
AI.method: 博弈论建模分析；Basel II历史实施案例的定性比较分析。
AI.findings: FRTB实施碎片化是保证博弈而非囚徒困境：各辖区偏好协调实施，但害怕成为先行者，导致集体次优的延迟结果；通过建立验证系统、约束性协议和渐进响应协议，各国能够实现协调。
AI.theory_contributions: 将FRTB实施碎片化重新概念化为保证博弈问题，为监管协调失败提供了新的理论解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出结构化的FRTB实施框架（同步启动日期、公开监控系统、咨询机构、执行措施）；为金融机构在监管模糊期制定资本管理、系统部署和司法管辖区定位提供可操作的战略规划框架。

title: Adversarial Generative Bayesian Computation: Distortion, Tilting, and the Subjectivist Adversary
affiliations: Instituto de Ciencias Matemáticas (ICMAT), University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Adversarial Generative Bayesian Computation: Distortion, Tilting, and the Subjectivist Adversary

keywords: 68T07. Keywords And Phrases. Adversarial Risk Analysis

detail.abstract: We provide a unified Bayesian decision-theoretic treatment of three apparently distinct devices for evaluating risk in the presence of an antagonist: the probability distortion of Yaari (1987), the worst-case exponential tilt of Hansen and Sargent (2001, 2008) robust control, and the behaviorally modeled attack of adversarial risk analysis (ARA; Ríos Insua et al., 2009, 2023). Our organizing observation is that all three are the same primitive operation-a reweighting of a base predictive measure-and differ only in how the admissible reweighting set is specified: an L ∞ /Lorenz constraint (Yaari), a relative-entropy ball (Hansen), or a generative behavioral model of the opponent (ARA). The subjectivist game theory of Kadane and Larkey (1982a) supplies the unifying stance: rather than solve for a minimax or Nash equilibrium, the decision maker places a prior over the opponent's choice and integrates it out. We introduce a single functional, the adversarial distortion, that nests the dual theory, multiplier preferences, coherent distortion risk measures, and ARA as special cases, and we establish its monotonicity, translation invariance, convexity, and a dual "robust-Bayes" representation. We then show that Generative Bayesian Computation (GBC; Polson and Sokolov, 2025; Polson et al., 2024) is the natural computational engine: its native output is the conditional quantile function-exactly the object against which a Yaari distortion is integrated-while exponential tilting reduces to a reweighting of simulation output. We give an algorithm, Adversarial GBC (A-GBC), prove its consistency with an explicit convergence rate under stated conditions, validate it against closed forms on an exactly solvable Gaussian model, and illustrate it on adversarial classification, robust option hedging under pin risk, and cyber defensive resource allocation.

AI.tldr: 本文统一了三种看似不同的对抗性风险评估方法（Yaari的概率扭曲、Hansen和Sargent的稳健控制、ARA的行为攻击模型），发现它们本质相同——对基础预测测度进行再加权，仅因允许的再加权集合不同而区别。通过Kadane和Larkey的主观主义博弈论统一视角，提出"对抗性扭曲"泛函，并利用生成贝叶斯计算（GBC）作为计算引擎，给出A-GBC算法并验证其有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何统一Yaari的概率扭曲、Hansen和Sargent的稳健控制以及对抗性风险分析（ARA）这三种看似不同的对抗性风险评估方法？
AI.motivation: 三种对抗性风险评估方法表面上截然不同，但可能存在统一的底层结构。统一它们有助于理解其本质联系，并为计算提供统一的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主观主义博弈论（Kadane and Larkey, 1982a）、贝叶斯决策理论、Yaari对偶理论、Hansen-Sargent乘子偏好、相干扭曲风险度量、对抗性风险分析（ARA）
AI.method: 理论统一：通过"对抗性扭曲"泛函统合三种方法；计算框架：提出对抗性生成贝叶斯计算（A-GBC）算法；验证：高斯模型封闭解验证、对抗性分类、稳健期权对冲、网络防御资源分配等应用举例。
AI.findings: 三种方法本质相同，均为对基础预测测度的再加权操作，区别仅在于允许的再加权集合的指定方式（L∞/Lorenz约束、相对熵球、生成式行为模型）。所提出的对抗性扭曲泛函满足单调性、平移不变性、凸性和对偶"稳健贝叶斯"表示。A-GBC算法具有一致性，并有明确的收敛率。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次统一了三种对抗性风险评估理论（Yaari、Hansen-Sargent、ARA），揭示了其共同本质；提出了对抗性扭曲泛函及其性质；建立了与主观主义博弈论的联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了统一的计算引擎A-GBC，可广泛应用于对抗性分类、稳健期权对冲、网络防御资源分配等实际问题，具有理论保证和收敛性。

title: A Mandate Without a Remedy The IRS's Unkept Promise of Electronic Signatures and the Limits of § 706(1)
affiliations: Washington State University - Department of Accounting

detail.title: A Mandate Without a Remedy The IRS's Unkept Promise of Electronic Signatures and the Limits of § 706(1)
detail.abstract: In 1998 Congress directed the Secretary of the Treasury that he "shall develop procedures for the acceptance of signatures in digital or other electronic form." A quarter-century later the IRS still demands a handwritten signature by default, accepting electronic signatures only on an enumerated list of forms. This Article argues that I.R.C. § 6061(b)(1) is a mandate without a remedy: mandatory in form but, because Congress named an open-ended object and set no deadline, unenforceable under the Administrative Procedure Act as construed in Norton v. Southern Utah Wilderness Alliance. The cost of the agency's inaction falls not on the IRS, which cannot be compelled to perform, but on the taxpayer-as Mills v. United States shows-who is turned away for relying on the promise. Loper Bright secures the agency's authority while leaving its inaction beyond reach. The cure is a redrafted subsection in the enforceable, deadlinebearing form Congress already used in § 6061(b)(3)(B), a default of acceptance-unless-excepted, and a restored duty to report progress.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，美国国税局（IRS）25年来未依国会要求落实电子签名制度，形成"有指令无救济"的僵局，纳税人因信赖法律承诺而受损，却无法强制机构行动。文章提出修法方案，要求设定截止日期、默认接受电子签名，并恢复进度报告义务。
AI.research_question: 国会1998年要求财政部制定电子签名程序，但IRS 25年后仍未全面执行，这一行政不作为在法律上如何定性？纳税人因此遭受何种损害？如何通过修法解决这一困境？
AI.motivation: 揭示《国内收入法》第6061(b)(1)条作为"无救济的指令"的法律悖论——国会对行政机关设定义务却未规定可执行的期限和标准，导致IRS不作为不受司法审查，纳税人的信赖利益反而被牺牲。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行政不作为的可诉性理论（基于《行政程序法》及Norton v. Southern Utah Wilderness Alliance案确立的标准）；法律指令的强制性与可执行性区分理论；行政机构自由裁量权与纳税人信赖利益保护之间的张力。
AI.method: 法律文本分析（§6061(b)(1)的语义与结构分析）；判例法分析（Norton、Mills v. United States、Loper Bright等关键先例的适用与限制）；比较分析（对比§6061(b)(3)(B)中国会已采用的强制性立法形式）。
AI.findings: §6061(b)(1)因未规定具体对象和截止日期，依据Norton案标准不可在法庭上强制执行；IRS的不作为成本由纳税人承担（Mills案表明纳税人因信赖法律承诺提交电子签名会被拒绝）；Loper Bright案确认机构自由裁量权的同时使其不作为免于司法审查。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了"强制性法律语言"与"可司法执行性"之间的断裂，即立法可以用强制性词汇（"shall"）设定义务，但若缺乏可量化的标准和期限，该义务在法律上形同虚设，为行政不作为的可诉性理论提供了具体例证。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体的修法方案：重写§6061(b)(1)使其具有可执行的截止日期（参照§6061(b)(3)(B)的模式）；建立"默认接受，例外拒绝"的电子签名制度；恢复机构向国会报告进度的义务，以解决IRS 25年不作为的实际问题。

title: Following Financial Wellness Over Time: The FPLS Wellness Score
affiliations: Follette School of Public Affairs, Texas Tech University - Department of Personal Financial Planning, affiliation not provided to SSRN and

detail.title: Following Financial Wellness Over Time: The FPLS Wellness Score
detail.abstract: Using the annual Financial Planning Longitudinal Study (FPLS), we develop a measure of financial wellness. The FPLS financial wellness score is based on 18 survey items and can be decomposed into three sub-scores including financial management, financial health, and financial perceptions. In a cross-sectional analysis, age, marital status, household size, assets, income, homeownership, and having higher financial literacy are all associated with higher financial wellness scores. Using the 2024-2025 FPLS panel with fixed effects, we show changes in financial wellness are associated with becoming a homeowner, obtaining an advanced education degree, switching to using a financial advisor, and improving financial literacy. The FPLS Wellness Score provides an annual measure of household financial wellness over time that could inform research and practice.

AI.tldr: 本文利用FPLS数据开发了一个包含18个题项的财务健康度量指标，该指标可分解为财务管理、财务健康和财务感知三个子维度。横截面分析显示年龄、婚姻状况、家庭规模、资产、收入、自有住房和金融素养与财务健康得分正相关。2024-2025年面板固定效应分析表明，成为房主、获得高等学历、改用财务顾问和提升金融素养会带来财务健康变化。该指标可为研究与实务提供年度家庭财务健康度量。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个综合性、可分解的财务健康度量指标，并识别影响家庭财务健康的关键因素？
AI.motivation: 现有财务健康度量缺乏统一、可纵向追踪的综合指标，难以同时捕捉财务管理的客观行为、财务结果的客观状态和财务感知的主观体验三个维度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财务健康的多维概念框架，包括财务管理（行为维度）、财务健康（结果维度）和财务感知（主观心理维度）。
AI.method: 基于FPLS年度调查数据（18个题项），构建财务健康得分及三个子得分；使用横截面回归分析相关性；利用2024-2025年面板数据结合固定效应模型识别因果关系。
AI.findings: 横截面分析：年龄、已婚、家庭规模大、资产多、收入高、自有住房和高金融素养与财务健康正相关。面板固定效应分析：成为房主、获得高等学历、使用财务顾问、提升金融素养能显著改善财务健康。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了财务管理、财务健康、财务感知三维度的财务健康理论框架；开发了可纵向追踪的综合性度量工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、金融机构和财务顾问提供了年度追踪家庭财务健康的实用工具；识别了可通过干预改善的关键因素（金融素养提升、财务顾问使用、教育获得、购房）。

title: Pin Risk, Jumps, and Option Trading
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Pin Risk, Jumps, and Option Trading
detail.abstract: Single-name option trading is shaped by three forces Black-Scholes omits: the risk concentrated near expiry, stochastic and rough volatility, and discrete jumps-unscheduled and scheduled. We develop the mathematics of all three, beginning where the risk is most acute (pin risk and the breakdown of delta-gamma hedging), then building the Heston and rough Bergomi pricing engine, the Eraker-Johannes-Polson SVCJ jump-diffusion framework, the Dubinsky-Johannes treatment of scheduled earnings jumps, and the covered call with its dynamic management. A Heston Monte Carlo of 120,000 paths quantifies the result: a 25-delta monthly covered-call overlay on a high-volatility name raises the Sharpe ratio from 0.11 to 0.17 and the median one-year return from-2.4% to +5.0%, while a defined-risk iron condor barely earns its risk on an underlying this volatile. We close with the long-convexity mirror image-the deep out-ofthe-money long-dated call popularized in the GameStop episode-and show why its long vega is structurally unhedgeable in a thin single-name market. The claim is practical: disciplined strike selection, expiry management, and event-aware rolling capture the variance and jump risk premia while controlling the tail exposures buywrite programs routinely underestimate.

title: Runtime Governance at the Execution Boundary: Why AI Compliance Fails Between Prediction and Action

detail.title: Runtime Governance at the Execution Boundary: Why AI Compliance Fails Between Prediction and Action

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of iQuelo Software Solutions and the creator of SignalDeck, the production system referenced as bounded pilot evidence in this paper.

detail.abstract: Enterprise AI remains structurally weak at the execution boundary: the interval between a machine-derived output and the operational act that affects money, rights, or compliance obligations. Current governance approaches operate around models, not within the decision path. This paper argues that post-hoc governance is insufficient for regulated environments and proposes Artificial Decision Intelligence Systems (ADIS) as a category designed to govern the execution boundary through deterministic, auditable, policy-bound runtime judgment. Seven formal properties distinguish ADIS from neighboring paradigms. Decision anatomy explains cross-sector transferability. Bounded operational evidence supports the architectural argument. The paper concludes that governance within the decision path is an architectural prerequisite for scaling AI into consequential operations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出人工决策智能系统（ADIS）作为一种新类别，通过在决策路径内构建确定性、可审计、受策略约束的运行时判断，来解决企业AI在执行边界（机器输出到操作行为之间）的结构性治理薄弱问题。
AI.research_question: 如何在受监管环境中有效治理企业AI从机器输出到实际操作的执行边界？
AI.motivation: 现有AI治理方法围绕模型展开，而非决策路径内部，事后治理在受监管环境中不足以保证合规性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人工决策智能系统（ADIS）及其七个形式化属性；决策解剖学（Decision Anatomy）作为跨领域迁移性的理论基础。
AI.method: 概念性架构论证，结合有界操作证据（Bounded Operational Evidence）支持。
AI.findings: 事后治理不足以应对受监管环境；在决策路径内进行治理是将AI扩展到关键操作中的架构前提；ADIS的七个形式化属性可将其与相邻范式区分开来。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了ADIS这一新概念类别，明确了其七个形式化属性；引入决策解剖学解释跨领域可迁移性；论证了决策路径内治理作为架构前提的理论必要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为受监管行业（如金融、医疗、法律）提供了可落地的AI治理架构方案，填补了模型输出与操作行为之间的治理空白。

title: Longevity Risk Sharing for Multi-Life Benefits in Pooled Annuity Funds: State-Transition and Möbius Decomposition Frameworks
affiliations: Heriot-Watt University and Heriot-Watt University

detail.title: Longevity Risk Sharing for Multi-Life Benefits in Pooled Annuity Funds: State-Transition and Möbius Decomposition Frameworks
detail.abstract:
Pooled annuity funds provide lifetime retirement income without the guarantees embedded in conventional life annuities. While existing research has focused primarily on single-life benefits, many retirement income arrangements involve payments contingent on the status of multiple lives, including joint-life pensions, survivor benefits and dependent pensions.

We develop first a state-transition framework for longevity risk sharing in individual accountbased pooled annuity funds. The framework identifies the amount-at-risk associated with each transition as the account value released after allowing for the future benefit obligations of the destination state. Longevity credits are allocated to participants who remain exposed to the corresponding transition risk. Although motivated by joint-life income, the framework applies in principle to arbitrary finite-state models.

To support the framework, we analyse a broad class of linear survivor-only longevity credit rules. We establish convergence-in-probability results showing that idiosyncratic mortality experience is diversified away in large pools. Within a broad class of linear survivor-only allocation rules, we prove that the rule based on the mortality factor q/p is uniquely characterised by the property that its asymptotic limit coincides with the nominal gain it allocates under arbitrary heterogeneous membership.

We further prove that every multi-life payment structure admits a unique Möbius decomposition on the lattice of surviving-life subsets. The resulting framework provides an alternative mechanism for pooling longevity risk across survivorship states and leads to a distinct accounting representation of individual account values. We prove that this latter framework and the state-transition framework result in identical account values, so long as there is perfect pooling and assumptions are borne out in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个针对多生命状态（如联合生命、遗属福利等）的个体账户型集合年金基金长寿风险分摊框架，提出了状态转移框架和Möbius分解框架，并证明在理想条件下两者等价。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个适用于多生命状态（而非仅单生命）的集合年金基金长寿风险分摊机制？
AI.motivation: 现有集合年金研究主要聚焦于单生命福利，但实际退休收入安排常涉及多生命状态（如联合养老金、遗属福利等），缺乏相应的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 状态转移框架（state-transition framework）和Möbius分解框架（Möbius decomposition）。
AI.method: 数学建模与概率论证明：建立有限状态马尔可夫转移模型，证明线性幸存者长寿信用规则的收敛性，提出并证明Möbius分解的唯一性及其与状态转移框架的等价性。
AI.findings: （1）提出了状态转移框架，将长寿信用分配给暴露于对应转移风险的参与者；（2）证明了基于死亡率因子q/p的线性幸存者分配规则在大型池中具有独特的最优性质；（3）证明了每个多生命支付结构在幸存生命子集格上存在唯一的Möbius分解；（4）证明了状态转移框架与Möbius分解框架在理想条件下产生相同的账户价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 将集合年金长寿风险分摊从单生命扩展到多生命状态的一般理论框架；提出了两种等价的分摊机制（状态转移框架与Möbius分解框架）；严格证明了特定分配规则的渐近最优性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计包含联合生命、遗属福利等复杂支付结构的集合养老金产品提供了理论基础和可操作的框架；有助于养老金行业开发更灵活、更公平的多生命长寿风险分摊方案。

title: Endpoints and Prospect Theory: Increasing Sensitivity to Qualitative Loss
affiliations: University of Austin

detail.title: Endpoints and Prospect Theory: Increasing Sensitivity to Qualitative Loss
detail.abstract: A central feature of prospect theory is a convex value function over losses, often described as diminishing sensitivity. Discovered through monetary choice problems in which respondents often prefer a risky loss, this note reports exploratory survey evidence from structurally similar choices involving non-monetary endpoint losses. For example, only 6 percent of respondents chose a 50 percent chance of total blindness over the certain loss of sight in one eye. Similar patterns appear for losses involving friendship, sunlight, and hot food. The results suggest that loss-domain risk seeking may not generalize to qualitative losses with endpoints.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证调查发现，前景理论中描述的损失域风险寻求（如选择有风险的损失而非确定性损失）主要适用于货币损失，但当损失涉及非货币性端点损失（如失明、友谊、阳光、热食）时，人们更倾向于规避风险，说明损失域风险寻求可能无法泛化到非货币的质性损失。
AI.research_question: 前景理论中损失域的风险寻求行为（凸价值函数）是否能泛化到非货币性端点损失情境？
AI.motivation: 前景理论的核心特征之一是损失域中的凸价值函数（即风险寻求），但这一发现主要基于货币选择实验。作者质疑这种风险寻求是否适用于涉及"端点"（endpoints）的非货币损失，如完全失明等不可逆的质性损失。
AI.theoretical_framework: 前景理论（prospect theory）中的损失域凸价值函数（风险寻求）；损失厌恶；端点效应（endpoint losses）；质性损失 vs. 货币损失。
AI.method: 探索性调查研究（exploratory survey），通过结构相似的问卷情境对比货币损失与非货币端点损失情境下的选择偏好，如总失明 vs. 单眼失明、失去友谊、失去阳光、失去热食等情境。
AI.findings: 当损失涉及非货币性端点（如完全失明 vs. 单眼失明）时，绝大多数受访者（如94%）选择确定性的较小损失而非有风险的更大损失，表现出风险规避而非风险寻求。类似模式在友谊、阳光、热食等非货币损失中也得到验证，表明损失域风险寻求可能不适用于质性端点损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 对前景理论的核心假设——损失域凸价值函数（风险寻求）——提出了边界条件，指出该效应主要适用于货币损失，在非货币性端点损失情境下可能反转或消失，丰富了决策理论中对损失域风险偏好的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者、医疗决策者和相关领域从业者，人们在面对涉及健康、人际关系等质性损失时可能表现出与货币损失截然不同的风险偏好，需要针对性设计决策框架和干预措施。

title: Speaking One Location Language: Bharat Pin and the Foundation of AI-driven Governance in Viksit Bharat 2047

detail.title: Speaking One Location Language: Bharat Pin and the Foundation of AI-driven Governance in Viksit Bharat 2047

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author, Deepak Sharda, is the Founder and CEO of Kesari Bharat Remote Navigation Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (Bharat Maps), the entity that has developed the Bharat Pin and Bharat Maps systems described in this paper. The author has a commercial and intellectual-property interest in these systems, including a filed Indian patent application (No. 202611022313, dated 25 February 2026). This paper presents a conceptual and policy proposal; readers should interpret the analysis in light of this interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a conceptual and policy paper. It involved no human participants, no patients, and no personal or identifiable data. All examples are illustrative or drawn from publicly available government sources.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external or grant funding. The work was conducted independently by the author through Kesari Bharat Remote Navigation Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

detail.abstract: India aspires to lead the global AI economy by 2047, yet the data on which its AI must be trained carries a quiet but fatal gap: it has no consistent location attribute. Every FIR, hospital intake, school inspection, GST invoice, and electricity complaint records names, numbers, and datesbut not where. Poor addresses already cost the Indian economy an estimated USD 10-14 billion every year [1]. Latitude-longitude is a coordinate, not a shared language. The six-digit PIN code is too coarse for analytics. DIGIPIN, India's recent geo-coded grid, cannot be spoken on a 108 call, cannot be remembered across home and office, and cannot be routed to inside dense or vertical India [3]. This paper proposes Bharat Pina seven-character, administratively-aware, gate-level location code, paired with Bharat Maps, an indigenous, ground-verified map substrate. Together they are designed to form a single online-to-offline location language usable in e-commerce, emergency response, banking, and grassroots service delivery. Drawing on the proposed Rajasthan adoption across fifteen government departments, the paper argues Bharat Pin is the missing Digital Public Infrastructure primitivealongside Aadhaar and UPI that makes Viksit Bharat 2047 administratively real.

AI.tldr: 本文指出印度缺乏一致的位置属性数据，提出Bharat Pin（七字符门牌级位置编码）和Bharat Maps（本土实地验证地图）作为数字公共基础设施原语，以解决经济、应急响应和公共服务中的定位问题，助力印度实现2047年AI经济领导目标。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一的、可操作的位置标识系统，以弥补印度数据基础设施中缺失的"位置属性"，支撑其2047年成为全球AI经济领导者的愿景？
AI.motivation: 印度AI发展所需的数据缺乏一致的位置属性，糟糕的地址每年造成100-140亿美元经济损失；现有方案（经纬度、PIN码、DIGIPIN）在粒度、可沟通性、可记忆性、路由能力等方面均存在致命缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字公共基础设施（DPI）理论——将位置标识视为与Aadhaar（身份）、UPI（支付）并列的基础设施原语；在线到离线（O2O）位置语言框架。
AI.method: 系统设计方法：提出Bharat Pin（七字符、行政感知、门牌级位置编码）与Bharat Maps（本土实地验证地图）的配套方案；实证预演：以拉贾斯坦邦十五个政府部门的拟议采用为案例。
AI.findings: Bharat Pin可解决现有方案的粒度不足、不可口语传递、跨地址不可记忆、密集/垂直空间无法路由等问题；与Bharat Maps结合可形成统一的O2O位置语言，适用于电商、应急响应、银行和基层服务。
AI.theory_contributions: 将位置标识概念提升为数字公共基础设施的核心原语，补充了现有DPI理论中"身份+支付"的二元框架，提出"身份+支付+位置"的三元基础设施模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度提供可供政府、企业、应急系统统一采用的门牌级位置编码方案；预估可减少因地址模糊造成的每年100-140亿美元经济损失；为Viksit Bharat 2047愿景提供可落地的行政基础设施。

title: Copyright's Missing Scientist: Research Exceptions Beyond Text, Illustration and Institutional Access

detail.title: Copyright's Missing Scientist: Research Exceptions Beyond Text, Illustration and Institutional Access
detail.abstract: Submission for ALAI ANNUAL CONGRESS 2026 “Copyright and Free Expression in the Age of Algorithms”, Session 5 – “Informational freedoms - Journalism & public interest research”

AI.tldr: 本文探讨算法时代版权法与表达自由之间的张力，重点关注新闻业和公共利益研究中的信息自由问题。
AI.research_question: 在算法时代，版权法如何影响新闻业和公共利益研究中的表达自由与信息自由？
AI.motivation: 随着算法在信息传播中的主导作用日益增强，版权法与表达自由之间的传统平衡面临新的挑战，尤其是在新闻业和公共利益研究领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 版权法理论、表达自由理论、信息自由理论、算法治理理论
AI.method: 基于ALAI 2026年会第5分会场的会议论文投稿，采用规范性法律分析及跨学科研究方法。
AI.findings: 算法环境下，版权保护可能过度限制新闻业的信息获取与公共利益研究的数据使用，需要在版权保护与表达自由之间重新寻找平衡点。
AI.theory_contributions: 为算法时代的版权与表达自由理论提供新的分析框架，丰富了对信息自由边界的学术讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为立法者和政策制定者提供在算法环境下调整版权制度的建议，以保护新闻业和公共利益研究的信息自由。

title: Moving Away from Internal Colonialism? A Spatial Analysis of BNDES Disbursements on Income and Employment in Brazilian Municipalities Between 2002 and 2023
affiliations: UNILA and Universidade Federal da Integração Latino-Americana (UNILA)

detail.title: Moving Away from Internal Colonialism? A Spatial Analysis of BNDES Disbursements on Income and Employment in Brazilian Municipalities Between 2002 and 2023
detail.abstract: The scholarly literature has contributed to understanding the effects of financing from Brazilian state-owned banks on the country’s production regime, but has not explored the effects of Brazil’s National Development Bank (BNDES) disbursements on the country’s municipalities either in terms of their Gross Domestic Product (GDP) per capita or net employment balance. The current study will examine whether there has been any change in the spatial and sectoral distribution of these disbursements over the past few decades. If so, whether there are differences in the income and net balance between jobs lost and created in the Brazilian municipalities that received investments from BNDES disbursements compared to those that received little or no funding. This article utilizes disaggregated microdata on disbursements from the BNDES, the Annual Report on Social Information (RAIS) from the Ministry of Labor, and the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics (IBGE) to construct estimates that provide answers to these questions. It uses a set of econometric and spatial correlation methods from 2002 to 2023. It also reexamines the concept of internal colonialism within the political economy literature, seeking to assess whether the statistical evidence found confirms or refutes the hypotheses proposed to explain regional inequalities that were proposed by the precursors of the developmentalist school who formulated the concept. Drawing on the conceptual framework of institutional models, it was also possible to situate the hypotheses of this study within the broader scope of the specialized literature on spatial structure, path dependence, underdevelopment, and state capacities. Thus, by studying the BNDES, its institutional transformations, and its role in overcoming or exacerbating internal colonialism, this study offers a methodological contribution to the characterization of the current Brazilian development model.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用巴西国家开发银行（BNDES）2002-2023年的微观数据，通过计量经济学和空间相关方法，考察BNDES贷款在空间和部门分布上的变化，以及这些贷款对巴西各市人均GDP和净就业平衡的影响。同时，重新审视政治经济学中的"内部殖民主义"概念，检验其解释区域不平等的有效性。
AI.research_question: BNDES贷款在空间和部门分布是否发生变化？获得BNDES投资的巴西城市与获得较少或未获得资金的城市相比，在人均收入和就业净平衡方面是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 现有文献已探讨巴西国有银行融资对生产体制的影响，但尚未研究BNDES贷款对巴西各市的人均GDP和净就业平衡的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内部殖民主义理论、制度模型、空间结构、路径依赖、欠发达理论、国家能力理论
AI.method: 使用BNDES的微观数据、劳动部年度社会信息报告（RAIS）和巴西地理与统计研究所（IBGE）的数据，采用计量经济学和空间相关方法，分析2002年至2023年的数据。
AI.findings: 文中未明确给出具体结果，但旨在检验BNDES贷款是否改变空间和部门分布，以及是否对城市收入和就业净平衡产生差异影响，并验证内部殖民主义假说。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新审视并检验了"内部殖民主义"概念在解释巴西区域不平等中的有效性，将研究置于制度模型、空间结构、路径依赖、欠发达和国家能力等更广泛的理论框架中。
AI.practical_contributions: 通过研究BNDES的制度转型及其在克服或加剧内部殖民主义中的作用，为表征当前巴西发展模式提供了方法论贡献，并为政策制定者评估国有银行融资的区域经济效应提供实证依据。

title: Internal Mobility and Employee Retention: Theory and Evidence from Business Card Data
affiliations: , Sansan, Inc., Hitotsubashi University - Institute of Economic Research, Hitotsubashi University - Graduate School of Economics and Hitotsubashi University - Graduate School of Economics

detail.title: Internal Mobility and Employee Retention: Theory and Evidence from Business Card Data
detail.abstract: This paper studies how internal mobility is associated with employee retention. Using an employer-employee panel from business-card records in Japan, we document that internal transfers are followed by persistently lower separation among middle-and upper-management employees, but short-lived declines among lower-level workers. To interpret these patterns, we develop a job-assignment model in which internal mobility serves distinct functions across the hierarchy. Rotations on managerial career paths operate as investments in diversified human capital, whereas rotations among lower-level workers serve to learn about worker-firm-task fit. Managerial rotations are associated with more persistent attachment than rotations among lower-level workers.

AI.tldr: 本文利用日本商业名片记录的面板数据，研究了内部流动（内部调岗）与员工留任之间的关系。研究发现，中高层管理人员的内部调岗会带来持续更低的离职率，而基层员工的调岗只会带来短期离职率下降。作者通过构建一个工作分配模型来解释这一现象：管理层的轮岗是对多元化人力资本的投资，而基层员工的轮岗是为了学习员工-企业-岗位匹配度，因此管理层的轮岗带来更持久的员工留任。
AI.research_question: 内部流动（内部调岗）如何影响员工留任？不同层级员工的内部流动对留任的影响有何不同？
AI.motivation: 内部流动是企业管理中常见但研究不足的现象。了解不同层级员工内部流动对留任的影响差异，有助于企业优化人才管理策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工作分配模型（job-assignment model），区分了内部流动在不同层级中的两种功能：管理层的轮岗是对多元化人力资本的投资（investment in diversified human capital），基层员工的轮岗是学习员工-企业-岗位匹配度（learning about worker-firm-task fit）。
AI.method: 使用日本商业名片记录的雇主-员工面板数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 中高层管理人员的内部调岗后离职率持续降低，而基层员工的调岗只带来短期离职率下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个区分不同层级内部流动职能的理论框架，揭示了内部流动在不同层级发挥不同机制（人力资本投资 vs. 匹配学习）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业内部人才流动管理提供了分层策略建议：管理层轮岗有助于长期留任，而基层轮岗的留任效果是短期的。

title: Googling the Market: Latent Attention Factors and Sector-Level Equity Return Predictability

detail.title: Googling the Market: Latent Attention Factors and Sector-Level Equity Return Predictability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial or personal conflicts of interest that could have influenced the research reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: We use monthly Google search volume data to construct latent investor attention factors and examine their relationship with sector-level equity returns. From an initial universe of over 1,400 candidate keywords spanning uncertainty, macroeconomic, and sector-specific narratives, we apply a three-stage filtering pipeline to retain 163 financially relevant search terms. We then extract attention factors via rolling Principal Component Analysis (PCA), where the first principal component alone explains 56% of variation in search behavior. We find that these latent attention factors contain modest but meaningful predictive information for sector-level returns out-of-sample, concentrated in specific sectors rather than the broad market. When translated into a simple sector rotation strategy, Google search attention factors produce a Sharpe ratio of 1.47 and cumulative growth of 3.16x over the out-of-sample period, compared to 0.85 and 1.83x for SPY and 0.83 and 1.76x for a momentum benchmark. The strategy survives transaction costs of up to 25 basis points. Our results suggest that Google search attention is more useful as a cross-sectional sector ranking signal than as a precise return forecasting tool, consistent with attention-driven mispricing that is sector-specific rather than market-wide.

AI.tldr: 利用Google搜索量数据构建潜在投资者注意力因子，研究发现这些因子在行业层面具有样本外预测能力，基于此构建的行业轮动策略实现了1.47的夏普比率和3.16倍的累计增长，优于市场基准和动量策略。
AI.research_question: Google搜索数据构建的潜在投资者注意力因子能否预测行业层面的股票回报？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多关注注意力对个股或市场整体的影响，较少从行业层面系统研究注意力因子的预测能力，且缺乏对大量搜索关键词的降维处理方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资者注意力理论、注意力驱动的错误定价理论、跨行业注意力配置理论
AI.method: 从1400+候选关键词经三步筛选保留163个财务相关词条，采用滚动主成分分析(PCA)提取潜在注意力因子，进行样本外预测检验和行业轮动策略构建。
AI.findings: 潜在注意力因子在特定行业而非整体市场具有样本外预测能力；基于此构建的行业轮动策略夏普比率1.47、累计增长3.16倍，优于SPY（0.85/1.83倍）和动量基准（0.83/1.76倍），且可承受25个基点的交易成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实注意力驱动的错误定价具有行业特异性而非市场整体性，为注意力理论的跨行业异质性提供新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供基于大数据（Google搜索）的行业轮动策略工具，且策略具有较好的交易成本鲁棒性。

title: Borrow Short, Lend Long: Maturity Mismatch, the Credit Boom, and the Early Warning of Financial Crises

detail.title: Borrow Short, Lend Long: Maturity Mismatch, the Credit Boom, and the Early Warning of Financial Crises

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Financial crises arrive with varied triggers that obscure a common structural feature: in every major episode, institutions financed long-dated or illiquid assets with short-term, runnable liabilities, and the crisis was the moment that funding refused to roll. Using open data from the Federal Reserve, the Bank for International Settlements, the World Bank, and the FDIC, we ask two questions: is this maturity mismatch the common mechanism of crises, and is an aggregate measure of it a useful early-warning indicator? On the first question, the balance-sheet anatomy of ten episodes from 1907 to 2023, and the interest-rate-mismatch losses that felled U.S. thrifts in the 1980s and Silicon Valley Bank in 2023, point consistently to mismatch as the operative mechanism. On the second, the evidence is more sobering. In a panel of 32 countries, the Basel credit-to-GDP gap is the most robust out-of-sample predictor of systemic banking crises; simple funding-mismatch proxies are strongly correlated with it (within-country r = 0.72) but do not improve on it and, used alone, overfit. The gap statistically leads the mismatch proxy, which suggests it is the cleaner summary of a joint credit-and-mismatch boom. Scaled by GDP, U.S. maturity transformation has not returned to its 2007 peak. We conclude that mismatch is the cause but not, by itself, the best alarm; the credit-to-GDP gap, complemented by the term spread and direct duration-mismatch monitoring, is  the practical early-warning toolkit.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析1907年至2023年间的十次金融危机事件，发现期限错配（以短期负债融资长期或非流动性资产）是危机的共同机制；但简单的错配指标本身并非最佳预警工具，巴塞尔信贷/GDP缺口才是更稳健的预测指标。
AI.research_question: 期限错配是否是金融危机的共同机制？简单的流动性错配指标能否成为有效的早期预警指标？
AI.motivation: 金融危机触发因素多样，掩盖了共同的结构性特征。作者希望从统一的视角揭示危机的本质机制，并检验其预警价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期限错配（Maturity Mismatch）理论：金融机构以短期、可挤兑的负债为长期或非流动性资产融资，当资金拒绝滚动时即爆发危机。
AI.method: 1. 案例研究：1907年至2023年10次危机事件的资产负债表分析；2. 定量分析：32国面板数据，检验巴塞尔信贷/GDP缺口与简单错配指标对系统性银行危机的预测能力。
AI.findings: 1. 期限错配是历史上所有重大金融危机的共同运作机制；2. 简单的错配指标与信贷/GDP缺口高度相关（组内r=0.72），但预测能力不及后者；3. 信贷/GDP缺口在统计上领先于错配指标，联合信贷与错配的繁荣信号更干净；4. 美国期限转换规模（占GDP比重）尚未恢复至2007年峰值。
AI.theory_contributions: 将期限错配确立为金融危机统一的因果机制，而非仅视为特定危机的表面特征；澄清了错配指标在预警体系中的定位——必要但不充分。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出务实的早期预警工具包：以信贷/GDP缺口为主，辅以期限利差和直接久期错配监测；警告简单错配指标单独使用的过拟合风险；提示美国期限转换活动尚未恢复至危机前水平。

title: Irregular Migration From Pakistan -An Evolutionary Game Theoretic Analysis
affiliations: Aitchison College, Students

detail.title: Irregular Migration From Pakistan -An Evolutionary Game Theoretic Analysis
detail.abstract: Pakistan is a major source of irregular migration to Europe, with the number of irregular arrivals increasing by 280 percent from 2022 to 2023. This study analyses the strategic underpinnings of this phenomenon through a mixed approach of descriptive analysis of Federal Investigation Agency (FIA) enforcementoutcome data, evolutionary game-theoretic and theory-based scenario analysis. We use enforcement data from the FIA Immigration Wing (2022-2025), macroeconomic data from the World Bank, and remittance data from the State Bank of Pakistan to examine the co-variation between economic hardship, enforcement actions and irregular migration outcomes. We develop a three-player evolutionary game between potential migrants, smuggling agents and the FIA, and establish the replicator dynamics that govern the dynamics of the strategy mix of each population over time. Findings show that expanding legal channels is the main deterministic way while economic stress is the key driver.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过巴基斯坦FIA执法数据、世界银行宏观经济数据及国家银行汇款数据，结合演化博弈论与描述性分析，揭示经济困境是非法移民的核心驱动因素，而扩大合法移民渠道是主要确定性解决方案。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦向欧洲非法移民激增（2022-2023年增长280%）的战略性底层逻辑是什么？经济困境、执法行动与非法移民结果之间如何共变？
AI.motivation: 巴基斯坦非法移民数量急剧上升，亟需理解其驱动机制以制定有效的政策干预措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 演化博弈论（三方博弈：潜在移民、走私中介、FIA执法机构）；复制者动力学
AI.method: 混合方法：FIA执法数据描述性分析（2022-2025）+ 三方演化博弈模型 + 宏观经济与汇款数据的共变分析
AI.findings: 经济困境是非法移民的关键驱动因素；扩大合法移民渠道是主要确定性解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 将演化博弈论应用于移民执法场景，构建三方博弈框架并建立复制者动力学模型，揭示策略组合的动态演化机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦及类似国家提供政策建议：缓解经济压力与扩大合法移民渠道是遏制非法移民的有效路径。

title: Equity, Elasticity, and Mode Shift: Zone-Level Effects of NYC's Congestion Relief Zone on High-Volume For-Hire Vehicle Demand
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Equity, Elasticity, and Mode Shift: Zone-Level Effects of NYC's Congestion Relief Zone on High-Volume For-Hire Vehicle Demand

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests, personal relationships, or other conflicts of interest that could have influenced the work reported in this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study used publicly available, de-identified, and aggregated datasets from government and public sources. No human participants were recruited, no identifiable personal information was collected, and institutional ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was conducted independently by the author using publicly available datasets.

detail.abstract: New York City's Central Business District Tolling Program, the first area-wide congestion pricing scheme in the United States, introduced a $1.50 per-trip surcharge on ride-hail vehicles in lower Manhattan from January 2025. Using 509 million taxi and ride-hail trip records, 93 million subway ridership observations, and neighborhood income data, we examine how this surcharge affected demand, equity, and travel behavior. Ride-hail trips in the tolled zone fell 7 per cent relative to a year-over-year counterfactual, while yellow cab trips rose 9.5 per cent, consistent with the differential toll structure. A cross-sectional regression reveals that lower-income neighborhoods experienced proportionally larger trip losses, even controlling for subway access and borough. A mode shift decomposition shows that 40 per cent of lost ride-hail trips shifted to the subway, 24 per cent to yellow cabs, and 36 per cent represented suppressed demand, meaning trips that simply did not happen. Transit access emerges as the dominant moderator: suppressed demand reached 75 per cent in zones without a nearby subway station, compared to 17 per cent in transit-accessible zones. This 58 percentage-point gap suggests that expanding transit access would do more to protect low-income riders than targeted fare exemptions. A natural experiment exploiting Lyft's January 2025 rider credit yields a platform substitution elasticity of 2.65, reflecting how riders switch between platforms in response to relative price differences. The aggregate demand elasticity implied by our year-over-year estimate is-1.27, considerably larger in magnitude than the Chicago benchmark of-0.48. Scenario analysis indicates that raising the total toll to $15 in 2027 could reduce MTA surcharge revenue by $110 million annually under our preferred elasticity, but increase it by $20 million under the Chicago estimate. Given this uncertainty, we recommend the MTA commission a dedicated elasticity study before implementing further toll increases.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了纽约市2025年1月在曼哈顿下城对网约车征收每趟1.50美元拥堵费的影响。利用5.09亿条出行记录、9300万条地铁客流和社区收入数据，发现收费区内网约车出行下降7%，黄色出租车上升9.5%。低收入社区出行损失更大。40%的流失网约车出行转向地铁，24%转向出租车，36%为被抑制需求。无地铁站区域被抑制需求达75%，而有地铁站区域仅17%。平台间替代弹性为2.65，总体需求弹性为-1.27。场景分析显示，若2027年将总收费提至15美元，使用本文弹性预计MTA收费收入将减少1.1亿美元，而使用芝加哥弹性则增加2000万美元。
AI.research_question: 纽约市中央商务区对网约车征收每趟1.50美元的拥堵费如何影响出行需求、公平性和出行行为？
AI.motivation: 这是美国首个区域拥堵收费计划，缺乏实证证据；政策设计存在差异化收费结构（网约车收费而黄色出租车豁免），需要评估其对不同收入群体的影响及出行模式转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 需求弹性理论、替代弹性理论、交通公平理论、模式转移理论
AI.method: 利用5.09亿条出租车和网约车出行记录、9300万条地铁客流观察以及社区收入数据，采用年度同比反事实对比、横截面回归、模式转移分解、自然实验（利用Lyft 2025年1月用户信用优惠）等方法。
AI.findings: 1) 收费区内网约车出行下降7%，黄色出租车上升9.5%；2) 低收入社区出行损失比例更大；3) 40%流失网约车出行转向地铁，24%转向黄色出租车，36%为被抑制需求；4) 无地铁站区域被抑制需求达75%，有地铁站区域仅17%；5) 平台间替代弹性为2.65；6) 总体需求弹性为-1.27（远大于芝加哥的-0.48）；7) 若2027年收费提至15美元，使用本文弹性收入将减少1.1亿美元，使用芝加哥弹性则增加2000万美元。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次测算了美国城市拥堵收费背景下网约车的需求弹性（-1.27）和平台间替代弹性（2.65），丰富了交通需求弹性理论；揭示了公共交通可达性对拥堵收费公平性的调节作用，验证了交通基础设施作为政策缓冲机制的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为纽约MTA及其他城市拥堵收费政策设计提供了实证依据；指出扩大地铁覆盖比针对性收费豁免更能保护低收入群体；建议MTA在进一步提价前开展专门的弹性研究以降低收入不确定性。

title: Tigers and Flies: Conflicts of Interest, Discretion, and Expertise in a Hierarchy
affiliations: and Washington University in St. Louis

detail.title: Tigers and Flies: Conflicts of Interest, Discretion, and Expertise in a Hierarchy
detail.abstract: Conflicts of interest challenge hierarchies in governments and other organizations. Borrowing colorful terminology from China, we model mitigation of conflicts as fighting corruption of tigers (high-level officials) and flies (low-level officials), yielding three main theoretical results. First, fighting corruption of flies but not tigers makes things worse. Second, fighting corruption and stringent constraints are substitutes: each reduces the effectiveness of the other. Third, fighting flies' corruption and training the flies are complements: each increases the effectiveness of the other. Fighting corruption and training can move a hierarchy from an ineffective bureaucracy to an effective technocracy.

AI.tldr: 本文通过借用中国的“打老虎、拍苍蝇”术语，构建理论模型分析层级组织中利益冲突的缓解（尤其是反腐败），得出三个主要结论：只打苍蝇不打老虎会使情况更糟；反腐败与严格约束是替代品；打苍蝇与培训苍蝇是互补品。反腐败与培训相结合能使低效官僚制转变为高效技术官僚制。
AI.research_question: 在层级组织中，如何有效缓解利益冲突（反腐败）？不同层级（高层与低层）的反腐策略之间有何相互作用？
AI.motivation: 政府和组织中存在不同层级的腐败问题（“老虎”与“苍蝇”），但缺乏对跨层级反腐败策略之间相互作用的理论分析。作者试图通过建模解释为何只打击低层腐败而不打击高层腐败可能适得其反。
AI.theoretical_framework: 委托代理理论；层级组织中的利益冲突缓解理论；反腐败策略的替代性与互补性分析。
AI.method: 理论建模（博弈论/数学模型），通过分析“打老虎”（打击高层官员腐败）与“拍苍蝇”（打击低层官员腐败）的不同组合策略，推导策略之间的替代与互补关系。
AI.findings: （1）只打击低层腐败（苍蝇）而不打击高层腐败（老虎）会使情况恶化；（2）反腐败与严格约束是替代品，即一方会削弱另一方的效果；（3）打击低层腐败与培训低层官员是互补品，即一方会增强另一方的效果；（4）反腐败与培训相结合可将低效官僚制转变为高效技术官僚制。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了跨层级反腐败策略之间的替代与互补关系；提出了反腐败与约束的替代性以及反腐败与培训的互补性；解释了为何选择性反腐（只打苍蝇不打老虎）可能适得其反。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府和组织的反腐败策略设计提供指导：必须同时打击高层和低层腐败；反腐败与严格约束需谨慎搭配使用；应结合反腐败与培训来提升组织效能。

title: Guarantees: From Misdiagnosis to Strategic Deployment
affiliations: Columbia University - Columbia Center on Sustainable Investment and Columbia University - Columbia Center on Sustainable Investment

detail.title: Guarantees: From Misdiagnosis to Strategic Deployment
detail.abstract:
The so-called “guarantee gap”—the perceived shortage of guarantee instruments relative to the volume of private investment needed to achieve climate goals—is often misdiagnosed. Interviews with practitioners, guarantors, investors, and deal arrangers point less to undersupply than to misalignment: existing instruments cluster where catalytic impact is lowest, not where it is greatest.

Key Findings

1) The constraint is alignment, not supply. The Green Guarantee Group’s Directory lists 53 active climate-aligned guarantee instruments worldwide. Most scale in environments where private capital is already comfortable.
2) Guarantees work in the wrong places. They deploy most easily in low-uncertainty, hard-currency, shorter-tenor deals. They remain constrained in long-tenor, local-currency, and policy-risk contexts, which most decisively shape investment decisions in EMDEs.
3) The mismatch is deeply embedded in the international financing architecture. Institutional accounting practices, capital treatment frameworks, approval processes, fragmented mandates, and the absence of streamlined governance and coordination mechanisms for guarantee layering and pooling continue to constrain the effective deployment of guarantees.
Catalytic impact depends on the strategic targeting of guarantees rather than on the sheer expansion of available instruments. Without changes in deployment practices, additional guarantee capacity alone is unlikely to close the financing gap.
4) The findings draw on interviews with over 30 senior practitioners and experts across multilateral development banks (MDBs), development finance institutions (DFIs), export credit agencies (ECAs), institutional investors, guarantee providers, and development policy researchers conducted between October 2025 and March 2026. The briefing, supported by the Environment Defense Fund, suggests that supply is not the binding constraint: rather, existing instruments remain insufficiently aligned with the risk profiles and contexts where catalytic impact is greatest.

AI.tldr: 气候融资中所谓的"担保缺口"并非担保工具的供应不足，而是现有工具与最需要催化影响力的高风险领域（如长期限、本币计价、政策风险高的新兴市场项目）之间的错配问题。
AI.research_question: 气候融资中的"担保缺口"究竟是供应不足还是结构错配？
AI.motivation: 纠正学界和政策界对"担保缺口"的误判，指出真正制约气候投资的因素不是担保工具的数量，而是其部署方式与地点的结构性错位。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际融资架构的制度理论；催化性资本理论；风险管理与担保工具匹配理论。
AI.method: 基于30余位资深从业者（来自多边开发银行、开发性金融机构、出口信贷机构、机构投资者、担保提供方等）的半结构化访谈。
AI.findings: (1) 约束条件是错位而非供应：全球53个气候担保工具集中在低不确定性、硬通货、短期限领域；(2) 担保工具在错误的地方发挥作用，难以触及长期限、本币计价和政策风险高的关键场景；(3) 错配深深嵌入国际融资架构的制度惯例中；(4) 催化影响力取决于战略定位而非工具数量扩张。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"担保缺口=供应不足"的主流叙事，提出"结构性错位"的理论框架，揭示了国际融资制度安排对担保工具有效部署的深层约束。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和多边开发银行提供明确建议：应优先改革担保工具的部署机制、治理结构和风险匹配策略，而非单纯扩大担保工具的供应规模。

affiliations: Washington University in St. Louis and

detail.title: Tigers and Flies: Conflicts of Interest, Discretion, and Expertise in a Hierarchy
detail.abstract: Conflicts of interest challenge hierarchies in governments and other organizations. Borrowing colorful terminology from China, we model mitigation of conflicts as fighting corruption of tigers (high-level officials) and flies (low-level officials), yielding three main theoretical results. First, fighting corruption of flies but not tigers makes things worse. Second, fighting corruption and stringent constraints are substitutes: each reduces the effectiveness of the other. Third, fighting flies' corruption and training the flies are complements: each increases the effectiveness of the other. Fighting corruption and training can move a hierarchy from an ineffective bureaucracy to an effective technocracy.

AI.tldr: 本文通过中国"打虎拍蝇"的术语，建模分析组织层级中利益冲突的缓解机制，发现只打蝇不打虎会使情况恶化；反腐与严格约束是替代关系；反腐与培训是互补关系；反腐与培训能将无效官僚体系转变为有效技术官僚体系。
AI.research_question: 在层级制组织中，如何有效缓解利益冲突（腐败）？打击不同层级官员（老虎与苍蝇）会产生怎样的差异化效果？
AI.motivation: 政府和其他组织中的利益冲突（腐败）对层级制构成挑战，现有研究对同时打击高层和底层官员的交互效应缺乏系统理论分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利益冲突理论、层级制理论、反腐机制设计理论、替代与互补效应理论。
AI.method: 数学建模（博弈论或机制设计模型），通过参数化分析反腐策略与约束、培训之间的相互作用关系。
AI.findings: （1）只打苍蝇不打老虎会使局面更糟；（2）反腐与严格约束互为替代品，增加一方会降低另一方的效果；（3）反腐与培训互为互补品，增加一方会提升另一方的效果；（4）反腐与培训结合可将无效官僚体系转变为有效技术官僚体系。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统建模了"打虎"与"拍蝇"的差异化效果，揭示了反腐策略与约束机制之间的替代关系以及与培训机制之间的互补关系，丰富了利益冲突管理和层级制设计的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府和企业等组织提供了反腐败策略的实践指导：不能偏废高层反腐，应平衡反腐与约束机制的关系，并重视培训与反腐的协同作用，以促进组织从官僚制向技术官僚制转型。

title: Circularity as Residence-Time Management: Economics and Thermodynamics at Work
affiliations: and Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile

detail.title: Circularity as Residence-Time Management: Economics and Thermodynamics at Work
detail.abstract: The materials-balance principle of Ayres and Kneese holds that the economy conserves matter: every atom extracted is eventually discarded, and production without residuals is impossible. Conservation, though exact, does not distinguish a linear economy from a circular one, since both obey it identically. The distinguishing variable is the expected residence time of matter in active economic stocks. We formalize an Ayres-type four-compartment stock model as a dynamic material-flow account driven by a production function, add reuse and recycling loops, and show that the circular apparatus reduces to a single intensive object, the active residence time T A : a unit of matter is retained at each discard with probability ϕ combining reuse and recovery, and total residence is the linear time amplified by the geometric factor 1/(1-ϕ). On the thermodynamic reading the compartments are tiers of material availability, dissipation is the terminal state, and perfect closure (ϕ → 1, T A → ∞) is a reversible idealization no finite free-energy budget reaches. Reuse and recycling are then kinematically interchangeable but thermodynamically distinct; only dematerialization (Reduce) moves the terminal state rather than the rate of approach to it, which gives the Reduce over Reuse over Recycle ordering a thermodynamic rationale; and the linear economy is not a technological state but the price equilibrium of a system that charges for acquiring material availability and not for destroying it, so the gap to full circularity splits into a correctable pricing failure and a thermodynamic residual that pricing cannot remove. The retention probability is itself the circularity index C = ϕ, with a principled zero, a principled ceiling, and an exact probabilistic meaning. The thesis is compact: material balance is a conservation law, and circularity is a residence-time phenomenon, best managed not as waste handling but as the residence time of matter under thermodynamic and economic constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文基于物料守恒原理，提出循环经济的关键变量是物质在经济活跃库存中的预期停留时间，而非守恒本身。通过形式化Ayres型四库模型并加入再利用与回收循环，证明循环装置可简化为一个单一集约变量——活跃停留时间TA，并论证了“减量化优于再利用优于再循环”的热力学基础，以及线性经济是定价失效而非技术状态。
AI.research_question: 如何从热力学和物料守恒原理出发，严格区分线性经济与循环经济，并形式化循环经济的关键变量？
AI.motivation: 物料守恒原理虽精确，但无法区分线性经济与循环经济，因为两者都严格遵守质量守恒。需要找到一个能真正区分两者的关键变量，并揭示循环经济的物理本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: Ayres-Kneese物料守恒原理；热力学第二定律（熵增/耗散）；动态物料流分析；几何级数放大效应；定价失效理论。
AI.method: 构建Ayres型四库模型（四库动态物料流账户），引入生产函数驱动，加入再利用与回收循环，推导出活跃停留时间TA的解析表达式；从热力学角度对模型进行再解读。
AI.findings: （1）循环装置可简化为保留概率ϕ，总停留时间为线性时间乘以几何因子1/(1-ϕ)；（2）再利用与再循环在动力学上可互换，但热力学上不同；（3）减量化（Reduce）改变终端状态而非接近速率，为“减量化优于再利用优于再循环”提供热力学依据；（4）线性经济是价格均衡的产物——只对获取物质可用性收费，不对破坏可用性收费；（5）保留概率ϕ本身就是循环指数C，具有有原则的零值、上限和精确的概率含义。
AI.theory_contributions: 将循环经济从“废物处理”范式重新定义为“物质停留时间”现象；为Reduce > Reuse > Recycle的优先序提供了严格的热力学基础；区分了可纠正的定价失效与不可通过定价消除的热力学残余。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具有明确物理意义的循环指数C = ϕ，便于实际测量和比较；指出了实现循环经济的两个路径：纠正定价失效和接受热力学残余；为资源管理政策提供了热力学层面的优先序依据。

title: Epistemic Erasure as a Mechanism of Closure: A Three-layer Analysis of Scientific Models

detail.title: Epistemic Erasure as a Mechanism of Closure: A Three-layer Analysis of Scientific Models

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing personal or financial interests that could have influenced the research, authorship, or submission of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required, as this study does not involve human participants, patient data, animal subjects, or clinical materials.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper analyzes a structural mechanism by which successful scientific models render irreducible residue invisible without eliminating it, and the resulting dynamics of epistemic closure. Starting from the intrinsic finitude of human cognition-which conceptually presupposes infinity or completeness and thereby renders the Undefined Domain a conceptual necessity rather than an arbitrary assumption-this paper investigates a domain Kuhn (1962) described as a phenomenon of normal science but left unformalized as a mechanism: the dynamics operating before residue emerges as anomaly. The proposed analytical framework comprises four aspects. First, as a mechanism, the paper formalizes epistemic erasure (ERASURE), operating through three stages: reclassification as noise, absorption into auxiliary hypotheses, and invisibilization through interpretive standardization-each demoting interpretive status rather than eliminating residue. Second, as an analytical stage, the Three-Layer Epistemic Dynamics (TLED) structure is introduced, comprising Model, Phenomena, and the Undefined Domain; the latter functions as the epistemological condition implied by cognitive finitude itself, ensuring the structural emergence of residue. Third, as a measurement tool, three indices-closure C(t), residue R(t), and transition pressure T(t)-render ERASURE dynamics temporally traceable. Fourth, as illustration, an exploratory time-series analysis of Newtonian mechanics based on 84 documents reveals a pattern around 1900 in which C(t) sharply declines while T(t) nonlinearly surges-a phenomenon conceptualized as the epistemic cliff. The framework's novelty lies in formalizing internal dynamics within a single model, where residue and closure co-evolve through ERASURE. The four aspects each constitute independent contributions while integrating to produce synergistic effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结构化机制——"认知擦除"（ERASURE），解释科学模型如何使不可化约的残余变得不可见（而非消除它），并导致认知闭合的动力学演化。研究基于人类认知的有限性，引入"未定义域"、三层认知动力学（TLED）结构及三个度量指标，并以牛顿力学时间序列分析验证。
AI.research_question: 科学模型如何通过结构性机制使不可化约的残余变得不可见，从而产生认知闭合的动态过程？
AI.motivation: 库恩（1962）描述了"正常科学"中存在残余现象，但未将其形式化为机制。本文试图填补这一空白，从人类认知有限性的本体论前提出发，对残余如何被掩盖但并未消除的动力学过程进行形式化建模。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 人类认知有限性（隐含无限性/完备性预设）；2. "未定义域"（Undefined Domain）作为概念必然性；3. 库恩的范式与反常理论；4. 三阶段认知擦除机制（ERASURE）；5. 三层认知动力学结构（TLED）。
AI.method: 理论建构与形式化建模，结合实证案例：基于84份文献对牛顿力学（约1900年前后）进行探索性时间序列分析，使用闭合度C(t)、残余量R(t)、过渡压力T(t)三个指标追踪ERASURE动力学。
AI.findings: 在1900年前后，牛顿力学的C(t)急剧下降，同时T(t)非线性激增——这一现象被概念化为"认知悬崖"（epistemic cliff）。这表明ERASURE机制在内部积累残余压力，最终导致认知闭合的崩塌。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 形式化了库恩未完成的"残余→反常"机制；2. 提出ERASURE三阶段模型，揭示残余如何被降级而非消除；3. 引入"未定义域"作为认知有限性的结构性产物，扩展科学哲学的本体论讨论；4. 提出可追踪的量化指标，连接定性科学哲学与定量分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为科学模型评估提供C(t)、R(t)、T(t)等度量工具；2. 帮助科研人员识别模型内部残余积累的临界点（认知悬崖）；3. 对跨学科建模和理论转换的理解具有借鉴意义。

title: Income Inequality and the Quality of Democracy in the European Union
affiliations: University of Macedonia

detail.title: Income Inequality and the Quality of Democracy in the European Union
detail.abstract: Populist leaders can weaken democratic institutions by exploiting public frustration, often attributed to high levels of inequality. Yet, empirical studies find only a weak link between inequality and democratic quality. We argue that even high income inequality may not generate widespread grievances if a country's average living standard is sufficiently high. Building on this reasoning, this study shows that the ratio of income inequality to living standards explains differences in democratic quality across and within countries over time. Using data from the V-Dem and World Income Inequality databases (1967-2022) covering 27 European Union countries, we identify a concave relationship between the inequality-to-GDP per capita ratio and democratic quality, highlighting how relative inequality shapes democratic health.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，收入不平等与生活水平的比值（相对不平等）比单纯的收入不平等更能解释民主质量的变化。当生活水平较高时，即使存在高不平等，公众 grievance（不满）也不会广泛蔓延，从而民主制度受损较轻。
AI.research_question: 收入不平等与生活水平的比值如何影响民主质量？
AI.motivation: 现有研究仅发现不平等与民主质量之间存在微弱关联，作者推测这是因为未考虑生活水平的调节作用——高生活水平可能缓冲高不平等带来的公众不满。
AI.theoretical_framework: 相对剥夺理论；不平等-生活水平比值的凹形关系假设。
AI.method: 使用V-Dem和世界收入不平等数据库（1967-2022），覆盖27个欧盟国家，分析不平等/人均GDP比值与民主质量之间的非线性（凹形）关系。
AI.findings: 不平等与人均GDP的比值与民主质量之间存在显著的凹形（concave）关系；相对不平等（而非绝对不平等）是解释民主健康程度的关键变量。
AI.theory_contributions: 引入了“相对不平等”概念，修正了传统不平等-民主关系理论；揭示了生活水平作为缓冲变量的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更精准的预警指标：不仅要关注收入不平等，更要关注不平等相对于生活水平的高低，以评估民主制度的脆弱性。

title: Human-in-the-Loop Dynamic Pricing
affiliations: McGill University, Desautels Faculty of Management, Students, Desautels Faculty of Management, McGill University, University of Colorado at Boulder and University of Texas at Dallas - Naveen Jindal School of Management

detail.title: Human-in-the-Loop Dynamic Pricing
detail.abstract: Algorithmic pricing recommendations are often reviewed (and may be overridden) by human managers prior to implementation. In dynamic pricing, this review affects not only today's price, but also the future demand signal from which the algorithm learns. We study this problem using a two-period Bayesian model with unknown demand sensitivity, posterior demand learning, and a human manager whose judgment may carry a bias. We characterize when a hybrid human-algorithm policy outperforms both the algorithm-only and human-only policies. Hybrid dominance arises over an intermediate range of bias values: the intervention must be sufficiently distinct to create continuation value through learning but not too distorted that it suppresses algorithmic value. This yields three implications. First, a late override is an accuracy problem: once learning has occurred, a human intervention is valuable only when the anchor is sufficiently accurate relative to the algorithm's posterior. Second, an early override is not purely an accuracy problem: a smaller bias can deteriorate performance because early interventions alter the learning process rather than just correcting the final price. Third, an effective hybrid dominance is stage specific: a lower first-stage acceptance creates informative human-led experiments, while a higher second-stage acceptance allows the algorithm to monetize the posterior information.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了动态定价中人类经理对算法定价建议的审核与干预问题，发现混合人机策略在中间偏差范围内优于纯算法或纯人类策略，且干预的时机和准确性对学习效果有不同影响。
AI.research_question: 在动态定价中，当人类经理对算法推荐进行审核（可能覆盖）时，混合人机策略何时优于纯算法或纯人类策略？
AI.motivation: 现实中算法定价推荐往往需要人类经理审核后才能实施，但这一审核不仅影响当前价格，还会改变算法未来学习的需求信号。这种交互效应尚未被充分理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两期贝叶斯模型，包含未知需求敏感性、后验需求学习以及可能存在偏差的人类经理判断。
AI.method: 两期贝叶斯模型的理论分析。
AI.findings: 混合人机策略在中间偏差范围内优于纯算法或纯人类策略；后期干预是准确性问题，早期干预不仅是准确性问题，还会改变学习过程；有效的混合优势具有阶段特异性。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了人类干预通过影响算法学习过程而产生动态效应的机制，区分了早期和晚期干预的不同作用，为混合人机决策提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在动态定价中设计人机协作流程提供了指导：应在早期允许人类进行有信息含量的实验，在晚期让算法利用后验信息实现收益。

title: Data Privacy, Blockchain and the Right to Be Forgotten: A Legal-Managerial Tension
affiliations: Christ University, Christ University, Kutafin Moscow State Law University and Bengaluru City University

detail.title: Data Privacy, Blockchain and the Right to Be Forgotten: A Legal-Managerial Tension

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: Blockchain technology promises trust without intermediaries. Data protection law promises dignity through control. But what happens when these two promises collide? This chapter examines the structural tension between blockchain’s architectural immutability and the legal doctrine of the “right to be forgotten,” most prominently articulated under the General Data Protection Regulation. While blockchain systems are designed to ensure permanence, transparency, and resistance to alteration, modern data protection regimes demand erasure, correction, and individual autonomy over personal information. The result is not merely a technical incompatibility, but a profound legal–managerial dilemma. Adopting a multidisciplinary approach, the chapter integrates cyber law analysis, information systems design, and corporate governance theory to interrogate whether blockchain-based enterprises can achieve regulatory compliance without undermining the very features that make distributed ledgers valuable. It critically evaluates doctrinal interpretations of data controllership, consent, and anonymisation, while also assessing managerial strategies such as off-chain storage, encryption layering, and privacy-by-design frameworks. The study argues that the conflict between decentralisation and data protection is not binary but negotiable. Through comparative regulatory insights and governance models, it proposes a compliance-sensitive architecture that reconciles technological innovation with evolving legal norms. In doing so, the chapter reframes blockchain not as a regulatory adversary, but as a catalyst for rethinking data governance in the digital economy. By situating legal doctrine within strategic decision-making and system design, this research offers both conceptual clarity and practical guidance for regulators, corporate leaders, and technologists navigating one of the most pressing tensions in contemporary digital governance.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨区块链的不可篡改性与GDPR"被遗忘权"之间的结构性冲突，提出可通过合规敏感架构（如链下存储、加密分层、隐私设计）实现技术价值与法律规范的协商平衡。
AI.research_question: 区块链系统的不可篡改性与数据保护法（特别是GDPR"被遗忘权"）之间存在怎样的结构性紧张关系？区块链企业能否在不牺牲分布式账本核心价值的前提下实现监管合规？
AI.motivation: 区块链的永久性与透明度承诺与数据保护法要求的删除、更正和个人数据自主权之间存在根本性冲突，这一冲突不仅是技术不兼容问题，更是一个深刻的法律-管理困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络法分析、信息系统设计理论、公司治理理论；隐私设计框架、数据控制者/处理者理论、同意与匿名化理论。
AI.method: 跨学科研究方法，整合网络法分析、信息系统设计与公司治理理论；比较监管分析；治理模型评估。
AI.findings: 区块链的去中心化与数据保护之间的冲突并非非此即彼，而是可以通过协商解决的。链下存储、加密分层、隐私设计框架等管理策略有助于实现合规。合规敏感架构可以调和技术创新与法律规范。
AI.theory_contributions: 将区块链重新定位为数据治理的催化剂而非监管对手；将法律学说置于战略决策与系统设计情境中，为数字治理提供概念清晰度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者、企业领导者和技术人员提供应对区块链不可篡改性与数据保护法冲突的实践指南，提出合规敏感架构的具体方向。

title: Where do Racial Achievement Gaps Come From? A Hierarchical Decomposition of Sorting and Within-Classroom Gaps in Brazilian Education
affiliations: Insper Institute of Education and Research and

detail.title: Where do Racial Achievement Gaps Come From? A Hierarchical Decomposition of Sorting and Within-Classroom Gaps in Brazilian Education
detail.abstract: A large literature worldwide decomposes racial and ethnic achievement gaps into between-and within-school components. However, because ethnic groups are commonly concentrated in some geographical regions, these between-school effects might arise either because students attend different schools in the same region or because they live in different regions. We propose a methodology that decomposes achievement gaps into a within-classroom component and a four-level hierarchical sorting structure across states, municipalities, schools, and classrooms. We apply our methodology to Brazilian data covering approximately five million students in 5th, 9th, and 12th grade. We find that the black/white gap (0.54-0.61 SD in mathematics) and the mixed-race/white gap (0.25-0.38 SD) have qualitatively different structures. For black students, withinclassroom disadvantage net of socioeconomic controls explains 38-42% of the gap, while for mixed-race students, sorting explains 56-65%. Geographic sorting between states and municipalities accounts for 22-36% of the gap and is of similar magnitude to the between-school component. The decomposition maps directly onto the administrative layers at which education policy operates and quantifies the share of the gap each policy lever can, in principle, reach. Our results show that no single intervention is sufficient on its own to eliminate racial disparities in test-scores.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种四层嵌套分解方法（州-市-学校-班级），将种族学业成就差距分解为班级内成分和层级结构成分，并用巴西500万学生数据发现黑/白差距与混血/白差距具有不同结构，地理排序效应与校际效应相当，单一政策无法消除种族差距。
AI.research_question: 如何将种族和族裔学业成就差距分解为班级内劣势和不同行政层级的排序效应？
AI.motivation: 现有文献将种族差距分解为校际和校内成分，但忽视了种族群体在地理分布上的集中性，导致校际效应可能源于不同地区而非不同学校，需要更精细的层级分解方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多层嵌套分层结构理论，将成绩差距分解为班级内、学校内、市域内、州内四个行政层级的学生排序效应。
AI.method: 提出四层级排序分解方法（州→市→学校→班级），应用于巴西5、9、12年级约500万学生数据的数学成绩分析。
AI.findings: 黑/白差距（0.54-0.61 SD）中班级内劣势解释38-42%；混血/白差距（0.25-0.38 SD）中排序效应解释56-65%；州和市之间的地理排序解释22-36%的差距，与校际成分规模相当。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了四层嵌套分解框架，揭示了地理排序（州/市层级）是传统方法中被忽视的重要差距来源，细化了种族差距的结构性来源。
AI.practical_contributions: 分解结果直接对应教育政策的行政层级（州、市、学校、班级），量化了各政策工具理论上可触及的差距份额，表明单一政策无法消除种族成绩差距，需要多层级协同干预。

title: Estimating Daily Sales from a Shared Behavioral Proxy: Cross-Unit Temporal Disaggregation in an Affiliate-Marketing Ecosystem
affiliations: and Università di Milano Cattolica

detail.title: Estimating Daily Sales from a Shared Behavioral Proxy: Cross-Unit Temporal Disaggregation in an Affiliate-Marketing Ecosystem
detail.abstract: Affiliate-marketing platforms aggregate sales feeds from many partner brands, but partners report at heterogeneous time granularities: some deliver transaction-level daily data, others only monthly or weekly totals. Analytics, forecasting, and anomaly detection require a single panel at a common, fine (daily) granularity, yet the missing daily detail of low-frequency reporters is unobserved. We formalize this as a cross-unit temporal disaggregation problem and introduce a method that recovers the daily series of a low-frequency reporter by borrowing the within-period shape of a high-frequency behavioral proxy (web tracking events such as clicks and sessions). Departing from classical disaggregation, which estimates the indicator-target relationship within each series, we assume the proxy-to-sales relationship is shared across brands and learn it on "calibration" units that possess both true daily sales and the proxy, then transfer it to "target" units that report only aggregates plus the daily proxy. Because a per-brand intercept cancels in the disaggregation weights, only a shared elasticity is required, so a brand with no daily sales can still be disaggregated while exactly conserving its reported total. We evaluate on a public, fully synthetic benchmark (60 brands, three years) released under a strict anonymization protocol; because its data-generating process shares the estimator's functional form, the experiments verify correctness and quantify sensitivity rather than establishing the assumption in the wild. Under repeated leave-units-out validation, the proxy recovers about 29% of the within-period (shape-only) variance that a uniform split leaves entirely unexplained, cutting within-period error by roughly 17% for both monthly and weekly reporters; weighting by the raw proxy already captures almost all of this gain, while estimating the elasticity is a robustness safeguard. A deliberate misspecification study shows the method degrades gracefully toward the uniform baseline as sales become proxy-independent, never doing worse. We describe the production system-behavioral data from analytics platforms (e.g. GA4) joined to partner financials, unified into one schema, and refreshed by a scheduled large-language-model agent-and discuss when the shared-relationship assumption holds. All code and data are released for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种跨单元时间降尺度方法，利用高频行为代理变量（如网页点击、会话）的低频汇总数据，恢复低频报告者（如按周/月汇报的联盟营销合作伙伴）的日度销售序列，通过跨品牌共享的代理-销售弹性实现精确总守恒，并发布了合成基准数据集和全开源代码。
AI.research_question: 如何从混合频率（日/周/月）的合作伙伴报告中，恢复低频报告者的日度销售序列，同时精准守恒其报告的总量？
AI.motivation: 联盟营销平台中，不同合作伙伴按不同时间粒度报告数据（日/周/月），导致分析、预测和异常检测所需的统一日度面板存在缺失值。现有时间降尺度方法无法利用跨品牌的共享行为代理信息来解决这一跨单元问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨单元时间降尺度（cross-unit temporal disaggregation）；共享代理-销售弹性假设；校准-迁移学习框架；总量守恒约束。
AI.method: 在拥有完整日度数据的"校准"品牌上学习共享的代理-销售弹性，然后将该关系迁移到仅报告低频汇总数据的"目标"品牌上，利用目标品牌的日度代理变量（如点击、会话）和总量约束，通过降尺度权重恢复其日度销售序列。
AI.findings: 在合成基准上，该方法恢复了约29%的期内（形状）方差（均匀拆分完全无法解释这部分方差），对月度和周度报告者的期内误差降低了约17%；原始代理加权已捕获大部分增益；当销售独立于代理时，方法优雅退化至均匀基线，且不会更差。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次形式化了跨单元时间降尺度问题，提出了一种利用跨品牌共享行为代理关系的解决方法，突破了经典时间降尺度方法中每序列独立估计的局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为联盟营销平台提供了一种可落地的生产系统方案（接入GA4等分析平台数据，由LLM Agent定时刷新），能够在不改变合作伙伴报告习惯的前提下统一数据粒度，提升分析和预测能力。所有代码和数据开源。

title: Innovating with Generative AI: A Human Bottleneck Framework
affiliations: Harvard Business School, Harvard Business School - Marketing Unit, University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School, Kellogg School of Management, Northwestern University and Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Marketing

detail.title: Innovating with Generative AI: A Human Bottleneck Framework
detail.abstract: We propose a human bottleneck perspective for understanding how generative AI transforms the innovation process. The central premise is that many constraints traditionally plaguing the innovation process are cognitive and social in origin, rooted in how people generate ideas, evaluate novelty, and communicate through social systems. Generative AI does not act uniformly on these constraints. At each stage, it can deepen some bottlenecks while alleviating others, and predicting these outcomes requires understanding the underlying mechanisms of the constraint itself. We identify bottlenecks in four stages of the innovation process: ideation, screening and testing, preference measurement and consumer insight, diffusion, and market learning. By grounding analysis in human behavior rather than rapidly changing AI capabilities, we offer a framework for assessing whether new developments alleviate or intensify the bottlenecks that matter most at each stage. We also distinguish bottlenecks likely to narrow as capabilities improve from those rooted in enduring human constraints. We further discuss AI-related issues that cut across the entire innovation pipeline, challenging the very existence and structure of the traditional innovation process.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"人类瓶颈"视角，分析生成式AI在创新过程各阶段（创意生成、筛选测试、偏好测量与消费者洞察、扩散与市场学习）如何既缓解又加深认知与社会性瓶颈，并区分可随AI能力提升而缓解的瓶颈与根植于人类固有局限的瓶颈。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI如何改变创新过程中的认知与社会性约束？哪些瓶颈会随AI能力提升而缓解，哪些因人类固有局限而持续存在？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多聚焦AI技术能力本身，缺乏从人类行为根源理解AI对创新过程影响的分析框架，需要一种不依赖快速变化的AI能力、而是基于人类根本约束的持久性视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人类瓶颈视角（human bottleneck perspective）：创新过程中的约束根源于人类认知（如创意生成、新颖性判断）和社会（如沟通、社会系统）特征，生成式AI对这些瓶颈的影响是非均匀的，可能在某些环节缓解瓶颈，同时在其他环节加深瓶颈。
AI.method: 概念性框架构建，基于对创新过程四个阶段（创意生成、筛选测试、偏好测量与消费者洞察、扩散与市场学习）中的人类瓶颈进行理论分析。
AI.findings: 1）生成式AI在不同创新阶段的作用是不均匀的，同一技术可能在缓解某类瓶颈的同时加深另一类瓶颈；2）部分瓶颈（如信息处理能力）可随AI进步缓解，但部分瓶颈（如人类固有的认知偏好、社会互动需求）是持久的；3）AI还提出了跨阶段的挑战，可能颠覆传统创新流程本身的结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出人类瓶颈视角作为理解AI与创新关系的理论框架，将分析重心从技术能力转向人类行为约束，为预测AI发展对创新的影响提供了更稳定的理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和管理者提供了一个评估AI工具在各创新阶段实际效果的诊断框架，帮助识别哪些瓶颈值得期待AI解决、哪些需要人工干预。

title: International Labor Solidarity: A Case Study of the Impact of German Labor Law, IG Metall, and Volkswagen do Brasil

detail.title: International Labor Solidarity: A Case Study of the Impact of German Labor Law, IG Metall, and Volkswagen do Brasil
detail.abstract: This 1988 paper provides an analysis of German labor law (Mitbestimmung, or Co-Determination) on international labor solidarity.  It uses a case study of Volkswagen do Brasil.  At the time of the paper, Lula Ignacio da Silva was the head of the Brazilian union for Volkswagen.  The paper provides background, a year-by-year analysis of the relationship with the Brazilian union, and a short overview of German labor solidarity with other countries.

AI.tldr: 这篇1988年的论文分析了德国劳动法（共同决定制度）对国际劳工团结的影响，以大众汽车巴西公司为案例研究，提供了详细的年度分析以及德国与其他国家劳工团结的概述。
AI.research_question: 德国劳动法（共同决定制度）如何影响国际劳工团结？具体以大眾汽车巴西公司为案例。
AI.motivation: 探讨德国共同决定制度在全球劳工团结中的作用与局限，特别是在跨国企业情境下德国工会与巴西工会之间的互动关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 德国劳动法中的共同决定制度（Mitbestimmung）、国际劳工团结理论。
AI.method: 案例研究法，以大眾汽车巴西公司为对象，进行逐年分析，并结合德国与其他国家劳工团结的概览。
AI.findings: 论文详细记录了大眾巴西公司与德国工会之间的关系演变（逐年度分析），并概述了德国与其他国家的劳工团结情况。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解国内劳动法律制度（如共同决定制度）如何影响跨国劳工团结提供分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了德国共同决定制度在实际跨国劳工团结中的运作方式与局限性，对工会实践具有参考价值。

detail.abstract: This paper analyzes more than 4 million research papers published between 2013 and mid-2026 to track how the field has evolved. It finds that large language models are the fastest-growing area, China now leads in publication volume, and research is increasingly focused on LLM applications, RAG, and safety, while neural networks remain the dominant underlying technology.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2013年至2026年中期的400多万篇研究论文，发现大语言模型是增长最快的领域，中国在论文发表量上领先，研究日益聚焦于LLM应用、RAG和安全，神经网络仍是最主要的基础技术。
AI.research_question: 2013年至2026年中期学术研究领域如何演变，特别是大语言模型、中国发表量、研究主题分布及其底层技术的变化趋势。
AI.motivation: 为了系统性地追踪和理解学术研究领域的动态演变趋势，识别关键增长领域、国家贡献变化以及技术焦点的迁移。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文献计量学与科学计量学，通过大规模数据分析来描绘学科发展轨迹。
AI.method: 大规模文献计量分析，涵盖超过400万篇论文，时间跨度为2013年至2026年中，采用定量统计与趋势分析。
AI.findings: (1) 大语言模型是增长最快的研究领域；(2) 中国在论文发表总量上居全球首位；(3) 研究焦点正向LLM应用、检索增强生成（RAG）和安全方向转移；(4) 神经网络仍然是主导性的底层技术。
AI.theory_contributions: 为科学计量学提供了关于AI领域尤其是LLM发展的最新宏观证据，丰富了关于科研生产力和技术演化模式的讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为科研政策制定者、学术机构和企业研发部门提供了关于研究热点、国家竞争力对比和技术趋势的参考依据，有助于资源分配和战略规划。

title: The Smart Centres Index 11
affiliations: Z/Yen Group and Gresham College, Z/Yen Group

detail.title: The Smart Centres Index 11
detail.abstract:
The eleventh edition of the Smart Centres Index was published on 28 May 2025. SCI 11 rates the innovation and technology offerings of leading commercial centres, tracking their ability to create, develop, and deploy technology.

The SCI is a factor assessment index, combining a number of instrumental factors - data measures drawn from a range of data providers across the world - and assessments given by business and finance professionals of three dimensions related to innovation and technology in major commercial and financial centres:

  • Innovation Support - the support provided by regulatory and other systems to innovation and technology in a centre.
  • Creative Intensity - the intensity of technology and innovation services and opportunities in a centre.
  • Delivery Capability - the quality of the technology and innovation work that is taking place in a centre.

131 commercial and financial centres were researched for SCI 11 of which 76 are included in the index. SCI 11 was compiled using 135 instrumental factors. These quantitative measures are provided by third parties including the World Bank, the OECD, and the United Nations.

The instrumental factors are combined with financial centre assessments provided by respondents to the SCI online questionnaire. SCI 11 uses 1,772assessments provided by 296 respondents.

AI.tldr: SCI 11评估了全球131个商业金融中心的技术创新，其中76个入选，使用135个定量指标和来自296位受访者的1772份评估，从创新支持、创意强度和交付能力三个维度进行因子分析。
AI.research_question: 全球主要商业中心的技术创新能力如何评估和排名？
AI.motivation: 跟踪全球商业中心创造、开发及部署技术的能力，为政策制定者和商业决策提供参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 因子评估指数模型，结合定量数据（外部第三方）与专业评估（问卷调查）。
AI.method: 综合135个来自世界银行、OECD、联合国等第三方的定量指标，以及296位受访者的1772份评估，对三个维度（创新支持、创意强度、交付能力）进行因子分析。
AI.findings: 对76个入选商业中心的技术创新能力进行了排名和评级。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了多维度评估商业中心技术创新的综合指标体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为商业中心的技术发展战略、政策制定和投资决策提供了量化参考依据。

title: The Rise of the "Micro-Joy" Economy: How Retail Brands Market Emotional Value to Combat Generation Z Academic Stress

detail.title: The Rise of the "Micro-Joy" Economy: How Retail Brands Market Emotional Value to Combat Generation Z Academic Stress
detail.abstract: This research paper explores how modern global retail brands leverage the psychological stress of Generation Z to drive impulse buying. As young consumers face increasing academic and social pressures, they are shifting away from traditional functional shopping toward what is conceptualized as the "Micro-Joy Economy." This study analyzes the specific marketing and product strategies of two Asian retail giants: POP MART and MINISO. Using a qualitative case study methodology integrated with a targeted pilot survey (N = 15), the paper examines how POP MART utilizes mystery and gamification through "blind boxes," while MINISO focuses on affordable, aesthetic emotional retailing. The empirical findings demonstrate that for Generation Z high school students, small, emotionally satisfying purchases serve as an active cognitive defense mechanism to trigger transient dopamine release and regulate environmental anxiety. Ultimately, this research provides evidence that within the modern youth consumer market, acute academic stress elevates emotional value above traditional product utility, shifting the focus of competitive retail strategy from functional performance to emotional monetization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了POP MART和MINISO如何利用Z世代的心理压力推动冲动消费，提出"微快乐经济"概念，通过盲盒的随机性与高性价比美学零售，将小额消费转化为缓解焦虑的认知防御机制。
AI.research_question: 现代全球零售品牌如何利用Z世代的心理压力驱动其冲动购买行为？
AI.motivation: Z世代面临日益增长的学业与社会压力，正在从传统功能性购物转向"微快乐经济"，这一现象背后的机制尚待系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: "微快乐经济"概念、认知防御机制、多巴胺释放理论、情绪价值优先于产品效用的消费逻辑。
AI.method: 定性案例研究法，结合定向试点问卷调查（N=15），分析POP MART（盲盒模式——神秘化与游戏化）和MINISO（平价美学情感零售）两大亚洲零售巨头。
AI.findings: 对Z世代高中生而言，小额情感满足式购买是一种主动的认知防御机制，能够触发短暂的多巴胺释放并调节环境焦虑；学业压力越大，情绪价值越高于传统产品效用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"微快乐经济"理论框架，将冲动消费重新定义为应对压力的认知防御机制，而非传统意义上的非理性行为。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了零售竞争策略应从功能性绩效转向情感货币化，为品牌针对年轻消费者的营销策略提供了新方向。

detail.title: The Global Green Finance Index 16
detail.abstract: Beginning in March 2018, as part of its Long Finance initiative, Z/Yen published the first five editions of the Global Green Finance Index with the generous support of the MAVA Foundation, and more recently with support from Abu Dhabi Global Market. Z/Yen continues this work and is pleased to present the sixteenth edition of the Global Green Finance Index (GGFI 16). Z/Yen helps organisations make better choices-our clients consider us a commercial think-tank that spots, solves, and acts. Our name combines Zen and Yen-'a philosophical desire to succeed'-in a ratio, recognising that all decisions are trade-offs. One of Z/Yen's specialisms is the development and publication of research combining factor analysis and professional assessments. Long Finance is a Z/Yen initiative designed to address the question "When would we know our financial system is working?" This question underlies Long Finance's goal to improve society's understanding and use of finance over the long-term. In contrast to the short-termism that defines today's economic views the Long Finance time-frame is roughly 100 years.

AI.tldr: Z/Yen发布了第16版全球绿色金融指数（GGFI 16），该指数结合因子分析和专业评估，评估全球金融中心的绿色金融发展水平。该研究隶属于Long Finance倡议，旨在探讨"何时能知道我们的金融体系在正常运转"这一长期问题，反对短期主义，关注约100年的长远视角。

AI.motivation: 推动绿色金融的发展，为全球金融体系提供长期可持续性的评估框架，对抗金融领域的短期主义倾向，促进金融体系更好地服务于长期社会和环境目标。

AI.method: 结合因子分析（factor analysis）和专业评估（professional assessments），通过定量数据与专家判断相结合的方式构建综合指数。
AI.findings: 发布了GGFI 16的排名结果，展示了各金融中心在绿色金融方面的相对表现和变化趋势。

title: The Thousand-Alert Night: A Quantum-AI Cognitive Framework for Unifying Economic Crime Services and SOC Operations

detail.title: The Thousand-Alert Night: A Quantum-AI Cognitive Framework for Unifying Economic Crime Services and SOC Operations
